635a3436503d9c47e1014621.synopsis: After being mistreated by his wife’s family for years, Leo discovers that he is the heir to a vast fortune. Now it’s time — for revenge!
635a3436503d9c47e1014621.title: Son in Law's Revenge

636961a2c13cfc775854b1e5.synopsis: Jasper Tate needed a wife urgently, while Chloe Adams needed money urgently in The CEO’s Contract Wife Movie. Seeking help from the same source leads the two needy people together, and they get married after Madam G recommended them to each other. What was supposed to be a contract agreement morphed into a full-blown love affair that they never expected.
636961a2c13cfc775854b1e5.title: The CEO's Contract Wife

6397ddc3c94f6e46282ef803.synopsis: Sarah Loren is a widow with a teenage son, Ethan Cole is a big shot CEO who wants to acquire her company. He is arrogant, brilliant, and unnecessarily good looking, and he'll stop at nothing to get what he wants, and what he wants… is Sarah's heart.
6397ddc3c94f6e46282ef803.title: Do Me Over

6397de2169201b3014613d43.synopsis: Lucy Harris and Luke Walker had an affair, but that was before she found out that he was her boss in The Boss’ Affair Movie. Lucy woke late for her first day at work and had to leave in a hurry. When she arrived at work, she got the shock of her life as she saw who her boss was.
6397de2169201b3014613d43.title: The Boss Affair

6397dea32825a83a57175495.synopsis: Ciara is slated to get married to Adrian Lewis, who is in a coma in Big Bad Husband Please Wake Up Movie. Ciara is desperate to do so because she needs the money to save her sick family, and she is humiliated by her choice until Adrian wakes up to the surprise of everyone and falls in love with Ciara.
6397dea32825a83a57175495.title: Big Bad Husband, Please Wake Up!

64596abc36c69c470e326454.synopsis: In Never Divorce A Secret Billionaire Heiress movie, Joyce has been a walking blood bank for her sister, Selena. It was the price she had to pay for forcing Tristan into marrying her. Joyce realized herself when she lost her baby and got no support or care from her husband. Now, the heiress wants a divorce.
64596abc36c69c470e326454.title: Never Divorce a Secret Billionaire Heiress

6459939c36c69c470e326456.synopsis: Adoria Cummins gets murdered by her husband and is taken back in time! She uses the knowledge from her previous life to get revenge on all those who wronged her, starting with winning the Mega ball! Then comes Elijah Snyder, a lawyer who seems to have her best interest in mind, but there's just something about him… that seems too familiar.
6459939c36c69c470e326456.title: My Husband Killed Me, then I Won the Mega Ball!

647aa5b086deef74cd0ebe66.synopsis: Ellie Holland is forced to marry bigshot billionaire Wayne Lyons in order to save her father's life. For the hefty price of five million dollars, Ellie sold herself into the Lyons family with the promise of delivering an heir. There's just one catch… Wayne Lyons is in a coma!
647aa5b086deef74cd0ebe66.title: Big Bad Husband, Please Wake Up! 2

647ffff5be685964fe120217.synopsis: In Fated to My Forbidden Alpha movie, on her 18th birthday, Selene found out that her mate was her nemesis, Alpha Jackson. He plans on rejecting her. Selene never planned on accepting him as her mate. He didn't know she wasn't any wolf but a Luna, kidnapped and mistaken for a regular wolf. As Selene plans on escaping her pack, she meets Alexander, her fated mate.
647ffff5be685964fe120217.title: Fated to My Forbidden Alpha

64b729ab51f0d103720c40c6.synopsis: After realizing she's been hating the wrong man her entire life, Elena dies in the arms of her husband Marcus. In a twist of fate, Elena is brought back in time. It's not too late, she still has time to change everything. In this life, she won't hate her husband... she will protect him at all cost.
64b729ab51f0d103720c40c6.title: The Reborn Wife's Redemption

64ba07d2e90f9a44374bfcad.synopsis: Brielle is wrongfully accused of killing her fiancé's sister. Her fiancé refuses to believe her, and sends her to rot in prison. Three years later, after her release, Brielle works to prove her innocence. A mysterious and handsome stranger, Jay, lends her a helping hand... But there may be more to him than what meets the eye.
64ba07d2e90f9a44374bfcad.title: My Gorgeous Wife is an Ex-Convict

64e451f080feb1543116ac03.synopsis: Fatal Temptation: Between Two Alphas movie summary will take us on a steamy ride as we see Mia, pregnant with her chosen mate Cameron's child, ends up as a rogue when a witch casts a spell on Cameron, he chooses her leaving Mia heartbroken. As Mia gets expelled to be a rogue she meets her fated mate. But she's tied to both Cameron and her newly found mate. The alphas are not willing to share, thus making the love triangle hot and curious to watch.
64e451f080feb1543116ac03.title: Fatal Temptation: Between Two Alphas

64e572c914fc5451293b5766.synopsis: Sophie McKenzie runs straight into the arms of James Knight after she was being pursued by a gang. James Knight takes her in according to Goodbye, My CEO Movie, and offers her protection but that came with a price. However, Sophie wants to break free from this bond, but she finds herself stuck as James Knight refuses to let go.
64e572c914fc5451293b5766.title: Goodbye, My CEO

651b5b2b1f32246c6a25e386.synopsis: Bound by Honor: Kidnapped by the Mafia King summary talks about the world of mafia families, the Saviano and the Mancinis who are bound by marriage alliance to help retrieve their family's glory. When Luca meets Harper she's sold by her father at an auction. Luca saves her not caring about the fact that he's betrothed to someone else. Their love can destroy their lives.
651b5b2b1f32246c6a25e386.title: Bound by Honor: Kidnapped by the Mafia King

6523c9d6ec314c3c5528dac1.synopsis: Rachel finds herself without a groom on her wedding day, only to realize that her soon-to-be husband is in bed with her own cousin! Refusing to become the laughing stock of town, Rachel decides to continue on with the wedding, there's just one little thing she needs to do… find a new groom!
6523c9d6ec314c3c5528dac1.title: Marry Me, Mr. White

65264474efd3301db005d353.synopsis: “The Alpha’s Daughter” Daphne Sinclair’s life shatters when her father, a powerful Alpha, is murdered on her 18th birthday. Betrayal by Alpha Atlas fuels her desire for revenge. Identity, transformation, power, and resilience collide. Daphne navigates a hostile environment, forging alliances and seeking justice. New situations are stressful, avoiding danger at the same time sucks. Survival game?
65264474efd3301db005d353.title: The Alpha's Daughter

65404e20f5707eab920b24d2.synopsis: When you're forced to wed the dark and dangerous Alpha Ronan — your mortal enemy — you're sure you'll kill each other before you make it to the altar. But when a common enemy threatens to destroy your pack, will you accept that you are fated to one another? Or reap deadly consequences?
65404e20f5707eab920b24d2.title: My Enemy Alpha

654204cdac3d62b7ce09b247.synopsis: In Bound by Vendetta: Sleeping with the Enemy movie, on her birthday, Daiana's father was killed. She's yet to find out who the killer is but she has a suspect. Daiana is torn between love and vengeance as her suspect turns out to be her lover. Daiana must decide whether to avenge her parent's death or forgive her lover.
654204cdac3d62b7ce09b247.title: Bound by Vendetta: Sleeping with the Enemy

654208935ec846a2e30698fa.synopsis: Natalie is a hybrid. She is a werewolf, dragon and vampire, and due to this, she is targeted by different people who are after her for so many reasons in Fatal Temptation: The Hybrid Princess Movie. Following her flee from her pack because of heartbreak, she returns when she hears of the death of her parents and a new Alpha.
654208935ec846a2e30698fa.title: Fatal Attraction: The Hybrid Princess

654e1d538b7ca93fd101f48c.synopsis: In True Luna movie, Emma is a powerful wolf known as the true Luna. Her kind is rare. When she got her wolf, a warning came along with it. Emma will be in danger soon as the rogue king is after her. Her joy of getting a wolf and finding a mate is torn when her mate rejects her.
654e1d538b7ca93fd101f48c.title: True Luna

65586eb88bbad5189e09bb8c.synopsis: In search of the truth behind her sister’s death, Zoe Hale marries billionaire Ashton Cross, whom she suspects to be the killer. However, as she gets to know him better, she discovers truth more twisted, and love more powerful than she could’ve ever imagined.
65586eb88bbad5189e09bb8c.title: Cross My Heart and Hope to Die

65605a422ebd4e4f290df77a.synopsis: In Married at First Sight movie, Summer has been the ideal girlfriend for her ex-boyfriend, Vincent. Frustrated by their actions, Summer enters into a contract marriage to save a billionaire she just met. She was shocked to find out about his identity.
65605a422ebd4e4f290df77a.title: Married at First Sight

6569a83afba584271b020cf3.synopsis: For centuries, the most powerful vampires, the Tepes family and the Velda family have remained an alliance which, if broken, could send the world into chaos like never before. The alliance is threatened by a seemingly normal human girl Sammantha Evans, a waitress at Club Dracula owned by the powerful Alarik Tepes. One fateful night on New Years Eve, the world will be changed forever…
6569a83afba584271b020cf3.title: Love Me, Bite Me

6572f80acac4b33e8408ee92.synopsis: A werewolf cursed to never shift. A vampire with dark secrets. Kaiya and Talon are supposed to be mortal enemies, but what will the two do when the impossible happens and... they form a mate bond?!
6572f80acac4b33e8408ee92.title: My Mate is a Vampire

To avoid marrying Jack again and getting killed, Blair married his nemesis and her enemy, Nathan. Will this be enough to prevent her death?
657c539736f92d4eae02f093.title: 30 Days Till I Marry My Husband's Nemesis

6585618b5e31851c140a2149.synopsis: Martina is the perfect Mafia daughter. Beautiful, quiet, and — most important of all — obedient. But to protect the one she loves most, she'll go against her father's orders and take her sister's place as bride to the deadliest, most notorious Mafia don of all... the Butcher.
6585618b5e31851c140a2149.title: I Married as the Replacement Bride

658ede55d7ffb9c594044a25.synopsis: What happens when you fall in love with your ex's uncle?!
658ede55d7ffb9c594044a25.title: Snatched a Billionaire to be My Husband

65a115e18ce4bc5dd801cabc.synopsis: Leslie Madison dated her boyfriend for two years in Married For Green Card, Stayed For Love Movie, so when she became desperate for a green card, she thought her boyfriend would get married to her, instead he broke up with her. Leslie eventually married someone who needed her as much as she needed him, Simon Williams. They fell in love.
65a115e18ce4bc5dd801cabc.title: Married for Green Card, Stayed for Love

65a8cec883959aedd8001107.synopsis: It was supposed to be an emotionless contract marriage and nothing more. But Sebastian couldn't resist growing a soft spot for Natalie. With her family planning her downfall and her estranged husband cooking up a deadly plan, what should Natalie expect? The Double Life of My Billionaire Husband trailer has a lot to reveal.
65a8cec883959aedd8001107.title: The Double Life of My Billionaire Husband

65a993a936fb85167d06a2e7.synopsis: She got drugged and sold by her bestie to a guy. After escaping, she meets a drugged stranger, and they spend the night. Waking up, she finds out her bestie and ex-fiancé betrayed her. Confronting them, she's hurt and caught in a fire. Luckily saved, she later has twins, but one is taken away...
65a993a936fb85167d06a2e7.title: We Are Twins, Daddy!

65a997ec3daa5df28a032b18.synopsis: He found himself stranded on a deserted island with two alluring women. With survival skills in his hands, he gradually won over the beautiful women who initially looked down on him.
65a997ec3daa5df28a032b18.title: Island Survival

65a9983d3daa5df28a032b1b.synopsis: After a night of drinking, a billionaire tycoon unexpectedly time-travels back to 1989. Seizing the opportunities in this era, he smartly grows his business empire, earning the title 'God of Investment.' Eventually, he becomes a respected business magnate, crafting an unmatched legend.
65a9983d3daa5df28a032b1b.title: Return to 1992

Everything changes when Timothy Wolfe, king of the school decides that he wants HER. It's forbidden, it's taboo, but what's more... Charlotte has a dark secret that could ruin them both.
65ab3d607b0faf2ea60e30b3.title: Ms. Swan, Teach Me Love

65b185b3f67cb895ff076de3.synopsis: The orphan was dying from a serious illness and unable to afford treatment, but he miraculously was reborn as the son of a multi-billionaire. Now, he needs to spend his inherited billion-dollar fortune within three months to gain a new lease on life!
65b185b3f67cb895ff076de3.title: The Doomed Spendthrift

65b41d423be9855a620121cd.synopsis: Noah Preston returns as a billionaire after six years of being away, and his fiance breaking up with him because he was poor in We Will Love Again Movie. Noah didn't know that his fiance did not mean to break up, but his mother pressurized her into doing it. He sought revenge against her until he found out the truth.
65b41d423be9855a620121cd.title: We Will Love Again

65bd459ee206e9dff90c29c6.synopsis: It's forbidden. It should be impossible. But you — a human — have been Marked: claimed forever as a dragon's mate. And not just any dragon... the Dragon King. A man whose dark beauty and lethal power are only whispered about. Will this mark mean your end? Or will it unlock a secret that could change everything?
65bd459ee206e9dff90c29c6.title: Curse of the Dragon King

65c2e3e42c76dd2373035d34.synopsis: Deadly Affair with My Brother-in-Law summary talks about Aurora who's engaged to Patrick, but she falls for Patrick's brother Noah. As the title suggests, the movie is filled with drama, action, and romance.
65c2e3e42c76dd2373035d34.title: Deadly Affair with My Brother-in-Law

Heather, who was termed as unwanted for being an orphan, is wanted and loved by Theo. Fiona, Heather's sister, conspires a revenge plan to ruin Heather's happiness. Heather has to find a way to break the magic spell to protect her love.
65c43b89ddf4d1ffd4098ac7.title: Fated to My Forbidden Vampire

65d3f565f7c33b958907c75e.synopsis: A young graduate applied for a job as a fashion designer, but the CEO thought she was a marriage candidate his mother sent him. The CEO was thus really picky and mean to her, and they didn't get along. But what he didn't know was that she was actually his online girlfriend...
65d3f565f7c33b958907c75e.title: My Cyber Beau, My CEO

Meanwhile, her family's financial struggles stopped her from finishing school. She worked multiple jobs to support herself, pay off her parents' debts, and cover her grandmother's medical bills... Circumstances have changed; how will their love evolve?
65d3f5af9bae57874c0d5e5a.title: Flash-Married My Ex 8 Years After Breakup

65da3ce0317029c81b040cb3.synopsis: Taming the Lion: Billionaire on Bikes summary is all about Leo Striker, a sexy biker who saves Kara when being harassed by her ex-boyfriend. Kara falls for Leo as he helps her learn how to protect herself. However, Leo is a dominant who wants Kara. Can Kara enjoy being submissive? Kara and Leo's romance is steamy, the biker gang trope is refreshing.
65da3ce0317029c81b040cb3.title: Taming the Lion: Billionaire on Bikes

65e27517a3983e189f08755a.synopsis: The groom is a cripple, and the bride is a bumpkin. People make fun of them, but little do they know, both harbor their secrets, waiting for the right moment...
65e27517a3983e189f08755a.title: Mr. Moody's Stand-in Sweetheart

65e2926c872ac65ef703e4c2.synopsis: In The Billionaire’s Baby Bargain movie, to save her dying sister, Abby, Amelia agrees to a contract marriage that will involve no sex, no love, and a baby by insemination. The arrangement was instigated by Nathan, a billionaire struggling to regain his position as CEO by fulfilling his father's wish. As they navigate their false marriage, unexpected feelings develop. This may complicate their business deal.
65e2926c872ac65ef703e4c2.title: The Billionaire’s Baby Bargain

65e66639b28f0dc6e5095d77.synopsis: A wealthy girl keeps her true identity secret and marries a guy who's not as rich. But his family disrespects her because she sells fish for a living. She calmly agrees to divorce, but now, three brilliant men rush towards her, each claiming her as their fiancée!
65e66639b28f0dc6e5095d77.title: Divorced and Desired! My Trio of Elite Suitors

65e7a9c8d94799ca6204bb48.synopsis: A powerful evil spirit appears, threatening the world. To restore peace, a young man is tasked with collecting five symbols. Along the way, he encounters funny and romantic incidents with various women, including his destined partner...
65e7a9c8d94799ca6204bb48.title: The Legendary Healer's Saga

Reborn and thrust back in time, he determined to make things right this time. He gambled, saved the powerful, and confronted those who wronged him with information only he, as a time-traveler, would know...
65e7a9ec7f5fd7e84102fc40.title: Back to 1998: World Domination

65e7aa11f387d37c8a01b999.synopsis: She's the mightiest ruler in the Dragon Kingdom, but a year ago, she lost her memory. Hoping to remember and wed properly, she caught her husband with another woman just before their wedding. Furious, she pulled a random young man to pose as her boyfriend and revealed her true identity, shocking everyone!
65e7aa11f387d37c8a01b999.title: The Dragon Dame

65e8fa23a5d3ee80390f60e2.synopsis: Returning once more, she's no longer the emperor's prime minister. Now, she's his concubine, trying to overthrow the nation!
65e8fa23a5d3ee80390f60e2.title: The Calamitous Concubine

65ebbebdbc8a2a5581011145.synopsis: Beth Nelson mistakenly ends up with her husband in Oh No! I Slept With My Husband Movie. After getting married to a man who did not even spare her a glance during marriage, Beth faces her ungrateful father and stepmother who insist on her asking her estranged husband for more money to give them. Beth becomes angry, desperate and drunk.
65ebbebdbc8a2a5581011145.title: Oh No! I Slept with My Husband!

65f5222803ea4cc92a0218c9.synopsis: The One that Got Away summary is all about Anna Starr who finds herself stuck in a loveless marriage after giving up her passion to settle down. Her husband is cheating on her thus making her marriage a misery. Anna meets her rock star ex-boyfriend Adrian, who still ignites the old passion in her. This time around Anna has to follow her heart as she dreams of Adrian.
65f5222803ea4cc92a0218c9.title: The One that Got Away

65f7b85ee745d44a1005b4e5.synopsis: She loves him dearly, yet he betrays her by plundering her home and bringing his lover. When he learns she is dying, he begs for another chance, but it's too late.
65f7b85ee745d44a1005b4e5.title: The Marshal's Toxic Love

65f7deae596069b6ca00c6c3.synopsis: She's framed by her fiancé and best friend, left ruined and eventually killed. Upon her rebirth, she becomes a billionaire's wife. Seeking revenge, he stands by her side, always ready to help.
65f7deae596069b6ca00c6c3.title: Reborn As The CEO's Darling Wife

65f7fa9e8c9c8f889a0c62f0.synopsis: In her past life, she was framed and lost everything by her husband and cousin. It's only on her deathbed that she realizes the billionaire she was once engaged to truly loves her. Reborn two years earlier, she wakes up and sets her sights on marrying the billionaire. This time, she won't allow tragedy to strike again. And this billionaire? He's not a playboy at all. His heart belongs only to her.
65f7fa9e8c9c8f889a0c62f0.title: Spoiled By The CEO After Rebirth

65f7fb7c684f77b63309b72e.synopsis: She got married while pregnant. But on the wedding day, her sister played a video of her being intimate with another man, claiming her unborn child was illegitimate. Just as everyone scorned her, the child's father appeared - he turned out to be a billionaire! Rumor had it that the billionaire was a vegetable, but how can he be so handsome?
65f7fb7c684f77b63309b72e.title: Escape After Pregnant with My Vegetative Husband

65f8085f7b054300570b2993.synopsis: She's the adopted daughter of a billionaire family, yet she bears her brother's child. She always thought he just wanted to possess her, but after their adoptive mother's murder, she realizes her brother truly loves her. Upon rebirth, she decides to be with her brother and not repeat past mistakes.
65f8085f7b054300570b2993.title: Marry My Fake Brother After Rebirth

After the divorce, her ex-husband's company boss offers a contract relationship to fend off other women. Little does she know, the billionaire has already fallen for her and will always cherish her.
65f80b24d6d66c21d3080902.title: Marry My Ex's Boss After Divorce

65f80b68d61ccf41270d6ba7.synopsis: In her past life, her husband ruined her family, causing them to go bankrupt, resulting in the death of both parents and leaving her unable to conceive. She died on the night she decided to divorce after learning the truth. Reborn, she vows to protect her family and cherish herself. However, she unintentionally attracts the attention of her ex-husband's younger uncle. Initially considered just a transaction, she finds herself entangled in a deep love with this billionaire...
65f80b68d61ccf41270d6ba7.title: Seduce My Ex's CEO Uncle After Rebirth

65f812994b05152fd00001d1.synopsis: She was deceived by a villain, left broke, and saw her son die. After rebirth, she's back for revenge with her billionaire CEO hubby, raising her son and living happily ever after.
65f812994b05152fd00001d1.title: Reborn Into High Society

65fc13874ef3830ed5018320.synopsis: Living under the control of a stepfather, Cleopatra has faced challenges in her quest for survival. Despite the circumstances she possesses a determination that cannot be crushed. Enduring one hardship after another， Cleopatra holds onto the glimmer of hope that some day she will break free from the shackles of her situation and carve out a better tomorrow...
65fc13874ef3830ed5018320.title: Cleopatra

At the young age of twenty-five, he is perceived as inexperienced and weak. However, Luca is determined to prove them wrong...
65fc158c24cde64f620ed8d6.title: In Love With My Godfather's Daughter

65fc1608eff485165208f229.synopsis: In the heart of a bustling city, we meet Emily, a dedicated and hardworking office assistant striving for a better life. When a passionate one-night stand with her charismatic boss, Richard, leads to an unexpected pregnancy, her world takes an unexpected turn...
65fc1608eff485165208f229.title: One Night Stand

65fc16323128d7b406079bf9.synopsis: Rosa and Emma are sisters, living their fantasy life in a castle their father had inherited, Rosa is engaged to Edward Douglas. As a result of an unfortunate accident, Rosa fell into a coma, but the marriage was not called off, and Rosa's name was replaced by Emma. Times goes on, the couple find themselves in difficult situations, and Rosa comes back to life after six months. When she opens her eyes, the growing tension urges Emma to confess the truth to Rosa...
65fc16323128d7b406079bf9.title: Sisters Have Crush On The Same Man

65fc16e9c8ef1b116202b4d8.synopsis: In the captivating narrative, we delve into the intricate tapestry of human emotions, where love and desire collide, and the choices we make reverberate through the lives of those we hold dear. Follow the compelling journey of Finch, a diligent middle-class man, whose unwavering dedication is directed towards crafting a life of contentment for his cherished wife, Mira, and their young son...
65fc16e9c8ef1b116202b4d8.title: Twisted Fates

65fc172307fa6beb36042c36.synopsis: Lyla's path to vengeance begins with her working as a waitress in a prestigious restaurant, a far cry from the life she once knew. With each passing day, Lyla's transformation is remarkable. She evolves from a broken-hearted waitress into a formidable and cunning businesswoman, fueled by a quest for revenge, works her way to the top. Does she get her desired revenge?...
65fc172307fa6beb36042c36.title: Revenge On My Cheating Fiancé

65fc17fd96dda47caa04e239.synopsis: Ava, who discovers that her boyfriend Ben and her best friend Sarah have betrayed her, decides to seek revenge, enlisting the help of her new partner, Max, and gradually revealing her meticulously crafted plan for retribution. They employ a series of clever and manipulative tactics to expose the depths of deception in their relationships. The plot takes unexpected twists and turns as Ava and Max, lead Ben and Sarah on a rollercoaster of emotions. Can revenge truly bring closure?...
65fc17fd96dda47caa04e239.title: Never Mess With A Badass Girl

65fc1832aca1bfcd00087ab1.synopsis: With a childhood filled with Love and abundance, Gigi Philips grows up to be ray of sunshine with nothing but love and sweetness. James and Laura Philips (Gigi's Parents) own and control the biggest shares of the cosmetic industry, ROSE beauty and cosmetics. Gigi is being groomed to take over the company as the only existing heiress of her parents...
65fc1832aca1bfcd00087ab1.title: Rosy Psycho

65fe6694b2d411400d03f7ce.synopsis: Serena caught her boyfriend, Ken cheating on her with her half-sister, Carol. He had always lied about holding it all in till marriage. Furious by their actions, Serena gets drunk and ended up in the bed of Jesse. She thought he was her escort but he was a man who has been inlove with her for years.
65fe6694b2d411400d03f7ce.title: Escorting the Heiress

6600e761553bd3ecab065188.synopsis: As a single mother raising her twins, she unexpectedly encounters a playboy who disrupts her life. Little does she know, this playboy has a hidden identity as a billionaire. And shockingly, he turns out to be the father of her children...
6600e761553bd3ecab065188.title: CEO, Those Twins Look Just Like you

6600e812c517ab85e60c0a77.synopsis: On my birthday, I received a birthday gift, a cowboy. And this cowboy is a daddy type. Originally thought it was just a one-night stand, I didn't expect the other party to be a billionaire. And this billionaire seems to have fallen in love with me, he insists on marrying me!
6600e812c517ab85e60c0a77.title: The One-Night Stand Daddy Is A CEO

It seems that I'm losing control over my heart this time...

Just as I was planning to return home to reunite with my wife and mother, an accident caused me to lose my memory! When I woke up, two women claimed to be my love—one dressed in luxury, the other in rags. Who should I believe?

Forced to experience life from a new perspective, they must live together.

66b8ad92909ea2f1bf0486ab.synopsis: On my way to my hometown to go through the divorce procedures, my husband and I missed the high-speed rail ticket, so we were forced to take the green train. In the previous life, no one knew that the zombie virus was spreading, and all the passengers on the train died. Fate made me reborn and returned to an hour before my death. At this time, I clearly realized that at this moment, there was only one way to save the fate of all passengers, that is, to stop the train and let everyone get off in advance!
66b8ad92909ea2f1bf0486ab.title: Countdown to Doomsday

66ba6efb1df4a48a110e058b.synopsis: Marry the man of her dreams was supposed to be the key to Ivy Donahue's happily-ever-after. Instead, it was only the start to an endless cycle of misery and heartbreak. But when her husband crosses the ultimate line, Ivy reveals she's not just any housewife—she's a billionaire heiress, and she's going to make him pay.
66ba6efb1df4a48a110e058b.title: Baby, You Had It Coming

66bacb08d03bd7bb9104c032.synopsis: After a job interview doesn’t pan out the way Stella Evans plans, she’s desperate to save her house and her mom. When Aston Montgomery gives her the offer of a lifetime — pretend to be his fiancée and mother of his love child in exchange for paying off her debts — she has no choice but to take it. Though it’s all temporary, Stella and Aston soon lose sight of what’s pretend and what’s real. Will Stella always be the borrowed bride, or will she win over the billionaire?
66bacb08d03bd7bb9104c032.title: Billionaire's Borrowed Bride

66c218e3cd9e8d40850de203.synopsis: A young girl's life was shattered by her tutor. She seduced the girl's father, causing the mother's death and leaving the girl with a severe facial scar. The girl was abandoned and suffered countless hardships while suffering from amnesia. When she regained her memory in an accident, she resolved to take revenge on the woman who had ruined her life.
66c218e3cd9e8d40850de203.title: Seems Like a Beauty Arrives

66c21902169914909d0fcb23.synopsis: The eldest grandson of the my family, urgently needs a bone marrow transplant. The son-loving old grandmother took the bone marrow from her granddaughter, causing her "dead". She was also blinded and thrown into a river so she could never find the way back home. Fortunately, she was adopted by a garbage collector and renamed. Sixteen years later, she accidentally offended the adopted daughter of her biological family, and was humiliated. Her adoptive mother was diagnosed with gastric cancer, which made things even worse. For medical expenses, she endured humiliation and endured all kinds of tortures from the family. However, the family who never gave up looking for their biological daughter, never thought that she was the lost daughter... In the end, can the family recognize her? Let us wait and see."
66c21902169914909d0fcb23.title: Blind Heiress

66c219648fcb50ccdc0c48b4.synopsis: The mother sells fish for a living and supports her two sons. However, because of the scars on her arms, she is considered as having an infectious disease and lives a difficult life. Because the younger son has allergies since childhood and gets more care from his mother, the older son is jealous. During a quarrel with his younger brother, he accidentally causes his younger brother to fall down the mountain and disappear. The mother always thinks that her younger son is not dead. She searchs for her son for years. Eighteen years later, the younger son who is rescued and becomes the heir of a big Group. He always wants to find his mother. However, due to the demolition of the old house, the lost son misses the opportunity to find his mother. But the eldest son abandons his mother and refuses to recognize her because he wants to marry a rich family. In the process of searching for her son, she experiences various humiliations and grievances, can she finally recognize him?"
66c219648fcb50ccdc0c48b4.title: My Long-Lost Son Turns Out to Be a CEO

66c30c67424a6859ae047da2.synopsis: Under threat, she had to assume someone else's identity to marry into a wealthy family. Unexpectedly, she ends up entangling with her fiancé's brother – a ruthless man who strikes fear into everyone. Due to her fake identity and the threats she faces, she doesn't dare to break things off with him easily. So, she decides to play along with him. When the family that once hunted her entire family proposes a marriage alliance with him, their relationship hits a deadlock... How will their budding romance unfold?
66c30c67424a6859ae047da2.title: Wrongly Entangled

66c3cde9b2e8a2b1c8045a71.synopsis: Lily met Dax Leone in a masked party where he was running away from his enemies. A forced kiss on Lily sparked what would be a romantic affair between Dax and Lily in My Sugar-Coated Mafia Boss Movie. Dax offers protection to Lily and invests in her pastry business while he deals with his family after becoming the mafia boss.
66c3cde9b2e8a2b1c8045a71.title: My Sugar-coated Mafia Boss

66c7bb55536dbafa2b007c10.synopsis: Break My Heart Again full movie story about: To protect her lover from the hands of her debtors, Lucie broke up with Felix giving him the wrong perception. Years later, Felix became wealthy and Lucie became his employee. Still angered by their past relationship, he promised to tear her apart and make her feel his pain. What happens when he finds out her true past intentions?
66c7bb55536dbafa2b007c10.title: Break My Heart Again

66cac7bdf153cc691907bad6.synopsis: Fifteen years ago, a father lost his finger while protecting his daughter, leading to their separation. Now, she faces betrayal from her ex-boyfriend, scorn from her family for her job as a water delivery worker, and the death of her adoptive father due to humiliation. As she struggles, her biological father—now a wealthy man—suddenly returns to take her home. However, the reunion is complicated by another woman who claims to be the true heiress, sparking imminent family conflict.
66cac7bdf153cc691907bad6.title: Four-Fingered Dad Helps Me Slap Back

66cd016fb51f2638ff0e3249.synopsis: Austin Harrington was the love of Grace Mitchell’s life in Love Ages Like Fine Wine Movie until he unexpectedly stood her up on their wedding day. While Grace thought the worst about Austin, she did not know that Austin had been forced by his grandfather to take on family business which led him back to her on a grander scale.
66cd016fb51f2638ff0e3249.title: Love Ages Like Fine Wine

66cd02d768c23caa3f0ab69c.synopsis: Sara was reduced to a maid in a home her late mother built from scratch in In Bed With Your Lies Movie. While she was trying to navigate such injustice, she looked out for a certain painting from her mother to her, which she found in the possession of Noah Dempsey, a billionaire who she was a substitute bride to.
66cd02d768c23caa3f0ab69c.title: In Bed with Your Lies

66cd617d8f0249e861022239.synopsis: After being swapped by her birth mother, who favored boys over girls, she went from being a heiress to a poor girl. By chance, she crossed paths with the fake heir who wanted to kill her for wealth and status after learning their true identities. With danger looming, how will she face it?
66cd617d8f0249e861022239.title: The Inverted Lives of Two Swapped Children

66cdbad69d6104fc1503e385.synopsis: Her parents were cruelly killed by werewolves, yet she has now become the Fated Luna of the werewolf Alpha. However, their love defies werewolf traditions, sparking conflict as they face rogue wolves and ancient prophecies. With hidden powers and fierce rivalries at play, love, destiny, and power clash in this thrilling tale of passion and survival.
66cdbad69d6104fc1503e385.title: Alpha Revenge: Wolf King and His Human Luna

66cfd7db66e8627a7e05e337.synopsis: A mural artist and an architectural engineer are instantly drawn to each other, but their budding romance comes to a halt when the past comes back to haunt them.
66cfd7db66e8627a7e05e337.title: Art of Falling in Love

66d44fb42a39737c5809dca2.synopsis: He, once the wealthiest man in town and a recluse, wanted nothing more than a simple life with his wife. However, due to his financial situation, she openly cheated on him. During this time, he met her, and together they dismantled her facade of vanity, ultimately finding happiness together.
66d44fb42a39737c5809dca2.title: The Hidden Magnate's Almighty Return

66d44fd7f58c5d84b80dd1db.synopsis: Years ago, a handsome rising star pursued the plus-sized Best Actress against societal norms, becoming a celebrated couple, but after achieving fame, he shockingly killed his wife and daughter, initially blaming a home invasion. Little did he know, his daughter has returned with a hidden identity, determined to avenge her mother and bring him to justice.
66d44fd7f58c5d84b80dd1db.title: The Movie Star's Daughter in the Dark

66d44feb40fe68980000c064.synopsis: I was once a billionaire CEO, but my husband tried to murder me to seize my fortune. Miraculously surviving, I went into hiding and was unexpectedly taken in by an incognito CEO. Now, fully prepared, I'm ready to rebuild my empire and reclaim everything that is rightfully mine.
66d44feb40fe68980000c064.title: Love's Redemption: Her Resounding Comeback

66d45038869f5d697d06c0f4.synopsis: She took her sister to visit a close friend, only to be betrayed and sold to local criminals. They were brutally abused, and their parents were killed trying to rescue them. This planted the seed of revenge in her. Meeting a former Phoenix who saw her own struggles in her, she became a disciple. She then rose as the new female warrior of the dark underworld, dismantling the criminal syndicate and rescuing her sister.
66d45038869f5d697d06c0f4.title: Awakend: The Female Agent Phoenix's Revenge

66d4505c61d49a2b110f8cef.synopsis: Born a freak of nature, she accidentally caused her mother’s death and was rejected by her grandmother. Raised by a virtuous onmyoji master, her innate powers to exorcise evil attract dark forces. After enduring numerous supernatural trials, she becomes the final onmyoji master...
66d4505c61d49a2b110f8cef.title: The Last Onmyoji

66d768a0bc767102400f59ce.synopsis: The Virgin And The Billionaire Movie is about how female lead Cindy found love under uncanny circumstances where she never thought it existed. Cindy, who was a child born through rape, was demoted to being a maid and a substitute bride in her father’s house until fortune smiled on her and billionaire Charles Kane fell in love with her.
66d768a0bc767102400f59ce.title: The Virgin and The Billionaire

66d76b7f92b035fea805be6a.synopsis: Look at how Emily Grace and William Valcor ran away from their engagement, only for them to still end up getting married to themselves in OMG! I Got Married In Vegas Movie. After declaring that they were both too spoilt for each other, Emily and William, unknown to them that they were the runaway bride and groom, eventually got married.
66d76b7f92b035fea805be6a.title: OMG, I Got Married in Vegas!

66da3de48f52b8896302151b.synopsis: Clyde enlists small time actress, Violet, to play the role of his long-lost sister, fulfilling his father's dying wish. Together, they face constant scrutiny and challenges from the antagonist. Living together , they inadvertently developed a forbidden romance. Determined to prove their taboo relationship, the antagonist sought to tarnish their reputation, leading Clyde's father to arrange Violet's marriage to another. In a desperate bid to reclaim their love, Clyde resolved to interrupt the wedding ceremony...
66da3de48f52b8896302151b.title: My Dear Brother is Obsessed With Me

66da3ef192c3e36f2f003bb4.synopsis: Valerie Patterson almost lost out a luxurious life with a billionaire lover after the Patterson family nearly succeeded in exchanging her with her sister, Daphne, in Mr. Hills’ Adorable Wife Movie. Born with a birthmark which her mother considered ugly; Valerie was ignored by her family until Andrew Hills fell in love with her after a sexual encounter with her.
66da3ef192c3e36f2f003bb4.title: Mr Hills' Adorable Wife

66da5b2863f055aeb90e1bf9.synopsis: She is a wealthy heiress and a renowned fashion designer who gave up her career for her husband. However, his coldness and distrust broke her heart. After their divorce, she met a handsome, wealthy, and caring new man who helped her slowly forget the pain of her past. She thought she had found her true love, but little did she know that he was only after her money and power. When she discovered the deception and left him, he realized he had truly fallen for her. At the same time, her ex-husband wanted to reconcile. Who will she choose?
66da5b2863f055aeb90e1bf9.title: Never Enjoyed Divorce Like This

66dc0ddd8126f02fcc06f461.synopsis: She was blind, but one day she suddenly regained her sight and discovered her husband cheating with her best friend. They had plotted to kill her for her inheritance. With danger looming, she chose to pretend to still be blind, cleverly outwitting them step by step to uncover the truth.
66dc0ddd8126f02fcc06f461.title: The Blind Wife's Unseen Trap

66ded2c845020f5d690188e4.synopsis: She was framed to death, and he misrecognized their daughter. Given another life, she is going to protect her love ones, and punish the bad!
66ded2c845020f5d690188e4.title: Mom, Love Me Again

66dfa270766d84b0ed08a34f.synopsis: She sacrificed her career for her husband, only to discover he was cheating and secretly transferring marital assets. To gather evidence for a divorce, she guided her husband's mistress to see his true colors and convinced her to cooperate. Will the alliance between these two rivals be unbreakable or filled with jealousy?
66dfa270766d84b0ed08a34f.title: Revenge-Uniting with My Rival

66e084d5d27afe2f01050c94.synopsis: A legendary figure has disguised himself as a beggar and is now wandering the streets. The eldest daughter of a prominent financial ruler has been afflicted with a mysterious illness. Despite a substantial reward offered by her father, no expert has been able to cure her. One day, the ruler's second daughter happens to pass by a reward notice and encounters the beggar with a tattered bowl. She drops some change into his bowl, and the beggar, recognizing her kindness, offers to fulfill one of her wishes. He then accompanies her to her family home. The ruler is skeptical that a beggar could cure his critically ill daughter, but the beggar calmly performs his exceptional skills and, indeed...
66e084d5d27afe2f01050c94.title: I'm the Dragon King & Legendary Healer

66e250f17011b0fcb403c8d0.synopsis: Riley Jones and Xander Thorne meet in Runaway Princess Bride after Riley ran away from her forced marriage to Corbin Hicks when he tried to force himself on her on their wedding day. Riley would come to find out that her parents were actively going to sell her, and that the stranger that saved her was more than a stranger.
66e250f17011b0fcb403c8d0.title: Runaway Princess Bride

66e252be905b22a9500d6cd7.synopsis: Who is the real Freya D’Lore? Time was against the original Freya D’Lore when a stranger stole her name and identity in Back Off, I'm The Real Mrs. CEO Movie. Freya D’lore was humiliated and insulted and could only watch her life-time's hard work go down the drain until she was eventually able to prove her identity on the spot.
66e252be905b22a9500d6cd7.title: Back Off! I'm the Real Mrs. CEO

66e36b0fcdc95e19cf0b2644.synopsis: Stella Hearth was kidnapped while her brother, Dennis watched helplessly. In Darling, Please Come Home Movie, Stella’s life changed drastically as she was saved by a poor and dumb man who became a janitor in her school, forcing Stella to be bullied by her own brother because he could not recognize her after so many years. Eventually, Stella was recognized.
66e36b0fcdc95e19cf0b2644.title: Darling, Please Come Home

66e88101c281fb5f2f06ff4a.synopsis: In Her Secret Crusader movie, Lyndon was the City's hero. After freeing the City from danger, he hid his identity to protect his girlfriend, Tatiana, from harm. Now City Hall is once again in danger as the Sewer rat returns to take it down. The mayor and his daughter are the Sewer rat’s target victims. With Tatiana’s betrayal revealed, Lyndon becomes a hero again.
66e88101c281fb5f2f06ff4a.title: Her Secret Crusader

66eb8ed6515789a3f3045166.synopsis: I once possessed remarkable martial skills, but after a girl risked her life to save me, I sacrificed all my power to bring her back to life, losing my memory in the process and becoming a fool. Grateful for my sacrifice, she took me in as her husband and protected me for three years. However, my foolishness made me an easy target for bullying. Now, as her family pressures her to marry for profit, I unexpectedly regain my memories and powers. I decide to keep pretending to be a fool, secretly guarding her while outsmarting those who underestimate me...
66eb8ed6515789a3f3045166.title: The Return of the Beggar: Starting from Being Picked Up by a Beauty

66efa579b2b806b9a906b9e1.synopsis: Having become a CEO, she learns that her long-lost twin sister was nearly bullied to death by classmates. She decides to assume her sister's identity and take revenge on the bullying group. Will the bullying gang recognize her true identity? What will their fate be?
66efa579b2b806b9a906b9e1.title: Fury Unleashed: Your Sister Rises

66efa62efa6130d3ee0f0131.synopsis: In the chaotic northern region, a young man, once exiled after a family dispute, rose to power in the Sixth Prison, becoming the "King of the North." Poisoned and nearing death, his master arranged several special women as fiancées to cure him, but he hesitated to involve them. One fiancée insisted on marrying him, but during the wedding, family secrets surfaced, leading to his collapse from the poison. His wife and the other women united to save him, becoming the key to his cure. Together, they restored peace to the northern region.
66efa62efa6130d3ee0f0131.title: The Supreme Warden Rescues His Young Bride

66f00a9976b82f16de069a55.synopsis: The protagonist, once the son of a wealthy tycoon, is kidnapped by the tycoon's adopted son and separated from his family. He later joins the Hidden Wolf Special Forces, growing up to become their captain, known as the Wolf King. Just as he is about to reunite with his father, the adopted son poisons him in a betrayal. In a desperate escape, he is injured and loses his memory, only to be saved by his sister. For eighteen years, the tycoon searches for his son, scouring the nation until he finally finds him in Yang City. Just as the butler brings the protagonist to meet his father, unforeseen events occur. The adopted son intervenes once more, threatening the protagonist by putting his sister's life at stake.
66f00a9976b82f16de069a55.title: Rise of Power: Dad, Your Son Comes Back

66f1c75a5e8ddc70fc018797.synopsis: In Captured and bound by my CEO movie, Lydia's father is dying and the family's company is drowning. She's the next in line appointed to take over her family's company. Her brother and her boyfriend wouldn't want that to happen. They joined hands with a common enemy, Declan, to bring her down. With Lydia being the longtime crush of Declan, she's about to win over her brother.
66f1c75a5e8ddc70fc018797.title: Captured and Bound By My CEO

66f1c911931a04169b0d263d.synopsis: In Accidental Surrogate for Alpha movie, Ella is a Luna werewolf kept hidden by her parents from everyone including herself. Without knowing this, Ella has always hated wolves. What she desired was motherhood. Her boyfriend has prevented that by drugging her. When Ella found out, she went for insemination but accidentally the sperm of an alpha wolf was placed in her.
66f1c911931a04169b0d263d.title: Accidental Surrogate for Alpha

66f509a2fdcd3027ad0cb0bf.synopsis: After kneeling to his ex-wife for 99 days, he is reborn with a determination to become a superstar. Facing numerous challenges and opportunities, he competes in "The Voice," writes songs live on stage, and showcases his talent at a prestigious family banquet. Along the way, his complex relationships with his ex-wife, friends, and rivals add emotional depth and tension to his journey toward stardom.
66f509a2fdcd3027ad0cb0bf.title: Becoming a Superstar Starts with Breakup

66f50a374f9a332106016243.synopsis: She, a gentle and timid illegitimate daughter of a wealthy man, suffers abuse from her husband's family after marriage. When the wealthy man unexpectedly dies, she is the sole heir to his fortune. Her husband hires someone to kill her to seize the inheritance, but the hired woman looks exactly like her. After a struggle, they both pass out and their identities are mistaken. The straightforward and tough hired woman, at the request of others, helps her reclaim the fortune. They soon discover that they are actually twin sisters. Together, they set out to uncover the truth about their parents' deaths and seek revenge on her husband's family.
66f50a374f9a332106016243.title: Don't Mess with My Sister

66f50a7586faad50d308e4e2.synopsis: The emperor's beloved princess was kidnapped by human traffickers during an outing and spent over a decade living as a child bride in a peasant family. Years later, the emperor finally finds his daughter's whereabouts, but mistakenly identifies the wrong person... With schemes and plots inside and outside the palace, can the real princess reclaim her identity?
66f50a7586faad50d308e4e2.title: The Lost Princess's Journey Home

66f50ad2b7be8d05910a3ad3.synopsis: A mentally impaired mother gave birth to a pair of twins, a boy and a girl. After her husband's untimely death, the family lived in poverty. The younger brother, craving chicken soup, persuaded their simple-minded mother to steal a chicken, which led to the neighbors demanding compensation when they were caught. To avoid responsibility, the brother falsely accused his sister, and their ruthless grandmother sent the sister away.Years later, the sister, now a successful CEO, unexpectedly reunites with her long-lost mother and brother. Shockingly, she witnesses her ungrateful brother publicly humiliating their mother...
66f50ad2b7be8d05910a3ad3.title: Mom, I Miss You

66f50b0f454cad4bdc08f28e.synopsis: Seven years ago, she traveled to this world and was supposed to leave after successfully winning over her husband. But she altered the rules and stayed for him and their child. However, her husband no longer loved her. So she made a wish to get cancer and die on her husband's operating table, hoping he would remember her forever...
66f50b0f454cad4bdc08f28e.title: Stay Alive to See You Don’t Love Me

66f50cdba9d68eda2f0d08c6.synopsis: She was originally a wealthy heiress, but after being abducted by human traffickers, she was raised by a madwoman. It wasn't until her father developed kidney failure and urgently needed a donor that he thought of finding his second daughter. Unaware of her father's true motives, she agreed to return home on one condition: she would bring her adoptive mad mother with her. Her biological sister, worried that she would take away her luxury and the CEO she was betrothed to since childhood, repeatedly tried to frame her. However, the CEO uncovered the truth about her abduction and the bullying she endured at school, and realized that she was the mother of his child—the same woman he had a one-night stand with after being drugged!
66f50cdba9d68eda2f0d08c6.title: Sorry, I Refuse to Be the Heiress

66f50daa6c33e97da200229e.synopsis: The King of Hell, after being trapped in reincarnation for 3,000 years, leaves the underworld in chaos, with ghost officials in deep slumber. In his final reincarnation, he lives as a struggling food delivery man, burdened by poverty and his mother's illness. Following a fatal heart attack caused by a malicious customer, he is taken back to the underworld by ghost messengers, where he regains his memories and powers as the King of Hell. Restored to his throne, he returns to the mortal realm, saves his mother, and astonishes everyone with his supernatural abilities. At an auction, he reclaims a lost artifact and subdues a demon. During the Yin-Yang Summit, he defeats powerful sect leaders, reopens the underworld, and restores balance between the realms, ultimately becoming the guardian of both the human and spiritual worlds.
66f50daa6c33e97da200229e.title: Hades: The Lord of the Underworld is Back

66f5f06f6cde23c2ea0054b1.synopsis: Recipe For Faking A Marriage Movie is about a poor orphan, Every, entering into a contract marriage with billionaire Julian Barlow, until they fell in love with each other for a fact. Bella Barlow, Julian’s eight-year-old daughter was the architect of the meeting between Julian and Every, and it developed into a scintillating love affair which blossomed forever.
66f5f06f6cde23c2ea0054b1.title: Recipe For Faking A Marriage

66f5f24f75ac6175cb0fe806.synopsis: Playing By the Billionaire’s Rules Movie is about Becky Jacobs who had a contract affair with Nick Walton for three years with rules. One of the rules was that they would not fall in love but they both broke it and found it difficult to maneuver Nick’s mother who wanted him to marry someone else for an alliance to ensue.
66f5f24f75ac6175cb0fe806.title: Playing by the Billionaire's Rules

66f5f4624f4761f082060bc8.synopsis: The Return of My Mafia Husband movie summary is all about Leo Marino who keeps his identity as the don of the Marino family as he dates Olivia Gray, an ordinary girl. After being in a coma for eight years, he finds Olivia still waiting by his side as he proposes to her. But a don can't marry a nobody as he promises to give Olivia the world.
66f5f4624f4761f082060bc8.title: The Return of My Mafia Husband

66f5f5c7f0ebf2edf50638f7.synopsis: In His One and Only Love movie, Lyla grows up feeling different from others and struggles with a sense of inferiority. Forced by her family to work and earn money, she faces abuse at every turn. On her 22nd birthday, Lyla wishes for true love. While working a part-time job, she saves Leo, a handsome and gentle president, and unexpectedly becomes pregnant. Leo takes her in and cares for her tenderly, and over time, their love blossoms. However, as they uncover the mystery of Lyla's past, they find themselves entangled in a web of conspiracy and evil. How will Lyla defend their love? What kind of ending awaits her and Leo under the care of the Goddess of Fate?
66f5f5c7f0ebf2edf50638f7.title: His One and Only Love

66f5f65bd83755dc700fc635.synopsis: Switched at birth, Allie had no idea who she really was until she fell for Xander Maddox. That's when she gets her DNA results. Now, she's torn between telling Xander who her father really is and risk losing him or keeping a lie from the man she loves.
66f5f65bd83755dc700fc635.title: My Stolen Billionaire Life

66ff3466df005948fa089723.synopsis: Fake It Till You Love Me Movie is about Edward Forrest and Caroline Dean. Edward has to do everything possible to remain the CEO of his company, and that would mean that he would get married to the lady he was caught in a scandal with to save face. A one-year marriage contract will cause them to fall in love.
66ff3466df005948fa089723.title: Fake it Till You Love Me

6705038e2c0f3f197a092eeb.synopsis: On the day of her long-awaited wedding into a wealthy family, a bride receives a shocking text—her husband is having an affair. She and her friends rush to confront the "mistress," but things take a bizarre turn when the woman’s true identity is revealed—she’s her future mother-in-law?!
6705038e2c0f3f197a092eeb.title: On the Wedding Day

6705039e637be4a3600a1411.synopsis: On the day he took over as CEO, he was attacked by thugs, leading to brain damage and memory loss. Years later, his adoptive daughter brought him to reunite with his biological children. However, his children’s family looked down on him for his low status and intellectual impairment, refusing to acknowledge him. They accused him of pretending to be their father for money and subjected him to verbal and physical abuse, eventually pushing him down the stairs. Miraculously, the fall restored his consciousness and memory. But his competitive sister, worried that his return would threaten her position, forged the paternity test results and kidnapped his adoptive daughter and mother. Can he clear the misunderstandings and reunite with his family?
6705039e637be4a3600a1411.title: Tracing the Path Home

670503c90c9534be780ef221.synopsis: I was born into a powerful family, blessed with extraordinary talent and limitless potential. But my mother held a priceless secret, one that led to betrayal by our own blood. In their greed, they conspired with powerful forces to hunt us down. Before her tragic end, my mother entrusted me to her most trusted friend. In the fight to protect me, my guardian sacrificed everything, losing the use of her legs. For twenty years, I lived in hiding, training under a mysterious master, waiting for the day I could return. Now, I have come back, no longer the powerless child they once discarded. My first mission is to reclaim what was lost and seek vengeance for my mother. As I dig deeper, the real masterminds behind the betrayal begin to emerge, one by one. This is my journey—to uncover hidden truths, expose the lies, and bring justice to those who wronged us.
670503c90c9534be780ef221.title: Pride of the Clan: The Return of the Martial Sage

670504fe793ca1bf2f02fdc1.synopsis: In her previous life, she devotedly loved her husband and did everything she could to help him rise in his career. However, he betrayed her, having an affair with her best friend, strangled her, and annihilated her entire family. Given a second chance at life, she encounters her husband's political rival and decides to join forces with him. This time, watch as she becomes resilient and strategic, successfully taking revenge on the scoundrel.
670504fe793ca1bf2f02fdc1.title: General! She Rised to the Top

A healthy relationship should be built on mutual understanding and support, rather than on oppressing one another for personal gain. With the strong intervention of her new partner, she embarks on a journey of continuous growth, reconnecting with society, returning to work, and reigniting her passion for her craft.

They meet again three years later - Mason, as the owner of Aria's workplace, and Aria, as the nurse who saved Mason's grandpa's life. 67418cb3c897fb05ef043dd9.title: The Bad-ass Heiress Returns After Divorce

67468b1d55e5e72c7e0bb666.synopsis: A legendary healer hides her identity and marries into the Gu family to study secret medicine, while the Gu family’s CEO is desperately searching for a healer to cure his son’s mysterious illness. By chance, they enter into a marriage contract—will love blossom between them?
67468b1d55e5e72c7e0bb666.title: Married Fast, I’m a Secret Healer!

67468b79bd7223538703f9c5.synopsis: My parents set me up with a contract marriage, and I heard my “future husband” is a total disaster. To escape, I ended up spending the night with a male model. Turns out, he’s actually my husband…
67468b79bd7223538703f9c5.title: My One-Night Lover Is My Contract Husband

6746aa92c946defef504c9ff.synopsis: Hailey Kaplan, a wealthy teenager who decides to conceal her true identity when she transfers to Western High, a public school. Tired of being known only for her family's wealth, Hailey hopes to make genuine friends and experience a normal teenage life. However, her plans are thrown into chaos when Candice Mathis, the daughter of the Kaplan family's maid, arrives at school posing as the Kaplan heiress. Candice quickly rises to the top of the social hierarchy, while Hailey finds herself at the bottom, subjected to bullying and ridicule.
6746aa92c946defef504c9ff.title: True Heiress vs. Fake Queen Bee

6746ab2669a3a61f880f858d.synopsis: Conscientious class president Emma is keeping a big secret: She's the poorest girl at her wealthy private school. When her rival, uber rich bad boy Lucas Bennett gets her fired from the part time job that's paying her father's medical bills, he makes it up to her — by hiring her to be his personal maid! Lucas agrees to keep their arrangement a secret... as long as Emma caters to his every need.
6746ab2669a3a61f880f858d.title: Maid for My Nemesis

674d37791ebc5fbf200f541e.synopsis: Bullied and forced to break up with her first love, she spiraled into pain, ending up in a mental hospital where she gave birth to a daughter. Five years later, struggling to survive with her daughter, the people who once tormented her return. After leaving her, her first love became a renowned lawyer. When they accidentally meet on the street, can they rekindle their lost love?
674d37791ebc5fbf200f541e.title: The Broken Me Met Him Again

674d444e07e38cfac708ba17.synopsis: Yu-Jin was murdered by her husband Chan-Yeong and his mistress Na Ju-Hui. Shortly after, her sister Yu-Ri is also killed and finds herself back in time before Yujin and Chan-Yeong's wedding. Determined to avenge her sister, Yu-Ri decides to marry Chan-Yeong. Just then, her first love Tae-O reappears before her.
674d444e07e38cfac708ba17.title: Marrying My Sister's Husband

674e2b072ce8ea42180433cd.synopsis: After learning that her boyfriend is cheating on her and is only after her fortune, Madeline decides to break up with him and accidentally gets married to Caden, a male nurse. She thought both of them were just hard-working poor people, but she gradually realized that her husband seemed to have hidden wealth and power.Caden Wilson Cashmore, the mysterious CEO of the group, became a male nurse volunteer in order to fulfill his brother's last wish. He's been searching for the recipient of his brother's heart, and could that person be the wife he married on the spur of the moment?
674e2b072ce8ea42180433cd.title: Unexpected Knot: Married to a Billionaire Nurse

674e2cd5f97c5cc4d4030f73.synopsis: Liam and Annie were a young couple until Annie was nearly assaulted. In the process of saving her, Liam severely injured the attacker, resulting in his imprisonment. The wealthy Holland family head revealed Liam as their heir, forcing Annie to leave him by promising to save him if she agreed, hiding her pregnancy and pretending to love money. Six years later, Annie is a janitor, and Liam is the Holland heir. Despite his resentment, Liam still loves Annie and repeatedly saves her, but she avoids him, fearing for their son Henry's safety and feeling guilty for the past. Liam decides to win her back by focusing on Henry, believing that with Henry, Annie will return. He carefully plans to remove the obstacles that separated them.
674e2cd5f97c5cc4d4030f73.title: Mommy, I Got You A Date

674e9ee70b7b25b0910b18d9.synopsis: Emma and Cameron were once in love until a fire tore them apart. Years later, Cameron returns seeking revenge, believing Emma betrayed him. After an accident causes him to lose his memory, he thinks Emma is his wife. Can their love survive the secrets, or is it too late for a second chance?
674e9ee70b7b25b0910b18d9.title: My Billionaire Husband Doesn't Remember Me

675110c567a002f3b1017570.synopsis: High school student Lindsay's life takes a dramatic turn when Wayne Adams, a star football player recruited by her dad, Mike, the school’s football coach, moves into her home. Their initial encounter is tense, but Lindsay must suppress her feelings due to Mike's warnings. Determined to find a boyfriend before graduation, Lindsay's attempts often end in awkward situations with unreliable guys. However, Wayne is always there to help when she’s in trouble. As their bond deepens, they start a secret relationship. Meanwhile, bullying at school escalates, prompting Lindsay to take a stand for her peers. Her efforts earn the support and respect of the school community. In the end, Lindsay and Wayne are crowned Prom King and Queen, and Mike finally approves of their relationship.
675110c567a002f3b1017570.title: The Virgin's Bucket List

6752885d3d9eb9334300b6ca.synopsis: Victoria was set to return to Texas with her fiancé Carl to plan their wedding, but she was horrifically humiliated and betrayed by him. To save face with her family, Victoria reluctantly agrees to marry Simon, a homeless man she had been helping. Little did she know, Simon is not just any homeless man—he's a handsome and charming billionaire, the CEO of the prestigious Savage Group, ranked number one in the country. Upon returning to Texas with Simon, Victoria unexpectedly crosses paths with her arrogant ex, Carl. This time, she’s determined to reclaim all the dignity she lost.
6752885d3d9eb9334300b6ca.title: Found A Homeless Billionaire Husband for Christmas

6753b6ca3fc663ea500b579a.synopsis: Forever invisible Skylar Heron hasn't started her senior year so hot. First, she's embarrassed in front of the whole school when trying to ask out her crush Jamie Donner, her childhood best friend and next-door neighbor. Then, she gets paired up with him to work on a class project together. And, finally, to top it all off, she's forced to live with him when his house burns down and he moves into her room! But now, Jamie's crazy ex-girlfriend is out to make their lives hell. The only thing that can save both their years is... to turn the school freak into the most popular girl in school!
6753b6ca3fc663ea500b579a.title: The Quarterback Next Door

6756a3f1e1061984750adf70.synopsis: After a one-night stand with Ben, the hottest guy on campus, Kelsey realizes she's pregnant...and decides to keep the baby. But will Ben stick around - or will he stay a flirty fratboy forever?
6756a3f1e1061984750adf70.title: Straight A Pregnancy

67579a7115ee2c04c30da549.synopsis: Becca needed the break after a rough year attending Yale and a break-up with her boyfriend. She didn’t expect for her summer of fun to include sleeping with James, the Italian Stallion–her best friend's father. Knowing it’s wrong, she allows James to pull her into a vortex of pleasure that has her breaching the surface of reality and grasping for survival. Can Becca endure this pleasure without Tally finding out? Or will her secrets cause her world to crash around her?
67579a7115ee2c04c30da549.title: Submitting to My Best Friend's Dad

67579c0b10b10b2cd907a4aa.synopsis: After dying alone due to pampering her love-blinded son, she’s reborn with memories of her past life. This time, she’s determined to take control, build her empire, and get revenge on her clueless son, his fiancée, and their parasitic relatives.
67579c0b10b10b2cd907a4aa.title: Rebirth and Cut Ties: My Love-Blinded Son Regrets

675a3400df0746172507d41c.synopsis: Betrayed by her fiance and her own sister, Esther marries Ricky without knowing his real identity – a secret billionaire. Together, they have to stand up against Esther's evil family, take back her mother’s company and find their happy ending.
675a3400df0746172507d41c.title: Married In A Heartbeat

675b8a0680590480bc08b778.synopsis: This Christmas, Eddie travels to his loving wife’s hometown to finally reveal he’s the billionaire CEO of the nation’s hottest start-up. But in a house and town full of Scrooges, will Eddie’s arrival be a Christmas present, or go down like a lump of coal?
675b8a0680590480bc08b778.title: Secret Billionaire Returns on Christmas

675b8fc5111c95d759079ada.synopsis: Nerdy girl Pearl is determined to catch the eye of her longtime crush, but is clueless on how to do it. But after a shocking encounter with Ethan Hart, the school's biggest bad boy, she makes a deal with him that will finally get her noticed. With his help, Pearl catches the attention of the guy she wants and sparks do fly... but in the wrong direction.
675b8fc5111c95d759079ada.title: The Hart-Breaker

675b906f095133d4f90de304.synopsis: After a medical mishap, the virgin Violet Gray becomes pregnant with the child of a billionaire stranger, Carter Watts. To provide for the child, they are forced into a hasty marriage. Carter leaves for a business trip and is away for six years, during which Violet raises their son, Patrick, on her own while working at a five-star hotel. Unexpectedly, the hotel is bought out by a mysterious new owner—Carter himself! However, after six years apart, they no longer recognize each other. By chance, Violet discovers that her charming boss, Carter Watts, is actually her long-lost husband...
675b906f095133d4f90de304.title: Genius Baby Gets Daddy Back

676101d414d3779d1608fc2a.synopsis: After Sam's ex cheats on her and steals her money, Calladan Vandalay marries her at first sight. But he doesn't tell her that he's secretly the richest billionaire in the country. What will Sam do when she finds out? And can they keep their true identities a secret from the preying family and friends in Sam's life?
676101d414d3779d1608fc2a.title: Fake Married to My Billionaire CEO

676111febda3c434c80ff750.synopsis: The Emperor's daughter, Yun, was betrayed and severely injured. A poor young man, Peng, saved her. To repay him, Yun hid her identity and married Peng, giving birth to their daughter,NiuNiu. While supporting the family, Yun secretly used the Emperor's power to help Peng succeed. When Yun planned to reveal her true identity, she found Peng cheating and wanting a divorce. Peng's mother humiliated Yun and eventually drove her and Niu Niu out of the house.At a grand banquet, Yun revealed her identity, exposed Peng's betrayal, punished the traitors, and became the Empress.
676111febda3c434c80ff750.title: Goddess Unbound: Rising After Divorce

676112491adef8d207013bac.synopsis: She plans to tell her husbandabout her pregnancy but finds him with the pregnant At her mother-in-law’s birthday banquet, she is humiliated and decides to divorce. Her brother steps in, bringing her home and arranging for her to host a business event, where she encounters them again. She tries to embarrass him, but fails. The family believes he is the boy's mistress, making her life difficult, until it’s revealed that she is the family’s eldest daughter.He finally realizes his mistake, but it’s too late to fix their relationship.
676112491adef8d207013bac.title: The Hidden Tycoon’s Wife

6761131dde796318ab0b65d8.synopsis: The daughter of the wealthiest man escaped her own wedding to look for her long-lost boyfriend. By chance, she encountered a college classmate who impersonated her, secretly wearing the jewelry of the wealthy man’s daughter and pretending to be the heir. When the real heir was being bullied, she met her boyfriend, who was cold towards her and was about to marry the impostor. At her boyfriend’s wedding with the impostor, the real heir exposed the impostor’s identity.
6761131dde796318ab0b65d8.title: From Poverty to Power: The Hidden Heiress

6761132b206fa7558e055e2a.synopsis: After losing her parents in an accident at age five, She was taken in by her aunt and uncle, who treated her poorly. At eighteen, she rescued a woman who turned out to be the mother of a billionaire, He, leading to an offer of adoption. To test She's character, He's three children hid their identities, but they were ultimately moved by her kindness and resilience.
6761132b206fa7558e055e2a.title: Angel From Above

67624d5d75f46bc2a80c3380.synopsis: When the fate of a business marriage seems inevitable, Emma Watson, the heiress of the Watson family, takes on an internship at Anderson Corporation. Meanwhile, Ethan Anderson, the heir of the Anderson family, steps in as the new CEO. Both hide their true identities while evaluating each other, but they unexpectedly fall in love at first sight. However, things take an unexpected turn when someone else mistakenly claims Emma’s identity, and she mistakenly believes another man is her “fiancé.” Determined, both Emma and Ethan set out to break off their "engagements" with their so-called "fiancés." Will they ever realize that the person they're searching for has been right in front of them all along?
67624d5d75f46bc2a80c3380.title: Secret Strangers in Love

6763331070d4a48fb00bc994.synopsis: Damian, the CEO of the world's most powerful military-industrial group, is mistaken for a poor salesman earning only $3,000 a month. Unexpectedly, he enters into a quick contract marriage with Iris, a company’s boss. Damian accompanies Iris to her hometown for a Christmas dinner, where he faces constant belittlement from her relatives and ridicule from Iris's suitor. Damian continually turns the tables on the antagonists, proving his power and status, and ultimately finds true love with Iris.
6763331070d4a48fb00bc994.title: Money, Guns, and a Merry Christmas

6764b7033cd5d1a54a0b52db.synopsis: Welcome to ReelTalk, a weekly ReelShort podcast hosted by Rachel Bencosme! Join us as we spill the tea with your favorite stars and dive into the raw, real conversations about life and ReelShort shows. With new episodes dropping every Friday, ReelTalk is sure to keep you hooked and coming back for more!
6764b7033cd5d1a54a0b52db.title: ReelTalk EP1-Under the Mistletoe with Seth and Nicole

6765dd4edea7008b970c8c8e.synopsis: After Matilda's only daughter, Elodie, is rescued from her kidnapper by local police - she is turned over to foster care and never to be seen again. Matilda and her son, Carson, never stopped searching for her - spending every last penny on posters and PI invesitgations till they starved. Then, after twenty long years of desperate attempts to get Elodie back, she returns. Except, now she's Billionaire CEO Miss Atkins and her company is going to destroy the very home she grew up in - and the only remaining clue that could bring the family back together again.
6765dd4edea7008b970c8c8e.title: The Lady Boss CEO is My Daughter

67682aeb51230aec08002f9a.synopsis: Before dying, 40-year-old Lin Chuxue learns that her husband, Lu Mingzhe, never truly loved her and their son, Lu Xuan, favors his father’s former lover, Su Yun. Reborn into the seventh year of her marriage, Lin Chuxue initiates a forced divorce, which must undergo China's mandatory 30-day cooling-off period. During this time, she joins Professor Wang’s team in Shanghai to tackle advanced brain cancer.
67682aeb51230aec08002f9a.title: 30 Days to Chill

67682c5cf5ecbf6c2d059797.synopsis: After getting drunk at a bar, Ye Lanxi accidentally spends the night with Lu Yanzhou, the CEO of Lu Group. To her surprise, a passionate night leads to an unexpected pregnancy with his child! Six years later, Ye Lanxi returns to her homeland with her four genius children, embarking on a mission to take down the scoundrels and seek retribution, all while attracting the attention of Lu Yanzhou.
67682c5cf5ecbf6c2d059797.title: CEO Lu's Four Wonders

67682c673f0f46d3bc0eea90.synopsis: Heir to Lingxiao Temple, She is forced into marrying him rumored to be on his deathbed. Neither wants the match, but fate steps in when she unexpectedly saves his life. Unaware they’re each other’s intended, they grow close amid a flurry of comedic misunderstandings before discovering the truth and embracing their happily ever after.
67682c673f0f46d3bc0eea90.title: A Second Chance at Love

67682c70e28fcaa707045c47.synopsis: On his wedding day, the heir to Jiangcheng’s wealthiest family gives up everything to save his fiancée, only to be framed and killed. Granted seven days to exact revenge and achieve true rebirth—alongside his also-reborn childhood sweetheart—He vows to protect his loved ones and crush those who conspired against him.
67682c70e28fcaa707045c47.title: This Life, My Comeback

67682d54102d03196304f630.synopsis: The female protagonist marries her boyfriend to inherit the family business, only to discover on her wedding day that she has stomach cancer and is immediately abandoned by her boyfriend! To get back at the scoundrel, she quickly marries a blind man, only to find out after the marriage that he is not blind at all, but the wealthiest person in the city. The female lead and her husband join forces to confront the scoundrel and the unfaithful woman, regain their family fortune, and after learning of the misdiagnosis, they live happily ever after.
67682d54102d03196304f630.title: The Power of Love: A Disabled Tycoon's Heart

67682d678198047ab10218f8.synopsis: Twenty years ago, Min Rou was gravely ill, and her husband tragically died in an accident. With no other options, she was forced to abandon her son, Zhao Han, at the doorstep of the affluent Zhao family, hoping that they would adopt him. Twenty years later, Zhao Han graduates with a PhD from a top university and is honored as a chief academician of the National Academy of Sciences. He participates in a family-searching program to find his mother…
67682d678198047ab10218f8.title: Pure heart, distant journey

67693591880cdb5cef0d563a.synopsis: Olivia and Finn are total opposites - she's a studious, artistic good girl, and he's a rebellious party animal straight out of rehab. But when they hook up the night before Olivia's dad marries Finn's mom, they realize they have one thing in common: their obsession with each other. Can Olivia put her feelings for her bad boy stepbrother aside?
67693591880cdb5cef0d563a.title: Oops! I’m in Love with My Stepbrother

676a45788b52b3a498015101.synopsis: She concealed her identity and fell deeply in love with him over the course of a year. Just as they were about to discuss marriage, his mother confidently pulled out a peculiar set of family rules and demanded that she sign and memorize them.
676a45788b52b3a498015101.title: Family Traditions, Quirky Rules

676a458bc9346b91f2042242.synopsis: After a tragic car accident, the parents redirected all blood supplies to save the brother, causing her to ultimately languish and die on her hospital bed. Reborn, she finds herself back at the age of ten. Determined not to survive as she did in her previous life, she plans to take revenge, strip the family of everything, and make her mother regret her actions.
676a458bc9346b91f2042242.title: Little Rebels

676dc3b9d143b166f80d57dc.synopsis: Ever wondered what your favorite ReelShort stars are like when the cameras are off? In this episode, Rachel Bencosme gets REEL personal with Seth Edeen and Nicole Mattox. Tune in as they give us the inside scoop on fans, dating, pet peeves, and the red flags they just can’t ignore. Buckle up for some candid confessions. You’ll never look at them the same way again!
676dc3b9d143b166f80d57dc.title: ReelTalk EP2-Let’s get reel personal

676dda478fc3bbcd4c0d1375.synopsis: To avenge her mother, Daisy disguises herself as a dancer to get close to the dangerous mafia boss, Hogan. Despite suspecting Daisy's intentions, Hogan finds himself irresistibly drawn to her deadly charm. Will Daisy manage to walk away unscathed, or will she be entangled in passion with Hogan?
676dda478fc3bbcd4c0d1375.title: Fatal Attraction: A Dark Mafia Romance

676e5f6b061f6ac5dc07eca9.synopsis: When Becca Morris gets a soccer scholarship to her dream school, Cliffton College, she gets some startling news alongside her orientation packet: she’s pregnant. But that doesn’t stop the varsity captain, Max, from falling for her. Together, Max and Becca hide her secret from scheming soccer players, a vengeful ex, and the soccer coach from Hell. But with a baby on the way, will Max give up his picture perfect image to be with Becca?
676e5f6b061f6ac5dc07eca9.title: Baby Daddy Goals

676e620de4d70b4ba105e2cd.synopsis: In DILFS movie, after moving to a new city, events out of Jordan’s control force her and her daughter to stay with three sexy single dads: Mason, who is gruff and bristly with a tragic past; Landon, the bad boy charmer; and Eli, your ice king boss. But after a night of passion with all three of them, Jordan finds herself pregnant. Which DILF is the father?
676e620de4d70b4ba105e2cd.title: DILFS

676f15658115af7a38038820.synopsis: Married moments after meeting for the first time, new couple Maya Moore and Ethan Armstrong attempt to make their spontaneous marriage work despite interference from their enemies and Maya’s mysterious past.
676f15658115af7a38038820.title: Hello, Let's Get Married

6771c32e13a2b724ec0341ca.synopsis: When Katie's younger sister's cancer worsens, she finds herself signing a contract to give birth to a mysterious billionaire's heir. However, when proving their relationship to the CEO's grandpa turns out to be more difficult than expected, Katie and Mr. Brandt find themselves growing closer to one another, despite the contract's one and only rule: no falling in love.
6771c32e13a2b724ec0341ca.title: Baby Trapped by the Billionaire

677352c9ba6133358b0d6915.synopsis: Meg and Jesse gets bubbly as they ring in the new year with Rachel Bencosme for a fun, reflective, and slightly competitive episode! The duo takes a trip down memory lane to revisit the biggest trends that made 2024 unforgettable. Did they hop on the latest TikTok lingo? Did they rock any of the Gen Z fashion fads?
