Reborn, Evelyn's motto is simple: she deals with problems with just action, no talk. When the impostor schemes against her, she retaliates. When her brother picks a fight, she has him arrested... But Lawson, the charming heir who proposed a purely transactional alliance, has become an unexpected complication. Now that her revenge is complete, why won't he leave her side?
69840a5f797bc850ea08ed3d.title: Mad Heiress Unleashed

69840aae74a8087cf002ad7e.synopsis: Henry, a salvager in the dangerous Mynara Sea, is swept away by a storm and gains the legendary Trident of the Sea King, unlocking a supernatural power to see treasure locations. With his newfound abilities, he navigates the treacherous waters, forms alliances with loyal Milo and merchant heiress Sophia, and rises to become the wealthiest and most powerful King of the Sea, determined to conquer the world’s oceans.
69840aae74a8087cf002ad7e.title: The Ocean's Gaze

69840ae27d5c7e868c0e7ae2.synopsis: Mason, a small worker in an antique shop, broke a vase, saved a Divine Dragon, and unexpectedly received the magic power Divine Vision! From then on, counterfeits and fakes could no longer hide. He helped his beautiful boss Clara resolve the crisis, becoming the best appraiser. Big shots from the capital lined up to give money to him! Mason constantly rose and became famous...
69840ae27d5c7e868c0e7ae2.title: Appraiser's Ascension

69840c1593ee7cb2c706be3e.synopsis: After two years at war, Andrew Garrison returns—not to his wife Lesley, but to his sister-in-law Evelyn. Unbeknownst to the Garrison family, Lesley is no helpless wife: she's the student of a renowned healer. While Andrew and Evelyn indulge in their affair, Lesley quietly revives the "deceased" heir Edward and seizes control of the household. In a mansion filled with lies and betrayal, she turns from the scorned woman into the master player.
69840c1593ee7cb2c706be3e.title: Dumped? She's Upgrading!

6984126daf663917f007a406.synopsis: Ethan, raised as an illegitimate child, lives with his mother until his estranged father, Matthew Lewis, reappears on his 18th birthday. Matthew, a feared kingpin, brings Ethan into his world, but it's a family built on cold deals, not love. To save his mother's life, Ethan agrees to serve the underworld. Thrust into a brutal world of crime and loyalty, he fights for those he loves and rises to make the entire underworld tremble. No regrets, no turning back.
6984126daf663917f007a406.title: From Pushover to Underworld Big Shot

698544a5524bab6f6f03e13c.synopsis: Ever wondered what it’s like to spend a day on set with a vertical actor? Savannah Coffee and Blake Lewis take us behind the scenes of their morning routines, sharing their favorite Laifen products that help them get ready for a long day on set. Get the inside scoop on all the glam in this week’s episode of ReelTalk.
698544a5524bab6f6f03e13c.title: ReelTalk EP 60-Spend a Day with Me on Set

698547cf937ed69992046f6d.synopsis: Sydney, secretly the heiress of Lawrence Group, marries Jackson Johnson and buys a house with her own money. But three months into her pregnancy, her mother-in-law, Gloria, moves in, claiming Sydney's home for her son, Jordan. What begins as a battle over family greed and entitlement turns into a war for Sydney's dignity. Justice may be delayed, but it's never denied.
698547cf937ed69992046f6d.title: My Mother-in-Law Wants My House

69857e7ef17e736a77090401.synopsis: All Damon Hayes wanted was to stay hidden in his new cultivation world, quietly enduring his humble job as a night soil collector. That plan was shattered the day he awakened the Intelligent Cultivation System. Instead of a godly tool for ascension, it became his personal guide to hell—stealing from a Demonic Sect Elder, offending the Demonic Saintess, and painting a target on his back for every powerful being in the realm. Now, as a forbidden technique descends upon him and the Saintess sharpens her blade, Damon has just one question for the system: “Was keeping a low profile really that hard?!”
69857e7ef17e736a77090401.title: The Lazy Immortal's Nightmare

69857f83b18aa925de0a090e.synopsis: Maya Nolan, once an abducted heiress, is now the world's top hacker and head of an assassin organization. But she's back for revenge. She infiltrates the Kane household under false pretenses, only to engage in cat and mouse game with her nemesis, the DarkNet Lord, Sebastian. In this crafted vendetta, who will be the ultimate mastermind?
69857f83b18aa925de0a090e.title: Who's Playing Whom?

6985800557e59287390ca4b1.synopsis: Daniel transmigrates into the body of a degenerate gambler, only to wake up and realize his own wife has just poisoned him. Salvation arrives in the form of the "Daily Intelligence System", which grants him crucial foresight each day. Seizing this second chance, Daniel completely reforms, and leverages modern knowledge to introduce advanced firearms, single-handedly turning the tide of battle and earning a noble title. Yet, his greatest challenge comes not from war, but from a rift in time itself, threatening to separate him from the wife he has grown to cherish.
6985800557e59287390ca4b1.title: Did You Just Poison Me, Wife?

6985986605b93e2be30a8c36.synopsis: Reborn as a five-year-old, Talia only wants to protect her mother. But her charm and secret talents soon win over powerful elders and silence the doubters. With a tycoon father, an even richer stepfather, and a future billionaire husband, she grows up as the family's darling, proving that even the smallest star can shine the brightest.
6985986605b93e2be30a8c36.title: Hey Mommy! Time for a New Daddy!

6985aa19b22a3493e806a571.synopsis: Determined to bear a child for her husband, Kyle Baker, Lauren Horton undergoes a risky heart surgery. Little does she know, Kyle is having an affair with intern Grace. During her surgery, Grace makes a critical mistake, but Kyle abandons Lauren on the operating table and leaves with Grace. But soon, he's going to regret it.
6985aa19b22a3493e806a571.title: My Husband, My Killer

69893d5e7adbe9e0af02c669.synopsis: "I'm Jason Hayes, and today, I am reborn. In my past life, I was weak. In this one, I choose to be the villain." From a humble waiter to the king of the underworld, Jason fights back against every bully and outmaneuvers the most powerful figures, including the father-in-law of a crime lord. His ironclad rule: touch what's mine, and you won't survive. Only when he stops stepping aside does Jason learn a brutal truth: the world makes way for those who refuse to move.
69893d5e7adbe9e0af02c669.title: He's Done Being Nice

69894eda02c476566206e5bb.synopsis: They butchered his clan when he was just a boy. A shadow killer pulled him from the ashes and spent fifteen years forging the orphan's grief into a sword, dressed in vengeance. Now, the blade is aimed at the one who erased his past!
69894eda02c476566206e5bb.title: He Who Rises for Blood

69894f2c3428950d97075ec6.synopsis: Evelyn Grant exposes Max Lang using the Grant family for power while cheating with Serena Rivers. She exacts revenge at her wedding and later finds true love with Adrian Preston.
69894f2c3428950d97075ec6.title: Burn at Her Wedding

69894f5dbc0ab958110f10f9.synopsis: Two decades ago, the esteemed Big Nine clans conspired to annihilate the Reid family. Craig Reid, the only survivor, was rescued by a sagacious master who recognized his potential. Under her guidance, Craig's extraordinary talent propelled him to the zenith of earthly cultivation, poised for ascension. Yet, the anticipated heavenly tribulation never came. His master, sensing that Craig's destiny was tangled with unresolved karma, expelled him from the sect. Now, Craig crosses paths with Zoe Zimmer and finds himself drawn into her battle against one of the Big Nine. Maybe this is the key to his long-awaited breakthrough.
69894f5dbc0ab958110f10f9.title: Crimson Storm: Lone Avenger

6989502b9108d65a150beeb0.synopsis: A quirky "Confession System" grants Alfred Carter rewards for professing love—but gives him only three chances to win the heart of his boss, Serena Harris. If she doesn't truly fall for him, he's dead. After a bold first move, Alfred doubles down with audacious flair, unexpectedly catching Serena's eye. But just as sparks fly, Chester Renwick targets her life force. Now Alfred must protect the woman he's trying to love—or they'll both lose everything.
6989502b9108d65a150beeb0.title: I Have a System, She Has My Heart

6989507a210388144101a21e.synopsis: When lawyer Elaine is accused of harboring her son who assaulted a neighbor, she must prove her only "son" is actually her dog, Cole. But the conspiracy deepens: fake DNA reports, a sudden pregnancy, and even her long-lost father return to torment her. Trapped in a web of lies and public shame, Elaine fights not just for her reputation, but to expose a ruthless scheme targeting single women.
6989507a210388144101a21e.title: The Prey's Counterattack

69897fe76ccc6463510d1af6.synopsis: After an accident, modern weapons expert Wendy awakens in ancient times in the body of a notorious lovestruck girl and must marry by twenty or face prison. She chooses the shy yet handsome Prince Zeller, but when war descends, she turns genius into firepower, forging weapons, saving the kingdom, and turning a forced match into true love.
69897fe76ccc6463510d1af6.title: The Prince and His Precious Vixen

698980a71775764b9a05a761.synopsis: After catching her fiancé cheating, Faith survives a car accident and is rescued by Grandma Zimmer, who mentors her into the Vice CEO of Zimmer Group. The spoiled heir Sam falls for her at first sight. Their arranged marriage sparks chaos, comedy, and unexpected romance.
698980a71775764b9a05a761.title: The Heir's Daily Confession

698a91d9056e74e3a406858d.synopsis: Victoria Bennett has it all: wealth, status, and Adrian Sinclair, a billionaire heir obsessed with marrying her. But her world is built on a lie. On the eve of their wedding, Victoria makes an unforgivable choice to pacify Ethan's suicidal threats, shattering Adrian's trust forever. At the altar, Adrian replaces her with Madeleine Lang.
698a91d9056e74e3a406858d.title: The Last Time I Forgive

698aa5b145e941c96d02e26a.synopsis: Grace Shaw, drugged while saving a man overseas, has a one-night stand with a stranger, Nathan Fenton. Back home, Nathan returns to break off an engagement. But he didn't know his fiancée was Grace. To reclaim her family's company, Grace forces him to stay engaged. Neither knows the other's true identity. Secrets and missed chances keep them apart until the truth surfaces, the past is revealed, and love finds its way back.
698aa5b145e941c96d02e26a.title: One-Night Stand With the Right Man

698aa7692b6093d39b007d83.synopsis: Sugar was adopted by the Millers but got abused and regarded as a demon due to her supernatural abilities. Actually, she was the granddaughter of Lord Underworld. Her dad knew about Sugar's background and rushed to find the Millers. By then, Sugar had been sold to a research institute. Her dad rescued Sugar in time and brought her back home. Sugar cured her Grandma, helped Uncle Chase stand up, and resolved the crisis of Uncle Jasper. Finally, she smashed the scheme of Lord Julian and reunited with her Grandpa, Lord Underworld.
698aa7692b6093d39b007d83.title: The Girl Who Healed Death

698aa797e37e04d9f60ca689.synopsis: On his engagement day, Bentley catches his fiancée's mother Cynthia in bed with her childhood friend Derek York. Before he can expose them, he's killed in a staged accident. Reborn on that same fateful day, Bentley has a new weapon: a live broadcast. He secretly administers an aphrodisiac to the illicit couple, streaming their compromising moment to the entire guest list. However, Bentley's quest for vengeance delves even deeper. His investigation uncovers a sinister plot involving Derek and his father. Bentley seizes this chance to decisively eliminate Derek, leaving his fiancée's family in regret...
698aa797e37e04d9f60ca689.title: Airing Their Dirty Laundry

698ac6b65204afad3507202d.synopsis: My little sister fell into a deathlike trance when she was six. I buried her with my own hands, thinking she was gone forever. But ten years later, she walked back into my life—just in time to save me from hell. Now the powerful family torturing me is about to learn the hard way: mess with my sister, and you answer to a goddess.
698ac6b65204afad3507202d.title: My Sister Is the Phoenix

698ac6feaefc0e37bc078596.synopsis: Empress Dowager Selena Hale is poisoned and reincarnated as Clara Satin, the illegitimate daughter of the Prime Minister. Shockingly, she becomes the concubine of her own adopted son, the reigning Emperor Saul Rex. Obsessed with his "mother," Saul conducts a three-year ritual to summon her spirit, unaware it now resides within Clara. Initially determined to escape the palace, Clara finds herself gradually drawn to Saul...
698ac6feaefc0e37bc078596.title: Entwined by Fate, Reborn to Love

698ac72855539fb4b50f1f81.synopsis: Fayne Carter wakes up as a despised live-in son-in-law, constantly humiliated by his cheating wife and her lover. Just when he's about to snap, he unlocks a game-changing system: spend on his "wife" and get 10x cash back. But Fayne quickly discovers a loophole—any married woman qualifies. From his mother-in-law to his rival's wife, he starts spoiling them all, stacking millions while turning the tables on everyone who once looked down on him.
698ac72855539fb4b50f1f81.title: Bugged Love: Spoiling His Wives

698ac752905a24e1b40a03da.synopsis: Maeve Astor, the time-traveling Princess Imperial of Zhouland, spends a decade transforming her husband, Alex Roy, from a penniless guy into a business tycoon. She even donates her kidney to him. Yet, during his sister's engagement party, Alex brazenly arrives with his mistress and their love child. Maeve finally awakens and secretly initiates a financial reckoning. She leaves behind three explosive documents that will bring her betrayers to their graves.
698ac752905a24e1b40a03da.title: He Begged, She Left

698af4a70cf40cc901023963.synopsis: Six years ago, Nina had a one-night affair with Dragon Sovereign Jayden, resulting in twins, her daughter Talia raised by her, and their other daughter taken by Jayden to the dragon clan. Six years later, Nina returns, determined to find Jayden for her daughter's treatment. When the twins are mistaken for each other, misunderstandings pile up, but through their matchmaking, Nina and Jayden are reunited, and all truths finally come to light.
698af4a70cf40cc901023963.title: Fated to Love the Dragon Again

698af5d5d250ba389b084f7a.synopsis: Ethan Lance, at Deity Transformation Stage, descends the mountain to find his disciples ruling the city.
698af5d5d250ba389b084f7a.title: Any Global Tycoon Is My Disciple

698af62315bf0d110a06acbe.synopsis: Ethan Lance, at Deity Transformation Stage, descends the mountain to find his disciples ruling the city.
698af62315bf0d110a06acbe.title: Any Global Tycoon Is My Disciple

698b070947fa4ef43f04a872.synopsis: A duke's daughter once propelled her husband to become a legendary general, only to face betrayal and execution at the hands of him and his mother. Reborn from the ashes, she returns with a steely resolve and a heart of ice. Methodically, she dismantles those who wronged her: vanquishing her cunning half-sister, executing her malicious stepmother, reclaiming her mother's stolen dowry, and ensuring her treacherous husband and his favored concubine meet their end by her sword.
698b070947fa4ef43f04a872.title: From General's Scorned Wife to His Final Judgment

698b081c2eb059d87c0e5ff4.synopsis: Evelyn, a modern food delivery worker, catches her boyfriend cheating and storms off, only to be whisked by her glowing jade pendant into the imperial palace of the Everlasting Kingdom. Using pizza, she cures Emperor Elliot's eating disorder and avoids danger. Discovering her delivery box preserves items across time, she trades ancient goods for cash to help her mother. Traveling between eras, she aids Elliot in palace and battlefield crises and sparks a romance that spans time itself.
698b081c2eb059d87c0e5ff4.title: Delivery to the Emperor

698bef948a4eb4de720d8482.synopsis: Nick Hale, who just got out of Dragon Prison, takes a mission from a dying cellmate, Don Rossi, protect his sister, Jade. Nick hides himself as a simple dojo janitor. However, when a rival challenges Jade to a life-or-death duel in seven days, he decides to step in. In the ring, Nick is going to shock everyone with his power.
698bef948a4eb4de720d8482.title: Ex-Convict Janitor and His Heiress

698c6c746633251c22050abc.synopsis: The Sterling curse strikes again—Arthur Sterling is poisoned. Berry fights to save him, but trouble arrives when Arthur’s jealous adopted daughter, Joanna, returns from abroad, teaming up with a girl claiming to be the family’s “Chosen Girl” to take Berry down. With Paxton and new ally Drake by her side, Berry survives the chaos—and emerges as the one true heiress.
698c6c746633251c22050abc.title: Little Heiress, Big Daddy 2

698c6cb93a6e97d8d703baf3.synopsis: Ethan Hayes travels back to the millennium with X-Ray vision. He finds Philip's artifact and Emperor Kane's porcelain. With Grace, he fights smugglers to retrieve lost treasures.
698c6cb93a6e97d8d703baf3.title: REBORN 2008: X-RAY VISION

698c6ce5c0f7679f8807f8cd.synopsis: When the evil cultivator Evan was cultivating with some ladies in the Immortal Realm, he fell into the mortal world and was transported to the body of a timid man with the same name. The original owner was imprisoned by his paranoid and spoiled fiancee, not allowed to leave the bedroom, and suffered humiliation. His two sisters-in-law also despised him for lacking masculinity, causing him great suffering. On the night when Evan was possessed by the evil cultivator, his spoiled fiancee came. This once timid fiance suddenly became a badass...
698c6ce5c0f7679f8807f8cd.title: The Devil in Disguise

698c6d6db14ad8ff000cfd92.synopsis: He was just a nobody dock worker. After an accident unlocks a power in his eyes, he starts seeing through every shipping container. What starts as stealing from the rich turns into a full-blown war against pirates and the mob. He's building an empire one secret at a time. This isn't just luck—it's the ultimate underdog story, powered by vision and guts.
698c6d6db14ad8ff000cfd92.title: The Unsealer

698da2dcadd4b743a80e2b5f.synopsis: Vivian, a 200-pound mother of three, is neglected by her husband and bullied by his childhood friend who covets her place. But fate intervenes when the soul of an Empress awakens within her. The ancient ruler wastes no time—shedding weight, reclaiming beauty, and seizing her own destiny. As a dazzling new Vivian emerges, her husband scrambles to win her back. But her eyes are set on a far grander prize: building an empire of her own.
698da2dcadd4b743a80e2b5f.title: Reborn Queen in the Modern World

698db830f71689fad4024f1d.synopsis: In her previous life, Evelyn was the spoiled Collins heiress. Her fiance Bill suddenly got back a girl named Lila, claiming Lila was the true Collins heiress who had been lost. On the wedding day, Lila's birth parents switched the wedding car, making Evelyn marry Bill's brother Victor, who had jinxed five wives. Evelyn forced Bill to marry her, but all she got was three years of cold marriage. Bill died and wanted to be with Lila in the next life. After rebirth, when the wedding car stopped, Evelyn chose Victor, becoming Bill's sister-in-law.
698db830f71689fad4024f1d.title: The Second Life Vow

698dba8acbc92f415300583b.synopsis: Star astronaut Maya discovers her husband in bed with a TV reporter. His excuse? A fake twin brother. She plays along, boards her shuttle to explore a black hole—and returns a different woman.
698dba8acbc92f415300583b.title: Orbiting Betrayal

698dbac16d6b6726930483a8.synopsis: CEO Elaine Langley finds her husband Kevin Hayes gifted her villa to mistress Fiona Monroe. Elaine exacts revenge on the betrayers.
698dbac16d6b6726930483a8.title: She Fled Hell Only to Marry Fate

698e68c49622da8bce0300d2.synopsis: Take a romantic long walk on the beach in this ReelTalk Valentine’s Day special! Jesse Morales and Seth Edeen open up about their dating styles and it just might make you fall head over heels all over again.
698e68c49622da8bce0300d2.title: ReelTalk EP 61-Beachside Valentine's

698f5880288ee1b4750751f5.synopsis: Yvette, orphaned daughter of a fallen general, once married Crown Prince Jeremy and suffered endless humiliation. Reborn on the day of the imperial marriage decree, she refuses to repeat her fate. This time, she chooses the Emperor's injured brother, Prince Yale. Miraculously awakened, Yale gives her respect and protection, and love grows between them, while Jeremy, recalling the past, realizes too late he has lost her forever.
698f5880288ee1b4750751f5.title: My Nephew, The Crown Prince

6991371b5b3b38697f0aa016.synopsis: During seven years of marriage to Ethan Grant, Vivian Whitmore has endured endless neglect as her husband openly favors his "dream girl", Angela. On their child's full-month celebration, Vivian reaches her breaking point. She announces divorce before all the guests, reveals the baby isn't Ethan's, and pulls her investments—plunging the Grant empire into chaos. The truth exposed and her revenge served, Vivian walks away with her child, leaving Ethan drowning in regret he can never undo.
6991371b5b3b38697f0aa016.title: I Took It All Back

699162c39ba5fa692c0b9368.synopsis: Two decades ago, the esteemed Big Nine clans conspired to annihilate the Reid family. Craig Reid, the only survivor, was rescued by a sagacious master who recognized his potential. Under his guidance, Craig's extraordinary talent propelled him to the zenith of earthly cultivation, poised for ascension. Yet, the anticipated heavenly tribulation never came. His master, sensing that Craig's destiny was tangled with unresolved karma, expelled him from the sect. Now, Craig crosses paths with Zoe Zimmer and finds himself drawn into her battle against one of the Big Nine. Maybe this is the key to his long-awaited breakthrough.
699162c39ba5fa692c0b9368.title: Crimson Storm: Lone Avenger

699163d1565822437b0a35aa.synopsis: Elaine Carver is reborn on the day her brother, Ryan, demands she buy him a luxury car. In her past life, this single act buried her under crippling debt and led to her death. Now armed with foresight, she watches coldly as Ryan runs up an astronomical bill at the dealership. When the final invoice—a staggering 100 million—is presented, Elaine refuses to pay. Her family is left in shock. This time, Elaine is fighting back, and they are about to face the full consequences of their greed.
699163d1565822437b0a35aa.title: Sister's Rebirth

6991fd22d0367cdc4008c77b.synopsis: Fired from Pelagia University after her lifebond beast died, Lydia Quinn summons Lucas King, a Rank FFF little zombie hiding SSS-tier powers. Together, they win the National Mentor Assessment despite sabotage. Now VP at Drayne University, Lydia faces a deadly trap. Surrounded by Bosses at antimagic domain, Lucas removes his Corpse-Suppressing Talisman, unleashing chaos, until Lydia's kiss brings him back.
6991fd22d0367cdc4008c77b.title: Zombie King Rise: Even the Belle Begs Me

6991fdca4641e509290a004f.synopsis: Solar storms strike the Inferno, trapping 8 billion people in a deadly survival game. Betrayed and killed the ones he trusts, Alex is reborn with the 100x Resource Multiplier System. Unlimited resources. Infinite upgrades. This time, he’ll kill the big Boss and claim victory!
6991fdca4641e509290a004f.title: Doomsday Game: Unlimited Shelter Upgrades

6991fe579fbdbd2bea07ad9b.synopsis: Alex Hayes awakens a System to build an Underworld University, teaching ghost-hunting, corpse-driving, corpse retrieval, and shaman-healer arts. As the school's fame grew, Alex took in more students and ascended to immortality through the Nether Path.
6991fe579fbdbd2bea07ad9b.title: Conning Classmates into Underworld University

6991fe8e2af7111d3a0eb3bd.synopsis: While others break through the 10th level of Energy Refining stage, Ether Reed stands at the 9999th level. Techniques revered as imperial treasures are kindling to him, and legendary artifacts are simply his household items. Even the sacred beasts, worshipped by all, eagerly compete to guard his house. Enter a world where the extraordinary is just everyday life for Ether Reed.
6991fe8e2af7111d3a0eb3bd.title: Already Invincible at Energy Refining

699480c623c5511b8f0cf7f4.synopsis: By day, Brooklyn is a broke college student from the trailer park. But online, she’s Echo—a fearless gamer gunning for the $50,000 Blackgrove Reign tournament prize, her one shot at freedom. To win, she has to dethrone Thorne, the reigning champion. What she doesn’t know? Thorne is really Ethan—the hot, cocky frat king who also happens to be her TA… and her best friend’s older brother. After they butt heads in real life, Ethan discovers Brooklyn is Echo and enters the game to toy with her—only to find himself drawn to her skill, fire, and spirit. Online, they become unstoppable partners. Offline, they’re bitter rivals. When will Brooklyn realize Ethan is Thorne, and can these sworn enemies stop fighting long enough to see they’re perfect for each other?
699480c623c5511b8f0cf7f4.title: Outplayed

6994c7def370c522ef066652.synopsis: In The Billionaire and the Baby Trap movie, to get out of her loveless marriage, Elara needs to get pregnant, but her husband refuses to touch her. One fateful night, she finds herself in Cole's arms, not knowing he's a secret billionaire CEO -- and her husband's uncle. When will Elara realize Cole's identity -- and that he's just the Mr. Right she's been looking for.
6994c7def370c522ef066652.title: The Billionaire and the Baby Trap

6995279a2cf4914de40f37a3.synopsis: A duke's daughter once propelled her husband to become a legendary general, only to face betrayal and execution at the hands of him and his mother. Reborn from the ashes, she returns with a steely resolve and a heart of ice. Methodically, she dismantles those who wronged her: vanquishing her cunning half-sister, executing her malicious stepmother, reclaiming her mother's stolen dowry, and ensuring her treacherous husband and his favored concubine meet their end by her sword.
6995279a2cf4914de40f37a3.title: From General's Scorned Wife to His Final Judgment

6997b6c7345c5a613e0de2e7.synopsis: #CrocsPartner We’re keeping the romance alive! Savannah and Micheal from our new show Charmed to Meet You spill all about dating apps and what their Jibbitz charms might be signaling to potential matches. Plus, don’t miss the juicy tea on their ideal types and who they’d write a love letter to using Jibbitz charms!
6997b6c7345c5a613e0de2e7.title: ReelTalk EP 62-Dating App Confessions

69990ddfa1b763a13b0e97fe.synopsis: Isaac Kane is a single father with a dark secret: he was once the most feared killer on the planet. After making a vow to his dying wife to never kill again, he now spends his days as a down-on-his-luck single father. But when his daughter is kidnapped by a major crime family, he must break his vow... and kill his way through the Russian Mafia, while re-taking his place as a near-mythic killer that haunts the nightmares of the wicked.
69990ddfa1b763a13b0e97fe.title: Return of the Reaper

6999c0e37b131be77a0c302c.synopsis: While Bluewave Holdings' CEO Matthew is away, his deputy Zoe holds the company together until an intern, Melody, falsely claims she's pregnant with his child to grab power. Her deception escalates into workplace sabotage and a damaged deal. When Matthew returns, he exposes the truth, and amid the fallout, he and Zoe finally see that trust has grown into love.
6999c0e37b131be77a0c302c.title: The Impostor's Diadem

6999c2c5813f9ac02b04931d.synopsis: On his wedding night, Adrian wakes up and finds that his bride's in his cousin's bed. Humiliated. Mocked. But Adrian's not the fool they remember. He's armed with a system that turns black sheep into legends—poetry, martial arts, medicine, business. He masters it all overnight. His secret weapon? Claire Collins. The noble lady who was forced to marry him. Except she's lived this life before—and this time, she chose him.
6999c2c5813f9ac02b04931d.title: Smile and Endure? Not This Time

699a3b6b850d2b8e8208155f.synopsis: Maria’s perfect life crumbles when she discovers her fiancé's affair. Determined to take control, she confronts betrayal, finds herself drawn to Alec, her long-lost ex and now a billionaire. As their paths collide, old feelings awaken, and Maria discovers that love can be unexpected, passionate, and impossible to ignore.
699a3b6b850d2b8e8208155f.title: Cancel the Wedding, Queen Moves On

699c01467466f67723080afb.synopsis: Fayne Carter wakes up as a despised live-in son-in-law, constantly humiliated by his cheating wife and her lover. Just when he's about to snap, he unlocks a game-changing system: spend on his "wife" and get 10x cash back. But Fayne quickly discovers a loophole—any married woman qualifies. From his mother-in-law to his rival's wife, he starts spoiling them all, stacking millions while turning the tables on everyone who once looked down on him.
699c01467466f67723080afb.title: Bugged Love: Spoiling His Wives

699c01cdca499949fd019b54.synopsis: Ethan Hayes travels back to the millennium with X-Ray vision. He finds Philip's artifact and Emperor Kane's porcelain. With Grace, he fights smugglers to retrieve lost treasures.
699c01cdca499949fd019b54.title: REBORN 2008: X-RAY VISION

699d06356f90da5e330090d7.synopsis: Reborn and reunited with her family after a decade, Pauline found her remarried parents bankrupt. But actually, Mom and Dad were both hidden big shots. There was a big family lie. And their love was the only thing real. As the truth came out, Pauline chose to enjoy the show and protect her family, just as they protected her.
699d06356f90da5e330090d7.title: The Art of Loving You

699d47ee9911429e390e3cbc.synopsis: In Tempting the Mafia Twins movie, Genesis discovers her mob boss husband, Kiefer's affair, and loses one of her twin babies due to his mistress' schemes. Genesis reports him to the authorities and flees while still pregnant. Seven years later, Genesis runs into Kiefer on the street. She thinks her murderous husband is going to kill her, but when Kiefer drags her back home against her will, she realizes the truth: Seven years ago, it was all a misunderstanding. Kiefer O’Reilly, the ruthless mafia boss, only wants one thing—to win Genesis’s love back.
699d47ee9911429e390e3cbc.title: Tempting the Mafia Twins

699d6310beec5d276e049e26.synopsis: Reborn in a city ravaged by the T-virus, Ethan Shaw discovers the System that lets him form the "Professional Goddess Squad." They raid stores, hoard supplies, and fight back against the ever-evolving undead.
699d6310beec5d276e049e26.title: Reborn: Leading Goddesses Against the Apocalypse

699d78f26350566c58068107.synopsis: When Zoe discovers a mysterious mask, she gains an extraordinary power: the ability to see the true value of any artifact. With her devoted father, David, by her side, she turns overlooked junk into life-changing treasures. But their success catches the eye of ruthless billionaire Dylan Langford, who will stop at nothing to crush them. In a world of greed and deception, one girl's gift might be the only thing that's real.
699d78f26350566c58068107.title: The Girl Who Sees Through Everything

699d7972e9f52c52fe035979.synopsis: Ethan Drake, an overworked intern, awakens a supernatural power: x-ray vision. Overnight, his life transforms from mundane to legendary. A stunning CEO becomes his personal secretary, his long-admired campus crush falls for him, and a billionaire heiress stays faithfully by his side. When the most powerful family in the state names him their sole heir, Ethan's rise is complete—from corporate nobody to unrivaled master of treasure and desire.
699d7972e9f52c52fe035979.title: See It, Own It, Rule It

699d799d8871b3ab92040336.synopsis: When Nina's father falls gravely ill, she's desperate for money until her family jade pendant unlocks a supernatural gift: the ability to see hidden truths and buried value. With her all-seeing vision, she wins the lottery, strikes gold, dominates the stock market, and uncovers priceless treasures. After saving Wade, head of the Yates Group, she steps into the business world, outmaneuvering rivals and building a powerful empire from the ground up.
699d799d8871b3ab92040336.title: The Empire She Saw Coming

699d888f56c50b74ee0ff75a.synopsis: Three years ago, Hades Cross was dispatched on a mission abroad and became a legend among the mercenaries. Now, returning home, his new mission is to investigate the Styx Syndicate. Hired as Diana Chase's personal bodyguard, Hades finds that the danger escalates with every step he takes.
699d888f56c50b74ee0ff75a.title: The Reaper's Contract

699def8dc8ae4aecf6097b59.synopsis: In Vicious movie, after Vicious bullies Emilia out of town, he reappears years later with an offer she can’t refuse: A job that could keep her afloat. But Vicious is haunted by a past of abuse, and trusting him could drag Emilia back into the world that once broke her... Can she let herself fall for him?
699def8dc8ae4aecf6097b59.title: Vicious

699e56d3e19b0b1c3201615b.synopsis: Deemed a waste, he's a transmigrator who awakens a system in the womb! Mastering the Ancient Sacred Body, he stuns the Immortal Realm at birth. Humiliated? He awakens the Supreme Bone. Oppressed? He crushes foes instantly. From outcast to Supreme Being, his invincible path is destined from the womb.
699e56d3e19b0b1c3201615b.title: Legend in the Making [Season One]

699e599c8ccacf8cb30e4af9.synopsis: Charles was brutally killed in his past life. Reborn with the powerful Devouring Bloodline, he sets out to avenge his enemies and right the wrongs of his past. As he devours power to grow stronger, he fights to protect his family and stands against foreign races, determined to save humanity from destruction.
699e599c8ccacf8cb30e4af9.title: The Devouring Avenger's Return

699ecd40beec5d276e049e39.synopsis: Victoria Bennett has it all: wealth, status, and Adrian Sinclair, a billionaire heir obsessed with marrying her. But her world is built on a lie. On the eve of their wedding, Victoria makes an unforgivable choice to pacify Ethan's suicidal threats, shattering Adrian's trust forever. At the altar, Adrian replaces her with Madeleine Lang.
699ecd40beec5d276e049e39.title: The Last Time I Forgive

69a0d16b1535460c9b051a0f.synopsis: Introducing the ReelHotline on ReelTalk! For the first time ever, fans can call their favorite vertical stars and ask the burning questions they’ve been dying to know. In this episode, Jesse picks up the phone and shares stories and secrets you’ve never heard before.
69a0d16b1535460c9b051a0f.title: ReelTalk EP 63-ReelHotline with Jesse

69a101b367c6be143b0d783c.synopsis: The supernatural returned—and the world panicked. Everyone except Alex Carter. While others trembled at shadows, he saw strange prompts only he could read. He clocked in as an orderly at the Hell Hospital, waited tables at the Hell Hotel, manned the desk at the Samsara Internet Cafe... and then built a prison that could hold gods. In a world of nightmares, Alex Carter was living his best life.
69a101b367c6be143b0d783c.title: Netherworld Manager

69a10a131a8c8bc1c30b6b8b.synopsis: He was once despised as a worthless failure, a man who drove his own family to ruin while chasing the favor of the powerful. Then he died—and woke up reborn, carrying five thousand years of immortal wisdom in his soul. Now, facing his dying mother and bitter sister, he swears to rewrite fate. Watch as the Immortal Sovereign returns to walk among mortals, settling old scores and shaking the world to its core.
69a10a131a8c8bc1c30b6b8b.title: I Returned, Everyone Else Fell

69a10b8cf8cf90cc4607943a.synopsis: I was reborn three hours before the apocalypse broke out, awakening with an Emotion Point System. In my previous life, I was tricked, killed, and eaten by my fiancee and a bully. In this life, I've cleared all my online loans, sold all my properties, and stocked up on supplies. Watch me as I exact my revenge on the cheating bitch, slay the bully, conquer apartment buildings, residential areas, communities, and even cities. I'll step by step uncover the truth behind the apocalypse.
69a10b8cf8cf90cc4607943a.title: Last Three Hours: Fortress of Rage

69a112d5ee4048bde00e2a03.synopsis: Transmigrated into a noble lady, Evelyn Shaw—once a special forces queen—now leads a double life. By day, she's the frail fiancée of Prince Adrian Lancaster. By night, she's the legendary leader of the Blackwind Bandits, Evie, fighting for justice. But when Adrian grows suspicious of his "delicate" fiancée, the hunt begins. Can Evelyn keep her mask on, or will the prince uncover the bandit hiding in his own home?
69a112d5ee4048bde00e2a03.title: My Husband, My Hunter

69a11334d9d157970a032080.synopsis: Pamela Frost is promoted to partner and awarded shares worth billions. Amidst the festivities, she receives a prank lottery ticket. She brings the ticket home, but her husband, Drew Tyson, and her mother-in-law mistake it for a genuine two-billion-dollar jackpot. Their greed is laid bare, and Drew confesses to an affair with Pamela's best friend. Pamela planned to reveal the truth, but she's changed her mind. Let the truth crush the villains.
69a11334d9d157970a032080.title: Divorced Over a Fake Ticket

69a1e36416c5b054630ec69a.synopsis: In My Duplicated Husband movie, for five years, Esther has been trapped in an abusive marriage. Her husband, Carl, cheated on her, was physically violent, and indirectly caused the death of their daughter. On their fifth wedding anniversary, during another violent confrontation, Carl dies accidentally. In shock, Esther buries his body in the backyard and goes to sleep. The next morning, Carl appears in front of her again — alive and behaving like the caring, gentle man he once was when they first fell in love. His personality no longer matches the abusive husband she buried. Esther begins to question what is happening. Did Carl somehow return from the dead, or has someone replaced him?
69a1e36416c5b054630ec69a.title: My Duplicated Husband

69a25e0df934d7d5dc0d387c.synopsis: In her past life, her husband's betrayal cost her everything. Reborn at the lowest point, she refuses to be a victim again. With a second chance and a secret space, she's done playing nice!
69a25e0df934d7d5dc0d387c.title: Rewriting the 1980s

69a25e490d82ad7760075189.synopsis: She sacrificed everything—her family, her fortune, her identity—to marry the man she loved, helping him rise from nothing to build a business empire, trusting his promise: "You will be my one and only, forever." However, that promise shatters when his mother's bestie returns from abroad, insisting on moving in as his "personal maid". As she infiltrates their lives, their love begins to crumble from within...
69a25e490d82ad7760075189.title: Love Betrayed

69a25e929841fac1ad056daa.synopsis: Nala Gomez, once a privileged heiress, falls victim to her cousin's jealousy and betrayal. Conspired against by her own best friend, she loses her fiancé and is sold overseas. Hitting rock bottom, she rises with ferocious determination and swears to turn the tables on her tormentors. Crowned as the Lioness Queen, she returns with a storm of vengeance.
69a25e929841fac1ad056daa.title: The Return of the Lioness Queen

69a2be1326c6b85454084f27.synopsis: Carson, the last heir of the Imperial Ascendant Lineage, is betrayed and forced to self-destruct by the Three Supreme Lords. Reborn at 20 with his memories intact, he vows revenge. With the help of Victor Yates and his family, Carson exposes his manipulative ex, crushes arrogant elites, and defeats Grandmaster Cyrus. Rising to power, he becomes the most feared figure in Newhaven, ready to claim his rightful place at the top.
69a2be1326c6b85454084f27.title: Reborn and Became a Legend

69a4f02402dfa284670b428a.synopsis: Caspian's the best special forces soldier the world's ever seen. Desperate to find out what happened to his parents, he takes on a dangerous mission — protect the genius CEO who found the cure for cancer, Chloe Brooks. Under constant attack from greedy men who want to take her cure for their own profit, Chloe will do anything to keep DIVINIA, the miracle drug, and her sister Iris safe. The only one who can help her? Caspian, who saves her time and time. But who IS he? Why is he so good at fighting? And can Chloe trust him, when their first meeting ended with a steamy one night stand!?
69a4f02402dfa284670b428a.title: The Magnificent Bodyguard

69a538156438e9f57b09a082.synopsis: Once the heiress to the Wild Group, Lyssa was slandered and betrayed. Her comeback plan is to use Greg Ryder as her pawn in her revenge game. Yet, she finds another shadowy figure pulling the strings from behind the scenes. To her surprise, Greg's sister, whom he cherishes deeply, is entwined in the Wild family's power struggles, holding secrets that could change everything.
69a538156438e9f57b09a082.title: Where Lies Bloom

69a5384142061564f30b509b.synopsis: After twenty years abroad, Reynold Zedler returns to Saltgrave—not only to find his estranged son, Dylan, but to uncover the truth behind his wife's murder. He finds Dylan living in poverty, working as a laborer, while Dylan's pregnant wife, Eva, is terrorized by the city's corrupt elite. As Reynold systematically dismantles the underworld that rules Saltgrave, he must reclaim his hidden power and reveal his true identity to protect the family he just found—before it's too late.
69a5384142061564f30b509b.title: A Father's Fangs

69a5513f26cd82dabc026d72.synopsis: Logan Collins, heir to a wealthy family, was framed by his first love and sent to prison. While incarcerated, his family was tragically killed, and their assets were seized by his ex-girlfriend Jenna Grant's family. The only surviving relative is his young aunt. Fortunately, during his time behind bars, Logan mastered extraordinary skills—antiques, appraisal, gambling, medicine, and even cultivation. Upon release, he emerges invincible. Watch as Logan protects his only remaining family and navigates the urban jungle with swift justice!
69a5513f26cd82dabc026d72.title: Reborn from Hell, Dragon's Wrath

69a551c1c117fbdcb2042f43.synopsis: Logan Collins, heir to a wealthy family, was framed by his first love and sent to prison. While incarcerated, his family was tragically killed, and their assets were seized by his ex-girlfriend Jenna Grant's family. The only surviving relative is his young aunt. Fortunately, during his time behind bars, Logan mastered extraordinary skills—antiques, appraisal, gambling, medicine, and even cultivation. Upon release, he emerges invincible. Watch as Logan protects his only remaining family and navigates the urban jungle with swift justice!
69a551c1c117fbdcb2042f43.title: Reborn from Hell, Dragon's Wrath

69a551eb9d036d03440e10df.synopsis: Ethan, raised as an illegitimate child, lives with his mother until his estranged father, Matthew Lewis, reappears on his 18th birthday. Matthew, a feared kingpin, brings Ethan into his world, but it's a family built on cold deals, not love. To save his mother's life, Ethan agrees to serve the underworld. Thrust into a brutal world of crime and loyalty, he fights for those he loves and rises to make the entire underworld tremble. No regrets, no turning back.
69a551eb9d036d03440e10df.title: From Pushover to Underworld Big Shot

69a5600225b65131f70c836f.synopsis: Zayden, Ivy's ex-husband, has become the ultimate victor in his family's power struggle. Years ago, Ivy left when he hit rock bottom, but now Zayden, still in love, demands she marry him again for revenge. Ivy was once seen as obedient and dull, but is secretly a fierce warrior and has left to join a peacekeeping mission. Now, with a second chance at marriage, Ivy returns stronger and more than ready to face Zayden's challenge. This time, she's not the woman he remembers.
69a5600225b65131f70c836f.title: My Ex-wife Is a Savage Warrior

69a56084cd3263ae7c0491b6.synopsis: To suppress the Ice Poison, Liam, the head of Yama Guild, had a one-night stand with Wanda. Wanda was the lady boss of Vermilion Bird Gang. However, they became enemies due to a check left behind by Liam. Liam defeated the following assassins, bidding the Dragon Blood Lingzhi with one billion. Wanda paid the money first and requested a fake marriage to please her grandpa. At the birthday banquet, Liam intimidated the entire audience with the Yama Token. He also saved Sir Quinn. Liam was with Wanda and the Ice Poison was removed...
69a56084cd3263ae7c0491b6.title: I Gave Her Check, She's Mad

69a565f5da8337d7a70a5015.synopsis: Fox spirit Lydia Rowan sacrificed her tail nine times over five centuries to protect the Arcanon Empire. Humiliated by Lady Camilla during a power loss, chaos ensued, and the royal family's indifference shattered her heart. Yet upon regaining her powers, Lydia quelled the unrest and supported Duke Adrian Collins in restoring the realm. Then, after securing his rise to the throne, she disappeared back to the celestial realm...
69a565f5da8337d7a70a5015.title: Fallen Fox, Kneeling Royals

69a5663856ecb844650e6509.synopsis: Audrey Beck, a fortune fairy who disrupted the balance of karma, is punished by being sent to the mortal realm with a mission to change the fate of the nation. Unexpectedly, she encounters her reincarnated sister, a biased father, and ends up in an arranged marriage with a notorious playboy! Yet, why does his family all seem to be cursed with short lives? But Audrey is ready to defy destiny and change everyone's fate!
69a5663856ecb844650e6509.title: When Heaven Made a Mistake

69a673519f65ba5ee90a8185.synopsis: In her previous life, Evelyn was the spoiled Collins heiress. Her fiance Bill suddenly got back a girl named Lila, claiming Lila was the true Collins heiress who had been lost. On the wedding day, Lila's birth parents switched the wedding car, making Evelyn marry Bill's brother Victor, who had jinxed five wives. Evelyn forced Bill to marry her, but all she got was three years of cold marriage. Bill died and wanted to be with Lila in the next life. After rebirth, when the wedding car stopped, Evelyn chose Victor, becoming Bill's sister-in-law.
69a673519f65ba5ee90a8185.title: The Second Life Vow

69a690c3de39c1df7307f5d9.synopsis: Winnie, the beautiful heiress of the Shaw family, finds the boy she once helped, now a beggar. In a shocking twist, she kneels and proposes to Timothy on the street. Impressed by her loyalty, he agrees to marry her and returns to the Shaw family with her. But her family is furious, demanding she either leave him or leave the family. Timothy warns that if they force them out, they will regret it.
69a690c3de39c1df7307f5d9.title: Don't Mess with That Beggar

69a690fa945642a017011a65.synopsis: Winnie, the beautiful heiress of the Shaw family, finds the boy she once helped, now a beggar. In a shocking twist, she kneels and proposes to Timothy on the street. Impressed by her loyalty, he agrees to marry her and returns to the Shaw family with her. But her family is furious, demanding she either leave him or leave the family. Timothy warns that if they force them out, they will regret it.
69a690fa945642a017011a65.title: Don't Mess with That Beggar

69a69ccf52e13afe1208a01e.synopsis: After 20 years, Evelyn returns to her family—only to find them shattered by betrayal. Her younger sister, Joy Sinclair, fueled by a toxic marriage, has drained their wealth, destroyed their name, and left their eldest brother crippled. But Evelyn is no ordinary girl. Behind her janitor's uniform hides the Queenpin—a feared figure who commands life and death. As her family faces ruin, Evelyn must decide: stay in the shadows, or rise as the Queenpin to deliver a reckoning Joy never saw coming.
69a69ccf52e13afe1208a01e.title: Hell's Warden Returns

69a6a7b45cd6f24f160747e3.synopsis: Scammed out of 70K by his cheating ex as the zombie apocalypse hits, Felix awakens a spending system with infinite Zombie Coins. Armed with unlimited wealth, he dominates the apocalypse.
69a6a7b45cd6f24f160747e3.title: Infinite Zombie Coins: Buying Out the Apocalypse

69a6c81f7c56a9aece015241.synopsis: In her previous life, Amelia, the daughter of Grand Tutor, was schemed against by her half sister Marianne and the Crown Prince Julian. Her family was ruined, and she met a tragic end in the Cold Palace. Valen, the strongest general, died fighting to protect her corpse. Amelia was reborn to the night when she was sent to Valen's bed. She wouldn't be a love-struck fool this time. Taking revenge and protecting her family was all she wanted. She proposed to be Valen's ally. She didn't know Valen had also returned with memories about their last life...
69a6c81f7c56a9aece015241.title: Dominate Me Please, General

69a791c1c016e4debe071a97.synopsis: Seo-yun joins the hit dating reality show “Clubhouse of Desire”, but the house is anything but simple. She finds herself caught between three very different men: Tae-ha, who follows his raw instincts; Jae-min, her best friend of ten years; and Dong-jun, her ex who is now drowning in regret. In a space where raw desire, hidden emotions, and lingering feelings collide, who will Seo-yun choose in the end?
69a791c1c016e4debe071a97.title: Clubhouse of Desire

69a7cedac016e4debe071aa1.synopsis: After dying on a night shift, nurse Sophia wakes up as the wife of a top tycoon. But she's immediately accused of being a mistress by the original wife's bitter ex, who even threatens her life. The husband, Spencer, is rich, handsome, and heirless, so Sophia decides to charm him into securing her future. To her surprise, this cold, woman-hating man turns into a loving, doting husband who can't get enough of her.
69a7cedac016e4debe071aa1.title: Spoiling Me, Spoiling You - The Rich Wife's Sweet Game

69a8eac48561fdabbc07262e.synopsis: Carson, the last heir of the Imperial Ascendant Lineage, is betrayed and forced to self-destruct by the Three Supreme Lords. Reborn at 20 with his memories intact, he vows revenge. With the help of Victor Yates and his family, Carson exposes his manipulative ex, crushes arrogant elites, and defeats Grandmaster Cyrus. Rising to power, he becomes the most feared figure in Newhaven, ready to claim his rightful place at the top.
69a8eac48561fdabbc07262e.title: Reborn and Became a Legend

69a8f666fb7a9f9f4408704d.synopsis: After failing her heavenly trial, Queenie Cole awakens in the body of a disgraced noble daughter and vows revenge. As she crushes her enemies and sheds her hidden identities one by one, she grows close to a mysterious tycoon, only to realize he's the powerful clan lord she once used and abandoned. Now, she must reclaim both her power and the man she left behind.
69a8f666fb7a9f9f4408704d.title: My Revenge, My Phoenix

69a924e66c24abd6ca0b8026.synopsis: Joyce Pike takes her mother-in-law, Grace, to her husband's fancy restaurant invested by her, only to discover they serve pre-made meals. Seeking justice, she faces humiliation from her husband's mistress. But Joyce is ready to fight back.
69a924e66c24abd6ca0b8026.title: Dine, Dash & Destroyed

69a9f2a9fe44bba000089d28.synopsis: Sky Kawai and Declan Clifford from Waterboy get candid as they play a round of “Who’s Most Likely To?” From revealing who’s the better kisser to debating who rocks booty shorts best, they drop behind the secrets from the set of ReelShort’s hit LGBTQ series. Tune in for laughs, playful roasting, and insider stories you didn’t see on screen.
69a9f2a9fe44bba000089d28.title: ReelTalk EP 64-Waterboy Duo Reveal Who’s Most Likely To

69aa7b78ee4d18d28207d022.synopsis: In Too Late Alphas movie, Aria was the beloved heiress, but on her birthday, she was abandoned by her two Alpha fiancés, Adrian and Julian. The scheming maid Selena took her place, using a potion to fake a mate bond and steal their trust. Drowned, forgotten on her birthday, even wounded by their own hands—Aria's heart turned to ice. Just as everyone thought she would submit, she declared: "I will marry Damien, the Alpha of the Blood Moon Pack!" The new engagement freed her and brought her a powerful guardian. When the truth was revealed, the regretful Alphas realized they had lost Aria forever—she was now the Luna of another pack.
69aa7b78ee4d18d28207d022.title: Too Late, Alphas

69aaab575157b646b907280b.synopsis: Cecilia Harrington, heiress of the Harrington empire, spent years in the mountains doing charity work—only to return home for her father's wedding. The bride? Giselle Drake, a poor student Cecilia herself had once sponsored. Beneath Giselle's gentle facade lurked a scheming monster who saw Cecilia as a threat. The torture began. But Giselle forgot one thing: Cecilia's father doesn't just love his daughter—he lives for her. When he arrived, the masks crumbled, secrets spilled, and the wicked got what they deserved.
69aaab575157b646b907280b.title: The Heiress You Don't Touch

69ab77dad2f2cfe8f2089395.synopsis: In Breathe movie, Sadie White takes her mom’s housekeeping job at the Stone family beachside mansion and accidentally saves global pop star Jax Stone from a mob of fans. Their worlds collide through forbidden chemistry, steamy tension, and explosive jealousy as Sadie is swept into Jax’s glamorous — and dangerous — life. But fame, sabotage, viral scandals, and heartbreak threaten to tear them apart. As Sadie discovers who she is outside of the chaos, she and Jax must decide whether love can survive the glare of the spotlight.
69ab77dad2f2cfe8f2089395.title: Breathe

69abb1797a64ad5c5208136b.synopsis: One fall sends Lily Carter into her favorite dating game, Demon Butler. But she's not the heroine, she's the villainess doomed to die. Her only way out? Tame four dangerous demon butlers. Too bad one of them is already at 97% corruption... and ready to kill her.
69abb1797a64ad5c5208136b.title: Taming the Demon Butlers

69abb4fced2b28680c070938.synopsis: Chris, a male model, got dropped into a world of demons. His gig? Posing for the demons. His side hustle? Collecting she-demon wives. Then he's thrown into a national survival game. There, he meets the enemy, and she is one of his.
69abb4fced2b28680c070938.title: My Wives Are She-Demons

69abb81428a46f62740a9429.synopsis: One fall sends Lily Carter into her favorite dating game, Demon Butler. But she's not the heroine, she's the villainess doomed to die. Her only way out? Tame four dangerous demon butlers. Too bad one of them is already at 97% corruption... and ready to kill her.
69abb81428a46f62740a9429.title: Taming the Demon Butlers

69ae2933e237ee74990583eb.synopsis: During seven years of marriage to Ethan Grant, Vivian Whitmore has endured endless neglect as her husband openly favors his "dream girl", Angela. On their child's full-month celebration, Vivian reaches her breaking point. She announces divorce before all the guests, reveals the baby isn't Ethan's, and pulls her investments—plunging the Grant empire into chaos. The truth exposed and her revenge served, Vivian walks away with her child, leaving Ethan drowning in regret he can never undo.
69ae2933e237ee74990583eb.title: I Took It All Back

69ae3a3e2535c508b50eabdf.synopsis: Corbin Creed, a retired ace assassin, hides in a remote town with Regina Snow, a wealthy heiress who lost her memory in a car explosion. Pretending to be cousins, they live small-town life as Regina adjusts from her privileged background. Despite her complaints, she grows to rely on Corbin, who secretly protects her while concealing his past. However, their peaceful life is soon threatened.
69ae3a3e2535c508b50eabdf.title: Playing with Fire, Burning Love

69ae3bf4fe655b0dec0c3f53.synopsis: Christopher Balcazar is the secret king of Imperial Andes Business Group, Inc. and the richest man in the world, but when he returns from the battlefield, his girlfriend brutally abandons him, thinking he's a clown. How will the king of all men make her regret it?
69ae3bf4fe655b0dec0c3f53.title: I'm The One In Charge

69ae665c0badfb39fb052f6a.synopsis: Raina's world shatters when she catches her husband cheating. In despair, she spends a reckless night with a stranger—and ends up pregnant. Divorced and broken, she's forced to marry Alfred Langford, the most feared man in the city. She has no idea he's the stranger from that night. Alfred quietly dismantles her enemies and restores her empire, but secrets and lies push them apart. As the truth surfaces, Raina realizes this isn't revenge—it's the end of a ten-year wait.
69ae665c0badfb39fb052f6a.title: Forever Your Prisoner

69ae6bfb4d28916a4b041b52.synopsis: In Back from the Dead Code of Revenge movie, programmer Finn is betrayed and killed by his girlfriend Millie and loan shark Rex. But when he's reborn with his memories intact, he returns to take revenge. Using his skills, he outsmarts the criminal underworld, saves his childhood friend Sadie, and leads his village in a fight against predatory loans. With tech and the law on his side, Finn exposes the conspiracy and takes down Rex, achieving both career success and love.
69ae6bfb4d28916a4b041b52.title: Back from the Dead: Code of Revenge

69aec6a2b817cb6f6607de96.synopsis: A walking apocalypse awakens. Caleb Weston commands an endless skeleton army—where his undead legion marches, no soul escapes.
69aec6a2b817cb6f6607de96.title: Undead Cataclysm

69aefec9d6db6f96240ff7b4.synopsis: In The Cooking Queen A Recipe for Divorce movie, Tiffany, once the legendary “Queen of Cuisine,” gave up her fame to support her husband Barry. But Barry betrays her, siding with his mistress Sera and treating Tiffany as if she's worthless. Heartbroken, Tiffany wanders aimlessly until fate leads her to Claude’s small restaurant. There, her hidden talent is reignited, and she dazzles her critics with her culinary prowess. Then, she crosses paths with Barry once again.
69aefec9d6db6f96240ff7b4.title: The Cooking Queen: A Recipe for Divorce

69af7a86ddc2e01e220f41f4.synopsis: On her deathbed, the Empress searches for her lost daughter, Laurel. Unbeknownst to her, Laurel is now a devoted wife to scholar Matt and lives a life of service. After Matt achieved high honors in the imperial exams, he conspired with the Governor's sister to accuse Laurel of adultery, forcing her to divorce him. Now, Laurel's true identity as the Empress's daughter is finally revealed.
69af7a86ddc2e01e220f41f4.title: Lost Empress: Coronation of Betrayal

69af838ac2908b3d4200bf42.synopsis: Once the heiress to the Wild Group, Lyssa was slandered and betrayed. Her comeback plan is to use Greg Ryder as her pawn in her revenge game. Yet, she finds another shadowy figure pulling the strings from behind the scenes. To her surprise, Greg's sister, whom he cherishes deeply, is entwined in the Wild family's power struggles, holding secrets that could change everything.
69af838ac2908b3d4200bf42.title: Where Lies Bloom

69afbbddfaff5bb4440e0352.synopsis: Betrayed by her sister and fiancé, modern doctor Juliana Collins is forced to marry Prince Aubrey—a crippled war hero despised by the emperor. Armed with a secret medical system, she navigates deadly court conspiracies, heals the wounded, and uncovers the truth behind her mother's murder. As she fights for survival, she transforms from pawn to power—winning Aubrey's heart and threatening the throne itself.
69afbbddfaff5bb4440e0352.title: Modern Surgeon Became the Princess

69afbc012ab17701b30229de.synopsis: Rosie Grant died saving the world—and woke up as a fetus in a novel. Her mother? A world-class love fool. Her father? A gold-digging deadbeat. The whole family? Doomed. Rosie panicked. And then her thoughts started leaking out—loud and clear. Her mother heard her. The romance-brain snapped awake. Armed with Rosie's inside intel, the maternal clan united: outsmart the scumbag, crush the scheming mistress. By the time Rosie was born, she and her mother were the most spoiled girls in the Grant family.
69afbc012ab17701b30229de.title: My Unborn Baby Called Me Out

69afd4b5e7149314cd020939.synopsis: In My Fiancé My Bodyguard movie, Finn, a battle-hardened soldier, wants peace but is forced back into action after a routine security check exposes his secret identity. Engaged to Josephine, the Sinclair family's daughter, he quickly realizes she's surrounded by danger. Using his skills to protect her, Finn is soon entangled in a larger conspiracy. With quick thinking and relentless determination, he overcomes each threat, turning the tables and emerging victorious.
69afd4b5e7149314cd020939.title: My Fiancé, My Bodyguard

69b0d80be70989c2ad0ada61.synopsis: Cast out years ago, Bonnie returns with a secret identity and a plan for revenge. As the mysterious "Satan," she seizes control of the Jones family, while her assistant Jacob turns out to be the powerful "Lucifer." Together, they crush their enemies and uncover a hidden conspiracy.
69b0d80be70989c2ad0ada61.title: The Devil's Power Couple

69b115f707305623260bec2a.synopsis: To suppress the Ice Poison, Liam, the head of Yama Guild, had a one-night stand with Wanda. Wanda was the lady boss of Vermilion Bird Gang. However, they became enemies due to a check left behind by Liam. Liam defeated the following assassins, bidding the Dragon Blood Lingzhi with one billion. Wanda paid the money first and requested a fake marriage to please her grandpa. At the birthday banquet, Liam intimidated the entire audience with the Yama Token. He also saved Sir Quinn. Liam was with Wanda and the Ice Poison was removed...
69b115f707305623260bec2a.title: I Gave Her Check, She's Mad

69b116127f2a19490e0772fd.synopsis: Gamble King Harold hid his identity, protecting the Daltons and taking care of Grace for three years as his master Victor Dalton begged him before he passed away. However, his silent protection was only repaid with contempt and ridicule. Harold endured it all until only three days remained. But Grace was tricked by her friend, and it seemed that the Dalton family would suffer heavy losses. Harold used his gambling skills to defeat the evil rivals. After that, Harold left. When Grace knew Harold's departure, she panicked and searched everywhere for his whereabouts.
69b116127f2a19490e0772fd.title: My Househusband Is Gamble King

69b11634c90a1fdbd10f6242.synopsis: Finn, a battle-hardened soldier, wants peace but is forced back into action after a routine security check exposes his secret identity. Engaged to Josephine, the Sinclair family's daughter, he quickly realizes she's surrounded by danger. Using his skills to protect her, Finn is soon entangled in a larger conspiracy. With quick thinking and relentless determination, he overcomes each threat, turning the tables and emerging victorious.
69b11634c90a1fdbd10f6242.title: My Fiancé, My Bodyguard

69b13e54bb5c789b380c3f80.synopsis: Hades Mason, a modern obstetrician, is in a death row convict's body alongside his sister-in-law for not providing a child as a remedy for the prince. Luckily, the palace is seeking someone to help induce the noble consort's lactation. Using his medical expertise, Hades seizes the opportunity, survives the ordeal, and gradually establishes himself in the palace by resolving multiple crises with modern gynecological techniques.
69b13e54bb5c789b380c3f80.title: The Strongest Male Obstetrician

69b13e7efebc362b470b0456.synopsis: Hades Mason, a modern obstetrician, is in a death row convict's body alongside his sister-in-law for not providing a child as a remedy for the prince. Luckily, the palace is seeking someone to help induce the noble consort's lactation. Using his medical expertise, Hades seizes the opportunity, survives the ordeal, and gradually establishes himself in the palace by resolving multiple crises with modern gynecological techniques.
69b13e7efebc362b470b0456.title: The Strongest Male Obstetrician

69b175f13a90646eaa0b7f38.synopsis: Transported to a cultivation world, Evan Yates is a broke, wounded sect leader with a game-breaking edge: take in a Destined Prodigy as a disciple, and his system returns everything 10,000x. When the Dark Heaven Sect rises to plunge the world into chaos and his disciples' deadly pasts come knocking, Evan leads his girls into battle. One lesson for all: mess with his disciples, and you face their master.
69b175f13a90646eaa0b7f38.title: Disciple Overload: From Zero to Empresses

69b17616d2c07c5201037185.synopsis: After a fatal accident, Leo awakens with the Delivery God System and gains the power to travel between two worlds. Time-traveled into a famine fantasy realm, he completes delivery quests, saves a girl from crushing debt, and turns rare resources into great wealth. Gold in another world? He takes it. Overpriced medicine in reality? He buys the factory. By trading between worlds, he rises from courier to tycoon and begins his path to godhood.
69b17616d2c07c5201037185.title: The Delivery God of Two Worlds

69b228d5783e458ec606bd4f.synopsis: After dying on a night shift, nurse Sophia wakes up as the wife of a top tycoon. But she's immediately accused of being a mistress by the original wife's bitter ex, who even threatens her life. The husband, Spencer, is rich, handsome, and heirless, so Sophia decides to charm him into securing her future. To her surprise, this cold, woman-hating man turns into a loving, doting husband who can't get enough of her.
69b228d5783e458ec606bd4f.title: Spoiling Me, Spoiling You - The Rich Wife's Sweet Game

69b22bd5f7910d5ce40c61be.synopsis: General Astrid Sinclair gave up her sword to save her husband, Chasel Grayson. Three years later, she returns with the cure—only to find him wed to another woman, Roxy Durant. Stripped of her title and dignity, Astrid walks away. But when the new emperor Asher Bellamy reveals his long-hidden devotion, her journey from abandoned wife to sovereign Empress only made her stronger. None of her betrayers will survive.
69b22bd5f7910d5ce40c61be.title: The General's Last Stand

69b26333f4cb3b22bb091b1a.synopsis: Ivy Stone, the daughter of the Duke, commits suicide in front of Austin Grayson, the man suspected of killing her father and her whole family. Given a second chance, Ivy's reborn as Maid Tyler. When she realizes her brothers are still alive, they have become rebellious. To protect her brothers and restore her family, Ivy reveals her identity to discipline them. However, she is forced to marry Austin by the imperial decree. Will this marriage help her find the truth or lead her to death?
69b26333f4cb3b22bb091b1a.title: The Enemy I Married

69b263554ebb401a900b4c44.synopsis: After ten years in prison for avenging his foster parents, Victor Warren returns to find the Titan Group still ruling the city—and now they're targeting his sister. Armed with skills forged behind bars and a burning need for justice, Victor wages a one-man war to dismantle the empire and unearth the dark secrets buried a decade ago.
69b263554ebb401a900b4c44.title: Back to Reckoning

69b2637b8095891cd10a39f6.synopsis: After ten years in prison for avenging his foster parents, Victor Warren returns to find the Titan Group still ruling the city—and now they're targeting his sister. Armed with skills forged behind bars and a burning need for justice, Victor wages a one-man war to dismantle the empire and unearth the dark secrets buried a decade ago.
69b2637b8095891cd10a39f6.title: Back to Reckoning

69b348af4cef791c6807cc79.synopsis: Kasey Esser and Vanessa von Schwarz from Your Husband Is Mine are back on our screens for some fun and games. Watch the couple put their relationship to the test as they see how well they really know each other. From non-negotiables to pet peeves, they’re revealing it all! You might just learn a few things about them you didn’t know before.
69b348af4cef791c6807cc79.title: ReelTalk EP 65-How Well Do Kasey and Vanessa Know Each Other?

69b34991f0e1f3b6030b4974.synopsis: In Pucked in the Friend Zone movie, when Reese unexpectedly reunites with her ex-best friend and first love Grayson four years after he broke her heart, she agrees to pose as his fake girlfriend for his sister's wedding. But as old feelings threaten to bubble out, Reese must decide if a chance at true love is worth the risk of repeating history.
69b34991f0e1f3b6030b4974.title: Pucked in the Friend Zone

69b3d4adc93aff3c59018a57.synopsis: Ben spent five years in prison for his girlfriend, Jane, and came out with the powerful Kirin Kidney. But when he returns to find Jane has betrayed him and colluded with her boss, Brandon, Ben is crushed. Disillusioned, he finds a new path working for Quincy, the CEO of Dragonrise Group, and their professional bond turns to romance. As Ben's past resurfaces and enemies come after him, he uses his newfound strength to protect those he loves and finally seek justice.
69b3d4adc93aff3c59018a57.title: Exiled and Empowered

69b3d4e17b2e23b790021dad.synopsis: Five years ago, Damian Cross woke up in a shallow grave. His wife sold him out. His parents were dead. His sister was gone. He was the only one who walked away. Now he's back. One man. Three syndicates. One mission: tear them all down. He starts from the bottom and rises fast. Too fast. Because the higher he climbs, the closer he gets to the truth. The people who destroyed his family? Just pawns. The real monster has been watching him the whole time. This isn't revenge anymore. This is war.
69b3d4e17b2e23b790021dad.title: The Funeral That Made a Boss

69b3d511e5de63568d0152dd.synopsis: Five years ago, Damian Cross woke up in a shallow grave. His wife sold him out. His parents were dead. His sister was gone. He was the only one who walked away. Now he's back. One man. Three syndicates. One mission: tear them all down. He starts from the bottom and rises fast. Too fast. Because the higher he climbs, the closer he gets to the truth. The people who destroyed his family? Just pawns. The real monster has been watching him the whole time. This isn't revenge anymore. This is war.
69b3d511e5de63568d0152dd.title: The Funeral That Made a Boss

69b3d54a4a5e2fa2bd03ed91.synopsis: Fred, a strong soldier, whose strength is so overwhelming that it drives his enemies to collapse, returns to the city after leaving the army. He finds a beautiful lady CEO to pretend to be a couple. And he will avenge his buddy Adrian.
69b3d54a4a5e2fa2bd03ed91.title: Undercover Protector

69b4ca382fa7f9e12b00f674.synopsis: When young and fiery Eddie is forced to work for and spy on her father’s ruthless rival Trent RexRoth, their hatred sparks into a forbidden desire - an age gap love that could ruin them both.
69b4ca382fa7f9e12b00f674.title: Scandalous

69b883090fe6e918cf0a6741.synopsis: When brilliant scholarship student Zoey Whitmore starts receiving mysterious gossip posts that predict her future with terrifying accuracy, her world implodes: her mom is arrested, her boyfriend betrays her, and she becomes the obsession of two powerful rivals — a royal heartthrob and a mafia prince. Each post helps Zoey overcome the bullying of her private school peers, but each victory leads to a new, even harder challenge. With the help of her "Gossip Godmother", can Zoey rewrite her fate one future post at a time?
69b883090fe6e918cf0a6741.title: Gossip Godmother

69b88396a5b6d3639400d47f.synopsis: In Meet My Brothers movie, Catherine Rowen spent three years as a contract wife, treated like a servant and discarded the moment her divorce papers were signed. Pregnant, humiliated, and threatened by her husband’s mistress, she hits her lowest point, until a helicopter lands, revealing the truth: she is the long-lost daughter of the powerful Lane family, rightful sister of Dominic, Connor, and Liam.
69b88396a5b6d3639400d47f.title: Meet My Brothers

69b8bbabff492f44ca032149.synopsis: In Stop That Homeless Man Is an American Hero movie, Ethan escorts his fallen comrade's ashes back home. On the way, he gets stopped by the local Sheriff who accuses Ethan of being a homeless vagrant. Ethan gets dragged in for questioning at the police station. They humiliate and torture him, but Ethan endures because he must protect his friend's ashes. But then, the sheriff goes too far. He desecrates the ashes! Just when things are about to take a turn for the worse, Ethan's old army subordinate– now the Director of the FBI– appears! Will Ethan's true identity as an American hero finally be revealed?
69b8bbabff492f44ca032149.title: Stop! That Homeless Man Is an American Hero!

69b924b0d8100bafa10174e9.synopsis: Left for dead in a sea of zombies, Zane discovers he can control any undead that bites him. What was meant to be his end becomes his rise. As the world falls, he builds an army of the infected and claims the apocalypse as his own.
69b924b0d8100bafa10174e9.title: Bitten, Not Broken

69b952ba47ac8c0ca80a4834.synopsis: Violet, a farm girl from Riverford, rises to become a royal consort and bears Emperor Henry two sons. But behind the palace splendor lies a dangerous secret: at night, the princes transform into black panther cubs. As rival consorts plot against her and misunderstandings strain her marriage, Violet fights to protect her children and conceal the truth until the secret is exposed before the entire court at a royal birthday banquet.
69b952ba47ac8c0ca80a4834.title: His Majesty Is A Shapeshifter

69b95345548d026af7036d95.synopsis: Country gal Eleanor Rhee rises to become a five-star hotel manager, dazzling the fashion world with her design talent and exposing impostors with her intricate schemes. Mob boss and CEO Wyatt Porter transforms into a master at discerning deception. When the truth about the jade pendant is revealed, the wedding turns into a face-slapping scene. But the best is yet to come.
69b95345548d026af7036d95.title: Country Gal to Hotel Queen

69b9537262958a15f6083a68.synopsis: After five years abroad, Cheryl returns to Saltwick ready to reclaim her life. But nothing awaits her but betrayal: her fiancé stolen by her stepsister, her family's company in enemy hands, and her name dragged through the mud. In her past life, she died broken and wronged. Now, reborn with every memory intact, she's no longer the naive heiress they once bullied. This time, Cheryl isn’t just fighting back. She's taking everything.
69b9537262958a15f6083a68.title: Stepmother, Go to Hell

69b9e726e7069f23f9031a37.synopsis: High school senior, Isabel, will soon die from a serious heart condition. She has a secret crush on her best friend Alex, and plans to confess her feelings to him after graduation. However, a huge misunderstanding in the middle of senior year ruins their friendship. Alex now holds a grudge against Isabel. He even lets her classmates bully her. Ten years later, Alex finds a collection of short vlogs that Isabel left for him. The videos reveal a shocking truth, a truth that completely changes Alex's world.
69b9e726e7069f23f9031a37.title: The Summer My Heart Stopped

69ba11bbb1bcd2854504d83e.synopsis: Edward Henderson hid his wealth to win the heart of Irene Lawson, a simple, kind woman who loved him for who he was—or so he thought. On their wedding day, he planned to reveal everything. But Irene's best friend Nancy had other ideas. Poisoned by whispers of "testing his love," Irene turned the wedding into a gauntlet of absurd demands. Edward begged, reasoned, pleaded—but his bride-to-be only listened to her friend. He looked at the woman he loved, saw someone he didn't recognize, and made a choice: "The wedding is off."
69ba11bbb1bcd2854504d83e.title: The Wedding That Wasn't

69ba11c9623f164cfe0609f7.synopsis: Edward Henderson hid his wealth to win the heart of Irene Lawson, a simple, kind woman who loved him for who he was—or so he thought. On their wedding day, he planned to reveal everything. But Irene's best friend Nancy had other ideas. Poisoned by whispers of "testing his love," Irene turned the wedding into a gauntlet of absurd demands. Edward begged, reasoned, pleaded—but his bride-to-be only listened to her friend. He looked at the woman he loved, saw someone he didn't recognize, and made a choice: "The wedding is off."
69ba11c9623f164cfe0609f7.title: The Wedding That Wasn't

69ba43471e473b1b39059190.synopsis: Martin Wayne returned to the night the Entity Outbreak began and was bound to the Guardian System. His mission was to romance Elaine Getty and stop her from becoming the Entity Sovereign. In the midst of danger, he slowly uncovered the hidden truth. With his sister’s true nature in question, relentless attacks from entities, and the system’s schemes, Martin and Elaine fought side by side, searching for the one hope to rewrite history.
69ba43471e473b1b39059190.title: Date to Survive

69ba436bd8d05acc890e1a56.synopsis: After betrayal and death, Leo Flynn was reborn in the apocalypse where zombies ran rampant. But this time, he's no longer a loser now that he has the Maid Collection System. Armed with lightning powers, badass mechs, and a squad of fiercely loyal maids, he’s ready for anything — zombie hordes, hidden conspiracies, and maybe even a little romance.
69ba436bd8d05acc890e1a56.title: Apocalypse: Call Me Master

69ba4a07c7b3b8f3d308a645.synopsis: The richest family's son had been comatose for three years. Even the finest physicians stood helpless. Then she arrived—a filthy beggar woman. They laughed. They sneered. Swords were drawn. She didn't flinch. One move. One touch. The room fell silent. "Prepare a bath. Hot water. Rose petals—cover every inch. And that pretty boy?" She pointed at the heir. "Bring him to me."
69ba4a07c7b3b8f3d308a645.title: Rose Petals and Resurrection

69ba4a559252021587069470.synopsis: Art world mogul Jeremy Finch concealed his identity to pave the way for his fiancée Crystal Klein's career. However, she used sexy painting with the wandering artist Collin Dupont to hold an art exhibition. Jeremy went to the scene and wrecked it completely. When Crystal arrived, she chose to trash Jeremy rather than blame Collin. Jeremy finally realized that she never cared about him. He finally decided to give up on this relationship.
69ba4a559252021587069470.title: Love Beyond the Canvas

69ba4ad214ee33e70609a16a.synopsis: Daisy Scott wakes up as the stand-in villainess in a short drama. Her role? Pretend to be the first love of her boss, Spencer Sutton. But Daisy isn't interested in drama—she's here for the paycheck. She happily plays matchmaker between Spencer and his real love, Vivian Winters, while pocketing his cash. Her plan goes off the rails when mysterious heir Liam Lawrence shows up with a magical blood ring that declares Daisy his fated one.
69ba4ad214ee33e70609a16a.title: The Stand-In Girlfriend

69ba4bbfe91697e6e4075351.synopsis: After leaving the army, Joseph and his fellow veterans start a produce business to build an honest life. When their late comrade's widow and daughter are harassed by an evil manager backed by a powerful tycoon, Joseph steps in only to have their company sabotaged. Cornered and humiliated, the veterans refuse to bow. With an unexpected ally exposing the corruption, they fight back and reclaim their dignity and their future.
69ba4bbfe91697e6e4075351.title: Veterans Who Refuse to Kneel

69ba56e3ac8ddd23000d746b.synopsis: CEO Vanessa Fontaine accidentally fell into the Three Gorges realm. There, she meets the reclusive cultivator Hagen Falk and his disciples Colin and Julia. In search of spirit stones, the four return to the city, only to face a new conspiracy.
