Forced to drink foot water, beaten by thugs, and trapped in her web of manipulation, he finally decided to get a divorce. Reclaiming his business empire, he reunited with his true love, Claire Shaw. Enraged and abandoned, Yolanda faked a pregnancy and stormed their wedding, only to have her lies exposed by her own lover. She fell. They rose. Love wins.
69def43569dc6fef82020edf.title: Kneel No More: The Billionaire's Divorce

69def43669dc6fef82020ee1.synopsis: Billionaire heiress Aurora Ashford gave her cheating husband the hospital, the black card, and her whole heart—then walked in on his mistress smashing his mom's $10M cochlear implant and claiming the VIP suite as "the boss's wife." Big mistake. Because the real boss just came home.
69def43669dc6fef82020ee1.title: The Mistress in My Hospital

69df0837a9981a3d7c0f277e.synopsis: Holden Stone wakes from a 3-year daze with immortal powers. Armed with godly healing and martial arts, he conquers the city, enjoying supreme power, loyal friends, and romance!
69df0837a9981a3d7c0f277e.title: Fool No More, King Returns

69df08661151acb7120993ae.synopsis: Holden Stone wakes from a 3-year daze with immortal powers. Armed with godly healing and martial arts, he conquers the city, enjoying supreme power, loyal friends, and romance!
69df08661151acb7120993ae.title: Fool No More, King Returns

69df086f585e2fb9020b5f04.synopsis: Joseph and Julia built a successful company, but without a child, their wealth draws the greed of his scheming brother. Bound by family ties, Joseph endures until Julia becomes pregnant. With an heir on the way, he stops holding back, exposes their plots, and fights to protect his family and fortune. In the end, he secures his legacy, leaving everything to his child and no one else.
69df086f585e2fb9020b5f04.title: The Child Changes Everything

69df09353885a1cc3e054158.synopsis: Betrayed by the Emperor, Leon Thorne, the Prince Regent of the Solarian Empire, reincarnates as a timid high schooler. Shedding his cowardly shell, he crushes the bully Chad Keller and meets Elise Mercer, a classmate identical to his past-life fiancee. After destroying her cursed necklace to dispel its dark magic, he settles the debts of his gambling brother, Jared Thorne. When the Sanctum, including Dexter Cross, targets the Mercer fortune, Leon unleashes his Prime Grandmaster powers. He obliterates their assassins, dismantles the syndicate, and wins the loyalty of Riverton's wealthiest man, Edward Langdon, ultimately redeeming his past regrets.
69df09353885a1cc3e054158.title: From Throne to Classroom: The Warlord Reborn

69df099ef9eedfda570591f7.synopsis: Cole Sterling, a retired Tier-1 Operator, arrives in Silverbay City to uncover the truth behind his mentor's death. His mission takes an unexpected turn when he becomes the personal protector of Evelyn Rutherford, CEO of the Rutherford Group, who is relentlessly targeted by the powerful Crawford family. As Cole dismantles assassins, rogue syndicates, and even the ghosts of his own dark past, he realizes the threat runs far deeper than corporate warfare. Protecting Evelyn isn't just about saving one woman — it's about stopping the city from falling into the hands of its most dangerous enemies.
69df099ef9eedfda570591f7.title: Ace Bodyguard

69df29aacc56265d4b029699.synopsis: In a future wasteland world, genius AI engineer Clara is devastated when her ex, Marcus, turns her warm companion robots into cold service tools. She quits and takes PWL-000, a Reject Robot slated for destruction. Little does she know, it holds a massive secret.
69df29aacc56265d4b029699.title: Beyond Us

69df33fa81a32b76590b6c05.synopsis: A prodigy of cultivation, Dean is trapped at the peak of the Foundation Establishment stage. His master, Aegis, orders him to descend from the mountain to find a woman marked with the "Path Seal", the key to breaking his limits. On his very first night down the mountain, Dean crosses paths with Victoria, CEO of CryoCore Group. By a twist of fate, he becomes her boyfriend, protecting her and her bestie. With unmatched medical skills and martial prowess, he dominates the city, crushes every enemy who crosses him, and rises to the pinnacle of power and success.
69df33fa81a32b76590b6c05.title: Rise of the Invincible Healer

69df535afcf0fce6cb0ce779.synopsis: Disguising herself as ugly, Clara marries elite heir Jace to honor her mother's wish. She thinks he loves her true self, but she's just his pawn to defy his family and shield his first love. After three years of abuse, she divorces him, unveils her beauty, and shocks everyone. Jace begs for a second chance, but Clara is done. Is his belated love too late?
69df535afcf0fce6cb0ce779.title: Love After Lies

69df535cfcf0fce6cb0ce77d.synopsis: Grace spent fifteen years loving a family that never loved her back. Then her cousin stole her college spot, her fiancé, and her wedding—so Grace walked out, vanished into the desert, and became a legend.
69df535cfcf0fce6cb0ce77d.title: Burn the Past, Guard the Nation

69df535efcf0fce6cb0ce77f.synopsis: Realizing the danger he is in, Eliot believes adopting Nolan is the only way to stop the tragedy. He chooses Nolan instead of Mia, seeing the boy as his only ally. With Nolan's constant inner reminders, Eliot carefully collects evidence of Lila's conspiracy. He also seeks help from his sisters, who stand by him against Lila's manipulation.
69df535efcf0fce6cb0ce77f.title: Son's Whispers Unveil Betrayal

69df53b59eb806ddd80723eb.synopsis: Mrs. Gallagher receives a massive relocation payout and plans to split it between her two biological sons. But Mr. Henderson warns that her sons may not be truly devoted, unlike her adopted girl. He suggests testing their loyalty. The test proves her sons are greedy, while her adopted eldest girl is genuinely loving. Yet, clinging to the traditional belief of raising sons as a retirement plan, Mrs. Gallagher gives the payout to her sons and rotates living with them. Her daughter graciously accepts this. However, Mrs. Gallagher faces severe mistreatment from her sons and daughters-in-law, and it is the eldest girl who defends her every time. Through these ordeals, she gradually realizes that raising sons as a retirement plan is no guarantee. Blood isn't the only family bond, and only a grateful heart deserves true devotion...
69df53b59eb806ddd80723eb.title: Mom's Relocation Payout

69df53b69eb806ddd80723ed.synopsis: Housewife Audrey Hayes suffers endless torment from her mother-in-law Edith Miller and husband Derek Miller for giving birth to Audrey. Favoring boys over girls, Edith relentlessly bullies Audrey Hayes, knowing she has no family backing. Meanwhile, her deadbeat Derek leeches off his parents, games all day, cheats repeatedly, and cowardly ignores their conflicts. Pushed to the limit after catching Derek with a prostitute again, Audrey Hayes demands a divorce but gets trapped in battles over property and custody. Later, her biological mother Josephine Kingsley steps in, empowering her to start over. She fights back, reclaims her life, and wins the house and Audrey's custody, while her toxic ex-in-laws finally get what they deserve.
69df53b69eb806ddd80723ed.title: A Mother's Rebirth

69df53bd9eb806ddd80723f9.synopsis: 18 years ago, Avery Stanton was switched at birth. Now, fake heiress Chloe Dawson shows up at the Stantons with a forged paternity test and transcript. She frames Avery for stealing the class fund and getting terrible grades, deceiving their parents to steal Avery's life. Misunderstood, Avery is kicked out of the master bedroom and mocked by her school. Aided by her cousin Riley Yates, Avery investigates and secures ironclad proof that Chloe bribed the lab and teachers. At the welcome-home gala, the truth comes to light. Chloe is arrested and Avery's name is cleared, but a wounded heart takes time to heal.
69df53bd9eb806ddd80723f9.title: The Straight-A Cousin Is the Real Heiress

69df5f70827a5e662a0c672b.synopsis: Disguising herself as ugly, Clara marries elite heir Jace to honor her mother's wish. She thinks he loves her true self, but she's just his pawn to defy his family and shield his first love. After three years of abuse, she divorces him, unveils her beauty, and shocks everyone. Jace begs for a second chance, but Clara is done. Is his belated love too late?
69df5f70827a5e662a0c672b.title: Love After Lies

69df5fd2827a5e662a0c677f.synopsis: Grace spent fifteen years loving a family that never loved her back. Then her cousin stole her college spot, her fiancé, and her wedding—so Grace walked out, vanished into the desert, and became a legend.
69df5fd2827a5e662a0c677f.title: Burn the Past, Guard the Nation

69df6020827a5e662a0c67a9.synopsis: Realizing the danger he is in, Eliot believes adopting Nolan is the only way to stop the tragedy. He chooses Nolan instead of Mia, seeing the boy as his only ally. With Nolan's constant inner reminders, Eliot carefully collects evidence of Lila's conspiracy. He also seeks help from his sisters, who stand by him against Lila's manipulation.
69df6020827a5e662a0c67a9.title: Son's Whispers Unveil Betrayal

69e07a2ccc56265d4b029700.synopsis: In his past life, James's wife cheated on him and always spent time with her first love. Reborn, James decided not to marry Jane. This time, he tossed the marriage application paper away and left for college, building a fortune through grit and sharp instinct. Yara's sincerity healed what Jane broke. When James rose to the top, Jane realized her chance was gone forever. That man would never come back. He had met his true love.
69e07a2ccc56265d4b029700.title: Reborn: This Time I Won't Marry You

69e07a323cd16879a80298f4.synopsis: In his previous life, James Lewis married his three childhood sweethearts one by one, only to be trapped in miserable marriages and labeled a jinx who doomed his wives. In this life, he rejects them all and turns to marry Vivian Shaw, the illegitimate daughter of a wealthy family in the Northern City. Little does he know that the future aloof business tycoon has been his secret admirer for years. Post-wedding sweetness strikes hard, with face-slapping revenge dialed to the max!
69e07a323cd16879a80298f4.title: Childhood Sweethearts, Get out of My Way

69e07a3498c748e19c0ff351.synopsis: Two years ago, Sarah Cole's life was destroyed by her ex-husband's powerful family. Her mother died disgraced, and Sarah disappeared. Now she returns as a world-class surgeon. When the Hayes family faces a life-or-death crisis, the only doctor who can save them is the woman they once crushed. Looking at her former father-in-law, she asks coldly, "My ex father-in-law, right? Need my help?" The media erupts, but one thing is clear. The old Dr. Cole is gone. She came back for revenge.
69e07a3498c748e19c0ff351.title: Scalpel of Revenge

69e0b7f139a61953f9025ea7.synopsis: In the Love Under Fire movie, When a disciplined former Secret Service agent is forced to partner with a reckless global pop star after his daughter is kidnapped by her obsessive ex, their race across the Philippines ignites a volatile romance- one that forces them to choose between control, trust, and the people they love most.
69e0b7f139a61953f9025ea7.title: Love Under Fire

69e0c0b34f69687e830a8270.synopsis: Kyle, once deemed unable to cultivate, was forced into a deadly succession trial as a disposable pawn. His parents were killed protecting him. After three years in hiding, he returns, awakened by a mysterious black tome through his unyielding will, inheriting a forbidden power. Reborn through suffering, Kyle rises step by step to the peak of strength, no longer the boy they discarded, but a force that challenges so-called invincibility.
69e0c0b34f69687e830a8270.title: Unworthy No More

69e0c9727142f8a98f08222e.synopsis: Life on the road. She drives the truck while her husband rests in the cargo hold. But every time, he comes out more exhausted, eats meals in secret, and never lets her near the back. Curious but trusting, she keeps driving—until one day, a strange woman's voice drifts from the trailer. She looks. And finds her husband has been hiding a woman inside all along.
69e0c9727142f8a98f08222e.title: The Secret Cargo

69e0e6d3172c5aa059024658.synopsis: A female general watches her husband die taking an arrow meant for her. As she falls from a cliff, she swears: if given another life, she will love him better. Then she wakes up—five years earlier, on the day of their engagement. This time, she marries him without hesitation. Armed with memories of the future, she foils her brother's schemes, dismantles a rival's plots, and mends every rift with her husband and his mother. Together, she helps him rise to the highest office—while earning the empire's highest honor for herself. The swords of the past become the foundation of their happiness.
69e0e6d3172c5aa059024658.title: Die For You, Kill For All

69e13d6661d01cba1a00b545.synopsis: Brace yourself, dark romance lovers. A special reading of a chapter from Bound by Honor, ReelShort’s hit adaptation of Cora Reilly’s book, is finally here. If you’re a fan of the book or the series, you won’t want to miss this intimate reading by Rhett Wellington, bringing Luca to life in a whole new way.
69e13d6661d01cba1a00b545.title: ReelTalk EP 70-Bound by Honor: A Special Chapter Reading with Rhett Wellington

69e1a219b0e4eed2b00bf311.synopsis: Reborn on the very day Valerie Stanton breaks off their engagement and humiliates him publicly, Miles Sterling awakens the Goddess Conquest System. He opens lucky chests, crushes Felix Vance and the security guards with ease, and turns Valerie’s attitude around instantly. After unlocking a $50 million black card from a chest, he exposes her desperate funding crisis. Valerie begs and fawns over him for a loan, her favor skyrocketing. Dominating the system step by step, Miles rises to the very peak of success!
69e1a219b0e4eed2b00bf311.title: Reborn: Female CEO at My Feet

69e1a21bb0e4eed2b00bf317.synopsis: Reborn on the very day Valerie Stanton breaks off their engagement and humiliates him publicly, Miles Sterling awakens the Goddess Conquest System. He opens lucky chests, crushes Felix Vance and the security guards with ease, and turns Valerie’s attitude around instantly. After unlocking a $50 million black card from a chest, he exposes her desperate funding crisis. Valerie begs and fawns over him for a loan, her favor skyrocketing. Dominating the system step by step, Miles rises to the very peak of success!
69e1a21bb0e4eed2b00bf317.title: Reborn: Female CEO at My Feet

69e1a3085752c3c76803bf49.synopsis: Money-obsessed, reborn Sophie saves Sebastian, the golden boy of the Kingson family, who poses as a frail man. When his cover is blown, she takes a massive payout and runs. Devastated, the obsessive man vows to win her back at all costs.
69e1a3085752c3c76803bf49.title: Runaway Gold Digger and Obsessed Heir

69e1a61570dbe63c34019be3.synopsis: Cole was the heir of the Lancaster family. He was the only son of his late parents. He learned martial arts in the mountains for years. He returned to inherit the family business. At his birthday party, he made a crazy wish. He just wanted to sleep and played video games. Everyone thought he was a total loser. They mocked him, and his fiancee dumped him. Cole ignored the insults. His parents' killer finally showed up. Cole revealed his true power. He was a hidden big shot, the Godfather. He lured the enemy out and took revenge for his parents. When his fiancee begged him back, he said no.
69e1a61570dbe63c34019be3.title: Loser? Call Me Godfather!

69e1d610a8d2b7b6230bea49.synopsis: Senior year was supposed to be the best year ever. Then two pink lines changed everything. Now Kelsey has to tell the campus heartthrob he's going to be a dad — and hide it all from the Dean who also happens to be her grandmother.
69e1d610a8d2b7b6230bea49.title: Positively Pregnant

69e1d9966a3cf0904c08ec99.synopsis: Cleo, daughter of the famed “Cockfight Sage,” steps back into the arena to save her gambler husband, Jared Foster. She fights her way through elite opponents to clear a crushing debt, only to uncover the truth: her senior brother killed her father and tried to wipe her out. In the final match, Cleo takes him down and walks away—for good—proving the only winning move is to stop playing.
69e1d9966a3cf0904c08ec99.title: Rooster’s Reckoning

69e1e9fcc05711c3ad086db7.synopsis: In the apocalyptic chaos of Fortress Doomsday, protagonist Gage Thorne is reborn with a unique "Rage System"—fueled by vengeance and emotional energy. As mutated beasts, ruthless gangs, and the mysterious Esper Alliance rise, he transforms his humble shelter into an impenetrable stronghold. From Tier-E defenses to nano-enhanced gear, Gage battles Alpha Zombies, Espers, and his own past to uncover the truth behind the Starlight Project and the ABRI conspiracy. Survival is just the beginning—domination is the goal.
69e1e9fcc05711c3ad086db7.title: Fortress Doomsday

69e1ea74eb4417c18d0069be.synopsis: Sold out by her blood, killed by the sister they chose over her. Vera died in a prison cell, taking the blame for a crime she didn't commit. Now reborn eight years earlier, she walks away from the family fortune—and builds her own, just to watch them beg.
69e1ea74eb4417c18d0069be.title: Born Again to Break Them

69e1eb64e5cdd30ee90604ec.synopsis: Evan Cooper runs a butcher shop in Silverport with his cousin Nolan. He was slaved away at this shop, helping make over $2 million a year—yet only earned $80,000. Sick of being exploited, he risked a $200,000 debt to open his own honest, fresh meat shop and quickly won loyal customers. His greedy cousin Nolan used rotten, tainted meat to cut costs, leading to a $3 million ruin, a broken family, and total disgrace. When relatives tried to frame Evan, his parents stood by him. Evan went on to secure huge contracts, took over a meatpacking plant, paid off all debts, and brought his family to Silverport. Nolan, however, was left crippled and homeless, crushed by his own greed. A brutal, inspiring story: integrity wins, greed destroys.
69e1eb64e5cdd30ee90604ec.title: Betrayal. Beef. Billions.

69e1f4ca748448024d0d9fdf.synopsis: Liam Gray died once after being betrayed and watching his sister die. Now he wakes up three days before the apocalypse with a second chance. He's done playing by anyone else's rules. He masters Zombie Transformation to become the Red Terror Zombie, a nightmare that the apocalypse fears. He hunts down his enemies, tames high-level zombies, and seizes control of the end-times to rebuild order and protect those he loves.
69e1f4ca748448024d0d9fdf.title: Apocalypse Game: Mess with Red, Get Dead

69e203c79c99c9b9df07a874.synopsis: Top modern assassin Sylvia Lockwood dies and wakes up in the body of a woman with the same name. Her father died in battle. To survive in The Lockwood Family, her mother disguised her as a boy since birth. Sylvia longs to be a woman, but fears they will be killed if exposed. She plans to flee. Instead, she catches the eye of Valerian Blackwood, the ruthless and powerful lord of The Empire of Aethelgard. Taken to his manor, she begins a life of pecking and matching wits with him to survive.
69e203c79c99c9b9df07a874.title: Chosen by the Regent–Season 3

69e2210a4e0b0a84af08df40.synopsis: College junior Gabriel dumps his gold-digging girlfriend, only to be dragged home by a stunning CEO. His dad married a billionaire, making the CEO and the campus belle his stepsisters! They suspect he is after the Tatum family fortune, but Gabriel suddenly awakens the Foresight System! With its power, he rises to the top!
69e2210a4e0b0a84af08df40.title: Dumped, My Step-Sisters Want Me

69e338710a2a37e91b0874fd.synopsis: With her mother deceased and father deployed, Penny Sterling suffers abuse from her uncle, Frank Dixon. After she faints from hunger, Sarah Granger saves her, and Penny's lucky nature rewards Sarah and Amos Granger with unexpected food. Locked out for returning late, Penny stays with the Grangers. Frank then kicks Penny out upon hearing her father, David Sterling, is dead and his stipend stopped. Sarah adopts Penny for 5 pounds of white flour, dividing her household to do so. When Mayor Higgins delivers David's death benefits, a greedy Frank tries to snatch Penny back. Penny then discovers rare herbs and saves Elite Physician Dr. Elias Hawthorne. Just as Rachel Granger plots with traffickers, a recovering David returns to rescue his daughter. He recognizes Dr. Hawthorne as Penny's granddad. The reunited family decides to start anew in the city.
69e338710a2a37e91b0874fd.title: Welcome Home, Penny

69e338780a2a37e91b08750d.synopsis: When Maya Sterling's husband Leo dies at the construction site, he leaves a $2 million death benefit. Seeking comfort from her family, Maya faces abuse from her mother and brothers, who favor boys over girls. Labeling her a jinx, they demand her only home. Leo's boss, Victor Hawthorne, intervenes, suggesting she fake leukemia to test their loyalty. Their true greed surfaces. Heartbroken, Maya reclaims her money and cuts ties completely. Her brothers soon fall into gambling debts, their wives flee, and her mother becomes paralyzed from stress. Maya embraces a new life, leaving her family to regret their cruelty.
69e338780a2a37e91b08750d.title: My Sister's Death Benefit

69e338790a2a37e91b08750f.synopsis: Billionaire CEO Victoria Sterling marries barber Garrett Fletcher, but is betrayed by him and the nanny, Stella Moore. Driven by patriarchal sexism, they sell her newborn daughter, fake her death, and swap in the boy, Zachary Fletcher, to gain her trust and steal her fortune. Victoria Sterling endures 23 years of humiliation while secretly guiding her sold daughter to become the richest woman in the country, Morgan Sterling. At the company handover, mother and daughter unite to expose the truth, ruining the four Fletchers. Garrett Fletcher is jailed for money laundering and murder, Stella Moore is sentenced for child trafficking, Zachary Fletcher is arrested for embezzlement, and Mrs. Fletcher suffers a stroke. Mother and daughter finally reunite, and the villains face justice.
69e338790a2a37e91b08750f.title: Never Marry a Gold-Digging Social Climber

69e33b0e276d97ac770bdba4.synopsis: To save her sick daughter, desperate single mom Elise Chandler spends a fateful night with her drugged benefactor, CEO Nathaniel Reed. But when her greedy family steals the lifesaving money and she discovers she is pregnant, Elise hits rock bottom. Cornered at the hospital by her degenerate gambler ex-husband and terrible parents, Nathaniel swoops in, knocking the trash out with one punch and paying all her bills. Learning the truth, he publicly declares that the baby she is carrying is his! Watch as he fiercely defends her, crushing the scumbags, and keeping the mother and daughter under his wing with endless love, turning a debt of gratitude into a match made in heaven.
69e33b0e276d97ac770bdba4.title: My Ex Rejected Me, He Protected Me

69e33b10276d97ac770bdba8.synopsis: After losing her parents in a crash, Victoria Thorne inherited Thorne Group and raised her sister, Penelope Thorne. She mistakenly believed Julian Croft's mother, Theresa Croft, donated a kidney to save her. She later discovered Mrs. Croft's donation was a lie by Julian Croft, aimed at plundering an heirless estate and seizing Thorne Group's wealth. To expose Julian Croft, Victoria Thorne feigned compliance with his family's outrageous demands while secretly gathering evidence, ultimately revealing the truth and bringing them to justice.
69e33b10276d97ac770bdba8.title: Taking Down My Scumbag Ex's Family

69e33b11276d97ac770bdbac.synopsis: Victoria, Silverton's wealthiest woman, disguises herself as a cleaning lady to attend her daughter Eleanor's wedding to Summit Group GM Spencer. Eleanor books rooms at their family's seven-star hotel but forgets to reserve one for her mother. Mrs. Montgomery arrives and bullies the simply dressed Victoria. At the wedding reception, Victoria shocks the Montgomerys with a billion-dollar dowry, only to catch Spencer cheating with his secretary, Cassidy. Cassidy lies to her father, Richard Sinclair, claiming Victoria is just a cleaning lady. When Richard arrives, he recognizes Victoria as the benefactor who saved his company and kneels to apologize. Furious, Victoria threatens to throw them in the ocean to sleep with the fishes, terrifying the villains.
69e33b11276d97ac770bdbac.title: The Billionaire Matriarch and the Wicked In-Laws

69e33ce7811cc491f405c7c2.synopsis: Martha Lewis's husband Robert Sterling is killed in a construction accident. Pregnant, she also loses her daughter Sophie. Fifteen years later, she supports her son Matthew Lewis marrying into her family, the Sterling family, while secretly suffering from black lung disease. Rejected by her son, she runs a bun stall and meets Sophie, now CEO of the Sinclair Group. Matthew Lewis tricks her into selling her house to pay his debts, then deceives her into working as a maid for the Sterling family. Humiliated, she discovers the father-in-law resembles Robert Sterling. Sophie Sinclair uncovers the truth and seeks a reunion. At Lily's birthday gala, Cynthia Sterling insults Martha Lewis. Sophie Sinclair defends her mother, canceling a massive contract. The truth prevails: Robert Sterling had amnesia, and Cynthia Sterling's plot is exposed. As Martha Lewis falls gravely ill, Matthew Lewis repents, and she forgives everyone.
69e33ce7811cc491f405c7c2.title: Son, I Am Not a Maid

69e33ceb811cc491f405c7cc.synopsis: After elite spouse Victoria catches her husband Bradley Sterling cheating, she plots revenge. When pregnant mistress Jessica Harper arrives to taunt her, she mistakes elegant Victoria for Bradley's mom. Victoria plays along, controlling Jessica with a 'bride test' and demanding to meet her parents. Eager for wealth, Jessica arranges this at her father's birthday, where Victoria publicly exposes her affair and pregnancy. Victoria then pretends to plan their wedding while gathering evidence. At the ceremony, she airs surveillance footage, forcing Bradley to surrender all assets. Victoria wins the divorce and keeps her wealth, leaving the duo utterly disgraced.
69e33ceb811cc491f405c7cc.title: Testing the Fake Bride

69e33cf4811cc491f405c7e2.synopsis: Eleanor Crawford unexpectedly won 300 million dollars in the lottery. She planned to split it among her sons, but they only abused her when she stayed with them. Only her grandson Leo quietly cared for her, even confronting his parents to defend Grandma. Heartbroken by her ungrateful sons, Eleanor gave up on them. Before passing away, she gave the winning ticket to Leo. Disgusted by his parents, he kept it a secret. Ultimately, Leo chose not to claim the 300 million dollars, donating it all to charity instead.
69e33cf4811cc491f405c7e2.title: Take the Lottery Ticket, I Just Want Grandma!

69e4d66aca45e80a830235fb.synopsis: Transmigrated as the lovesick villainess, Lynn has her husband's black card, but she'd rather blow it at a host club. James is certain it's just a ploy. Until she signs the divorce papers with a smile, pivots to her career, and her family, and is surrounded by different guys. Too late, James realizes the woman who only ever saw him has gone. But an old video and a secret become the final bargaining chips. In their marriage war, who actually let go first?
69e4d66aca45e80a830235fb.title: Ex's Fortune, My Fame

69e4d9e93af8912485044ab0.synopsis: Betrayed and brutally tortured to death by the Emperor, the Crown Prince, a powerful general, and the principal graduate in her past life, Rosalind Ashcroft is reborn on the eve of the imperial selection. She allies with head eunuch Lucian Thorne after discovering his fake identity. One by one, she strikes down her enemies: she destroys the new principal graduate Benedict Fairfax, schemes to overthrow the Crown Prince, and turns the Emperor and the general against each other. As they bond through blood and fire, Lucian is revealed to be a former royal. Together, they tear the palace apart, send their foes to hell, and seize the ultimate throne.
69e4d9e93af8912485044ab0.title: The Eunuch’s Secret Queen

69e4db8e62581d903c0df223.synopsis: The traitors killed Lord Damien. But death couldn't hold him. Reborn as a different child, he hides in plain sight. His sister? His past love. His enemies? Everywhere. His ace? Memories of a lifetime in hell. Now the family secrets crumble. The traitors tremble. The mighty prodigy is rising.
69e4db8e62581d903c0df223.title: A Boy's Hand, the Dead's Wrath

69e588fc8e2712ecdc063911.synopsis: To avoid being sold off by her aunt, destitute orphan Chloe Winters tries to manipulate Silas Thorne—her aunt's lover and the second-in-command of Port City's top gang—to fund her escape abroad. Silas sees through her scheme and forces her to stay. Trapped in a dangerous world, Chloe plays the obedient pet until she glimpses the villain's true heart: Silas risks his life to protect her in a gang shootout and secretly secures her study abroad application. Betrayed and ambushed, Silas vanishes into the sea before giving it to her. Heartbroken, Chloe leaves the country, only to unexpectedly reunite with an amnesiac Silas. Embracing her hidden feelings, they share a peaceful life until a cartel attack forces them back to Port City. There, the illusion shatters: Silas's amnesia was nothing but a calculated ruse for his ultimate revenge...
69e588fc8e2712ecdc063911.title: Tempting the Mafia Boss

69e59e18f141c3af82068143.synopsis: Reborn into betrayal, Theo Lee, the rightful heir of the Lee family, was deceived by his girlfriend, Michelle, and two others, leading to his tragic demise. Now, back from the dead, Theo's done pretending. He dumps his manipulative girlfriend, reconnects with his real parents, kicks out the fake heir, and takes down his scheming step-sister. This time, Theo is taking back everything that's rightfully his, no more compromises.
69e59e18f141c3af82068143.title: Lost Heir's Comeback Plan

69e5f3a8a332f649ee088e7d.synopsis: A legendary specter wakes up in hell on earth. The problem? A glitchy System keeps labeling him "Human". To survive an S-class zombie apocalypse, he calls the government to surrender, only to be made mayor of the last city. But when he tries to rebuild civilization by turning his undead men into construction workers and massage therapists, he accidentally wakes up an ancient evil from an interdimensional asylum.
69e5f3a8a332f649ee088e7d.title: Designated Human

69e5fd439d561ff43905a5de.synopsis: Haunted by his brother’s murder, elite soldier Lucas Hayes infiltrates The Lockwood Family to protect his sister-in-law, Cynthia Sinclair. Fighting corporate sabotage, poisoning, and dark forces after a secret energy formula, Lucas resolves multiple crises. What begins as hostility slowly turns to quiet devotion as Lucas faces down danger after danger. When he unleashes his global connections to turn the tide, his fearsome true identity—The Judge—is laid bare. In a final, explosive reckoning, he crushes the conspiracy, avenges his brother, and vows to protect Cynthia forever.
69e5fd439d561ff43905a5de.title: The Judge

69e6368af5d1c8622c099106.synopsis: In Lady CEO's Fatal Contract movie, after a heart transplant, Violet learns her donor, Eve, died at the hands of her boyfriend, Liam, a famous artist. Seeking proof, Violet signs a BDSM contract to become his servant, but Liam doesn't abuse her—he protects her with a tenderness that terrifies her. When her ex-husband uncovers her lie and blackmails her, Liam quietly makes him disappear. Now Violet faces an impossible truth: she came to destroy a monster, but he may be the only one who truly owns her.
69e6368af5d1c8622c099106.title: Lady CEO's Fatal Contract

69e6dc455706198256042a0d.synopsis: Mother-in-law Irene Sullivan stabs gambler Conrad Pierce in the chest after he refuses to halt his divorce from her daughter, Mia Gallagher. But Conrad survives—and time-travels back to 1994! Armed with future knowledge, he sets out to conquer the world. Conrad saves his friend Dustin Boyd and discovers fraudster Vito Moretti is posing as a tycoon to marry Mia. Conrad rushes to the Gallaghers to expose Vito's scam. He then partners with Ruby Sullivan and Dustin to sell cordless city phones, though Vito's sabotage puts their business at risk. Using his past-life skills, Conrad fixes a limited-edition sound system for Southport City's wealthiest man. This connection helps him win big on the World Cup finals in Macau. With his first pot of gold, Conrad expands his empire, eventually becoming the richest man in Southport City. Later, Irene and her secret lover, Otis Caldwell, steal Conrad's office buildings. Conrad traps them, forcing Otis to confess and face justice. Using the newly emerging DNA paternity test, Conrad discovers Irene is not Mia's real mother—Irene and Dominic Hawthorne actually kidnapped her! When Mia's biological father dies abroad, leaving her a massive inheritance and an ancestral estate, Irene plots to kill her for the money. Conrad intervenes just in time, exposing Irene and Dominic and sending them to prison. With the truth revealed, Conrad and Mia finally get their happy ending.
69e6dc455706198256042a0d.title: Back to 1994

69e6dc475706198256042a11.synopsis: Twenty years ago, Raymond Crawford killed his best friend for gold and adopted his young sons, Arthur Gallagher and Desmond Gallagher. Discovering the truth, Arthur faked his death to escape. He founded Torrent Group, waited in the shadows for twenty years, and returned with five hundred tons of gold to launch a full-scale commercial assault on Vanguard Corporation. Blinded by lies, Desmond ended up taking the enemy as a father and even attacked Arthur under Raymond Crawford's coercion. Ultimately, Arthur used the gold for short selling Vanguard Corporation, acquired 60% of its shares, completely crushed Raymond Crawford, and avenged his parents.
69e6dc475706198256042a11.title: a fortune lost will always return

69e6f0ad2d2518095d057a23.synopsis: Mr. Sinclair Sr. is dying but waiting for someone. As the Sinclair family despairs, a stunning woman named Celeste knocks on their door. They assume she is the descendant of his lost love. Yet when Celeste meets Mr. Sinclair, he miraculously rises from his deathbed!
69e6f0ad2d2518095d057a23.title: Before His Last Breath

69e727f49dd5a1fb0106a4d0.synopsis: Sterling Group CEO Nathaniel suspects his wife Olivia is cheating when a smart cat feeder records a stranger in their home. After catching her and his old friend Franklin together, he plays along. He secretly buys an apartment, installs hidden cameras, and sets a trap. At the Spring Festival dinner, he publicly exposes their conspiracy, transforming from a betrayed husband into a mastermind of revenge!
69e727f49dd5a1fb0106a4d0.title: The Footage That Broke a Marriage

69e727fd9dd5a1fb0106a4e6.synopsis: When the apocalypse hits, Alex sacrifices his lifespan to shelter humanity in the bunker for 30 years. Yet, he is betrayed by his adopted daughter Evelyn and the ambitious Diana. They fake footage of a peaceful surface to incite the masses and send Alex to the gallows. Blinded by lies, the people destroy the bunker for a promised oasis, only to walk straight into a deadly trap set by Diana and the Giants. As the Giants begin their massacre, regret washes over the survivors. Will Alex, armed with secret mecha tech, let go of his grudge and save humanity once again?
69e727fd9dd5a1fb0106a4e6.title: Thirty Years of Protection and Betrayal

69e776b5e26e2e226c0175bc.synopsis: Nathan, an ordinary male nurse, discovers he has the rare Sun-Forged Physique and is chosen by a martial master. With x-ray vision and overwhelming strength, his life flips overnight. He rises fast, making money, turning heads, and crushing anyone who stands in his way. In the end, he crushes the ultimate boss and becomes one of the richest and most powerful men alive.
69e776b5e26e2e226c0175bc.title: Nurse by Day, Hero by Night

69e776efbf1743903a01e938.synopsis: Eight years of agony. Endless betrayals. Then a second chance. Madeline Hayes awakens at the start of her nightmare, and she's not the same naive girl anymore. She cuts off her so-called uncle, trashes his precious first love, and gets her revenge cold and clean. But when she turns to leave for good, the man who once broke her now clings to her, red-eyed, begging her to stay.
69e776efbf1743903a01e938.title: Reborn, Not Yours

69e827a9733786f94900002f.synopsis: A nobody delivery driver, Wyatt Fletcher, suddenly discovers he is the long-lost heir to the Winslow family — the owners of Starlight Media, a struggling live-streaming empire. Surrounded by scheming rivals like Vaughn Sterling and betrayal within the company, he must rise from the bottom, take control of the failing group, and outplay everyone who once looked down on him. No longer an errand boy, he becomes the boss — and he’s ready to rewrite the rules of the industry.
69e827a9733786f94900002f.title: Wrong Heir, Right Throne

69e82d465e22182d7b0588cb.synopsis: Broke medical student Audrey unexpectedly awakens God-tier X-Ray Vision. After saving a dying billionaire heir, she uses her superpower to uncover hidden treasures and dominate the stock market, transforming into the richest woman. Pursued by elite bachelors, she handles them all with grace. Who says girls are meant to be weak? Watch Audrey rise as a badass queen!
69e82d465e22182d7b0588cb.title: The Visionary Queen

69e82d84293cb253560fd2b4.synopsis: Simon unexpectedly awakens a system that helps him raise seven extraordinary nephews. With Sawyer dominating the stock market, Mason healing with silver needles, Joy winning mansions, and Skylar rewriting reality, Simon rises from being overlooked to exposing corporate conspiracies and winning the Smith heiress's heart. He becomes the youngest major shareholder in a family empire. When his family returns, they're stunned by his success and new mansion.
69e82d84293cb253560fd2b4.title: The Nephew Mastermind

69e836e2cda47bca1300cceb.synopsis: Celeste Monroe taught the Bancroft family medicine. Matriarch Bancroft wished for Celeste's visit before dying. Yet, her descendants disrespect Celeste, using Mr. Bancroft to suppress her, unaware that he learned everything from her!
69e836e2cda47bca1300cceb.title: After Her Last Will

69e836e4cda47bca1300ccef.synopsis: Destroyed by those she trusted, top star Aurora dies knowing her greatest rival, Pierce, was the only one who truly loved her. Reborn, she's on one mission: to court Pierce, crush her enemies, and rewrite her fate.
69e836e4cda47bca1300ccef.title: Red Carpet, Hot Kiss

69e8447d6540d07eb10f8a31.synopsis: Journalist James got betrayed by Travis and was killed by Dominic while investigating an underground casino. Three years later, his daughter Hailey becomes a master of gambling skill. To save her gambling addict aunt and track down the killer, she sneaks into her enemy's underground casino...
69e8447d6540d07eb10f8a31.title: Fold or Die: Gamble Queen Rises

69e867662d4a53728b07a050.synopsis: Vanessa, head of the Horton family, goes abroad to find a cure for her daughter, Hazel. She returns to discover Hazel has been tortured into madness by her gold-digging husband and her fake adopted sister, Fiona. Furious, Vanessa becomes the Queen of Slaps, crushing the scumbags to avenge Hazel.
69e867662d4a53728b07a050.title: Furious Mom: The Last Slap

69e8676cc332d9c61a0d62b2.synopsis: Once the chief researcher of the Ark Lab, Miles now leads the Starlight Coexistence Zone, a sanctuary where humans and harmless undead live side by side. But his greatest challenge isn't politics or war. It's raising his daughter, Elara: the Zombie Queen. Infected but not lost, Elara commands the very forces that terrify humanity. As enemies from the Three Zones close in and the Ark's dark legacy resurfaces, Miles must protect the one girl who could either save the world, or end it.
69e8676cc332d9c61a0d62b2.title: The Zombie Queen's Guardian

69e87a6719c78a7efd0ce13c.synopsis: Adrian returns as The CEO, while vain Simon disowns Momma! The wealth Simon craves means less to billionaire Adrian than Mommy's smile. True success is never letting Mommy cry!
69e87a6719c78a7efd0ce13c.title: Her Smile Above All Riches

69e87adb7de81098f80bcee4.synopsis: Tucker, a seasoned detective in his past life, is reborn in ancient times as an eight-year-old low-ranking official. When the Righteous Magistrate System awakens, he quickly solves a kidnapping case, outwits corrupt gentry, and defeats bandits. Using the system's rewards, he gains martial arts skills and wisdom. Watch as he uses his newfound powers to serve the people, punish evil, and leave his mark on history!
69e87adb7de81098f80bcee4.title: Age 8, Justice Straight

69e8933d22d3ca290d09ca02.synopsis: When Epoch of Beasts becomes reality, the world turns into a living hell. Grinder Gideon leads humanity through countless battles, collecting seven Spire Keys to resurrect his grandmother. But right before the world reboots, his girlfriend Chloe and best friend Tyson betray and kill him. The mastermind, Nightwraith King, then descends to plunge the world into an eternal Icebound Deathscape. Unexpectedly, Gideon is reborn 12 hours before the apocalypse. Armed with past memories, he uses his knowledge of the game to win. Before the servers shut down, he spends wildly, drawing the server's only SSS-Rank Spirit Pet, Nine-Tailed Sacred Fox and forms an early pact with her.
69e8933d22d3ca290d09ca02.title: Fox Queen & My Apocalypse Payback

69e8b3d61942c155d907fcc1.synopsis: In 1990, gambling addict Arthur Hayes is reborn thirty years in the past. His previous life was ruined by his addiction, costing him his family. This time, he vows to rewrite his destiny. Making his first fortune flipping antiques, he buys the failing Star Foods Factory and creates Pinnacle Cola. He signs Ricky as a spokesperson, acquires nationwide soda plants, partners with real estate moguls, and turns the small factory into Pinnacle Group in just one month. But he must fight off hostile foreign takeovers, greedy in-laws, his lingering first love, and deadly revenge from former gambling buddies. Armed with future memories and business wits, Arthur protects his family and builds an ultimate business empire.
69e8b3d61942c155d907fcc1.title: Pinnacle

69e8b4c47aafe1dcda02c5ff.synopsis: On his birthday, Carter Brooks inexplicably falls into an infinite time loop, shot dead in a bathroom stall by the person in the clown mask. Waking up on the couch, Carter assumes it's a dream. He enters the bathroom a second time, sensing danger, but the killer strikes again. On his third reset, Carter realizes he must lose his pursuer to escape this terrifying time loop. But as he and Audrey Evans try to get into a car, a truck crushes them. Waking up a fourth time, he decides to investigate everyone. While Audrey and Brock Thorne argue, a clown mask falls out of Brock's bag. With each reset, Carter gathers more clues. During a scuffle, he discovers the killer is a woman, realizing she is a hired gun working for a mastermind. He uses her phone records across multiple resets to eliminate suspects. Eventually, clearing everyone around him, Carter is forced to capture the killer for information. Exploiting an 11 PM office power outage, he finally knocks her out and interrogates her. His colleagues arrive, reacting differently to her unmasked face. While Carter questions Oscar Wright about selling shares, the killer suddenly breaks free and murders everyone. Furious, Carter beats her down but kills himself before midnight to revive his friends. In the next reset, he captures her again. Just as he thinks it's over, a sudden death proves there are two killers: one driving the truck, the other shooting him. Carter must simultaneously subdue both to break the cycle. After another reset, his clues point to Brock. During their confrontation, the killer knocks everyone out. Brock reveals his true colors, confessing he orchestrated everything to seize The Skyborne Project. Nearing midnight, Carter tries to get himself killed, unsure if the time loop works past 12 AM. When an arrogant Brock refuses, Carter forcibly kisses Audrey, provoking Brock into killing him before the clock strikes. Once Brock and the killers are brought to justice, Carter goes to retrieve security footage as evidence. Suddenly, it dawns on him: there is another accomplice. At that moment, a Security Guard smirks, a dagger slipping from his sleeve.
69e8b4c47aafe1dcda02c5ff.title: Outsmarting the Clown Killer

69e8b7cffb25288a540dc0fe.synopsis: After being murdered, single CEO Clara Hayes is reborn in the 80s. She outsmarts traps set by the Vance family, including assault, her stepmom stealing her marriage, poisoning, framing, and rumors that her menstruation is unclean. Clara Hayes reunites with her partner and empowers local women to help restore the historic manor. She uncovers dark secrets, realizing her stepmom is her biological sister and her father is an imposter. In the end, she chooses to perish together with the villains. Clara Hayes then awakens in the modern era, knowing her brief presence forever changed their destinies.
69e8b7cffb25288a540dc0fe.title: The Woman in the Historic Manor

69e9b1a3b19a7b26c708ce7f.synopsis: Replaced by the true heir Justin, the adopted son Caleb is given an empty zoo by the Sterling family. He accidentally activates the Jurassic System, hatches a Triceratops, and goes viral with the help of streamer Kira. When the Sterling family tries to seize the property, Caleb drives them away with a T-Rex and later thwarts a poacher attack. Unlocking more dinosaurs like the Diplodocus, he partners with the Caldwell Group to expand, eventually buying out the Sterling Group to build the world's first Jurassic Dinosaur Park.
69e9b1a3b19a7b26c708ce7f.title: Geez! I Have a Dinosaur Park!

69e9b5a0b3436643670a5433.synopsis: Reborn as her Grandmother by a sickbed, she escapes an arranged marriage and falls for General Hayes. Using her modern wits, she helps him conquer all odds to live happily ever after.
69e9b5a0b3436643670a5433.title: The Lady and the General

69e9b5a2b3436643670a5437.synopsis: The Cross Family of Northbay is massacred, but Gideon Cross survives. After learning The Seventy-Two Earthly Shifts, he returns eighteen years later for revenge. He soon rescues Valerie Pierce from Lord Drake's goons, and she later discovers Gideon is her fiance. When Malcolm Graves, the richest man in Northbay, seeks Drake's help, Drake sends his goddaughter, Nadia. Her assassination attempt fails, and Gideon toys with her instead. After crashing Malcolm's birthday with a coffin, Gideon defeats experts from The Apex Roster. He is nearly killed by Drake's poison master, Trent, but Valerie saves him, revealing herself as the Commander of the Dragon Order. When Jagger, the original assassin, is hospitalized, Gideon stops Malcolm and Drake's hitmen from silencing him. Impressed, Drake sends Nadia to seduce Gideon. While dining, they are harassed by the Governor's drunk nephew, Preston Hale, at a restaurant owned by Malcolm's daughter, Evelyn Graves. Feigning loyalty to Drake, Gideon fights The Valdorian Delegation for Northbay. Malcolm and the Governor's wife, Beatrice Hale, conspire to kill him. Gideon crushes the delegation, but an envoy fatally overdoses on enhancers. Framed, Gideon is trapped by Beatrice's Golden Snare until Valerie exposes Beatrice as an enemy spy. Drake then plans to marry Nadia to Preston. Meanwhile, Evelyn overhears Malcolm ordering Madam Blanche to poison Valerie. Gideon saves Valerie just in time. At the engagement, Gideon takes three strikes from Drake to free Nadia. When Drake breaks his word and tries to kill him, Gideon fights back. To survive, Drake exposes Malcolm's treason. Gideon chases the fleeing Malcolm but is lured away, allowing Malcolm to kidnap Valerie, Nadia, and Evelyn. Facing Malcolm alone, Gideon shifts into The Great Trickster, defeats him, and avenges his family. Yet, torn between three beautiful women, Gideon faces his toughest choice yet.
69e9b5a2b3436643670a5437.title: Watch My 72 Shifts

69e9b5aab3436643670a544b.synopsis: Fifteen years ago, Lydia gave up her billionaire adoption spot to her twin, Diana. Years later, ruthlessly bullied by elites, Lydia attempts suicide and barely survives. Diana returns victorious, only to find her beloved sister fighting for her life in the Intensive Care Unit. Devastated, she seeks vengeance, becoming the bait to personally punish the monsters who pushed Lydia to the edge!
69e9b5aab3436643670a544b.title: Cheating Death: The Avenging Twin Goes on a Rampage

69e9b5abb3436643670a544f.synopsis: Wealthy heiress Caroline Hawthorne secretly weds a poor country boy, David Miller. A year later, her disapproving father, Mr. Hawthorne of Hawthorne Enterprises, tracks them down. Just as the couple is happily caring for their adorable boy and girl twins, Mr. Hawthorne barges in. Ignoring their desperate pleas, he forcefully takes Caroline and the twin boy away, renaming the boy Mason Hawthorne. David is left alone in the country to raise their little daughter, Emma Miller (Emmy).
69e9b5abb3436643670a544f.title: Where did Mom go

69e9ceb2081f34529d08f1bc.synopsis: In the kingdom of Aethelgard, where men bow and women rule, Princess Valerie, the ruthless Goddess of War, seeks revenge. To humiliate the enemy who once bested her on the battlefield, she takes the legendary Valdorian Warlord as her consort. But the seemingly submissive man at her side is not who he claims to be. He is Caspian Vale, the twin brother of her enemy, and a Blood Proxy forced since childhood to bear every wound, every poison, every agony meant for his sibling. Chained by a dark blood pact, Caspian hides behind his brother's name, waiting for the one thing that can set him free: the mythical Icebloom. But what begins as a game of deception slowly turns into something neither expected...
69e9ceb2081f34529d08f1bc.title: Her Hidden Blade

69e9d01b27d59bed110a3101.synopsis: A female general watches her husband die taking an arrow meant for her. As she falls from a cliff, she swears: if given another life, she will love him better. Then she wakes up—five years earlier, on the day of their engagement. This time, she marries him without hesitation. Armed with memories of the future, she foils her brother's schemes, dismantles a rival's plots, and mends every rift with her husband and his mother. Together, she helps him rise to the highest office—while earning the empire's highest honor for herself. The swords of the past become the foundation of their happiness.
69e9d01b27d59bed110a3101.title: Die For You, Kill For All

69e9d67108db954e5e0d868e.synopsis: Thomas, a traditional medicine graduate, awakens as a rogue in Calvin Village. He uses modern medicine to outsmart his uncle Edwin, rescue Caroline, and start a successful business. After exposing the corrupt officials and curing a plague, he saves the emperor from an invasion. Who knew someone so weak could turn out to be a hero?
69e9d67108db954e5e0d868e.title: Reborn: I'm the Legendary Healer

69eac93a1665d9d2e30fbd1e.synopsis: Maria Barseghian and Nate Flores from Once Upon a Breakup hit the streets of LA for the ultimate foodie date. Maria takes Nate through her go-to spots from trendy coffee shops to smash burger joints, ending with a little friendly competition at the arcade. Great food, real chemistry, and a day that gets a little more intimate with every stop.
69eac93a1665d9d2e30fbd1e.title: ReelTalk EP 71-Maria and Nate's First Date

69eadde7df79a48dcb0f67ec.synopsis: Jeremy, a fortune teller from the 21st century, is transported to ancient times and becomes a fake eunuch. Initially planning to stay under the radar, his life changes when he's caught by the princess while pretending to serve her. Forced into a relationship, Jeremy wins the princess's heart. Using his strategic genius, he rises through the ranks in the palace, eventually becoming the first-ever "Lord of Leisure."
69eadde7df79a48dcb0f67ec.title: The Eunuch's Gambit

69eb235540c196bed1003c3e.synopsis: When poor student Lincoln Cross is hit by campus queen Audrey Sterling, he suddenly gains powerful X-ray vision. His astonishing talent leaves gang heiress Vera Blackwood, stunning sisters Blair Leighton & Amber Collins, and the elegant Audrey Sterling utterly captivated. After all—who wouldn’t want a walking god of wealth? Adapted from a hit web novel.
69eb235540c196bed1003c3e.title: X-Ray Eyes, Billionaire Rise

69ee144b9145b171320d315a.synopsis: The night before the State Championship final, cheerleader Jessica invites the Maple Giants football team to party with her at the bar. Katlyn, as the team's manager, puts her foot down and demands they get a good nights rest instead of going out and drinking. The next day, the Maple Giants win the championship, only to be greeted with terrible news — Jessica went out alone last night, was assaulted and broke her legs. The team, led by Logan, pins the blame on Katlyn, claiming that if she hadn't stopped them from going to Jessica's party, Jessica would still be safe! Logan demands that Katlyn suffers the same fate and breaks her leg. While trying to escape, Katlyn falls off the roof and dies. The football team even frames her as a bully. Katlyn suddenly wakes up the night before the Championship Final! Not about to waste her second chance at life, Katlyn swears to herself she'll never help these dumb jocks again. Instead, she'll watch and enjoy as they bring about their self-destruction!
69ee144b9145b171320d315a.title: Reborn to See the Football Stars Ruin Themselves

69eec35f4bc5cb71330647f1.synopsis: In Got Dumped. Got LadyAid movie, Gavin is a broke delivery guy, and his girlfriend has dumped him for a rich man. Humiliated, he activates the LadyAid Cash-back System: help a woman, get huge cash. A small favor earns $78k. Soon, he's saving women from debt and disaster, rising from zero to power. His ex fights back with lies and schemes, but every woman he helped has his back.
69eec35f4bc5cb71330647f1.title: Got Dumped. Got LadyAid.

69eedad16efacf0b460c5a19.synopsis: Facing her husband's deadly trap, heiress Elise hires Silas, a mysterious and elite bodyguard. She is a dying phoenix; he is a blade in the dark. Using the Tate family as their chessboard, everyone assumes he is just her pawn. Little do they know, this is a high-stakes gamble of lives and hearts.
69eedad16efacf0b460c5a19.title: Love, Bound & Blooming

69eefd088924136e2a02c409.synopsis: Billionaire heiress Briana hides her identity to support her husband Dylan. Pregnant again, she leaves their daughter in his care, but he locks the child in a car in order to help his ex! Rushing to save her daughter, Briana goes into emergency labor. When Dylan shows no remorse, Briana decides it's time to leave and take back everything.
69eefd088924136e2a02c409.title: They Locked Her Daughter in the Car

69eefd7fc9e41a3f6c0e8546.synopsis: Top fighter Damian returns as Lord Hades to protect his fiancée, Sterling Group's CEO, Vivian Sterling. After revealing his true identity to NSB Captain Avery, they share an unexpected night of passion. Damian defeats global assassin Marilyn, exposes Vivian's friend Sylvia as a mole, and continuously thwarts the Blackwood family's plots to steal an anti-cancer project. He survives sniper fire, subdues Don Carmine of the Azure Gang, and easily crushes the assassin Clyde Barnes.
69eefd7fc9e41a3f6c0e8546.title: The Unbeatable Guardian

69eefd85c9e41a3f6c0e8556.synopsis: Top fighter Damian returns as Lord Hades to protect his fiancée, Sterling Group's CEO, Vivian Sterling. After revealing his true identity to NSB Captain Avery, they share an unexpected night of passion. Damian defeats global assassin Marilyn, exposes Vivian's friend Sylvia as a mole, and continuously thwarts the Blackwood family's plots to steal an anti-cancer project. He survives sniper fire, subdues Don Carmine of the Azure Gang, and easily crushes the assassin Clyde Barnes.
69eefd85c9e41a3f6c0e8556.title: The Unbeatable Guardian

69ef22c5b36ddb3bde05ca76.synopsis: Eighteen years ago, Miles' family was massacred over two legendary medical books. The two-year-old was sent to a mountain and adopted by an old master. Now, Miles returns with a Marriage Pact. On his way, he saves Melanie and Scarlett, healing Melanie's facial scars. Arriving at the Prescott family, he faces disdain and a broken engagement, only to notice Robert is on the verge of death. Wielding the Peerless Immortal Skill to control life and death, and his family's medical skills to reverse fate, Miles begins his journey...
69ef22c5b36ddb3bde05ca76.title: Miracle Healer's Love Story with Ms. CEO

69f024cf72189b81f30776c0.synopsis: After witnessing Reginald murder his wife, Lottie feigned muteness to survive. Years later, she fell for her rescuer Julian, but they were separated by her mother. When her family fell, Lottie sought Julian, only to have her identity stolen by Natalie. To escape Reginald, she married Julian. Pregnant and mistrusted, she fled, later returning disguised as a kidnapper. Their conflict ultimately exposed the truth, allowing them to take down Reginald together.
69f024cf72189b81f30776c0.title: The Mute Bride's Revenge

69f04835a620c88b94027610.synopsis: 18 years ago, vengeful maid Brenda swapped her baby with her mistress Victoria's daughter. The real young lady Charlotte suffered abuse and poverty, while the imposter Lily enjoyed a wealthy life. After Charlotte was hired by her birth mother, Brenda and Lily framed her repeatedly. As birthmarks and DNA revealed the truth, Victoria uncovered her husband and Brenda's poisonous conspiracy. Evil schemes were exposed, the wicked were expelled, and Victoria finally reunited with her long-lost daughter.
69f04835a620c88b94027610.title: Switched Heiresses- A Destiny Misplaced

69f05a032d36237c2b0136ba.synopsis: Fifty-year-old cleaner Joyce Abbott is kicked out by her greedy son and daughter-in-law. In despair, she impulsively marries a security guard, Richard Sterling. Little does she know, her sweet new husband is secretly a billionaire! Even more shocking, his daughter, Stella Sterling, is Joyce's biological child she lost in the ruins 30 years ago. When her snobby in-laws return to humiliate her, her security guard husband steps up to protect her, sparking a heartwarming journey of sweet revenge and family reunion.
69f05a032d36237c2b0136ba.title: Late Love With A Tycoon

69f158afd8c0deda7f0c4bc4.synopsis: Eight years of agony. Endless betrayals. Then a second chance. Madeline Hayes awakens at the start of her nightmare, and she's not the same naive girl anymore. She cuts off her so-called uncle, trashes his precious first love, and gets her revenge cold and clean. But when she turns to leave for good, the man who once broke her now clings to her, red-eyed, begging her to stay.
69f158afd8c0deda7f0c4bc4.title: Reborn, Not Yours

69f1bafcc88faab6300cffe4.synopsis: Wolf Agent Evelyn accidentally time-traveled, waking up in a poor village. She became the stepmother to three kids after their father, Arthur, went missing. Left to raise them alone, Evelyn unlocked the Emotion Exchange System. Soon, she had her family feasting on meat during a famine and earning money by selling candied haws. But peace never lasted long. With new dangers threatening the family of four, how would Evelyn and the children survive?
69f1bafcc88faab6300cffe4.title: The Agent Mom: Survive the Famine

69f1bb38cbc5d826c1041bf8.synopsis: Sarah Palin, Patient Zero in the mental hospital, takes a job at OmniMed after recovering. When her tormentor, Morgan Hunter, turns workplace bullying into a vicious campaign, Sarah fights back. But Sarah is thrown back to the mental hospital...
69f1bb38cbc5d826c1041bf8.title: Patient Zero's First Day of Work

69f1bb39cbc5d826c1041bfc.synopsis: Lucas Hayes and his wife Chloe go for a routine checkup. The results come back: advanced liver cancer. But Chloe misreads the report — she believes Lucas is the one dying, not her. While Lucas scrambles to raise the $50,000 surgery fee, Chloe refuses the hospital's arranged liver donor and lends the $50,000 to her younger brother to get a car. "Lucas doesn't deserve to spend that much", she tells herself. Then Lucas places her real diagnosis in her hands. But the money, the one thing that could have saved her, is already gone...
69f1bb39cbc5d826c1041bfc.title: The Test She Failed

69f2cff5a10838ffa605da0d.synopsis: Trapped in the Summer Heat is a 54-episode English short drama of family ethics & realistic tragedy. Set in extreme summer heat, it tells a heartbreaking story that 5-year-old Lily is locked in a scorching car by her father Ryan for hours, because Ryan chooses to stay with his mistress Sienna and her son Miles. Lily eventually dies of heatstroke. Her mother Marin frantically searches for her daughter, confronts her husband’s coldness and betrayal, and ushers in a broken ending and cruel truth. The drama focuses on three realistic pain points: marriage betrayal, parental neglect, and fatal danger of leaving kids in hot cars, with high emotional tension and dense conflicts, which is a realistic short drama with strong warning significance and payment appeal.
69f2cff5a10838ffa605da0d.title: The Godfather's Redemption and Betrayal

69f30e51e725ee20ad0c680a.synopsis: After a zombie outbreak, Zachary Auden awakens the True Love System and is forced to date gorgeous zombie CEO, Caroline Stark. But that's not the only problem. Between fighting off zombie hordes and dodging dirty schemes from rival survivors, he still has a world to save.
69f30e51e725ee20ad0c680a.title: Love Bites: My Girlfriend Is a Zombie CEO

69f3ed48faeb4f798601aad9.synopsis: Two major forces in verticals finally collide. Jen Cooper of Vertical Drama Love joins Nicole Mattox for an intimate conversation on the state of verticals. From where the industry is headed to what audiences are really craving, nothing is off-limits. It’s an unfiltered deep dive into the conversations creators, actors, and fans have been waiting for.
69f3ed48faeb4f798601aad9.title: ReelTalk EP 72-Vertical Drama Love Unfiltered

69f4c7f4843c9ba3b80c4285.synopsis: Jason gave everything for his dream girl, Mia — only to catch her cheating with a wealthy rival. On the verge of a breakdown, he awakens the Trillion-Dollar Subsidy System, which rewards him with luxury homes and supercars for completing tasks. He rises from rock bottom, humiliates the cheating woman and her lover, then saves his father by confronting his own cousin, gaining hotel equity and launching his business empire. Along the way, he protects a childhood friend and helps a woman named Sophie, steadily expanding his wealth until he becomes the richest man in Cloudhaven.
69f4c7f4843c9ba3b80c4285.title: Cashback Over Crushes

69f7696e9d97ba20aa0edcbd.synopsis: Audrey Harrington, the adopted daughter of the Harrington Estate, is betrayed and murdered by the trueborn child, Stella Harrington, and the rest of House Harrington. Reborn, Audrey vows revenge. Calculating her every move, she reclaims the steward's power only to strategically let it go, plunging House Harrington into financial ruin. She then exposes Stella Harrington's schemes, completely humiliating her. Meanwhile, she allies with His Highness Rowan Lancaster to uncover the dark secrets of House Harrington. Ultimately, Audrey exposes their crimes, leading to the family's exile. Free from their grasp, she finds her happily ever after with Rowan Lancaster.
69f7696e9d97ba20aa0edcbd.title: Not My Clan, Not My Problem

69fa0a977e9368c0730c1459.synopsis: In the Rejected Luna Is the Alpha Queen movie, after her Moonshadow Pack was slaughtered by rogues, Arya, the werewolf warrior, hides her immense power to honor her mother's dying wish. She marries Alpha Micah, and hides her strength. But then, Alpha Micah breaks his vows and returns from war with a new mate, Vera, and demands that Arya share her Luna title with her. Faced with Vera, Micah, and his family's cruelty, Arya can no longer bear it. She leaves Micah and unleashes the immense power of the White Wolf, reclaiming what is hers with the help of Lowe, the Lycan King. After separating from Micah, Arya discoveres that Vera not only stole Micah from her, but is also the traitor who slaughtered her parents and the Moonshadow Pack. Arya rushes to the battlefield to face her betrayers, and in the process, finds love in Lowe, the Lycan King.
69fa0a977e9368c0730c1459.title: Rejected Luna Is the Alpha Queen

69fa0a987e9368c0730c145b.synopsis: A prince torn from his throne. A peasant girl who risked everything to save him. Years later, he returns as king, only to be betrayed, beaten, and forced to fight for love, honor, and revenge.
69fa0a987e9368c0730c145b.title: Prince, Thief, to Warrior King

69fa1e880683f8510b02930c.synopsis: War hero Harrison returns from war to discover his sister has died by her fiancé, Karter's hand. Harrison infiltrates Karter's banquet wearing his worn fatigues, announcing to Karter that his punishment will arrive in 3 days. Eventually, he reveals his true identity as the Director of FBI, and achieves his ultimate revenge.
69fa1e880683f8510b02930c.title: The Warlord Returns

69faa3a3d0f105e060066c52.synopsis: Sixteen years ago, Eleanor Fletcher's husband faked his own death and abandoned her — all for wealth and status. Left alone to carry the Blackwood family, she did the unthinkable: she married the family's adoptee, Silas, giving the household a new future. Sixteen years later, Silas has risen to become the most powerful minister in the court. Together, he and Eleanor share a deep and unbreakable bond — until the past comes crashing back. Caleb — the husband who supposedly died — returns with another woman and her children, demanding his birthright. But he has no idea what he's walking into...
69faa3a3d0f105e060066c52.title: Ex Left for Gold, She Married the Throne

69faa3a4d0f105e060066c54.synopsis: Dying of cancer, Serena Vance let her husband cheat. But in the end, she's run over by his mistress and dumped like trash. Reborn, cancer gone, the mistress never appears. Now she's back as design queen, joins Grant Group, and crushes it. No more doormat. Only boss.
69faa3a4d0f105e060066c54.title: Dead to Love

69faa3a5d0f105e060066c56.synopsis: Maya Hayes is a straight-A student with one goal: study hard, escape her violent father, and never look back. But when she stumbles into a tattoo parlor — fleeing a beating — she comes face-to-face with Oakridge High's resident rebel, Jude Sinclair. Soon, the well-behaved scholar and the rich kid with a broken past are thrown together as desk mates. Late nights turn into shared secrets. Insults give way to understanding. Bit by bit, they begin to see through each other's armor — and find something real underneath. Together, they make a pact: break free, fight back, and burn down everything that tries to keep them down.
69faa3a5d0f105e060066c56.title: The Rebel and the Scholar

69faab23fdb63161f2087bf6.synopsis: When Tessa Reed reunites with Nathan Vance, she’s the humble contractor, while he stands tall as her arrogant client. It’s just like their college days: she pined for him silently, yet the cold, coveted campus heartthrob only had eyes for his perfect moonlight girl. As Nathan gets closer, Tessa falls for him again, until she hears him mock her as a poor girl he could never love. Heartbroken, Tessa walks away. Panicking, a tearful Nathan chases her into the rain to beg for her heart.
69faab23fdb63161f2087bf6.title: Pride Fell For Me

69faadb86f782eff4301a833.synopsis: A top CEO from 2026 dies — and wakes up in 1993 as Ivory Dawson, a disfigured woman betrayed by her cheating husband and a ruthless homewrecker. Stripped of her dowry and thrown out to die, she refuses to stay down. A modern smartphone can change everything. Toxic mother-in-law, brainwashed son, and a scumbag husband, she's fighting them all back.
69faadb86f782eff4301a833.title: Beauty & Billions: She Strikes Back

69fab2df0fd3bf50d305f3ee.synopsis: Invincible Grandmaster Arthur descends into the mortal world. He sparks a fiery romance with his childhood sweetheart while captivating a martial arts goddess and a wealthy heiress. Thrust into Meridian's brutal war for supremacy, Arthur ruthlessly crushes every rival, sweeping aside all obstacles to claim his throne at the absolute peak.
69fab2df0fd3bf50d305f3ee.title: The Immortal's Return

69fab2e00fd3bf50d305f3f0.synopsis: College student Jason time-traveled to the Cultivation World. After cultivating for 10,000 years to become a Sage, he returns to Earth to find only one day has passed! Before he left, his father died, his adopted brother forced his mother into debt, his buddy Derek stole his patent money, and his crush Alyssa was stolen by his rival. Now back, Jason ruthlessly crushes those bullies! He dismantles loan sharks, saves the head of Reed Group, and helps his secret admirer Zoe make a stunning comeback. Facing hidden enemies on Earth, he uses his 10,000 years of cultivation power to crush everything in his path.
69fab2e00fd3bf50d305f3f0.title: Sage in the City: 24-Hour Comeback

69fad8547b11a0bb350e64a4.synopsis: Invincible Grandmaster Arthur descends into the mortal world. He sparks a fiery romance with his childhood sweetheart while captivating a martial arts goddess and a wealthy heiress. Thrust into Meridian's brutal war for supremacy, Arthur ruthlessly crushes every rival, sweeping aside all obstacles to claim his throne at the absolute peak.
69fad8547b11a0bb350e64a4.title: The Immortal's Return

69fae1475d993aaf0d039292.synopsis: Heir Rowan Kingsley survives a cliff fall, rescued by poor farmer Theodore Palmer and his daughter Nora. The Palmers sacrifice everything to send him abroad. Nora hides her own college acceptance to support him. Five years later, Rowan returns to repay the family who saved him.
69fae1475d993aaf0d039292.title: True Love Prevails

69fae3db71ec89999c062a98.synopsis: Amnesiac John Miller and his daughter Mia keep a low profile at Sinclair Group until John accidentally provokes Zachary Sinclair. Brutally harassed, John's fate takes a turn when Zachary recognizes a unique charm. The shocking discovery transforms Zachary from bully to bewildered son: his victim is Jonathan, the father he never knew.
69fae3db71ec89999c062a98.title: The Father They Never Knew

69faeb5bc5ebabd7cd07a9d2.synopsis: In her past life, Karol Eisen married Prince Harold Jackson by royal decree. She gave him her heart, only to discover he loved someone else. After a life of neglect and abuse, she died in despair. Reborn, she swears never to repeat her tragic mistakes!
69faeb5bc5ebabd7cd07a9d2.title: Too Late for Us

69faf9b835cf4a063b0a624d.synopsis: College student Jason time-traveled to the Cultivation World. After cultivating for 10,000 years to become a Sage, he returns to Earth to find only one day has passed! Before he left, his father died, his adopted brother forced his mother into debt, his buddy Derek stole his patent money, and his crush Alyssa was stolen by his rival. Now back, Jason ruthlessly crushes those bullies! He dismantles loan sharks, saves the head of Reed Group, and helps his secret admirer Zoe make a stunning comeback. Facing hidden enemies on Earth, he uses his 10,000 years of cultivation power to crush everything in his path.
69faf9b835cf4a063b0a624d.title: Sage in the City: 24-Hour Comeback

69fb80fb9feee94a1309f720.synopsis: Seraph was a princess cherished by her family her entire life, until her sister was murdered. When her husband and best friend helped the killer escape justice, she was forced to grow up overnight.
69fb80fb9feee94a1309f720.title: Your Love Broke My Heart

69fbf3647af8964bc00a85cf.synopsis: Dossey Hope, intellectually disabled since childhood, was deceived by her parents into taking the fall for her sister and went to prison, where she secretly learned martial arts. Upon her release, her parents attempted to commit her to a mental hospital. At that moment, Nathan Gannon, heir to the wealthiest family in the Capital, suddenly proposes marriage.
69fbf3647af8964bc00a85cf.title: Fool Me Once

69fc26fa701aa19375023e5d.synopsis: Penny Stirling transmigrates into a romance novel as the loyal sidekick and lackey to the villainess Evelyn Sterling. In the original plot, Evelyn meets a ruinous end after crossing the lead couple—and Penny is dragged down to the same tragic fate right alongside her. Now, the Overseer tasks Penny with fixing Evelyn's foolish obsession with love. She helps Evelyn expose the scumbag. While completing her mission, she sticks close to Miss Sterling, achieving both career success and massive wealth!
69fc26fa701aa19375023e5d.title: Saving My Villainess Boss

69fc3afbfdb63161f2087c2e.synopsis: In Got Dumped. Got LadyAid movie, a broke delivery guy, Gavin, is dumped by his girlfriend the day she graduates for a rich man. Humiliated, he activates the LadyAid Cash-back System: help a woman, get huge cash. A small favor earns $78K. Soon, he's saving women from debt and disaster, rising from zero to mansions, a restaurant empire, and a law firm. His ex fights back with lies and schemes, but every woman he helped has his back. She ends up in jail. Gavin walks away with Paige's heart, a fortune, and no regrets.
69fc3afbfdb63161f2087c2e.title: Got Dumped. Got LadyAid.

69fc66ba27c436701c0aa300.synopsis: The true heiress, Stella, was unloved. On her deathbed, her parents celebrated the fake daughter's birthday. Only her aunt and uncle said goodbye. Reborn, she chooses them. They worry they're powerless, but she'll reclaim everything her father, Edward, stole. At the family party, she challenges him: whoever secures the order becomes head. The loser is erased. He takes the bet. The contract? It goes to her uncle.
69fc66ba27c436701c0aa300.title: True Heiress: Trading Up My Family

69fc82d7d30acc2a0b072463.synopsis: Seattle's relentless rain brings a chilling nightmare to Marilyn's doorstep: her husband's secret mistress has been brutally murdered. Overnight, the illusion of her perfect marriage completely shatters. Four months pregnant and seemingly blindsided, Marilyn is thrust into a terrifying police investigation where her husband, David, is named the prime suspect. Yet, as Detective Sarah Green digs deeper into the dual tragedies, eerie inconsistencies begin to surface—most notably, a ghostly figure caught on a neighbor's security camera in the dead of night. Everyone has a deadly motive, and no one is truly innocent. Trapped in a twisted game of cat and mouse, how far will a desperate widow go to survive? In a city where the truth is obscured by deception, the most chilling question remains: who is the real puppet master orchestrating this bloodbath?
69fc82d7d30acc2a0b072463.title: My Husband's Mistress is Dead

69fc8a25105a230d0c0da6bd.synopsis: Penny Stirling transmigrates into a romance novel as the loyal sidekick and lackey to the villainess Evelyn Sterling. In the original plot, Evelyn meets a ruinous end after crossing the lead couple—and Penny is dragged down to the same tragic fate right alongside her. Now, the Overseer tasks Penny with fixing Evelyn's foolish obsession with love. She helps Evelyn expose the scumbag. While completing her mission, she sticks close to Miss Sterling, achieving both career success and massive wealth!
69fc8a25105a230d0c0da6bd.title: Saving My Villainess Boss

69fc8a93a90184a23e042ccd.synopsis: After four years of slaving away for an unfaithful girlfriend, deliveryman Glenn inherits the Ghost Valley Legacy, unlocking godlike skills. He vows revenge and takes Oakhaven by storm. Discovering Lyra is key to his cultivation, he marries her to save her father. Despite a rocky start and attacks from the Eclipse, they bond. Glenn crushes enemies, builds an empire, and wins Lyra's heart, melting her cold exterior. Together, they find their happily ever after.
69fc8a93a90184a23e042ccd.title: The Husband Delivered by Fate

69fc8ab8802fea273d001ccb.synopsis: After four years of slaving away for an unfaithful girlfriend, deliveryman Glenn inherits the Ghost Valley Legacy, unlocking godlike skills. He vows revenge and takes Oakhaven by storm. Discovering Lyra is key to his cultivation, he marries her to save her father. Despite a rocky start and attacks from the Eclipse, they bond. Glenn crushes enemies, builds an empire, and wins Lyra's heart, melting her cold exterior. Together, they find their happily ever after.
69fc8ab8802fea273d001ccb.title: The Husband Delivered by Fate

69fc97f7f35208d08800c854.synopsis: In My Boss Loves Me Too Much movie, Ella planned to challenge herself by taking a new job after years of managing crises, but her world is turned upside down when her new boss, Christian, drags her in a fake marriage! What starts as a simple arrangement soon becomes something far more intense. Every touch, every kiss, draws Ella deeper into his world. But what she doesn’t know is that Christian has been playing a dangerous game all along, determined to make her his forever.
69fc97f7f35208d08800c854.title: My Boss Loves Me Too Much

69fd0c482d20ccc4be08afe5.synopsis: We’re hitting the road for festival season! Cole Gerdes and Mellisa Goodwin hop behind the wheel for a special carpool karaoke-style Finish the Lyrics challenge. Can they recognize the songs or will they completely flop under pressure?
69fd0c482d20ccc4be08afe5.title: ReelTalk EP 73-Can Vertical Actors Sing a Justin Bieber Song?

69fd0d45fe565cebed0b600b.synopsis: For Mental Health Awareness Month, Gabrielle Brown opens up about the unglamorous side of the industry and overcoming hardships. From setting boundaries to navigating healing after marriage, Gabrielle discusses growth, resilience, and protecting your peace. Tune in for a vulnerable discussion on mental health and advice for anyone navigating a difficult time.
69fd0d45fe565cebed0b600b.title: ReelTalk EP 74-Gabrielle Brown: Surviving Betrayal and People Pleasing

69fd0d804bd18783fa0c5c1c.synopsis: Join Savannah Coffee and Chris Quartuccio as ReelTalk goes international for its first-ever ReelTrip to Thailand. From the vibrant streets and skyline of Bangkok to iconic landmarks like Wat Pho, these costars dive into Thailand’s culture through unforgettable food, shopping, sightseeing, and makeovers. Experience the flavors, fashion, and beauty of Thailand through their adventure abroad.
69fd0d804bd18783fa0c5c1c.title: ReelTalk EP 75-ReelTrip: Thailand

69fd0ddb105a230d0c0da6c3.synopsis: Our iconic enemies-to-lovers is back and better than ever! Go behind the scenes of Taming My Bullies 2 and discover how Meg's signature look comes together. Cam also gives the inside scoop on filming some of the shirtless swimming scenes, while the director breaks down the inspiration behind key shots and what it really takes to bring this story to life.
69fd0ddb105a230d0c0da6c3.title: ReelTalk EP 76-Backstage: Taming My Bullies 2

69fd0dfdb6f786ada703b918.synopsis: Four breakout stars from ReelShort’s hit LGBTQ series come together for an intimate Pride Month special short video, sharing their most genuine crush confessions through cinematic monologues inspired by real emotions, memories, and love stories. Set against dreamy summer nights, camcorder footage, and coastlines, Crush Confessions captures the quiet ache of longing, youth, and the moment every love song finally starts to make sense.
69fd0dfdb6f786ada703b918.title: ReelTalk EP 77-Love Whisper
