He is willing to swallow his pride and risk heartbreak if it means finally escaping the constraints of his magical existence. Christine Parrish Christine Parrish is an ignorant, prideful woman who mistakes wealth for character. She spends her marriage looking down on Elijah and believing he’s unworthy of her love. She eventually faces the consequences of her actions, and her downfall couldn’t be more satisfying. Tony Roth Tony Roth is Christine’s ex-boyfriend. He’s arrogant, selfish, and delusional about his importance, believing he deserves Christine more than anyone. His own schemes backfire on him when he discovers the truth about Elijah’s identity. Ruby Hiller Ruby Hiller is Elijah’s second chance at love. She’s the granddaughter of another billionaire Elijah helped in the past. Unlike Christine, Ruby knows what she wants, recognizes true humility, and cherishes Elijah the way he deserves.
6a5191d8fa9f9f7a09081789.title: The Great and Powerful Genie

6a544e264e8edf02280ca29d.synopsis: Khloe has always played by the rules until her sister's life depends on money she doesn't have. So she signs the unthinkable: marry ruthless billionaire Jasper Tate, give him the heir his empire demands, and walk away rich. No feelings. No complications. Just business.Khloe has always played by the rules until her sister's life depends on money she doesn't have. So she signs the unthinkable: marry ruthless billionaire Jasper Tate, give him the heir his empire demands, and walk away rich. No feelings. No complications. Just business. But Jasper never expected his fake wife to get under his skin. And Khloe never planned to want a man she's only pretending to love. The contract had one rule — don't fall in love. Breaking it could cost them everything.
6a544e264e8edf02280ca29d.title: A Marriage Deal with the Billionaire

6a544e2b68ff54a82a095030.synopsis: On her wedding day, Ava discovers the truth: her father has been pushed to the back of the room while a rich girl’s dog gets a seat at the main table. One public humiliation exposes her fiancé’s family for who they really are. So Ava walks away from the perfect wedding and chooses the man who gave her everything, building a future where her father finally stands in the light.
6a544e2b68ff54a82a095030.title: My Father Outside the Spotlight

6a544f954199bdefcb07d765.synopsis: At her sacred bonding ceremony, snow leopard princess Diana is rejected by all three fated mates and betrayed by the maid who stole her first love. Desperate to protect her dying tribe, she invokes an ancient Moonstone law and chooses Carl, a chained arena slave, as her beast husband. Everyone mocks her for marrying beneath her, until Carl’s Silver Tiger bloodline awakens and Diana carries his legendary heir. As jealous ex-lovers, rival tribes, and royal conspiracies close in, Diana rises from public disgrace to unstoppable queen, while the man everyone called a slave reveals himself as Emperor Yuan.
6a544f954199bdefcb07d765.title: The Silver Tiger Mate's Gentle Pampering

6a547c258e7dc74d870b30af.synopsis: In The Valkyrie Divorces the God of War movie, to protect his wife, God King Kairos sealed his divine powers and feigned being a worthless mortal. Instead of gratitude, Cassia returned bearing her lover's child, demanding the family relic while humiliating him publicly. Driven past his limit, Kairos shattered his shackles, awakening his supreme godhood. He exposed her lover as an abyssal spy, leading to the traitor's execution. Begging for mercy, Cassia fled in exile, as the God King reclaimed his absolute throne.
6a547c258e7dc74d870b30af.title: The Valkyrie Divorces the God of War

6a547dbf24890ff5cd06e619.synopsis: Iris’s mother, who had immigrated to the United States from Thailand as part of a blended family, died in a car accident along with her American husband while they were on their way to get married. Unwilling to see Iris deported, her stepfather’s son, Leon, dropped out of school to work on a construction site and shoulder the financial burden; as they relied on each other, the two grew close. After graduating from high school, Iris was accepted into a New York law school, just as she had hoped. Leon promised to join her, but on the very last day, he was involved in an accident at the construction site, and the two lost contact. Five years later, Iris joined a top-tier law firm, and Leon walked through the doors as a billionaire client—reuniting the two.
6a547dbf24890ff5cd06e619.title: The Boy Raised Me is Mine

6a549b2451cf0e4d6c0a153d.synopsis: "I had been switched at birth for seventeen years. When my wealthy biological parents finally found me, they showed up in patched shirts, pretending to be poor. Together with the fake heiress, Seraphina, they threw me into a condemned building and forced me to repay them fifty thousand dollars every month. Then one day, my mother publicly cursed whoever had framed me, saying they would “go blind and have their legs broken.” The next morning, on the red carpet at a ball, Seraphina’s eyes bled and both her legs snapped. Only then did they fall to their knees before me, screaming, “Who the hell are you?” I lowered my eyes. A flash of dark gold passed through my pupils. “The witch who didn’t burn on the Salem stake three hundred years ago.”"
6a549b2451cf0e4d6c0a153d.title: The Karmic Heiress

6a549b295a4a5345b00e507f.synopsis: Ava Reed is accused of murdering Lilian Winslow, the precious baby heiress of a billion-dollar family trust. Surrounded by guns, fake evidence, and a flatlining monitor, Ava suddenly hears Lilian’s tiny voice begging for help. From poisonous perfume to forged medical records, fake pregnancy schemes, and trust-fund murder plots, Ava follows the baby’s clues and tears the whole conspiracy apart.
6a549b295a4a5345b00e507f.title: Mind-Reading Ultimate Guardian

6a549d9551cf0e4d6c0a1540.synopsis: In her past life, the female lead saved a homeless man — actually the Wine God in disguise. He gave her a goblet. Drinking from it gave her the Midas Touch, but each use cost her life force. Used as a pawn by a power hungry prince, she was exploited and ultimately killed by her jealous sister. With her last breath, she turned her sister's family to gold — and died. After her death, the Wine God revealed she was his daughter. He reversed time and gave her a second chance. This time, her sister stole the goblet first, gaining the Midas Touch herself. The prince still chased power, and the curse remained: the sister's body decayed, greed consumed the family and the court, and all were destroyed by their own desires. The female lead watched from the shadows — and let them destroy themselves.
6a549d9551cf0e4d6c0a1540.title: The Curse of the Midas Touch

6a54aab7320378451205e865.synopsis: When her childhood best friend Leo ties her to the school goalpost as a prank to impress another girl, Eleanor Vance transfers to a California high school to start over. As she heals, excels academically, and finds new love, Leo spirals into regret—but some betrayals can never be undone.
6a54aab7320378451205e865.title: He Pulled a Prank on Me and Lost Everything

6a54dceea398b25e350d0c8b.synopsis: Ava Russell on the eve of her arranged marriage, is drugged by her fiancé Nico Moretti and has her hair brutally shaved off by his comrade Scarlett. Refusing to swallow this humiliation, Ava secretly contacts Damian Costello, the powerful heir of the Costello family who has secretly loved her for twelve years. On the wedding day, when Nico tries to sneak Ava into his family through a shabby, hidden ceremony and Scarlett publicly strips off her wig to mock her, Damian arrives with a magnificent fleet to marry Ava in style. With the help of Damian and the Commission, Nico and Scarlett are stripped of their power and arrested for violating family laws, while Ava finally finds her true protector and happiness.
6a54dceea398b25e350d0c8b.title: His Partner, Her Revenge

6a55ac24485f9d5b0506785a.title: Dying After Ten Years for His Sin

6a55cba42bfaaef26f0f5299.synopsis: Wren is labeled wolfless and abandoned by her childhood lover Tristan at his coronation, who publicly rejects their mate bond and lets his lover cut her hair. Heartbroken, she leaves the Dark Moon pack and enters the elite Apex Academy. There, she awakens the rare powerful White Wolf bloodline hidden inside her. With the quiet Frost heir Killian's support, Wren defeats rivals, uncovers Vaelen's evil plot that preys on wolfkin's blood power, and rescues her dad. She stands side by side with Killian to build a new order where no one is forced to kneel for power.
6a55cba42bfaaef26f0f5299.title: The Lycan's Savage Luna

6a55d76bef68ac498703dd1b.synopsis: Lian Vier has spent his life hiding at Sanctum Academy as a harmless mixed-blood student, while in truth he is the last pure-blood male incubus under a kill-on-sight order. When a loss of control throws him into the arms of Lance Silverwood, the exorcist heir born to destroy him, blackmail, black-market hunters, and an abyss ritual close in. Lance chooses to feed him, bind himself to him, and fight beside him; when the buried truth about the demon purge is exposed, Lian stops being prey and becomes the one who judges the hunters.
6a55d76bef68ac498703dd1b.title: Bite the Exorcist Heir

6a55d7c500cd6e27a200316a.synopsis: Aurora Pyrelyn dies with her black drake husband Rowan’s claws in her chest, only to wake on the day of their Soulflame Bond. This time, Rowan remembers too, and he chooses Aurora’s golden sister Celeste for the throne she was promised. But Aurora no longer begs for a love built on ambition. She gives Rowan away, chooses the mocked white dragon Silas Frost, and discovers his vow is the one loyalty she was always denied. As Celeste, Rowan, and Aurora’s father chase bloodline power, the Old Flame Law reveals its truth: Aurora is not the heir, but the one who chooses who deserves the Throneflame. Betrayed again, she takes back her stolen fire, breaks the old bloodline order, and flies free with the dragon who chose her first.
6a55d7c500cd6e27a200316a.title: The Black Drakes Second Vow

6a55eb34abf3824e3a08be70.synopsis: Five years married, and he kicked me out for his "amnesiac" sister. After I miscarried, he said, "Let's get divorced, just pretend, to keep her calm." So I signed the real papers, blocked him. Her fake amnesia got exposed, she ended up in a psych ward. He faked cancer, then a car crash. Years later, I'm on Forbes, my sister's insane, my mother lives on the $200 a month I give her, and the man who threw me away is just someone I don't even bother to name anymore. They tried to destroy me, now I'm out of their reach.
6a55eb34abf3824e3a08be70.title: The Wife He Gave Away

6a56dd826a410e5f5d04c33b.synopsis: In Zero to Alpha Return of the Wolf King movie, exiled for failing to awaken his wolf form, Nory trained twenty years under three Masters beyond Sacred Rank. Returning to see his mother, he enters the Clan Tournament, shatters the test stone, crushes every foe, and is revealed as the savior three Gold Leaders sought. When vampires invade, he slams the Legendary First Sire through seven walls. Learning his mother was injured saving him, he gathers three sacred relics to heal her. But crimson eyes in distant mist hint a greater threat.
6a56dd826a410e5f5d04c33b.title: Zero to Alpha: Return of the Wolf King

6a56ddb45c65371f2b0a3f8a.synopsis: Kyle is the son of a wealthy family. His biological mother died early. At home, he's constantly excluded and framed by his stepmother Alicia and his half-brother Ryan. His father Robert banishes him to live in a backyard tool shed. At school, his family background makes him a target as well. He's mocked as "Trash Boy" and subjected to relentless bullying. One day, an alien spacecraft crashes into the backyard. Inside the shed, Kyle discovers an injured alien observer named Zorp. The two strike a deal: Kyle will wear Zorp's energy wristband and, by overcoming adversity and generating emotional energy, help Zorp repair his ship. In return, the wristband awakens Kyle's own latent potential. With heightened perception and physical abilities, Kyle begins fighting back against his bullies, enraging Ryan. In the school cafeteria, Ryan publicly accuses Kyle of stealing a valuable watch and, together with his lackeys, subjects him to brutal humiliation. As his dignity and spirit come under critical fire, Kyle makes a desperate plea for Zorp's help.
6a56ddb45c65371f2b0a3f8a.title: Trash Boy's Super Watch

6a56e53710cf0d2533014cfd.synopsis: Before I left for the Rogue Wars, my best friend Selene made me memorize one warning: if I ever came home and saw her eating almonds, that woman was not her. Three months later, I returned to Blood Moon Pack and found the Luna smiling at the dinner table, chewing the one food that should have killed her. Same face. Same scent. Same memories. She even called me by our childhood nickname. But Selene had never given false warnings. If the woman in front of me was not her, then where was my real Luna?
6a56e53710cf0d2533014cfd.title: The Silent Luna’s Secret

6a56e53a4ffb908818071aad.synopsis: New York's two deadliest queenpins, Vera Marchetti and Bianca Conti, have been rivals for twenty years and lovers in secret. When Bianca is exposed as a fake heiress, stripped of her name, and thrown to the enemies she made for her family, Vera flies home to claim the only person allowed to kill her. Together they turn a blood debt into a power play, crush the Contis, and make the underworld watch its most dangerous enemies become wives.
6a56e53a4ffb908818071aad.title: Queenpins- My Enemy, My Wife

6a56fdb294a9400558057de0.synopsis: Elana gave everything to her husband, her children, and a family that never protected her. On the day she gives birth, her babies are taken from her and handed to another woman. Even her most precious dragon scale is ripped away in the name of “atonement.” When regret finally comes, it is already too late. Reborn far from the palace, Elana becomes a healer, finds warmth again, and leaves the ashes of her old life behind.
6a56fdb294a9400558057de0.title: She Left The Ashes Behind

6a571f2c1e9758b002077f74.synopsis: Stan Shaw, a skilled master of medicine and martial arts, disguises himself as a beggar to escape a marriage contract with the Miller family. Contrary to his plan, they insist on the marriage. Yet the one they want him to marry isn't necessarily the one he thought.
6a571f2c1e9758b002077f74.title: That Beggar Wants Out

6a5722d9988fca73730da144.synopsis: Stan Shaw, a skilled master of medicine and martial arts, disguises himself as a beggar to escape a marriage contract with the Miller family. Contrary to his plan, they insist on the marriage. Yet the one they want him to marry isn't necessarily the one he thought.
6a5722d9988fca73730da144.title: That Beggar Wants Out

6a5724f41fd2b06f5e0142b5.synopsis: Eve helped Noah build Black Tech from nothing, only to discover he has married the intern Mia and plans to hand her Eve's biggest project. At the Grant signing ceremony, Eve reveals her true identity as the Grant Group heiress and exposes Mia's leak, Noah's entitlement, and the cost of eight wasted years. Walking away from his collapse, she signs back the life that always belonged to her.
6a5724f41fd2b06f5e0142b5.title: Eight Years Gone Down the Drain

6a5724f6dfc97c1a9403cf25.synopsis: "Wren's S-rank white lion shifter abandoned her mid-mission to soothe her sister instead. She almost died. The first thing she did after waking? Filed to swap him out. The only shifter available was a B-rank snake no one wanted—Silas. He came with his twin brother, River. Wren took them both. She didn't know Silas was the one who'd saved her that day. he'd hidden his SSS-rank just so she'd pick him. Now her ex is begging at her door while Silas cooks her dinner and River warms her bed. Then the Bonding Agency calls: Silas has been reassessed. A better match is available. His answer? " "I choose Wren."
6a5724f6dfc97c1a9403cf25.title: Two Snake, One Mate

6a575df904e2a3e52d00406b.synopsis: One drunken night, one humiliating ex, fake-date her worst enemy Blake or watch the Greenharts lose every point because of her. Hannah signs the contract expecting torture. Instead, she finds the cold, untouchable rival everyone fears has a side no one's ever seen, fiercely protective, quietly devoted, and hiding a secret of his own. When the pretending stops feeling like pretending, is it still an act? Then her ex Tristan discovers the truth—Hannah is Miss H, the anonymous genius the whole school idolizes. Now he's on his knees, begging for a second chance. Two boys, one choice.
6a575df904e2a3e52d00406b.title: The Fake Dating Spell

6a580b359cc3a55a2b08ad6d.synopsis: She came to town for a fresh start. Instead, Penelope Harris got pregnant by her ex’s powerful older brother, Knox Grant– the rugged cowboy who owns the ranch where she works. Now Penelope is caught between the man who would burn the world down for her and her ex, who wants to see her burn.
6a580b359cc3a55a2b08ad6d.title: Keeping the Cowboy's Baby

6a580e0abaa3c12b130cb57d.synopsis: In How to Wreck My Bully's Heart movie, Kristina Cooper's a scholarship student by day, online masked singer by night. She's got the perfect internet boyfriend in Dax – sweet, caring, and supportive – until she finds out he's Daxter, the monsterous thug who's been bullying her at school! Will she forgive Dexter, the damaged, broken boy she once loved, or will their anonymous love end in Dexter's never ending regret as Kristina choses a brighter future without him?
6a580e0abaa3c12b130cb57d.title: How to Wreck My Bully's Heart

6a5840e82769ac7896097974.synopsis: My best friend died with an Ivy League acceptance in one hand... and a billionaire heir's secrets in the other. So I reinvented myself as a Silicon Valley heiress and started dating the man who destroyed her. His family mocked me, used me, and treated me like their personal ATM. I smiled through every insult—because I was collecting evidence. But when I overheard them plotting to drug me, get me pregnant, and steal my fortune... the hunt officially began.
6a5840e82769ac7896097974.title: The Fake Heiress's Revenge

6a5840e92769ac7896097977.synopsis: I followed my lady through three rebirths. When she married the commander, I was drowned; when she married the duke, I was stabbed through the heart. In the third life, she set her sights on the Elf King. To survive, I slipped into the earl’s study, only to find a female elf sealed inside heartwood amber, dressed in green, with the exact same face as Calem. Then the lock clicked behind me. “Elara, you saw her.”
6a5840e92769ac7896097977.title: Max Maid’s Survival Rules

6a586d61f1819245a007809e.synopsis: An injury brings Ian, the cold and distant team doctor, and Noah, the hot-shot rugby captain, together. Forced into a 24-hour close-contact physical therapy session, they survive homophobic backlash, a terrifying rescue, and a toxic ex-boyfriend’s dark obsession. In a dramatic rainstorm, they finally lay their hearts bare, embracing a love they fought so hard for. But heartbreak strikes when Noah lands a multi-million-dollar pro contract. Threatened by a blackmailing cheerleader, Ian chooses to sacrifice his own happiness. To save Noah’s career, Ian breaks his heart with a brutal lie. While Noah numbly signs his life away under the spotlight, Ian quietly drops out of school and disappears into a raging blizzard. Will their love survive the ultimate sacrifice, or have they lost each other forever?
6a586d61f1819245a007809e.title: Illegal Touching

6a589b96716ca7d47a0a97f4.synopsis: Blinded by tragedy, genius musician Ciel Frost survived the dark by clinging to the suffocating love of a brilliant director, Marco Kingsley. But a conspiracy tore them apart. a sighted Ciel falls into a web of lies—mistaking Marco's manipulative nephew, Liam, for the savior from his past. Three years later, Marco returns as an all-powerful capitalist tyrant. Concealing his identity as the chief investor and "family elder," he closes in on Ciel’s world. When the familiar, dangerous breath and scalding touch overlap once more, Ciel’s memory floods back in a shiver of shock, instantly tearing through the lies. Ultimately, Liam faces utter ruin for his deceit, while Marco and Ciel shatter all barriers to reunite in an unstoppable destiny.
6a589b96716ca7d47a0a97f4.title: Seduced by My Boyfriend’s Uncle

6a58d32795d3f308540031d8.synopsis: Dumped by his ex-wife Kyla, Osbert's fortunes change with the Everything Plus System, letting him add 5cm to anything he touches — from finances to sports cars. Overnight, he rises as a top plastic surgeon, rescues the stunning Julia, and outshines Kyla at a reunion. As his powers grow, Osbert transforms from a ridiculed loser to a business titan, finding true love and ultimate respect along the way.
6a58d32795d3f308540031d8.title: Everything Plus, Everyone Else Shuts

6a598ba60bcf6849150ba5bd.synopsis: The Last Stand sets in a near-future deep-cold winter apocalypse. Wealthy heiress Lily Carter awakens on the live finale stage of a reality show, retaining memories of a previous life where her stepsister Sue Bishop betrayed her, hired strangers to seize her cabin, and left her to freeze. Armed with foreknowledge of the coming catastrophe, Lily claims her grand prize — a luxury Newmar King Aire RV — and secretly transforms it into an armored mobile fortress. As the freeze descends, she navigates sisterhood rivalry, a fanatical doomsday preacher, roving survivors, and buried family secrets.
6a598ba60bcf6849150ba5bd.title: The Last Stand: Iron RV, Ice Plains

6a598bdc118ac35b290f065a.synopsis: I‘m Elowen, the only rabbit shifter with purifying blood, destined to be Alpha King Kael’s Luna. But on our bonding altar, he brought his pregnant snake mistress, ordering me to raise their child as their servant. I revoked our bond and offered myself to any shifter willing to claim me. Everyone feared Kael—until cursed, discarded Prince Rowan stepped forward. I chose him, my pure blood suppressing his deadly curse. The old prophecy shifted to us. Kael lost all power and begged me back, while his serpent lover sank into dark corruption. Can Rowan and I stop the feral beast tide sweeping the realm?
6a598bdc118ac35b290f065a.title: The Rabbit Bride Who Rejected Her Alpha King

6a598bde89a94812de0b87db.synopsis: On her big day, she caught her fiancé with her best friend in bed. Furious, she married a random guy on the spot. But guess what? this "nobody" was her ex's uncle—and the richest man alive!
6a598bde89a94812de0b87db.title: Married Ex-Fiancé's Uncle

6a5d836dda4a556288063f1e.synopsis: My boyfriend Carter body-shamed me and paid me to get a breast reduction. I posted online to find a new guy, only to chat with his cold best friend Jude. He bought back my late dad’s bracelet and wired me 1.43 million. At his birthday party, I learned Carter got another girl pregnant. When I flew to surprise Jude at his hotel, I caught him with a woman clinging to his arm—was he just another liar?
6a5d836dda4a556288063f1e.title: Hook With Boyfriend's Best Friend

6a5d83c2142a64de2f0f292d.synopsis: Three years ago, Elena Vance was humiliated on her wedding day when her husband, Tristan, brought his pregnant mistress and forced her to sign divorce papers. That night, Elena disappeared and married Adrian Blackwood, the most feared Mafia Don on the East Coast. Now pregnant with Adrian’s second child, she returns to Edenport, only to be slapped by Tristan, who thinks she is pretending to be Mrs. Blackwood. When Chloe crushes Elena’s black onyx signet ring at a gala, Adrian arrives with their son. One word exposes everything: “Mommy.” Now the city will learn who Elena really is.
6a5d83c2142a64de2f0f292d.title: The Mafia Don's Secret Wife

6a5d843cea03716a8b0caa59.synopsis: A woman cannot lead a pack. The day she defeats every rival, her father hands the Alpha title to her cousin and betroths her to an Alpha King she's never met—making her a bargaining chip. Seraphina refuses. She binds her chest, sprays on scent-masking perfume, and slips into Lupine Academy disguised as her male cousin. Every five years its champion becomes the Supreme Alpha, ruler of every pack. Win, and no one can trade her away again. But the perfume has one fatal flaw: it fails the moment she shifts into her wolf, or falls for a dominant male. And the deadliest wolf there—the Lycan King, Ronan—sees straight through her. He doesn't expose her. He closes in. He doesn't want her secret. He wants her. One girl. A pack of bloodthirsty Alphas. A disguise one breath from unraveling. Can she seize the throne that was stolen from her?
6a5d843cea03716a8b0caa59.title: When The Moon Hides Her Crown

6a5d84c66c05476ac30ef75f.synopsis: Emma is alone after her husband leaves on a mafia mission, trapped by a painful blocked milk duct and a crying baby. Then Dante Vella, her husband’s wounded mafia boss, breaks into her home, hiding from killers outside. To keep the baby quiet, Emma has no choice but to let him help relieve her most private pain. But his steady hands and dangerous closeness awaken feelings she should never have. When her husband suddenly video-calls, Dante stays just outside the frame, his hand moving from the ache he was supposed to soothe toward the shadow beneath her skirt. As her husband talks about hunting Dante for a bounty, Emma realizes the real danger is no longer outside the door.
6a5d84c66c05476ac30ef75f.title: The Mafia Boss My Husband Betrayed

6a5d856b50f13fa4a20836b1.synopsis: Aria hides her identity as the sole heiress of America's richest family and enters college disguised as a scholarship student to evaluate her arranged fiancé. Instead, she becomes the target of a cruel dating game where wealthy students compete to break girls' hearts for money. She plays along until the night they publicly dump and humiliate her. Just when everyone expects tears, Aria ends the game with a single phone call. Their fortunes, reputations, and futures begin collapsing one by one. But the revenge she prepared is far from over.
6a5d856b50f13fa4a20836b1.title: They Bet I'd Cry, I Bet They'd Fall

6a5d856e4847039a4d062892.synopsis: Seraphina heard her husband plot to swap their baby with his mistress's child. He would raise the mistress's daughter as the prophesied Warden. Seraphina's own child would be crushed into nothing. She smiled, said nothing, and switched the babies back. Eighteen years later, she stood in the shadows and watched her husband beat his own daughter bloody. She watched him throw her into a viper pit. She watched his mistress brand the girl's face with a permanent scar. They never knew the girl was theirs. All that cruelty meant for Seraphina's child—they poured into their own. On Awakening Day, Seraphina gave her enemies everything they wanted—until she revealed the truth in front of the entire realm. Their ""chosen"" daughter was never theirs. And the girl they destroyed carried their blood.
6a5d856e4847039a4d062892.title: The Elf Queen's Revenge

6a5db3ec49ae13222f0ca5dc.synopsis: The moment the Alpha King pins me onto the bed, I slap him. "You’re my wife." He growls dangerously. "The wife you refused to touch for three years? I'm not that pathetic woman." I'm not, for real. I went to sleep a college girl, and woke up a Queen. Servants said the King hates his Queen, so his mistress rules the palace—but that was before me.
6a5db3ec49ae13222f0ca5dc.title: I AM THE LUNA QUEEN

6a5db3ef3a92735f1a059d89.synopsis: Wren Calloway spent three years saving Dorian, a voiceless siren heir. He calls Wren a worthless null and tears their bond apart to protect Wren'sister, Celeste. But Wren was never worthless. Her devouring aura had been suppressed, and Celeste's genius was stolen from her. The unwanted white lion sent as Wren's replacement bond-partner is Kane, the kitten she once loved, now the beast king the rift monsters obey. When Wren takes back every stolen power, Dorian learns too late he was only holding Kane's light.
6a5db3ef3a92735f1a059d89.title: The Beast King Worships the Worthless

6a5db4b9d2d51395fd03a48b.synopsis: After being betrayed by her Alpha mate and watching him lead the pack to slaughter both her and her newborn daughter, Lyra is given a second life. This time, she rejects fate, chooses a new mate, and awakens the legendary White Wolf. As the truth behind the pureblood bloodline unravels, the Alpha realizes he destroyed the very bloodline his family hunted for generations. But when Lyra becomes pregnant again, the hunt begins once more.
6a5db4b9d2d51395fd03a48b.title: I Married the Alpha They Threw Away

6a5db4bdb72949b20d0fdcb9.synopsis: Aria Voss lost her voice and scarred her face dragging Alpha Damon Kade out of a wolfsbane fire. Three years later, Damon believes Vivienne, the woman wearing Aria's stolen pendant, is his savior. He calls Aria a liar, gives her to his warriors as a reward, and ties her to the border for execution. Aria has no voice, no wolf, and no pack left to trust. Then Frostfang's Caleb cuts her free. With her voice returning and her pendant back in hand, Aria walks into Blackthorn as Ravyn Vale to expose the fraud and reject the Alpha who ruined her.
6a5db4bdb72949b20d0fdcb9.title: The Alpha Made His Savior the Pack's Slave

6a5db5613d1410127c0846fb.synopsis: Minutes before her engagement, Manhattan's richest heiress catches her fiancé in bed with the scholarship student she personally sponsored. He humiliates her in front of the entire city, believing love has finally defeated money. Instead of begging, Sera unleashes the contracts that built his empire. Frozen assets, federal investigations, and billion-dollar lawsuits turn his dream into a nightmare. But when he realizes the woman he betrayed was the only reason he ever stood at the top, it is already too late.
6a5db5613d1410127c0846fb.title: My Fiancé Betrayed Me, So I Bankrupted Him

6a5db5c7607675185a0af2fb.synopsis: After five years stranded on Mars, Evelyn Carter returns to Earth expecting a reunion, only to be branded unstable by Ethan, Mia, and the powerful Vaughn family. Her mother's final message was hidden, her commendation was suppressed, and her sacrifice was rewritten as a scandal. With Noah's help, Evelyn restores the black box records, exposes the cover-up, and takes back the name they tried to bury.
6a5db5c7607675185a0af2fb.title: Stardust and Lies

6a5dc49f92835bc7bb000b61.synopsis: Ann’s family destroyed Dane’s entire pack. Dane hates her, but he is forced to marry her. On their wedding night, he marks her in front of everyone, throws morning-after pills at her feet, and leaves her for another woman. But Ann is already pregnant with his twins. Heartbroken, she breaks their bond, fakes her death, and runs away. When Dane finally realizes he loves her, it is too late. Now he must spend his life chasing the wife and children he threw away.
6a5dc49f92835bc7bb000b61.title: Blood and Silver

6a5dc4a1b30cbe1ede0594fe.synopsis: Ann’s family destroyed Dane’s entire pack. Dane hates her, but he is forced to marry her. On their wedding night, he marks her in front of everyone, throws morning-after pills at her feet, and leaves her for another woman. But Ann is already pregnant with his twins. Heartbroken, she breaks their bond, fakes her death, and runs away. When Dane finally realizes he loves her, it is too late. Now he must spend his life chasing the wife and children he threw away.
6a5dc4a1b30cbe1ede0594fe.title: Silver Curse

6a5de4cb2eb293969e01b197.synopsis: Princess Helena is ordered to share her wedding day, her husband, and her throne with Damon, Leah, and a child passed off as his heir. Instead of yielding, she removes her ring and activates the Black Shield Guard left by her late father. With Cassius at her side, Helena exposes treason, stolen army grain, a false heir, and the murder of the king, then rebuilds Sparta on her own terms.
6a5de4cb2eb293969e01b197.title: Share a husband? You're not worthy

6a5e29f0ead6c0bb740f4c79.synopsis: After her mother's remarriage thrusts her into the glamorous yet unfamiliar world of a chaebol family, Yi Seo finds herself living under the same roof as Ji Seung-hyun—her seemingly perfect but emotionally distant stepbrother. From the moment they meet, the two clash relentlessly, unable to stand each other. But as their constant battles give way to stolen glances and undeniable chemistry, the line between family and forbidden desire begins to blur. In a world where every emotion comes with a price, can they resist a love that should never exist?
6a5e29f0ead6c0bb740f4c79.title: My Forbidden Brother

6a5ed3717990cea9e702b93f.synopsis: An ordinary guy, Max, gets a system that grants him all sorts of skills. Just as he's about to win the ultimate prize, one bad review from Rita resets everything. Desperate to fix his rating, he goes all out to win her over!
6a5ed3717990cea9e702b93f.title: Final Skill: Win Her Heart

6a5f32adb362c31e4d0ce294.synopsis: Nora was a rising defense attorney until her fiancé Adrian perjured himself on the stand, framing her and sending her to prison for three years. She emerged to find Adrian with Brooke—the real Bennett heir, who killed her own best friend Emma and stole her song. Nora quietly allied with Julian (the wrongly convicted man's cousin) and Emma's father Frank. Frank retrieved a deleted recording from Brooke's home: Brooke ordering the murder. In court, Nora exposed everything. Brooke got life. Adrian fell. Nora reclaimed her law license, cut ties with all who betrayed her, and began again with Julian.
6a5f32adb362c31e4d0ce294.title: The Ex-Con Lawyer's Revenge

6a5f32b02d9c74faad04b00c.synopsis: Twenty-four years after Ethan Holt abandoned her, Ava Stone returns with power, capital, and one impossible demand: she wants his son, Noah, as her fiance. Their engagement becomes the blade that opens old crimes inside the Holt Group, from stolen trust funds to a deadly family cover-up. Ava came back for revenge, but she leaves with justice and a man who chooses freedom with her.
6a5f32b02d9c74faad04b00c.title: The Queen's Revenge

6a60170b103930ddda06a0a9.synopsis: Karter, the legendary Poker King lost everything when he reported Aaron for money laundering 3 years ago. He was rescued by Elena, the daughter of a small casino's owner. When Aaron returns to put Elena and the casino in danger, Karter gives up his disguise as a humble waiter, and reveals his true identity.
6a60170b103930ddda06a0a9.title: The Poker King Returns

6a601869953a7d189a0267a9.synopsis: Lucas Thorne, a powerful demigod disguised as a beggar finally finds love with a mafia heiress who accepts him at his lowest—but when danger closes in, he must reveal his true identity to protect her, risking the secret he was bound to keep.
6a601869953a7d189a0267a9.title: Her Man Is the Son of Death

6a6030ba1ee6c0486900da8c.synopsis: Evelyn Shaw believed Adrian Grant loved her. To the world, he was the devoted husband who kissed her at galas and called her his only weakness. But after years of kidnappings, scars, and a lost child, Evelyn discovers the truth: Adrian built their marriage to make her a decoy wife, a public target meant to keep his real love, Maya Cole, safe. When she uncovers his diary, hidden money transfers, and the lies behind every “rescue,” Evelyn uses Maya’s arrogance to secure Adrian’s signature, files for divorce, erases her trail, and disappears. By the time Adrian realizes what he destroyed, Evelyn has already chosen herself.
6a6030ba1ee6c0486900da8c.title: His Decoy Wife

6a60312dd082ebff8b06879a.synopsis: “Did you get rejected?!” My sister Jade laughs at me. “I knew it! I told you that you would. No one would ever want you. A wolfless. But I’m more surprised that you, of all people, found a fated mate. Kind of unfair if you ask me.” It stings to hear this. It’s exactly what happened. She was right. “Well, let’s not let this bring us down.” Mother smiles and claps. “It’s been decided that Jade is to be mated to the fourth wolf prince. ” Jade smirks. “One of the bastard illegitimate princes, but I’m not complaining.” She smiles with pride. “He’s still a prince.” The crowd suddenly grow noisy. The princes arrive. “Alpha Prince Dorian, the fourth prince, Antonio the fifth, and Emmet the sixth—all of them illegitimate.” All three men wave with broad smiles. Suddenly, another man hurries past them. “That’s Alpha Prince Raphael! Second born to a true royal‑blooded Luna.” The stunning blond man—his hair lighter than even my mother’s or sister’s—strides forward with an imposing pace. His bright blue eyes gleam beneath the black suit and satin shirt, half‑unbuttoned to reveal the edge of his tattoos. I freeze as his gaze locks onto mine. Time itself seems to stop, because that man… is him. The one who broke my heart. The one who rejected me. The one who shattered our bond. My fated mate.
6a60312dd082ebff8b06879a.title: The Raven Wolf King: Wolfless

6a6031b6939b5006a8001c1b.synopsis: Asher secretly dated QB Chase for six months. Chase never went public—instead he played the perfect couple with Asher's sister Daisy. A naked photo of Asher leaked across campus. Daisy stole it from Chase's phone. Chase told Asher to stay quiet and kept using him. Hockey captain Finn opened Instagram in front of everyone: “Want to date? Follow me first.” Next day, he held Asher's hand in the hallway—fingers laced, for everyone to see. Daisy faked a nut allergy attack to frame Asher. Asher shoved her head into a fountain. Chase lost his game and screamed at Daisy on the sideline—his golden image shattered. Finn won, looked at the camera, and said: “Our goalie held two periods alone. I didn't want him carrying it alone anymore.” Everyone understood.
6a6031b6939b5006a8001c1b.title: The Boy the QB Used in Bed

6a6032183c861b8b8805cd9d.synopsis: Before my Alpha husband poisoned me, he said, “You’ve fulfilled your purpose.” I was reborn on the day he came to our door with the marriage contract. In front of everyone, I tore it apart and refused him. My mother called me insane, but my younger sister dragged me into a room, trembling all over. “Sister, after you died, he married me too. He cut off my limbs, gouged out my eyes, and left me only my voice, so I could sing for him every night.” In our last life, both of us sisters were nothing but his tools. In this life, he won’t get either of us.
6a6032183c861b8b8805cd9d.title: Two Husbands, Three Lives

6a603335b43f3ec5e80e092a.synopsis: I am Wren, an Omega. My Alpha mate, Kade, lost his memory after falling from a cliff. He fell in love with the nurse who saved him and completely forgot me. After being reborn, I stopped trying to awaken his memories. I watched him burn my silver wolf hunting knife, smash the moonstone wall engraved with our names, and place the wolf-fang necklace he had once carved for me around her neck. When she faked a fall into the water, he shoved me under. When the kidnappers sank us into the lake and forced him to choose one of us, he chose her to live. I sank beneath the surface, and the mate mark on the side of my neck split open. Kade, the life-saving debt from my past life and my letting go in this one are both fully repaid. Let’s never meet again.
6a603335b43f3ec5e80e092a.title: The Alpha Forgot Me, So I Let Him Go

6a6033a807e23079ca015d8b.synopsis: Elara Weir was born with Sunblood, but in her powerful family, she was never treated like a daughter. She was made into a scapegoat: whenever her gifted brother Kaylan failed, Elara paid the price. On the night before the Solar Crown Trial, their mother locks her inside the Moonfrost Chamber, a forbidden room that can freeze Sunblood magic from the inside out. Kaylan begs, their father arrives too late, and Elara dies betrayed by the family she tried to survive. But the scapegoat ritual does not end with death, and her next life may finally set her free.
6a6033a807e23079ca015d8b.title: The Sunblood Girl Frozen to Death

6a6035c0f2b19bb318052a0b.synopsis: I ran from my arranged wedding after catching my fiancé in bed with another woman. That same night, I lost my virginity to a stranger—only to discover he was my fiancé all along. When I became pregnant, he looked me in the eye and said, “Get rid of the baby.” I walked away for good... until his powerful rival offered me a new life. Now two mafia heirs are fighting for me, but only one deserves my heart. The problem? The man who broke me refuses to let me go.
6a6035c0f2b19bb318052a0b.title: Two Mafia Bosses Begging Me For Love

6a603610db0b2f6baa08d6de.synopsis: Elara is the Moon's Voice—whatever she speaks becomes real. To save the world, she swore silence for ten years. Her husband Roman believed Vanessa's lies that Elara betrayed him. He cut off her hand, blinded her eyes, slaughtered her entire family—all to force her blessing. When her seven-year-old sister's head rolled to her feet, Elara finally screamed her first words in a decade. But she didn't speak a blessing. She spoke a curse: “The Lycan King's reign is rotten. The world will break.” Roman's kingdom crumbled. Frostmoon crushed him. Vanessa's heir was exposed as a bastard. Roman burned his own hall to let Elara escape. Ten years later, a new Lycan King united all packs—a strong age built without any Moon's Voice at all.
6a603610db0b2f6baa08d6de.title: The Mute Luna and Her Cursed Word

6a6059c96a805ace3109c7e6.synopsis: When a future version of her rival crashes into the present with a terrifying warning, motocross star Tessa learns that falling in love with Riggs Heartstone will end in tragedy. Now she's stuck as his racing partner, fighting their chemistry while racing toward the biggest competition of her life. But the harder she tries to save him, the harder she falls.
6a6059c96a805ace3109c7e6.title: Boyfriend from the Future

6a6095f6d9ab3292c807c4ff.synopsis: She discovers her mob boss husband's affair and loses one of her twin babies due to his adopted sister's schemes. She reports him to the authorities and flees while still pregnant. Seven years later, she runs into him on the street. She thinks her murderous husband is going to kill her, but when he drags her back home against her will, she realizes the truth. Seven years ago, it was all a misunderstanding. The ruthless mafia boss only wants one thing—to win her love back.
6a6095f6d9ab3292c807c4ff.title: Torn Between the Mafia Twins

6a616fcbc063a1f59108d8ca.synopsis: Exiled half-beast prince Cassian storms back from the dead, slaughters his father, and seizes the throne in a bloodbath. His first prey, Vera, the ice-cold former queen. The woman who crushed their love for a crown, married his father, and cast him into the beast pit to rot. Consumed by rage, the ruthless new king forces his stepmother into his bed as his personal captive and swears to kill Lucian, Vera's royal son with the dead king. Then a bombshell drops. His so-called half-brother shares his rare, exclusive beast blood. Vera has hidden the truth of Lucian's identity.
6a616fcbc063a1f59108d8ca.title: Crowned in His Claws

6a6170f28a8cdb3e7d0e440b.synopsis: I died broken, my unborn baby killed by my fiancé Kael and his scheming sister Celestia. Reborn, I dumped him and married his mighty uncle Dravon to get revenge. Kael torments my silver dragon, insults me publicly, even kidnaps me on my wedding eve. Trapped in a cursed arena, chained and drained of magic, I thought all hope was lost—until ancient dragon power bursts from my veins. Everyone kneels, and a ghost reveals my hidden identity: the sacred Dragon Lord. Can I make Kael pay for two lifetimes of pain?
6a6170f28a8cdb3e7d0e440b.title: Revenge as My Uncle’s Wife

6a6175020e58adb4bc0cafae.synopsis: In 2006, Marcel "The Sniper" Wallace wins THE LEAGUE title, then loses his wife to rival Tyler Murray's hitman. He vanishes into a fast-food job for twenty years. Lured back as coach, he reunites with his resentful son Mars, a LEAGUE star. Marcel proves himself through impossible shots while Murray escalates to kidnapping and blackmail. At the Hall of Fame, Marcel reveals his identity and Murray confesses to murder. Victory comes when Mars accepts twenty unsent birthday letters and they embrace.
6a6175020e58adb4bc0cafae.title: Full Court Legend

6a617638677231413606d68b.synopsis: Ravena Mooncrest, secret Wolf Queen, has her wolf sealed so that she can runaway with her fated mate, Alpha Draven Nightfang. But Draven mistakes the birthmark on their son to mean Ravena cheated and makes them his slaves. Only when the life of their son is threatened, is there a chance for Draven to realize the truth, but will it be too late then?
6a617638677231413606d68b.title: You Betrayed the Wrong Alpha Queen

6a61fcc5e1c7863b130cc0eb.synopsis: Nora Hayes is a brilliant drug researcher and the true daughter of the Hayes family, but her brother Mason, her best friend Emma, and the adopted Lily all choose to erase her. To steal Nora’s drug launch and hand the spotlight to Lily, Mason arranges a brutal attack, destroys Nora’s reputation, and even delays the surgery that could save her future. After uncovering years of stolen credit, including the kidney she gave Emma and the fire where she saved Mason, Nora stops begging to be believed. With Professor Voss’s help, she disappears into a protected life in France, relearns how to work, creates a breakthrough drug, and returns as someone they can no longer break.
6a61fcc5e1c7863b130cc0eb.title: The Second Wound

6a61fcc72109ad2b77051835.synopsis: After waiting five years for Hunter to marry her, mafia princess Celine is betrayed when he chooses her maid instead. Rather than pulling the trigger, she blesses their marriage and accepts an alliance with the ruthless Rossi boss. As Hunter slowly uncovers the truth behind the betrayal, everything he believed begins to crumble. But by then, Celine is already standing beside a far more dangerous man, and the revenge she has planned is only just beginning.
6a61fcc72109ad2b77051835.title: You Chose the Maid,Now You Beg

6a62971687b70290eb03ff9a.synopsis: In Marry Me Twice, Mr. Grant movie, everyone's always told Nora to keep her head down and stay silent, but there's one exception — Vince Grant, her husband. As their contract marriage comes to an end after the best year of her life, Nora is faced with returning to her abusive family, who are already plotting to marry her off again. Always the calm, collected CEO, Vince finds himself desperate for a chance to win Nora over, even though she left him without looking back. He watches Nora shrink back into the shell he spent a year coaxing her out of, and decides enough is enough. Whether it's as the best "ex-husband" the world's ever seen, or Nora's real husband, with no contract between them, he'll protect her with everything he has.
6a62971687b70290eb03ff9a.title: Marry Me Twice, Mr. Grant

6a629f5ea1c787017500913a.synopsis: A lifetime ago, figure skating prodigy Gwen Tyler was at the top of her game and on her way to Olympic gold. But ten years later, she's stuck in a loveless engagement and a shadow of her former self. Then, her childhood best friend Aaron Lansing comes back into her life after a decade apart, and Gwen starts to realize... maybe the love she's been missing is the one she had when she was eighteen. Now she has to decide whether she's just going to keep letting life happen to her, or take back control for herself.
6a629f5ea1c787017500913a.title: Take Me Back to the Night We Met

6a62a25bff3dc346ee01104a.synopsis: In Honey-Trapped My Fiancé's Billionaire Rival movie, after ten years of loving Ryan, Jade Gray is asked to seduce his billionaire rival, Asher Blackwood, to help save Ryan’s first love, Eleanor. But Asher secretly has feelings for Jade, turning Ryan’s carefully planned scheme into a dangerous love triangle. As Jade grows closer to Asher, she begins to question who truly deserves her love.
6a62a25bff3dc346ee01104a.title: Honey-Trapped My Fiancé's Billionaire Rival

6a62c99877ad3657000aa34d.synopsis: Bullied for ten years, human girl Lia turns sixteen — and the two most dangerous Alphas in town both claim her as their fated mate. One has secretly protected her for a decade, never daring to come close. The other cuts a deal with werewolf hunters to make her his. A forced mark. Hunters in the dark. Nights she vanishes from her bed — and wakes up covered in blood. As every conspiracy points back to her birth, the truth surfaces: she is the Moon Goddess's lost daughter. On the night of the Blood Moon, war swallows the town, and the man she loves takes the fatal shot meant for her. Grief awakens the goddess within — the battlefield freezes, wolves kneel, and a single command shatters an entire army. She rips him back from death itself. But something else came back with him…
6a62c99877ad3657000aa34d.title: Mated to Two Bad Boy Alphas

6a62fae20fe809fbcb097c76.synopsis: Elara was chained in a red wedding dress and dragged through the snow, sacrificed by her husband to save his pregnant mistress. He thought the Wolf King would destroy her. He thought she would die forgotten in the North. But seven years ago, Elara saved a starving wolf boy from a fighting pit and gave him a name. Now that boy is Kael, the ruthless Wolf King. When he returns to camp and sees Elara bleeding, burned, and whipped, the entire wolf army watches their king fall to his knees. The bride they mocked is the one woman he would burn the world for.
6a62fae20fe809fbcb097c76.title: Sold to the Wolf King

6a631d4b7f6e39aad1061157.synopsis: Leo, the legendary surfing champion, loses his title to a mysterious newcomer named Ruslan. But the biggest shock comes when he discovers that Ruslan is the man from his unforgettable night. Forced into an uneasy partnership, the two rivals find themselves drawn to each other as secrets, danger, and betrayal close in. Behind their battle for glory lies a hidden truth about Ruslan—and their forbidden desire has only just begun...
6a631d4b7f6e39aad1061157.title: Caught in His Current

6a63772975b2eafae30ae379.synopsis: Reese Calder orders a custom companion android, 006, with the face of Nolan Vance, her spoiled, maddening lifelong rival. By day, 006 cooks, cleans, and kneels when she says, "Down." By night, he breaks every command and makes her forget he is supposed to be a machine. Then Kindred Care texts: "Your companion hasn't shipped yet." Nolan calls it a prank. Miles calls it suicide: "If Reese finds the truth, you're done." But Reese finds the truth anyway, and now the liar is still kneeling.
6a63772975b2eafae30ae379.title: My Sex Robot Has My Enemy's Face

6a66b7bd7fa17f5a6102246c.synopsis: Cora took in three wounded wolves and raised them. The moment her sister Vivian appeared, the wolves couldn't look away—they turned cold and rough, trying to break Cora. She overheard them mocking her. So she offered a trade: three wolves for Vivian's snake. Silas the snake was ice-cold, yet he stayed—doing chores, guarding her. When her family forced an arranged marriage, Cora faked agreement, then fled through a window on her wedding day. Silas tracked her to the airport, injuring two wolves who tried to stop him. “You'll never get rid of me,” he said. Cora took over the family business and bonded with Silas. The cold snake was truer than any wolf.
6a66b7bd7fa17f5a6102246c.title: Traded My Wolves for a Snake

6a66b7bf7fa17f5a6102246f.synopsis: On the night before her engagement, Celeste Yarrow is locked inside a rooftop glass greenhouse by Ingrid Sloane, drenched in freezing water while the guests film and laugh. Damien Thorne, the man she spent three years saving, refuses to protect her and even exposes her deepest trauma for Ingrid’s amusement. Everyone thinks Celeste is just a small-town woman clinging to power, but she is the real force behind Yarrow Capital and the projects that made Thorne rise. After shattering the glass cage herself, Celeste cancels the engagement, pulls her investment, releases the evidence, and makes every betrayer pay.
6a66b7bf7fa17f5a6102246f.title: The Glass Cage

6a66b7c17fa17f5a61022472.synopsis: Xanthea Plath, an illegitimate child of the Alpha of Virgo pack, was an omega and omegas weren't allowed to dream, yet she never stopped dreaming. She wanted to be a doctor just like her mother but the luna of the pack, her stepmother would break her physically and mentally and stop at nothing to crush all her dreams. Xanthea had still found a way though all the abuse her steps put her through. But one day her world came crashing down right before her entrance in a medical college when she found out that she was being offered as a bride to the ruthless triplet alphas also known as the demon lords of the Infernal pack of the underworld. Xanthea had heard the horrifying stories of several suitors who had come before her, all of whom had met a gruesome end.
6a66b7c17fa17f5a61022472.title: Offered to the triplet Alpha

6a66b7c27fa17f5a61022475.synopsis: Ava Moretti loved Luca Conti for nine years, believing the Conti family’s blood oath would always protect her. But when the Petrov brothers kidnapped her and demanded a six-hundred-thousand-dollar ransom, Luca listened to Valentina Russo and refused to pay, letting Ava “learn obedience.” After three months of captivity, Ava escapes barefoot back to Manhattan, broken, terrified, and no longer in love. While Luca keeps mistaking her trauma for rebellion, Dante Vitale, the Conti security chief and former detective, becomes the only person who truly protects her. As Valentina’s role in the kidnapping is exposed and Luca’s regret comes too late, Ava chooses the man who saved her, not the Don who abandoned her.
6a66b7c27fa17f5a61022475.title: The Mafia Don Refused My Ransom

6a66b7c47fa17f5a61022478.synopsis: Hazel is dragged back to House Vance as the lost daughter Seraphine, but they only see a rogue-marked woman with two children. Her parents shame her, Roman rejects their birth contract for Celeste, and House Vance even tries to sell Hazel to a councilman by using her children as leverage. They all think her mate is a nameless rogue. Then the Alpha King's gala begins. Lucian arrives, names Hazel his only Luna and the mother of his heirs, and reveals the truth: the woman they called filthy is the War-Marshal who saved the Vale.
6a66b7c47fa17f5a61022478.title: The Rogue-Marked Mom Is the Alpha King’s Luna

6a66bbf41925a6ea440cc029.synopsis: Married To The Devil is an original short-form drama that blends modern fantasy, dark romance, and a story of destiny and redemption. The story follows Angela, a young woman whose life is shattered by betrayal, suffering, and forces beyond her control. At the darkest point of her journey, she encounters Lucifer — a mysterious and powerful man who carries the loneliness of eternity and possesses a hidden identity that will change everything. As their fates become intertwined, Angela discovers that Lucifer is not an ordinary human, but the ruler of Hell. Caught between Heaven, humanity, and his own destiny, Lucifer must choose between the overwhelming power he possesses and the love that has awakened something within him. Meanwhile, Angela transforms from someone defined by her pain into a woman who finds her own strength and chooses her own destiny. Centered around the forbidden love between a demon and a human, Married To The Devil explores themes of identity, sacrifice, redemption, and the power of choice through dramatic revelations, emotional conflicts, and supernatural challenges. With a gothic visual aesthetic, a modern fantasy mythology, and an intense emotional core, the series reimagines the legend of the Devil — revealing that the greatest power is not the ability to destroy the world, but the courage to change for someone you love.
6a66bbf41925a6ea440cc029.title: Married to the Devil

6a66bcda57f05e0f510c12da.synopsis: 1994 Chicago. Lucy bandages a stranger, not knowing he is Ace Cavallo, a feared mafia boss who claims her as his wife. When her fiancé and uncle sell her at her wedding, Ace saves her, offering 30 days as his wife for her mother's surgery. She accepts, learns he already paid. Through betrayals and attacks, Lucy finds devotion beneath his violence and confesses love. The Carters kidnap her. Ace wins a deadly blackjack gamble but takes a bullet. They wed in an empty church and ride into the night.
6a66bcda57f05e0f510c12da.title: The Mafia Boss Who Loves Me

6a66bd9349bced6d830bf871.synopsis: Emily’s late husband Ethan was a decorated war hero. Their teen daughter Ava is kidnapped, tortured and framed for theft by rich heir Jason and his corrupt father Richard. Emily pleads with police and school for help yet gets shut out. She carries Ethan's coffin and medals to a military base to beg for justice. Supported by a general and Ethan's surviving ally Marcus, they expose a big plot. The Whitmores steal veterans' funds. With surveillance proof presented at the hearing, all villains get arrested. Ava proves her innocence...
6a66bd9349bced6d830bf871.title: When the Hero's Daughter Was Bullied, I Carried a Coffin to the Military District

6a670d5c4fc3fdef560395e8.synopsis: Tessa’s crush throws her cinnamon roll in the trash and calls her a fat pig in front of the whole class. When she finally stops begging to be chosen, she starts glowing up and catches everyone’s eye, including the boy who destroyed her. But Tessa has already chosen Adrian, the masked outcast everyone calls scarred and pathetic. By the time Chase wants her back, Adrian’s secret is out: he was never weak. He was the richest, most dangerous boy in the room.
6a670d5c4fc3fdef560395e8.title: The Ugly Girl Turned Pretty

6a672bc50dc68f56a409f670.synopsis: In Sold to the Warlord Born for the Sky movie, a sheltered northern princess who was sold into marriage to the dragon-riding warlord of the brutal Blackclaw horde must decide whether surrendering to the man who bought her is her greatest betrayal or the only thing that can save her dying people.
6a672bc50dc68f56a409f670.title: Sold to the Warlord, Born for the Sky

6a67cca11ec24d81c80639bc.synopsis: Based on the novel by Cora Reilly. As the heir to the Chicago mafia, Dante is logical to a fault. The only thing Valentina has in common with him is being a widow. When Dante chooses her as his next wife, it's a business decision made by a man still haunted from losing the love of his life. But Valentina won't repeat the lovelessness of her first marriage. As she struggles with her own desire for her new husband, little does she know -- his heart may have already started beating for her.
6a67cca11ec24d81c80639bc.title: Bound by Duty

6a67d06112cc28505607205a.synopsis: In God of Pain movie, a sheltered mafia princess tries to escape an arranged marriage, only to fall for the school’s most dangerous bad boy. But he refuses to love her… Until he can’t let her go.
6a67d06112cc28505607205a.title: God of Pain

6a680a0ee4b3871eb50e9f9b.synopsis: Isabella gave up her secret life as the leader of the legendary Shadow Circle to be with her beloved mate, whom she works hard as an herbalist to support. But when he's promoted to Alpha's General, instead of thanking her, he breaks their mate bond and replaces her with a scheming Commander's Daughter. He's not expecting the Alpha himself to show up and reveal Isabella is the lost wolf princess — destined to be Alpha Queen — and he'll regret letting her go.
6a680a0ee4b3871eb50e9f9b.title: She Bows for No One

6a6848570706aa908c0a81f9.synopsis: Luca Conri is the wolf-less runt of the Nightreign Pack, whose bark is bigger than his bite. Tormented by his own pack and hunted by rivals, Luca is reluctantly put under the protection of his dominant Alpha, and older brother's best friend, Dalton. However, everything changes when the two become fated mates, a bond that violates the natural order of the pack. As enemies close in and traditions try to tear them apart, Luca and Dalton must decide if they want to give into their lustful temptations in a forbidden romance that threatens their own lives.
6a6848570706aa908c0a81f9.title: Fated to His Brother's Alpha

6a68491f7434a5b9ed0f8045.synopsis: “It’s just a formality.” Reynolds threw those words in Eliot’s face on their wedding day, leaving him behind to greet his comrade. Four years of lies, another Alpha’s scent on Reynolds’ skin.Eliot didn’t cry. He ripped off his ring, threw it at Reynolds’ feet, and walked into the hall across.Vaughn had been waiting there for four years. White roses. Starlight lamps. A ring he’d kept since they were kids. He spent four years climbing four ranks just to rewrite the law that locked Omegas out of the mech bay. He never told Eliot. He just pried the door open and waited.
6a68491f7434a5b9ed0f8045.title: The Alpha Commander’s Long-Awaited Omega

6a6849207434a5b9ed0f8048.synopsis: Lyric, an Alpha’s scarred and wolf-less daughter, was betrayed by her mate and exiled after a one-night stand with a powerful stranger. Five years in the human world cured her face and awakened a forbidden gift: she is a "Siphon," able to absorb any disease. Forced back by family debt, Lyric enters a contract marriage with the ruthless King Jaris—only to realize he was her one-night stranger. Misled by his scheming "wife" Marta into believing Lyric betrayed him, Jaris is cruel by day, yet so obsessed with her body that he drugs her by night for secret intimacy, leaving Lyric believing it’s all a vivid dream. But the secrets run deeper: Lyric’s presumed-dead twins are alive, stolen by Marta to claim the throne. And from the shadows, Jaris’s exiled brother Caden is returning with a blood-drinking army to burn it all down.
6a6849207434a5b9ed0f8048.title: The Rise of the Ugly Luna

6a6849227434a5b9ed0f804b.synopsis: Eileen Carter was once a gifted dancer and heiress, but after her family collapsed, she gave up everything to secretly support Theo through law school. Years later, he repays her with humiliation, betrayal, a fake mistress, and a divorce agreement. When his cruelty costs Eileen her stage and nearly her life, she stops explaining, stops waiting, and starts rebuilding. With Noah by her side, she exposes every lie, protects girls like her, and proves that even a broken dancer can still command the spotlight.
6a6849227434a5b9ed0f804b.title: Dance of the Broken

6a686012cd3a8257390f38c9.synopsis: At Waverly University, the ice rink is split in two: on one side, the hockey team trains with brutal intensity; on the other, the figure skating team glides through elegant routines. Abby Williams is the golden girl of the ballet-on-ice program — obedient, disciplined, and desperate to land the lead role of the Black Swan in the Winter Showcase. There's just one problem: she has no idea how to be "bad." Enter Tristan Beaumont, the university's most notorious playboy and captain of the hockey team — reckless, magnetic, and hiding a devastating secret behind his bad-boy reputation. When Abby asks him to teach her how to unleash her dark side, neither of them expects what happens next: a forbidden attraction neither can control. Standing between them is Taylor Beaumont, Tristan's younger brother — Abby's skating partner, her best friend, and the "good" Beaumont everyone expects her to choose. As rumors, sabotage, and a jealous rival threaten to destroy everything Abby has worked for, she must decide who she really wants — and who she's willing to fight for. Torn between two brothers, a forbidden romance, and the role of a lifetime, Abby will learn that becoming the Black Swan means learning to stop following the rules — and start listening to her heart.
6a686012cd3a8257390f38c9.title: Offside with the Hockey Star

6a695cfbe05b3907da0c851a.synopsis: Framed for destroying his family, Grace endures five years as a servant in her own husband's home—despised, replaced, punished for refusing to lie. No one knows she's dying, and carrying his child. By the time James reads her letter, it's too late.
6a695cfbe05b3907da0c851a.title: I Left Him a Letter, Not a Goodbye

6a6964532c99fcb36e0f17bb.synopsis: The heir of a wealthy family, Lucas, voluntarily went to prison to overthrow his half brother. His fiancée abandoned him and went to live with his half brother. After being released from prison, he concealed his wealthy identity and entered into a contractual marriage with the orphaned girl, Ava. Gradually, true feelings developed between them. Ava discovered that she was the long-lost heiress of a rich family. When her old enemies came after her, Lucas revealed his true identity and embarked on a desperate revenge to help her.
6a6964532c99fcb36e0f17bb.title: The Double Life of My Ex-Con Husband

6a6975bf5d8851c89d0fcc8d.synopsis: Sophie grew up in an orphanage and was adopted by the wealthy Johnson family at the age of six. She spent twelve happy years under the love of her three elder brothers and adoptive parents. However, when her adoptive parents' biological daughter, Camille, returned, Sophie fell from being the cherished gem to a misunderstood and hurt outsider. Camille maneuvered step by step, constantly framing Sophie, while the family chose to listen selectively, and the repeated coldness and hurt left her disheartened. Sophie decided to become the first volunteer for her elder brother's 'Sleep Project,' which had been planned for five years, repaying her adoptive parents’ kindness through a life experiment. On her eighteenth birthday, she severed all ties with her family, entered the sleep chamber alone, and donated her corneas to her blind second brother. When she awoke after thirty years of slumber, her family had grown old, but she could no longer remember them—leaving only that misplaced familial affection, etched as an eternal regret through the river of time.
6a6975bf5d8851c89d0fcc8d.title: My Freeze. Their Tears. No Forgiveness

6a697704372818095101b114.synopsis: Mother's mysterious death, stepmother's deadly conspiracy, hateful brother... Thomas decides to pose as a wastrel to fool everyone. But his father hires Harper, a bodyguard known as the God of Slaughter, to protect him. Now, who'll outsmart whom?
6a697704372818095101b114.title: The Wastrel & The Assassin

6a69928e1c117e13980f9f41.synopsis: After three years of fighting on the northern front, legendary dragon rider Kalen Gerard returns home, ready to marry the woman he has loved for years. Instead, he finds his castle occupied, his fiancée pregnant with another man's child, and his family legacy stolen by a shameless usurper. Branded a worthless nobody, Kalen is ordered to give up his title, his home, and even raise his fiancée's illegitimate child. But no one knows the truth—he is the kingdom's greatest war hero, the man who slew the Black Dragon and saved humanity.
6a69928e1c117e13980f9f41.title: The Betrayed Demi-God Reclaims Everything

6a69994f1ed5911c3f03759d.synopsis: Bankrupt heiress Isolde signs a three-year mistress contract with Savien Thorne, heir to the Thorn Group, just to cover her mother’s life-saving medical bills. The second the contract ends, she’s ready to walk away for good. Until she finds out she’s pregnant. His arranged fiancée learns the secret, and torments her at every turn. Worse — she’s never been anything but a double for the other woman. She moves out and cuts all ties. But he’s not letting her get away.
6a69994f1ed5911c3f03759d.title: His Caged Love

6a699eaa437c05bf2f08576c.synopsis: Ethan Cole, a top-tier aviation legend in his previous life, dies as a national aviation legend. He is reborn as an 8-year-old boy on the same flight where he once flew with his father. Only this time, he knows the truth: Flight 8236 is going to crash, and everyone on board will die. At 9,000 meters above sea level, fire begins to burn along the wings. The fuselage cracks open into freezing air. As panic spreads across the cabin, Ethan realizes he is the only one who understands what is coming. Trapped in a child’s body, he must stop the disaster and save his father—the man he loves most—before it is too late.
6a699eaa437c05bf2f08576c.title: The Eight-Year-Old Captain

6a69bbba1893284da90e5a36.synopsis: Joelle believed her husband wanted nothing more than to get rid of her. He demanded divorce again and again, flaunted a pregnant mistress, and even drugged her before sending her back to the ex she once loved. Only after her tragic death did she learn the truth. There was never another woman. Every betrayal was a lie, every cruel word a performance, because Sutton was dying of terminal cancer and wanted her to hate him before he was gone. Reborn on the day he asked for their ninety-ninth divorce, Joelle refuses to let the man who loved her more than his own life sacrifice everything again. This time, she's determined to rewrite their ending before it's too late.
6a69bbba1893284da90e5a36.title: 99 Divorces, Then My Husband Died for Me

6a69bbbb1893284da90e5a39.synopsis: Chloe freezes to death after giving her last food to the husband and son she thinks are trapped in a deadly blizzard. But as her soul leaves the storage room, she sees the truth: there was no disaster, only a cruel punishment staged by her husband, brother, son, and the fake heiress they all protected. While they feast upstairs and call her a liar, Chloe's body becomes the evidence that exposes every betrayal and drags the whole family into ruin.
6a69bbbb1893284da90e5a39.title: Frozen by the Man She Loved

6a69d75694d45d05cf089596.synopsis: A gifted contract mage, Layla, spent her past life collecting ninety-nine sacred cores to help her contracted beast, the Sacred Whale Neil, take human form—only to have Neil pierce her heart and push her into the Bloodtide Trench the moment he transformed. Reborn on the day of the contract ceremony, Layla abandons the Sacred Whale and chooses a dying little spirit snake instead. Neil, now in human form, teams up with her sister Evelyn to humiliate her, but the little snake turns out to be Poseidon, the Sea Emperor. As past betrayals and old wounds resurface, Neil kneels in regret—too late. Only Poseidon stands by her side. This time, Layla will never waste herself on the unworthy again, and finally learns to live for herself.
6a69d75694d45d05cf089596.title: After the Sacred Whale Betrayed Me, I Contracted Poseidon

6a6ab69baaeb8126f103b73a.synopsis: To discover who truly loves them, wealthy couple Hannah and her husband fake bankruptcy, with him pretending to be paralyzed after a stroke. Their test exposes the truth: their biological son Thomas and his wife refuse to help and turn them away, while adopted son Theo and his wife give up everything to save him. After learning the truth, Hannah and her husband leave their $50 million fortune to Theo. Thomas loses everything and finally realizes that true family is built on love, not blood.
6a6ab69baaeb8126f103b73a.title: The Billionaire Parents' Final Test

6a6adc4372e65640410ab2a3.synopsis: I'm a fraud who snuck into the most elite magic academy in existence.I'm a fraud who snuck into the most elite magic academy in existence. Everyone here wields real power — vampires, werewolves, dragon clan, witches — while I survive on street performer tricks and sleight of hand. If I'm exposed, what awaits me is worse than death. But I had to come: my sister died here. The academy called it an "accident." I know better — her killer is somewhere on these grounds. I kept my head down, stayed invisible. It wasn't enough. The blood heir, the wolf clan's little prince… the most powerful men in this academy are closing in on me one by one, marking me, declaring in front of everyone: "You're mine." Are they falling for me — or have they already uncovered my secret?
6a6adc4372e65640410ab2a3.title: Fake Witch Claimed by Two Heirs

6a6ae33772acafdfe00daafc.synopsis: Claire Morgan was born to inherit an empire. She married beneath her for love, only to become her husband's stepping stone. His old flame taunts her, his family leeches off her, and even her own family tries to push her around. But they underestimate her. Claire divorces the cheater, crushes every scheme, and sends anyone who tries to kill her to prison! After everything, she finally realizes she doesn't need a man at all.
6a6ae33772acafdfe00daafc.title: Mrs. Grant Is Single Now

6a6afb1f12895345d90f1e50.synopsis: No mate, no wolf, and raising a pup alone, Ella never expected one act of kindness to tie her fate to Alpha Torin, who is cursed to never touch a woman. When she becomes the wet nurse to his newborn heir, Ella is pulled into a deadly game of jealousy and betrayal inside the Alpha's keep.
6a6afb1f12895345d90f1e50.title: Thirsty for the Wet Nurse

6a6b01dc39f964ed56043895.synopsis: Three years ago, rising star Danny lost everything after being betrayed by the two people he trusted most. Everyone believed he was gone for good. Now he's back with a new identity and a carefully planned revenge. His target? The ex-lover who destroyed his life and the best friend who helped cover it up. But things take an unexpected turn when he crosses paths with Allen, the younger brother of the man he hates most. What starts as a dangerous game soon becomes something neither of them can control. As old secrets resurface and feelings grow stronger, Danny must decide, finish his revenge, or risk everything for the one person he never meant to love.
6a6b01dc39f964ed56043895.title: Revenge in My Ex's Brother's Bed

6a6b2207a6fa584bc0046f6e.synopsis: After surviving a month of kidnapping and torture, Claire returns home with severe PTSD, only to be misunderstood and humiliated by her brother Maxwell and her family. As her trauma becomes impossible to ignore, Maxwell begins to doubt his judgment — but when Claire gives up on ten years of love and walks away, he finally realizes the truth was never what he believed.
6a6b2207a6fa584bc0046f6e.title: Once Love Is Lost, It Never Returns

6a6c022eedfbef3f380fbfbf.synopsis: I lied about my age and ghosted my clingy online boyfriend half a year ago. Staying at my best friend’s house for break, I froze—her cold, CEO older brother Rhys was exactly the man I dumped online. He recognized me just by my voice and kept testing me nonstop. Later at a bar, he chugged eight drinks to shield me from a creep guy who drugged me. Trapped in his car, he recited every fake detail I told him online, staring at me: “Did you ever regret leaving me?”
6a6c022eedfbef3f380fbfbf.title: The Cold CEO Who Spoiled Me Online

6a6ff241989753f010020609.synopsis: Born with super strength, Dorin hid her martial arts talent since women were barred from martial arts. When Sky City and the Mann family were in danger, only Dorin could fight for them. Tricked into destroying her powers to save her kin, she watched them perish. Saved and healed by a master, Dorin returns for revenge.
6a6ff241989753f010020609.title: The Forbidden Fist

6a6ff71e2cf525542e0730f1.synopsis: Head over heels for Preston, the Principal's son, Mia has always put him first. But when she finds out he's been cheating on her with the rich heiress Vivian Walden, Mia hatches a grand escape plan with Preston's opportunistic mother. Will Preston capture her heart back before it leaves permanently for London, or will Sebastian, the mysterious royal boy from London get Mia's love?
6a6ff71e2cf525542e0730f1.title: My Royal Rebound

6a7002bdf1b7555be101d640.synopsis: Nia, an ordinary 18-year-old, goes viral overnight after posting a video exposing injustice at her school — only to be maliciously re-edited and mobbed online by a top Beverly Hills influencer dynasty. As hidden-camera footage, deepfakes and long-buried dirt surface one piece at a time, she discovers that her school, a PR firm and a wealthy family are jointly weaving an enormous campaign of public deception. To protect her family and find the truth, Nia joins forces with Jax, a rich-kid documentary director, to fight back — only to find that everyone is hiding something, herself included. When the truth can only be told to the world on a live stream, she must decide: stay silent, or bet everything and expose everyone for who they really are.
6a7002bdf1b7555be101d640.title: DRAMA IN HD

6a7002db07b37ca2420bcffe.synopsis: Sebastian Vale, founder and CEO of Vale Tech, was once the son of mafia boss Carmine Rossi. Twenty-five years ago, to escape his family's criminal destiny, he broke with his father, changed his name, built a world-leading technology company from nothing and developed an AI system powerful enough to change the world. But just as the company nears a major breakthrough, Sebastian walks in on his wife and co-founder Claire in a compromising moment with his close friend and COO, Marco, and his marriage collapses. At the same time, the AI system he built spins out of control: power grids, hospitals, transport and aviation fail one after another across the globe, plunging the world into an unprecedented crisis — and every finger points at him. Just as the board prepares to remove him and the world casts him as the villain, the mafia father who vanished twenty-five years ago suddenly reappears and reveals a long-buried truth: it was not his father who betrayed the family, but his mother. And the man who engineered the entire conspiracy to seize control of the company is Sebastian's half-brother — Marco. To take the life he believes should have been his, Marco exploits a bloodline loophole to breach the AI system, steals the company's assets, kidnaps Claire and sets out to destroy Sebastian's business, family and faith entirely. Facing a global crisis, a brother's revenge and old family blood debts, Sebastian must confront his mafia heritage, fight alongside his father to rescue his wife and stop the AI catastrophe, and make a final choice between revenge and justice. Yet just when everything seems settled, the mother who disappeared twenty-five years ago appears at the wedding and reveals an even bigger secret behind it all, leaving Sebastian once again at the crossroads of his family's fate. The true war of the mafia family has only just begun.
6a7002db07b37ca2420bcffe.title: Mafia Son: Unbroken By Betrayal

6a7006698a1b1823640e172f.synopsis: Evelyn, a senior purser at Atlantic Airways, is reborn with intact memories of her previous life. Drawing on her foreknowledge, she sees through the deadly murder plot hatched by her husband and her trusted best friend. At an altitude of 30,000 feet, she turns the tide against all odds and saves the heir to the Sterling family. After being wrongfully framed and later fully exonerated, she secures the patronage of the Sterling family and is parachuted into the airline’s corporate headquarters. Leveraging her elite risk management expertise, she dismantles the conspiracies of her long-standing career arch-rivals, and ultimately ascends to the absolute pinnacle of power in the aviation industry.
6a7006698a1b1823640e172f.title: Reborn: A Flight Attendant Counterattack

6a70084e74a2229b72018fb6.synopsis: For ten years, janitor Maya scrimps and saves while raising her daughter Lily almost entirely on her own—only to discover that her husband, Adrian, is actually a multimillionaire who has lavished all his love and affection on his first love and her son. Completely heartbroken, Maya leaves with Lily. She is later revealed to be the daughter of a fallen war hero, and after reclaiming her true identity, she becomes the long-lost beloved heiress of the powerful Harrington family. When Adrian loses his business, his family, and the wife and daughter he took for granted, he falls to his knees and begs for forgiveness. Lily gives him only one final answer: “Daddy, we’re done.”
6a70084e74a2229b72018fb6.title: Daddy We're Done
