6a9528b29e1ac8de2d01d8e4.synopsis: Cassius, a former top-tier bodyguard, retired to the countryside. After his family was persecuted by criminal forces, he wielded the Valerius family's supreme black card to settle scores with all his enemies. Standing side by side with Celine, the family head who admired him, he protected his loved ones and dismantled a transnational criminal network.
6a9528b29e1ac8de2d01d8e4.title: Black Card The Reckoning

6a954112ffb159a50b0e241a.synopsis: To save his dying daughter, he knelt in the rain begging his ex-wife, only to be pushed into the mud. Left for dead, he was run over by a luxury car—but at that very moment, his royal dragon blood awakened! With golden eyes and giant wings, he became the last living dragon on earth. To escape an arranged marriage, the cold female CEO offered him a contract marriage and saved his daughter. He hid his identity as her assistant, mocked by his ex-wife as a worthless toy boy. Until the night of the elite gala— The city's richest tycoons and the war general knelt before him, shouting: "Welcome back, Your Highness!" His ex-wife spat blood in pure regret. But when the enemies who slaughtered his clan thirty years ago kidnapped his daughter, they crossed the line. Touch the dragon's scale, and prepare to die! No more hiding—his wings blocked the sky, bringing down divine wrath in the storm to crush them all. He saved his child, conquered the cold CEO's heart, and claimed his throne as the only king of this world!
6a954112ffb159a50b0e241a.title: My Hidden Dragon Awakened

6a9545d6d55acb83c70423d7.synopsis: Four years ago, healer Seraphina saved cursed Infernal Legion commander Drake and gave birth to twins. Unaware of his identity, she was exiled by her family and raised the children alone. Years later, the wounded Drake is found by the kids and brought home. He falls for Seraphina at first sight and proposes firmly. Amid stepmother's persecution, brother's power grab and dark magic crisis, they uncover the truth of their past. Finally Drake inherits the Lord of the North, and the family of four lives happily together.
6a9545d6d55acb83c70423d7.title: The Inferno Warlord's Secret Healer Bride

6a962bb32b4cbe2329008357.synopsis: Enslaved by the Alpha who slaughtered her family, Lyra is forced to the altar until his son Asher kills him and claims her. Their fated bond ignites, but Asher hides her and takes political Luna Selene to shield her. Selene's jealousy explodes into brutal torture, forcing his cruelty to mask his devotion. When Selene and brother Garrick's coup erupts into war, Lyra reveals she is a lost Alpha's daughter and helps crush it, killing Garrick herself. Selene is exiled, and Lyra is crowned his equal.
6a962bb32b4cbe2329008357.title: The Alpha's Forbidden Mate

6a9631352b4cbe232900835a.synopsis: In my past life, my husband's niece drowned my newborn. To protect their precious heiress, the mafia family told me to let it go. When I refused, my own husband murdered me. Now, I’ve been reborn on the morning it all happened. This time, I secretly send my son to my father, the most powerful Mafia Godfather in the city. But when I return to the party, another baby still ends up in the pool. Predictably, my husband and his family rush to destroy the body to cover it up. Now there's just one question: whose child did their golden girl really kill?
6a9631352b4cbe232900835a.title: A Mother's Vengeance

6a963220a45123e37f0d6aa7.synopsis: Returning from three years of exile, Evelyn no longer resisted the torment and punishments, choosing instead to submit to it all. What her family didn't know was that she had awakened a system that converted her pain into cash rewards. The day she accumulated enough pain points would be the day she finally left them for good.
6a963220a45123e37f0d6aa7.title: The Death Payout System: Escaping My Toxic Pack

6a963ba8fda5294962054f78.synopsis: Tessa is pushed off a building by her adopted sister Chloe. She wakes up at fifteen, reliving her life. This time, she refuses to fight for her family's love. Chloe manipulates everyone, framing Tessa for cheating. Tessa calmly proves Chloe's guilt using surveillance footage. Chloe is expelled. Tessa earns straight A's and a Yale scholarship. Her family apologizes, but she remains distant. She leaves for Yale alone, determined to live for herself.
6a963ba8fda5294962054f78.title: I Watched Them Love Her

6a963bbc7308ebfe9309c899.synopsis: Serena Vale died with Adrian's silver knife in her chest after her sister Lila screamed, "Serena stole my Luna mark." Reborn at the Moon Den, Serena refuses to bleed for Lila again. The mark chooses her in front of the pack, and when her former betrothed steps forward, she makes the choice that shatters Blackwood: "I choose Rowan Blackwood." Rowan is Adrian's cursed uncle, poisoned into a living corpse, but his wolf still answers her. When he wakes and asks who dared touch his Luna, Serena's second life turns from survival into war.
6a963bbc7308ebfe9309c899.title: Reborn as the Cursed Alpha's Luna

6a96459a9521102b6f0c2bf8.synopsis: Delaney is the youngest daughter most beloved by the Dragon God, but she falls in love with a human named Dylan. As a test, the Dragon God seals Delaney’s divine powers for three years. During those three years, Delaney, a female CEO, helps Dylan’s company grow into a household-name corporation. To protect Dylan’s pride, she supports him quietly from behind the scenes. In the third year of their marriage, Delaney gives birth to a dragon egg that needs to be hatched, but Dylan becomes involved with Daphne, his secretary who is secretly his mistress. At an auction, Delaney crosses paths with Daphne and the two clash. The dragon egg, on the verge of hatching, becomes the target of Daphne’s jealous rage…
6a96459a9521102b6f0c2bf8.title: She Smashed My Dragon Baby, I Smashed Her Life

6a9666af470904d5580f098e.synopsis: For ten years, Evelyn helped Stephen rise from fallen prince to emperor, protecting him and bearing his two children. She thought their love would last forever until he married her sister. Heartbroken, Evelyn activated her system and returned to the modern world. Only after she vanished did Stephen and their children realize what they'd lost, crossing a thousand years to beg her back. But Evelyn is done being anyone's consort or mother. This time, she chooses herself.
6a9666af470904d5580f098e.title: Your Consort Is Back in the Modern World

6a966a6a2b3144019f077a7f.synopsis: GT endurance driver Kai Mercer is pushed into a reserve role after refusing his sponsor’s sexual advances, while struggling with his father’s debts and his mother’s illness. Through an anonymous platform, Kai develops an intimate relationship with a mysterious man named Nox, unaware that Nox is actually Adrian Cross, his new team owner and a four-time World Endurance Champion. As Kai falls for both identities, Adrian’s secret creates a dangerous conflict of trust and power. When the truth is exposed, Kai walks away. After kidnappings, threats, professional investigations, and an ethics hearing, the two eventually rebuild their relationship, while Kai earns his place as a professional works driver.
6a966a6a2b3144019f077a7f.title: Below the Red Line

6a966b738b5041bbb80e1d41.synopsis: Desperate to pay for her sick mother’s treatment, restaurant waitress Anna is betrayed by her biological father, Richard, and sent into a deadly trap controlled by an East Side crime boss. Using her combat skills and intelligence, she survives, defeats Victor, and escapes with crucial evidence. With the help of Leo, an undercover operative and Thomas’s son, Anna rises through Los Angeles’ criminal underworld, taking control of casinos and territory. But she soon discovers that her entire rise has been part of Thomas’s larger power game. Together, Anna and Leo expose the money-laundering operation and bring down Thomas and Richard.
6a966b738b5041bbb80e1d41.title: Blood Rose Crushing the Cartel

6a967daf71807a57f7059e60.synopsis: Odysseus is the secret demigod son of Apollo, bound by a deathbed vow to give his queen, Antigone, a hundred chances to earn his trust — and never seize her throne. He turns white-haired overnight saving her kingdom from a monster, only to catch her in another man's arms. Stripped of power, tortured, framed, betrayed again and again — every wrong she commits burns away one more chance. When the hundredth chance runs out, his true power awakens. He returns for vengeance, spear blazing with divine fire — but victory comes at the ultimate price: his own existence.
6a967daf71807a57f7059e60.title: Demigod Under Oath

6a9786141e7b557da205265b.synopsis: Bullied university student Elena saves her mysterious professor, Lucien, from a deadly poison. Their fateful encounter leaves Elena pregnant with sextuplets—six baby dragons! Just as her abusive family and cruel classmates attempt to burn her alive for carrying "monsters," Lucien descends as a Black-and-Gold Dragon King to claim her as his Queen. However, Elena's rare ability to bear dragon heirs makes her the ultimate prize for the wicked Frost Dragon, Kael. Caught in a deadly war, can Elena awaken her true power and protect her family?
6a9786141e7b557da205265b.title: Pregnant with the Dragon King's Sextuplets

6a978afb992e4c583d089fdb.synopsis: Tim Harper is secretly Titan, but at school he's a bullied new kid. His powers keep nearly slipping out, and Sarah suspects his double life. Their bond grows through a talent show and a scholarship contest run by billionaire Blackwell, secretly Tim's mentor. Confessing his secret costs Tim his powers. Mayor Hunter and Jax frame him at a gala, and a blast nearly kills everyone. Powerless, Tim risks his life anyway, regains his powers, and flies off with Sarah as the villains are arrested.
6a978afb992e4c583d089fdb.title: World's Strongest Loser!

6a97933e4755502ce50b4a6b.synopsis: Elf Princess Helena dies tragically when her husband and "daughter" let a crused rabbit drain her rare golden blood. In her final moments, she uncovers the sickening truth: the rabbit is his cursed mistress, and the girl she raised is an evil spirit possessing her true daughter’s body. Reborn on the exact day the beast arrives, Helena plays the oblivious, fragile wife—while secretly plotting a savage retribution to destroy the traitors and reclaim her child's soul.
6a97933e4755502ce50b4a6b.title: My Blood-Sucking Familiar Is My Husband’s Lover

6a97bb7b5edcbfc5b9067696.synopsis: Though blind, Lyra has an incredible gift: she can understand the language of spirit beasts. Then she starts bonding with adorable spirit pets and gathers a group of steadfast companions. Using her kindness and wit, she calms the beast tides!
6a97bb7b5edcbfc5b9067696.title: I Calm the Beast Tides With Spirit‑Words

6a97c252a24f1db6960c76d2.synopsis: Cast out penniless by the Zellers with just $280 and a family pickling jar, Charles hits rock bottom in Frostpond. Desperate, he turns wild cress into a signature tangy sensation, going from local joke to go-to hot pot supplier. Targeted by rivals with smear campaigns, knockoffs, and sabotaged water lines, he refuses to cut corners. Through radical transparency and a village co-op, he turns a desperate hustle into a thriving empire, a comeback built on grit, craft, and pure integrity.
6a97c252a24f1db6960c76d2.title: His Pickled Empire

6a97cd86f09d793bab0603ad.synopsis: Born a commoner, Eleanor has spent years quietly protecting her husband, Duke Adrian, and his kingdom. Yet he has always mistaken her loyalty for ambition, believing she married him only for status and power. After being publicly humiliated and heartlessly cast aside by the man she loves, Eleanor finally gives up on their marriage and walks away. Only after she leaves does Adrian discover that the mysterious masked warrior who repeatedly saved his life was Eleanor all along. What he still does not know is that she is also the long-lost heir to a powerful empire. When Eleanor reclaims her identity and the power that rightfully belongs to her, Adrian finally realizes what he has lost. Meanwhile, an ambitious regent launches a coup, plunging the entire kingdom into crisis. With both his former wife and his realm in danger, Adrian is willing to sacrifice everything to protect Eleanor. But this time, he is no longer fighting to win back her love—only for the chance to earn her forgiveness.
6a97cd86f09d793bab0603ad.title: The Duchess They Cast Away

6a97fcd41810d9e05a02c5a5.synopsis: Nia is a 300-pound Omega mocked by the entire pack as a disgusting fat wolf. When Alpha Zayne chooses her as his Luna, she believes she has finally been loved. She poisons herself, bleeds for him, tears her own fur to keep him warm, and carries his child. Then she overhears the truth: Zayne only used her as a womb and plans to kill her after the baby is born. Betrayed, abused, and forced through unbearable trials, Nia awakens as a legendary White Wolf. Now she returns under a new name, not for love, but to save the child Zayne killed. The Alpha finally falls in love with her beauty, but the woman who once loved him has already died.
6a97fcd41810d9e05a02c5a5.title: After the 330-Pound Fat Wolf Left, the Alpha Went Crazy with Regret

6a97fe91ae5bf68c3c0ed5e7.synopsis: After catching her boyfriend cheating with her best friend at a college party, Vera accidentally falls into a pool and wakes up in Ancient Egypt. Branded an outsider and hunted for her mysterious origins, she's rescued by Prince Amon, who discovers she carries the blood of an ancient god. As a power-hungry queen plots to use Vera's divine bloodline to seize the throne, Vera and Amon are drawn into a deadly game of palace intrigue, betrayal, and forbidden love. Just when Vera finally finds a way back home, the person she trusts most is killed. Choosing revenge over escape, she embraces the godlike power within her—but the truth behind her bloodline could destroy everything Ancient Egypt was built on.
6a97fe91ae5bf68c3c0ed5e7.title: Bound to the Pharaoh

6a980049dd7014e615023656.synopsis: Vivian, a strong career woman, has exceptional work abilities. Leo, the president of a rival company, secretly admires her but has been repeatedly rejected when trying to recruit her. In her personal life, Vivian has a hard time. After being diagnosed with infertility, she discovers her boyfriend's infidelity. In a drunken state, Vivian has a one-night stand with Leo and surprisingly gets pregnant. To keep this hard - won child, she tries every means to hide it, not expecting that her "rival" is even more eager for the child's birth.
6a980049dd7014e615023656.title: Pregnant With My Rival CEO's Baby

6a98068fa11efb8684067d36.synopsis: To pay off her father’s debts, Diana Banning unexpectedly shares an intimate night with billionaire CEO Ethan Vance and ends up marrying him out of guilt and obligation. She is determined to fulfill her dream of being a designer, yet she winds up with an overly clingy, jealous husband.An ex-boyfriend, a young female rival chasing Ethan Vance, and an imposter pretending to be the CEO’s wife keep stirring up trouble. Ethan Vance fakes illness to hold her close while fiercely standing up for her against anyone who dares to hurt her. A hilarious, heart-fluttering tug-of-war filled with love and jealousy kicks off!
6a98068fa11efb8684067d36.title: Moonlit Wilds, A Secret Yearning

6a980ef9a68d1a06280ed24a.synopsis: Fifteen years ago, Princess Serafina of the White Dragon Clan shattered her dragon crystal to save three dying alien youths—Kael the wolf, Dorian the merman, and Soren the vampire. She lost three‑quarters of her power in exchange for their vow of eternal marriage. On the night of her father's funeral, she caught them cheating with her stepmother Lilith in the mourning hall. Heart‑turned‑ash, she tore up the tri‑clan contract on the spot. Her ex‑fiancés, who had risen on her power, felt their strength crumble as the dragon crystal shards inside them backfired. They begged. She walked away. Now Serafina is on a path to recover her complete dragon crystal and reclaim the Dragon Clan's throne. And a mysterious man who never owed her anything, yet would burn himself for her, is stepping out of the shadows.
6a980ef9a68d1a06280ed24a.title: Dragon Girl's New Choice: All 3 Fiancés, Get Lost

6a98116575e068605f0b3cf7.synopsis: Aria, a human teenage girl, suddenly finds herself homeless after her family goes bankrupt. She's forced to live in her car, a shameful secret she needs to hide from the vicious bullies at her elite private high school. One day, she discovers that she's the mate of both Damon, the werewolf heir, and Levi, the vampire prince. These two supernaturally handsome boys have opposite personalities. One as passionate as fire, and the latter as cold as ice. Which one is her true love? Aria later discovers that there's more to her real identity than she thought. It's a secret that could destroy everything.
6a98116575e068605f0b3cf7.title: Bound by Crimson and Silver

6a9813f417879200f002d8ca.synopsis: Falsely condemned to bear only lowly mongrels, Moonwolf she‑wolf Aurora is viciously harmed by her husband and clan leader Tristan. Reborn on the day of the political marriage, she hears the hateful prophecy again and watches Tristan wed her sister to produce a noble Silverwolf. On a full‑moon night, Aurora slips into Moonillusion Bar and surrenders herself to the trapped, heat‑stricken ancient wolf god Fenrir for a child. Their fiery night frees Fenrir from his thousand‑year bonds. He shocks everyone by claiming the pregnant Aurora as his bride. She delivers a supreme wolf king. Her powerful bloodline erases every disgrace. The traitor and her scheming sister kneel in defeat. Aurora changes her fate and gains unmatched glory.
6a9813f417879200f002d8ca.title: I Gave Birth to the Strongest Alpha Werewolf King

6a981593d34037288f0fc899.synopsis: When a zombie outbreak hits, Mia saves someone—only to be attacked in return. Just when she’s about to die, Damian, the Zombie King who’s secretly loved her for years, comes to her rescue. Things get even crazier when Damian takes her home and his zombie parents already call her their daughter-in-law. Then Mia learns the cure may lie in Damian’s genes! Now she has one crazy plan: win over the Zombie King, have his baby, and save the world！
6a981593d34037288f0fc899.title: Walker Love Tale

6a981a168259296cb909cc7d.synopsis: At Cascadia Reptile Research Institute, Noah Hayes is assigned to Avery, the largest and most bad-tempered white python in the facility. Avery refuses food, scares away every snake Noah cares for, bites only him, and keeps wrapping around him like a jealous lover. Noah thinks the snake hates him, until a breeding-season check reveals the ridiculous truth: Avery has been courting him all along. When Avery starts leaving “gifts,” guarding him from other snakes, and appearing in Noah’s dreams as a beautiful silver-haired man, Noah realizes his troublesome white snake may want far more than care. He wants Noah.
6a981a168259296cb909cc7d.title: My Black Python Wants My Eggs

6a981ef8d195cd20c4027700.synopsis: A month before the most important piano competition of her life, gifted heiress Evelyn Sterling is kidnapped—and her hands are shattered on her fiancé’s orders. He plans to replace her with her adopted sister, steal her inheritance, and erase her from New York’s music world. Betrayed by everyone she called family, Evelyn undergoes a dangerous surgery and returns to the stage with bleeding fingers. Her impossible perfect score ignites a ruthless war of forged drug tests, stolen identities, and deadly revenge. They broke her hands to silence her, but Evelyn is ready to reclaim her music, her name, and everything they stole.
6a981ef8d195cd20c4027700.title: He Crushed My Hands for My Sister

6a981efcfbf28c4f110062c3.synopsis: Selena is the real biological daughter of the Grant family but is framed and alienated by her adopted sister Kelly, neglected by her three elder brothers. In her past life, she stayed loyal and cared for them even after the family fell apart, only to die tragically in a car accident. Reborn, she vows to stay away from the cold Grants and live for herself. Unexpectedly, her three brothers also return with full memories and endless regret. They dote on her fiercely and crush every scheme from Kelly. Hardened Selena slowly melts under their desperate love, getting the family devotion she was denied in her last life.
6a981efcfbf28c4f110062c3.title: My Three Brothers Finally Chose Me

6a98202ff5b9b83c45081220.synopsis: Emma, the wife of the founder of a Paris‑based fashion brand, endured long‑term humiliation and betrayal from her husband Maxime, her best friend Camille and her sister‑in‑law Valerie because of her weight. She was even pushed off a terrace and locked in a cold storage room to die. On the brink of death, she was rescued by her biological grandfather Henri, who had been searching for her for years. She learned that she was the sole heir to the Villard fashion empire. With the companionship of her childhood sweetheart Lorenzo, Emma rebuilt herself over seven months. She made a glamorous comeback under the identity of Adele Villard and carefully laid out schemes to take revenge on those who had betrayed her. In the end, she exposed their crimes, took over the empire, and embarked on a brand‑new life.
6a98202ff5b9b83c45081220.title: Revenge Is a Size Zero

6a9831f092ff5baf3c0a5dde.synopsis: Ruby spends six years sacrificing her future for James, believing they are married. She gives up her education and career to build his empire, only to be branded infertile and betrayed when she discovers his secret marriage and child with Jane. She also learns she is the lost heiress to a multibillion-dollar fortune. Then Emmett, the man she once saved, finds her and offers a marriage of convenience. Ruby fights back, reclaims her place, exposes her enemies, and falls for Emmett.
6a9831f092ff5baf3c0a5dde.title: Her Billion-Dollar Vendetta

6a98d56ee2c86a26c0043d17.synopsis: In her past life, Sloane was betrayed and killed by her fiancé, Liam, and her stepsister, Gemma, who stole her family fortune. Reborn on her engagement night, she calls off the wedding and marries Tristan Hawth, Liam's ailing uncle. Together, they uncover the massive secret plot crafted by Jonathan and Valerie. After gathering evidence against their enemies, Sloane and Tristan fall in love and have a real wedding, starting their new life together.
6a98d56ee2c86a26c0043d17.title: Reborn: My New Groom Is My Fiancé's Uncle

6a98d78bfe666e19a6074b29.synopsis: Deliveryman Nathan Hayes takes a chef job to fund his sister's surgery. Armed with his family's secret recipes, he battles a ruthless rival, clears his grandfather's name, and wins gold at a national cooking contest. Now a star chef, he opens free classes for the underprivileged and finds love along the way.
6a98d78bfe666e19a6074b29.title: From Deliveryman to Cooking God

6a98d9755972ce3f4d0efdb8.synopsis: Silas was the world's greatest magician—a masked vigilante called the "King of Magic." When an assassin's bullet meant for him killed his mentor, Silas vowed to vanish and protect the man's daughter, Lyra. Now hiding as a janitor at Lyra's failing theater, he silently guards her and her little girl. But her vicious ex, her greedy uncle, and a parade of elite magicians descend to seize everything—forcing her into deadly magic duels where losing means death. One by one, Silas steps from the shadows. Whispers spread: could this lowly janitor be the missing King of Magic himself?
6a98d9755972ce3f4d0efdb8.title: American Magician: The Last Encore

6a98faf36b47f6c32e069f44.synopsis: A broke small-town perfumer agrees to a $50,000 marriage of convenience—only to discover her "nobody" husband is the werewolf king who married her for the scent that calms his beast.
6a98faf36b47f6c32e069f44.title: Boss, Your Wolf Secret Is Out!

6a98fc7809dda853590ac775.synopsis: After their fates are reset, two sisters embark on completely different life journeys. Letting go of past pains, the younger sister chooses to stand side by side with a duke misunderstood by the whole world. Step by step, she uncovers the truth of manipulated destinies with courage and wisdom, breaking the invisible chains that trap countless people. In the end, everyone breaks free from prearranged lives and learns to take responsibility for their own choices.
6a98fc7809dda853590ac775.title: Ashes and Thorns

6a99555185913218590748f3.synopsis: Orphaned Caine spent ten years of his life prioritizing his five mates in Rejecting My Five Female Mates. They were his foster father’s beloved daughters—spoiled, cherished, and fearless in their own ways. They became the anchor of his existence, and for so long, he thought one of them would become his fated mate. Everything changed when Seth, a notorious rogue, came onto the scene. Blinded by Seth’s lies, the five female mates turned against Caine, relentlessly humiliating him and constantly challenging his honor as the next-in-line alpha of the pack. Their treatment of Caine eventually became more than he could bear. Rather than stay and endure another humiliation, he left the pack and looked elsewhere for a future. His search took him to a foreign pack, where a marriage alliance brought him together with Princess Sylvia. He didn’t expect to fall for her so quickly, but he did. Caine thought leaving would put the worst behind him, but his life with Sylvia soon ran into trouble. One problem followed another, testing a relationship that had only just begun. Still, they refused to turn against each other and managed to get through it. For a brief moment, their future finally looked secure. That was until his five female mates crashed their wedding, demanding to settle the score and begging him to take them back. Would Caine accept their apology, or would it be the last time they ever brought up the past? Characters Caine Caine is the central character of Rejecting My Five Female Mates. He’s resilient, compassionate, and humble, always acting out of honor and always determined to fight for the truth. Enduring the hardships eventually pays off when he discovers a place where no one can doubt him again. Princess Sylvia Princess Sylvia is the reigning princess of the Silvermoon Pack. She’s mature, morally upright, and perceptive, exactly the kind of traits that match Caine’s personality. No wonder fate brought them together and allowed them to live happily ever after. Seth Seth is the notorious rogue who lies his way into the five female mates’ hearts. He creates stories to attack Caine’s character, believing they would be enough to get everything Caine has. His schemes fall through when Caine exposes him and he is punished for his sins.
6a99555185913218590748f3.title: Rejecting My Five Female Mates

6a995cdc6e8dbc842a09eb91.synopsis: Cole Sullivan, a trucker in no man's land, lives by three rules. However, his life takes a turn when he unexpectedly takes in Elena, a woman fleeing loan sharks, her gambling husband, and human traffickers. Desperate to save her daughter, Elena begs Cole to smuggle her across the border. A desperate mother and a loney truck driver, things could turn into heat.
6a995cdc6e8dbc842a09eb91.title: Road of No Turning Back

6a99ded16d3e99d8c804e117.synopsis: Jesse Morales and Grandma Dana couldn’t keep it together while reading Bound by Love and Sweet Temptation. Watch their funniest outtakes!
6a99ded16d3e99d8c804e117.title: ReelTalk EP 89-Bound By Blooper

6a9a22922dffdf54e50ba5a5.synopsis: In Accidentally His The Dragon King Won't Let Go movie, on a Blood Moon night, a drunken human girl steps into a cabin where the Dragon King lies in heat. After a steamy night with him, her belly suddenly swells, terrifying her into fleeing and leaving the loyal Dragon King to believe she has abandoned him. Days later, fate brings them together again, only for him to discover that she remembers nothing about him! But wait... is she secretly raising a child with horns all by herself?
6a9a22922dffdf54e50ba5a5.title: Accidentally His: The Dragon King Won't Let Go

6a9a2a1759516005be053227.synopsis: Alice is swept into the undersea world of Atlantis and becomes the mute, wicked supporting character everyone despises: the disgraced princess whose four merman husbands are ready to kill her. A healing pearl regrows her tongue, and the newly activated system sends her on missions to recover her beautiful voice and rebuild her spirit power. Through singing and other spirit-based purification skills, Alice eases the ocean corruption driving her husbands berserk and slowly turns their resentment into trust, affection, and fierce devotion. Soon, Gunnar the shark warrior, Will the irresistible merman, Vincent the sharp-tentacled octopus, and Albert the venomous jellyfish mage - four stunning, chiseled merman husbands - are all competing to protect and spoil her. When a two-faced rival tries to take everything Alice has reclaimed, she gives her enemy a satisfying reality check, turns the tables, and rises from Atlantis’s most unwanted woman to its most adored.
6a9a2a1759516005be053227.title: Spoiled by Four Sea Monster Husbands

6a9a616c75a26d4b52079b89.synopsis: When Grey Town is swallowed by a catastrophic flood, Erin expects Kyle, the crippled wolf guard she spent seven years healing, to save her. Instead, he throws away his crutch, reveals his leg healed long ago, and gives the boat’s last seat to her scheming sister, Sienna. Erin dies betrayed—but awakens on the day her father first brought home twin wolf guards. This time, she refuses Kyle, abandons the family that never loved her, and fights for her own power. Yet Kyle remembers their past life too, and his regret becomes obsession just as the feared Alpha King, Ronan, chooses Erin.
6a9a616c75a26d4b52079b89.title: My Wolf Chose Her, but the Alpha King Chose Me

6a9a62c047b73c93ed010ce8.synopsis: Mira is the long-lost biological daughter of the Hale family of Ashen City. Yet after returning home, she repeatedly gives way to their adopted daughter, Lia—surrendering her room, her place as a dragon rider, and even half of her mother’s inheritance. Before the wedding, Draegoth—the bonded dragon Garrick personally tamed and the only keepsake Mira has left from her mother—is trained to obey Lia alone and nearly kills Mira. Realizing that Garrick, her fiancé of eight years, has always seen her as nothing more than a gullible woman, Mira walks barefoot across burning coals, breaks off their engagement, and turns to marry Theron, the Lord of the North, who has waited eight years for her. When Garrick, Lia, and Mira’s brother Cael arrive at the magnificent Northern wedding and discover that Mira is the bride, they are overwhelmed with regret—but it is already too late. In the end, Mira is surrounded by the love she deserves, and her mother’s dragon finally returns to her side.
6a9a62c047b73c93ed010ce8.title: Goodbye My Ex, I'm Marrying the Dragon Prince FINAL

6a9a62f26495d8525209847f.synopsis: Kind-hearted Isabella always believed that being useful meant being loved. On the night she planned to propose to her boyfriend, she catches him cheating with her boss. Heartbroken and drunk, she stumbles into the hotel room of Owen—her company's cold, wealthy CEO, who's been drugged in a business trap. One night leaves her pregnant, binding two strangers in a marriage of convenience. What starts as distrust slowly becomes real. But when Owen's glamorous ex Lisa returns, she fuels Isabella's insecurities, convincing her she'll never truly have his heart. After a devastating accident, Owen believes their baby has died—while Isabella disappears with their son. Five years later, a stronger Isabella returns. Owen discovers the truth: she kept his child from him. Forced back into each other's lives, they must face old wounds, buried feelings, and Lisa's schemes—before they can finally choose love and become the family they were always meant to be.
6a9a62f26495d8525209847f.title: One night with my billionaire CEO

6a9a76ca38999d12c103c839.synopsis: In the ancient Greek era, when gods ruled the heavens and the earth, a single pure love — steadfast for five long years — stood against the prejudice and malice of the entire world, weaving a tale of redemption between god and mortal. Elena, a fallen noble girl, endured mockery and family pressure without flinching. For five years, she held on — never wavering, never abandoning Aether, a man with a broken mind. Her family, eager to climb the social ladder, forced her into marriage with Drakon, an ambitious temple priest. On the eve of the wedding, the two bid each other a painful farewell — only to be cruelly ambushed by Drakon. Aether was mortally wounded, teetering on the brink of death. In that desperate hour, Aether awakened the primordial origin of the Chaos God — a power sealed for ten thousand years. The supreme divine force that once towered above all the heavens surged back to life. The once-submissive mortal transformed into a ruthless sovereign of the divine realm. To protect the one he loved, he defied the odds, overturned their fate, and rewrote their destiny with his own hands.
6a9a76ca38999d12c103c839.title: The God They Called a Fool

6a9a9f24146dc32fdc02e4c9.synopsis: Diana, the Wolf Queen, grew tired of war and bloodshed. She disguised herself as a simple healer in the woods. To give her daughter Katherine a normal life, she sent her to the Conroy pack. Little did she know, it was a living nightmare. The Conroy pack treated Katherine like a worthless slave—humiliated, abused, beaten, and nearly raped, simply because she had no power. When Diana discovered the truth, her motherly fury was unleashed. As the dark secrets of the Conroy pack’s betrayal of Lord Julius Redblood came to light, it was no longer possible to hide. The Wolf Queen had to strike back, defeat her enemies, and reclaim her crown.
6a9a9f24146dc32fdc02e4c9.title: The Wolf Queen Strikes Back

6a9aa0e1879a1f7da603a46b.synopsis: Abe Tatum is a transmigrator and a Great Emperor. But all he wants is a peaceful life and hides his true strength at the Azure Cloud Peak. Too bad his system forces him to take in three misfits——a reincarnated Empress, a troublemaker, and a girl with massive bad luck. He wants to keep a low profile, but keeps getting dragged into conspiracies, revenge, and heavenly karmic backlash. When his home and disciples face absolute peril, Abe Tatum is forced to drop his act.
6a9aa0e1879a1f7da603a46b.title: My Strongest Master Likes Acting Weak

6a9ab541307b23911801c401.synopsis: After she supports him through law school, Vicente dumps her. His reason? He found a rich girl to marry! Heartbroken, Abril marries a stranger... only to discover he is the billionaire CEO Cristóbal Noriega!
6a9ab541307b23911801c401.title: Flash Marriage to the Wild Billionaire

6a9b046ef7be38ef68007d67.synopsis: Ten years ago Layla's parents died pulling Elias Cole out of a burning building. She watched it happen, and the trauma took all five of her senses. Sight came back. Hearing and speech never did. Elias learned sign language for her and made her a promise: he'd be her eyes, her ears, her voice, and show her the whole world. The Coles raised her. The whole school knew whose girl she was. Then a transfer student named Molly turns the school into a game, and in the boys' bathroom Layla's hearing comes back — just in time to learn that Elias has been on the other side of that game for a long time. She says nothing. She lets them keep talking, keep escalating, keep filming, while a recorder collects every voice, every insult, every line about a cripple who can't call for help. She takes the beatings, the wastewater tank, the broken ribs, and she keeps the file. Molly is going to hear her own voice played back to her. And when Elias finally turns around and starts breaking things to make it up to her, Layla will already be on a plane, with an uncle who has been waiting ten years for her call, learning to say her first word out loud.
6a9b046ef7be38ef68007d67.title: All the Words I Never Said

6a9e1564668ea4a80b077b17.synopsis: Evelyn is the Godfather Damian Moretti’s secret wife, carrying his only heir. Hidden away for her safety, she is mistaken for a discarded mistress by Bianca, who brutally humiliates her and kills her unborn child. When Damian discovers the truth, he gives Evelyn the power to punish everyone involved. One month later, the gentle wife returns as the true Lady Moretti, and no one who wronged her will escape.
6a9e1564668ea4a80b077b17.title: The Godfather’s Hidden Wife

6a9e210d6851b4c2d303c2cb.synopsis: When nine-year-old Samara Brenner, the last heir of the legendary White Wolf bloodline, witnesses her family slaughtered, she escapes and spends the next nine years hiding under a false identity, pretending to be a weak Omega while preparing for revenge. Her plan unravels when she discovers her fated mate is Roman Hartwell, the Alpha she has believed was complicit in her family's massacre. As hatred turns into reluctant trust, Samara uncovers a devastating truth: Roman has spent years searching for her and hunting the real mastermind behind the betrayal. Together, they must expose a conspiracy that reaches deep into their own families, reclaim her pack, and decide whether love is stronger than vengeance.
6a9e210d6851b4c2d303c2cb.title: Mated to My Sworn Enemy

6a9e2a86c0ec57312203b897.synopsis: Eleanor Stone, a top national security advisor, attends a wealthy family blind date in a low-key casual outfit and is deeply underestimated. A parking lot accident occurs when the CEO's drunk assistant crashes her DoD-approved bulletproof car. The arrogant CEO Alexander refuses to apologize, humiliates Eleanor in public, and even allows his subordinate to extort federal officials. Eleanor strikes back decisively. With just two phone calls, she mobilizes federal tactical forces and millions of evidentiary funds. A reckless farce collapses a billion-dollar empire overnight. The arrogant heir is expelled, and the insolent assistant is arrested.
6a9e2a86c0ec57312203b897.title: You Wrecked a Federal Bulletproof Car, Mr. CEO

6a9e50f2f0b3ac02d102ff76.synopsis: He is the only Omega in the entire military camp, crushing every Alpha with perfect scores just to join the legendary team Raven and stand beside his idol, Ares Thorn. But on the day he earns his place, the man waiting for him is not Ares. It is Logan Frost, an ace sniper and the legal husband assigned to him by the matching system, kneeling before him with roses in his hands. Before Ethan can refuse, Ares steps out from behind Logan, grips Ethan's chin in front of everyone, and says, "He is mine." His idol claims him. His husband proposes. On the same day. As the countdown to his forced match closes in and enemy fire surrounds them, Ethan realizes he never wanted only to stand beside Ares. He wants far more than that. He does not want to become anyone's Omega. He wants to become Raven.
6a9e50f2f0b3ac02d102ff76.title: The Omega's Command

6a9e5e483e3e3774520ffddd.synopsis: Careless father leaves toddler in a hot car unattended. Will her mother be able to find her and save her in time?
6a9e5e483e3e3774520ffddd.title: Daddy Left His Baby to Die

6a9e7a740bc0a33f1e000e25.synopsis: Ares is a decorated special‑forces war hero who retires after his closest comrade dies in battle—haunted by trauma, bound by a promise. That promise: protect his fallen brother's wife and daughter. They fall victim to a loan scam, trapped in crippling debt and terrorized by local thugs. Ares steps in with brutal efficiency—only to discover the thugs are small fish. Behind them: a sprawling criminal web of corrupt cops, dirty officials, and military moles. They smear his name, set traps, and try to bury him. He doesn't break. He gathers his loyal comrades, fights from the ground up, dismantles the syndicate, purges the corruption, and clears his name. In the end, he honors his promise, avenges the innocent, and bring
6a9e7a740bc0a33f1e000e25.title: A Promise to My Fallen Brother

6a9f7829742cadec7602d145.synopsis: On a blood moon night, Lilith, daughter of Count Dracula, was born. Her power was too great—the crystal ball went dark. Her father declared her "worthless" and tried to kill her. Her mother Ileana threw her into the abyss to save her, losing her magic and youth, and was banished. In the abyss, Lilith was adopted by Cain, leader of the "impure bloodline." Eighteen years later, she awakened the bloodline power of the "Moon Goddess." She returned to the surface, saved her withered mother, and was imprisoned by Mirela, the Count's fake daughter. When werewolves attacked, Lilith turned the tide with raw combat power—but because she refused to reveal her true power, she was again dismissed as "worthless." Ileana risked her life to seek help from Cain. In the final battle, Lilith unleashed the power of the blood moon, revealed her true origins, deposed her father, banished the impostors, and was crowned Countess. She abolished the old order of blood purity, restored her mother's youth, and brought the exiled home.
6a9f7829742cadec7602d145.title: Return,Goddess of the Moon

6a9f7ddf7b9496291a06823c.synopsis: No one knows Serafina is the hidden daughter of New York’s most feared mafia boss. For five years, she concealed her identity, cleared Damian’s debts, protected him from enemies, and secured the $30 million contract that could save his company. But when she arrives at his pre-IPO gala with a gunshot wound, Damian is proposing to his young intern, Lillian—and handing her Serafina’s project. Humiliated and betrayed, Serafina cancels the deal and withdraws her family’s protection. As Damian’s empire begins to collapse, he finally discovers that the woman he discarded was the only reason he ever survived.
6a9f7ddf7b9496291a06823c.title: Never Betray a Mafia Princess

6a9fa251f8c2c567f70eeab6.synopsis: Twenty years ago, Queen Amelia gave birth to a daughter—but the temple flame went dark. High Priest Mordred forged an oracle, branding the infant a "bloodless curse." King Carl ordered her execution. Amelia tore out her Titan blood, forced it into her baby's mouth, and threw her into the River Styx. She was chained to a pillar and drained for twenty years. The baby was rescued by Ryan, Lord of Tartarus, and raised as Zoe—trained as a top assassin. She returned to Obsidian disguised as a blood slave, freed her mother, and uncovered the truth. Tiffany and Mordred activated the "Ten Thousand Blood Purgatory Array." Zoe's sealing ring shattered, awakening her Titan Primordial Queen power. She exposed the forged oracle. Tiffany fused with the ancient evil god, but Zoe tore it apart. Ryan fell protecting her—his soul shattered. Zoe ventured to the Titan Temple, awakened the Titan Heart, split it in two—one half healed her mother, the other restored Ryan. She was crowned Supreme Queen, forging an eternal alliance. The "bloodless freak" became the guardian of all beings.
6a9fa251f8c2c567f70eeab6.title: The Ichorless Thrall Is The Primordial Queen!

6a9fa3ff72bf93a3100ed278.synopsis: Kallydia, head priestess of the Temple of Philotia, is exploited by her mother—forced to seduce the Sun God Helios for gold coins. An enchanted incense leads to a night with him. She flees at dawn, leaving only a silver armband engraved with her name. Helios had grown fond of her—but after a misunderstanding, he believes she's just a social climber who toys with men. Enraged, he cuts all contact. Kallydia discovers she's pregnant. Alone, she guards the faint golden light in her womb through public humiliation and family oppression. The God of War and Goddess of Wisdom arrive, revealing the truth: the gentle maidservant they remember is the "bad woman" Helios spoke of. By the time Helios reaches her, Kallydia has been tortured bloody and cast into a pit of serpents. With her last breath, she begs the gods to protect her child.
6a9fa3ff72bf93a3100ed278.title: The Sun God’s Beloved

6a9fb0874d22c3fe30088d7d.synopsis: After thirteen years of loving the wolf she rescued from the black market, Emma overhears Brian admit he has always wished he belonged to her beautiful cousin. Crushed by a lifetime of being mocked for her looks and never chosen by anyone, Emma dissolves their bond, leaves him her home, and starts over as a university lecturer in Miami. There, she meets Finn, a scarred fox Beastkin abandoned after escaping a trafficking ring. As Emma gives Finn the kindness she once begged for, he gives her something Brian never could: fierce devotion and the courage to see her own worth. When Brian returns begging for another chance, Emma must choose between the love that wounded her and the one that finally feels like home.
6a9fb0874d22c3fe30088d7d.title: He Never Wanted Me, So I Chose the One Who Did

6aa016f0dec67ee5640992c5.synopsis: Joanne Yates, the badass female Chief Instructor of the Navy SEALs, was betrayed and murdered in a classified nuclear trap engineered by her clout-chasing ex-boyfriend, Brandon. But death couldn't hold her. She wakes up reborn in a dark, abusive terrorist bunker, trapped inside the frail body of a 14-year-old angelic girl. An innocent face, but a bloodthirsty war god's soul! With pure muscle memory and tactical supremacy, she silent-kills her captors, pulling off impossible blind shots that leave Brandon’s reinforcement unit trembling in shock. From the ashes of the Middle East to the corrupt elite circles of North America, she adopts a new identity, secures the ultimate protection of an Alpha warlord family, and signs a dangerous pact with a seductive arms billionaire. Watch her crush her toxic ex's dignity and ignite a tactical nuclear strike against the Deep State itself!
6aa016f0dec67ee5640992c5.title: Reborn: The Angelic War God with a Barbie Face

6aa0b83410e6e406410874a7.synopsis: As emergency physician Naomi rushed to resuscitate a patient, lines of comments scrolled across her vision, warning her that the patient was already dead. It revealed that entering the ER meant taking the fall for the hospital director’s daughter, ultimately dooming Naomi and her family to a brutal death at the hands of the patient’s relatives. Desperate to avoid the trap, she tried everything to steer clear of the ER. Yet, the director still framed her using fabricated footage and forged signatures. Guided by the comments, Naomi exposed two fatal flaws: a birthmark on the imposter’s neck and a missing dot in the forged signature. The truth finally exploded. The director was stabbed to death by the enraged family, and his daughter was left facing execution.
6aa0b83410e6e406410874a7.title: Escaping the ER Death Trap via Scrolling comments

6aa0bd39fc29657998080be1.synopsis: After the sudden death of her father, Charlotte is cruelly abused by her succubus stepmother and two stepsisters. At an elven banquet, the Orc Queen arrives to choose a new bride with a magical goblin. After being secretly framed by her stepsister, Charlotte is chosen by the goblin and taken back to the orc castle as a “bargaining chip.” She is ordered to choose between two orc princes and marry one of them at her 18th birthday ceremony. At Saint Elaine’s Supernatural Academy, Charlotte meets two orc princes with completely opposite personalities: Vesper, an aloof, restrained snake prince with dark hair, and Claude, a charismatic, sunshine-bright lion prince with golden hair. As her stepsisters Skyler and Blair relentlessly torment her at school and the lecherous hyena Logan repeatedly schemes against her, the two princes transform into fiercely protective mates. They publicly declare Charlotte as theirs in front of the entire school, and time and again, they unleash their full beast forms—the Golden Berserker Lion and the Black-Armored Giant Serpent—to rescue her from danger. As they spend more time together and their intertwined fates pull them deeper into one another’s lives, Charlotte finds herself torn between the possessive, jealous Vesper and the gentle, devoted Claude. Caught between their overwhelming affection, she gradually falls hopelessly in love with both. On the eve of her coming-of-age ceremony, she even takes the final step with Vesper inadvertently awakening the rare and supreme bloodline of the “Holy Elf,” an ancient elven lineage of unparalleled power.
6aa0bd39fc29657998080be1.title: The Elf Bride’s Impossible Choice

6aa0bec5daf44451500e0686.synopsis: As a child, Elian was condemned by her father Marcus for being a magicless waste; her mother Selene burned her life force to save her and cast her off a cliff, where she was adopted by Kaelen. Twenty years later, she awakened the Golden Dragon bloodline, returned home to find her mother, exposed the truth, stripped Leora of power, exiled Marcus, and became Queen of Ashridge. Leora made a deal with dark sorcerer Morgaine, sparking war and taking Kaelen hostage. Elian awakened Dragon God power, defeated the dark magic, saved her parents, and was ultimately crowned Sovereign of the continent.
6aa0bec5daf44451500e0686.title: Abandoned Dragon, Ascendant Queen

6aa0bec90b22d50efa081ac4.synopsis: Will O'Connell, the city's most powerful mafia boss, dies saving an overweight, bullied teenager, Cayden, only to awaken in the boy's body. Forced back into high school, Will quickly clashes with campus bully Dane. After enduring a brutal public beating, he shocks everyone by knocking Dane down with a single punch. With help from his trusted confidant Vinny, Will secretly regains control of the O'Connell family while posing as his own illegitimate son. Using mafia resources, he transforms Cayden's body, returns to school in spectacular fashion, humiliates Dane, defeats a vindictive teacher with his academic brilliance, and survives an assassination attempt.
6aa0bec90b22d50efa081ac4.title: Bully Me? I Run the Mob!

6aa0c32f740c3351330796a2.synopsis: Layla Hale, a fallen heiress, scrapes by working at a small‑town bakery with her twin sons, who can shift into wolf cubs. She endures harassment from her lecherous boss and constant hunger, until her best friend signs her up for the Voss Group Jewelry Competition. She returns to New York and wins the championship through her own talent. Yet barely after lifting the trophy, she is framed by her malicious adopted sister Maggie, who had wronged her in the past. Layla is forced down onto a chair at City Hall and made to take Maggie’s place in marrying the notorious CEO of Voss Group — a man rumored to be hideously ugly, brutal and perverse. When the door swings open, however, the man who steps forward is none other than the one who marked her five years ago — the biological father of her two wolf‑cub sons. What she does not know is that the man she has spent five years running from has spent those same five years searching for her. — Fled with my kids for five years, only for my toxic sister to force‑marry me to the Wolf King CEO — who happens to be my boys’ real father.
6aa0c32f740c3351330796a2.title: The Alpha King Is My Baby’s Daddy!

6aa0c794f0a554f6be08413a.synopsis: Thirty‑two‑year‑old Alice has a middle‑class marriage that others envy. Her husband Richard is a senior bank executive who provides abundant material comforts, yet their marriage is frigid. Plagued by Richard’s physical issues, their relationship is little more than a hollow formality, leaving Alice trapped inside a gilded cage. Richard’s younger brother Noah comes to spend the summer, and their old romance resurfaces. They had been lovers before Alice’s marriage. Back then, Alice’s father fell seriously ill. Richard forced Alice into marriage by offering to cover her father’s medical expenses, and the two were torn apart.
6aa0c794f0a554f6be08413a.title: The Forbidden Desire

6aa0cc0c8ee9b4536c0e27de.synopsis: Exploited and sold off by her adoptive family, reborn genius Scout uses DNA matching to reunite with her biological father—Dominic Moretti, America’s supreme Mafia don. Backed by three elite brothers, she debuts as the sole Moretti heiress at her coming-of-age gala, exposes her abusers, and claims her place at the top.
6aa0cc0c8ee9b4536c0e27de.title: My Second Life as a Billionaire Heiress

6aa0cd02e672b974be0cc507.synopsis: Chloe Sullivan, CEO of Sullivan Corp, faces relentless schemes from business rivals. She crosses paths with Logan Shaw, who works undercover as a security guard. Skilled in combat, Logan protects her time and again. Chloe hires him to stay by her side. They tackle boardroom power struggles and corporate troubles together. Though Logan holds enormous power, he prefers a quiet life. Once all storms pass, Chloe makes him her exclusive bodyguard. They build their empire side by side.
6aa0cd02e672b974be0cc507.title: The Ice Queen's Secret Bodyguard

6aa0d8974cfd2f8e44057b76.synopsis: Adopted daughter Olivia is betrayed by her own brother, her fiancé and her family. Her wedding is stolen, and she is exiled to the border for eight years. Over those eight years, she evolves into a top‑tier intelligence strategist and protects eight heirs from major powerful families. Her old enemies track her down and force her to abandon the children. Conflicts erupt on all fronts, and Olivia is pushed to the brink of danger. When Don MacRae arrives with armed reinforcements, layers of lies are exposed one after another. All parties return to the East Coast Committee for a public trial, and the betrayers receive their due punishment. Olivia cuts off her toxic bond with her birth family and gradually climbs to the apex of power within the East Coast Committee. The eight children she once protected become her most loyal backing.
6aa0d8974cfd2f8e44057b76.title: The Godmother Returns

6aa0e4992d54042dab0172a6.synopsis: On her 7th anniversary, pregnant Amelia finds husband Trevor dining with another woman. She leaves Boston, files for divorce using a prenup clause he wrote, and reclaims her hidden identity as Dr. Amelia Voss—co‑founder of Longmoor Labs and creator of VESL. As she rebuilds her career and custody of daughter Adi, Trevor’s world crumbles. With support from her grandmother, loyal colleagues, and quiet suitor Hugh, Amelia wins sole custody, 75% assets, and a new life. Trevor loses everything—too late, he finally sees who she truly is.
6aa0e4992d54042dab0172a6.title: I Flew Home Pregnant Only To See His Secret

6aa13bb19674f217f40375c8.synopsis: In her past life, Seraphina Sterling forsook her royal duty for Lucius Hawthorne, only to die painfully by his betrayal and poison. Reborn amid blood, she comes back with glorious military victories, exposes every conspiracy, and leaves the guilty drowning in regret. Beyond love and hate, she claims ultimate power and rules as empress.
6aa13bb19674f217f40375c8.title: Reborn From Betrayal to Reign

6aa14b83871c17602008654b.synopsis: My family never remembered my birthday. Ethan’s meant a steakhouse booked a month ahead; Chloe’s meant Six Flags and Mom’s Instagram carousel: “Happy birthday to our little princess.” Mine is July 19th, mid-summer—always ignored. On my eighteenth, I woke early, put on makeup, and waited on the couch. Mom passed with Chloe’s dance bag: “Heat your own lunch. I’m taking her to intensive.” Dad left with Ethan to play ball. By noon I was alone. I texted the family chat: “I’m eighteen today! 🎉” Silence. At seven they came home—Ethan’s ribs, Chloe’s mac and cheese. No cake. No candles. No song. Nothing missing, to them. Everyone got a birthday except me. I was eighteen now. I could finally choose where to go.
6aa14b83871c17602008654b.title: You Ignored My Birthday So I Erased Myself From The Family

6aa20b80756571a6090712d5.synopsis: My childhood friend promised to marry me—then proposed to my adopted sister. The most powerful man on the West Coast suddenly swept in and married me. For five years, he was the perfect husband. Until I heard the truth: he only married me to keep me from blocking my adopted sister's happiness. So I changed my name, faked my death, and set up a video to expose everything. But after I died, he went mad with regret.
6aa20b80756571a6090712d5.title: After My Fake Death, He Went Mad with Regret

6aa20de315d359602001a835.synopsis: Mason Todd, once the Culinary King, lost everything after refusing to endorse Damon Holt's gutter-oil brand and was saved by Tessa Ford, owner of Crossroads Bistro. Though stripped of his sense of taste, Mason rebuilt his skills in humble kitchens and entered the Culinary King Championship to protect Tessa and her restaurant. Facing sabotage from Holt and Gavin Cole, he fought his way to the final and reclaimed his crown with a simple bowl of soy sauce fried rice.
6aa20de315d359602001a835.title: Rise of the Culinary King

6aa213ce7d560fa0290979b7.synopsis: Henry, a culinary genius with ancestral imperial-chef recipes, spent eight years building the high-end Starlight Feast for his childhood friend Jasper—only to be betrayed. Jasper coveted the recipes, shortchanged him, and humiliated him publicly. With his mother gravely ill, Henry turned to a street stall, but Jasper’s men smashed it and injured his best friend Cole. At his lowest, Iloen, owner of the rival restaurant Voss, offered help—covering his mother’s surgery and inviting him to run her failing restaurant. Bound by cuisine and business, they fought Jasper’s attacks: supply cuts, chef sabotage, and online smears. Henry’s mother gave him a ticket to a cruise culinary exchange. On board, Jasper kidnapped Henry’s sister, forcing a deadly wager: loser loses wrist tendons. Through two rounds, Henry exposed every scheme, bringing the villains to justice. A month later, Voss thrived, his mother recovered, and Henry found family, friendship, and mutual love with Iloen.
6aa213ce7d560fa0290979b7.title: The Royal Chef’s Comeback

6aa214827f10f7350d061957.synopsis: Ethan Carter, a brilliant algorithm prodigy, gave up his career to secretly marry into the Lin family and support his wife Evelyn Lin's dream. For ten years, he was treated as the family's "free housekeeper" and "human ATM" — until he caught her cheating with Damian Rivers, who also fathered a secret child with her. The decade of silence ends. Ethan Carter files for divorce and strikes back: recovering transferred assets, reclaiming pre-marital property, and leveraging his hidden identity — the creator of "Pangu," the core algorithm keeping Evelyn Lin's company alive — to plunge her empire into crisis. Meanwhile, Charlotte Shaw, president of Charlotte Group and his longtime "rival," confesses she has secretly loved him for ten years. Under her pursuit,Ethan Carter heals, severs his past, and embraces a new life.
6aa214827f10f7350d061957.title: Divorced, Betrayed, and Claimed by Her Rival

6aa217a1550d0f52260da399.synopsis: Seven years after she ran, Yukino comes home to find her father in prison and the family company in the hands of her stepbrother—the man she once loved. He forces her into an engagement to finish his revenge. What he doesn't know: the daughter she's hidden overseas for six years is his.
6aa217a1550d0f52260da399.title: Engaged to My Enemy

6aa2199faf0e20bdc4094519.synopsis: Five years ago, gifted surgeon Elara Voss fled a suffocating marriage while secretly carrying her husband’s unborn daughter. Now, one drunken mistake lands her back in bed with her cold, billionaire ex‑husband, Damian Sterling. Determined to protect their five‑year‑old daughter, Elara insists the child isn’t his and proposes a strictly physical arrangement: Tuesdays only, no publicity, no interference, and no entanglement. What she doesn’t know is that Damian has loved her for five full years and waited for her all along; he simply never knew how to express his feelings. As old desire reignites, their daughter’s identity and the carefully staged fake‑infidelity hoax that destroyed their marriage begins to surface. Can two people who never learned to understand each other’s love give their marriage a second chance once the truth comes to light?
6aa2199faf0e20bdc4094519.title: My Possessive Ex-Husband

6aa21db9c23f3ec68f045ece.synopsis: After ten years abroad, Felix returns home as a renowned security strategist to uncover the truth behind the injustice his mother suffered. When his cousin Ember's biotech company becomes the target of a ruthless corporate battle over a breakthrough cancer drug, Felix steps in to protect her and secure vital funding. As a key figure from his mother's past resurfaces, Felix pursues the truth legally while protecting his family and fighting for justice.
6aa21db9c23f3ec68f045ece.title: The God of War's Feisty CEO Cousin

6aa21efefba1c5524b00a0de.synopsis: Logan Westbrook was abducted as a child and separated from his family. Having risen to become a renowned industry leader, he finally reunites with them. Yet the family business hits a crisis; their old allies turn against them and break off the childhood betrothal, publicly humiliating his father. Watch Logan strike back and shield his family from disgrace.
6aa21efefba1c5524b00a0de.title: Pretending Poor in the Elite Clan

6aa22454583b26ec3b03141d.synopsis: A ruthless mob boss dies saving Vivian and wakes up in her body. Determined to start over and earn her place at college, she discovers she's the school's worst student, bullied by a fake heiress and her own family. Now she's ready to fight back—until her long-lost sister returns to claim the throne.
6aa22454583b26ec3b03141d.title: The Top Student Is a Mob Boss

6aa24b86d6c23093cf06e859.synopsis: After three years of hidden trial in a homeless camp, Vince Astor is crowned America's Godfather, heir to $20.9 billion. He keeps the secret when Helen Stark, the CEO he saved two years ago, proposes to him on the street. Still dressed as a bum, he follows her home and swallows her family's scorn as they force her to marry Philip West. His power then surfaces layer by layer. A bank president kneels, a $1 billion bid lands, an underboss kisses his ring. Helen chooses him anyway, for who he is.
6aa24b86d6c23093cf06e859.title: Step Back! That Homeless Man Is Not to be Messed with

6aa24f8c75dcbe9d3807009c.synopsis: When Sloane’s heat approaches, Mason calls her fat and vicious. Cole begs not to be chosen. Gavin, whom she loves, says he would rather see her dead than father her cub. Chosen since childhood to give Mercer Clan an heir, all three reject her. Sloane gives up on them and vows to make them regret every insult. After a month of brutal training, she enters mate selection slim, powerful, and unrecognizable. As all three stare in shock, Sloane rejects them before every clan and names Ronan, the territory’s lowest slave, as the mate chosen for her by the Goddess.
6aa24f8c75dcbe9d3807009c.title: Rejecting My Three Suitors After I Slimmed Down

6aa25a957520bcf44103332b.synopsis: On her wedding day, Orton Reed is abandoned, slapped, and humiliated in front of everyone, all because her fragile stepsister Lucy is having another crisis. Her fiancé Cole, her childhood friend Ryan, and even her biological parents all choose Lucy over her. After discovering she is seriously ill, Orton finally stops begging to be loved. She leaves New York for a remote school in New Mexico, where she teaches, heals, and learns to live for herself. When the people who hurt her come back with apologies, Orton no longer wants a place in their lives.
6aa25a957520bcf44103332b.title: I'm Done Playing Along

6aa27cbefff49e7f1307ea4c.synopsis: An ordinary salesman meets a rich heiress dodging an arranged marriage — and one fake relationship gets way too real... When Lydia Kensington finds hidden treasures in Logan Ashford's home, his "cousin" Vanessa Hale drops the bomb: he's the heir to Crown City's richest family. After trials and growing feelings, Lydia and Logan choose each other, and the Ashfords prepare a lavish bride price for a happy new life.
6aa27cbefff49e7f1307ea4c.title: My Heiress Wife Won't Let Go

6aa35dfd4d5aaf051600f537.synopsis: Laura, sold to a violent old man, escapes into a cave and bonds with silver dragon duke Kyle—becoming pregnant with his heir. They marry for the child, then fall in love. Despite rival schemes and assassination attempts, Laura discovers runemaster talent, gives birth to twins, founds an academy, and stands equal beside Kyle.
6aa35dfd4d5aaf051600f537.title: Becoming the Heirless Dragon King's Fated Mate

6aa3618b8b03e71fd0047437.synopsis: Enduring six years of humiliation as a contract wife, Belle received nothing but her husband Nicholas's indifference, her rival's scheming, and even the betrayal of her own son. When she finally walked away battered and broken, the mysterious billionaire Sebastian stepped in with unwavering protection—only to reveal that this marriage had been nothing but a transaction all along. True love, after all, is never something you beg for. When the truth finally comes to light, who will be her ultimate destination?
6aa3618b8b03e71fd0047437.title: The Contract Wife’s Vengeance

6aa361dabb9c46cea20e79f9.synopsis: I was dying from a difficult childbirth, yet my husband stayed outside the delivery room of his subordinate’s widow. I signed the divorce papers and left without hesitation. He was filled with deep regret and ended up abandoned by everyone around him.
6aa361dabb9c46cea20e79f9.title: I Signed My Divorce Papers on the Operating Table

6aa362809c3d2a806c09b7b5.synopsis: Cross Corleone, the feared head of the Corleone crime syndicate. Stricken with amnesia after a sniper ambush during a drug crackdown, he lives incognito as a lowly kitchen helper for five years. A devastating betrayal restores his memory. He uncovers an imposter misusing his identity and the ruthless Columbo clan exploiting his reputation to seize power. With loyal underboss Daisy and heiress Selena Hayes, he reclaims his throne, exposes the deception, and crowns Selena his only Mrs. Corleone.
6aa362809c3d2a806c09b7b5.title: The Godfather with Amnesia

6aa363575c614c71b500c008.synopsis: After completing her final trial, Elena, the High Priestess of the Hidden Order, learned that fragments of her soul were missing and that she needed to go to the Sterling and Forrester families—where her biological parents were—to retrieve them. The two families were on the verge of a marriage alliance, and she seized the opportunity to return. But she soon discovered that both families were riddled with schemes and intrigue, and there were villains coveting the power of the Hidden Order and the wealth of the Forrester family. While fighting against these conspiracies, Elena searched for her missing soul fragments, ultimately uncovering the truth, protecting her identity and the one she loved, and completing her self-redemption and the closing of her fate.
6aa363575c614c71b500c008.title: The true heiress returning is the grand priestess of fat

6aa37a12b55dd4a1cf053ff6.synopsis: Sophia suffered domestic abuse at the hands of her father, Antony, since a very young age. As an adult, Sophia encountered a paranoid and abusive partner, Gordon, who eventually pushed her off a cliff. Miraculously, Sophia survived and was rescued by Alpha Bernard, who had recently lost his partner. After being rescued, Sophia decided to move forward despite the doubts and pushbacks. Antony and Gordern, in an attempt to cover up their crimes, had since been planning to take Sophie out. Fate intertwined, Sophia and Bernard became partners. With Bernard's love and encouragement, Sophia not only overcame her inner fears, but also discovered her powerful abilities as the white wolf. With Bernard's assistance, she defeated Antony and Gordern, and ultimately became the queen.
6aa37a12b55dd4a1cf053ff6.title: My fated Alpha: Rejected and Reclaimed

6aa39542cfad6e0f1e036697.synopsis: I'm Elena. Ten years I built his company with him. The day we went public, I walked in on himwith his pregnant secretary.He forced a divorce that night—cashed out my shares, gave me the house, the money. Hethought I was crying over him. He didn't know I was crying because the fraud evidence washitting the regulators the next morning.I took the money. I signed. I walked away.Let him and his empire burn together.This time, I'm not betting on anyone. Because I'm holding all the cards.
6aa39542cfad6e0f1e036697.title: Divorced and Billionaire

6aa39e12f4ae9dbd480c9e1f.synopsis: She can't stand her boss, and he'd rather tease her than tell her how he feels. When he's sent away to turn around a failing restaurant, he insists she come along. What she doesn't know? Her biggest workplace rival is also the man she's fallen for online.
6aa39e12f4ae9dbd480c9e1f.title: My Worst Boss Is My Online Crush

6aa3a8de4c3ae91aba01e787.synopsis: Eleanor Vance spent sixteen years protecting Leo Carter, only for him to turn her into the school's laughingstock to impress Savannah. She vanishes to California, where a new school, real friends, and a gentle captain help her become someone the old Eleanor never dared to be. When Leo finally tracks her down, his apology comes too late—she has already built a new life with no room for him.
6aa3a8de4c3ae91aba01e787.title: Bullied Girl

6aa3b5bdd5aadad2080fbafd.synopsis: In Dragonblood Alpha movie, abandoned as an infant for lacking a "wolf spirit," Kyle is raised by three Legendary Beasts in the Beast Forest. Eighteen years later, he has not only grown into a fierce fighter but also awakened the hidden power of a dragon within him. Seeking his parents, Kyle rescues Freya, the Princess of the Silvermoon Pack, and follows her to the Crimson Flame City. There, he discovers that Elina, a disgraced slave tormented by the pack's hypocritical Alpha, Alaric, is actually his birth mother. Just as they reunite, the Thunderclaw Pack launches a devastating invasion. While Alaric and the cowardly heir Kent surrender and betray Freya to save themselves, Kyle steps forward, unleashing his dragon-wolf bloodline to crush the invaders. However, a darker conspiracy emerges: the Thunderclaw Pack has allied with the Liches, an evil undead race bent on destroying the world. Facing the terrifying Lich King and an endless army of ghouls, Kyle is empowered by Freya's holy light and the united strength of every werewolf worldwide. Transforming into a colossal silver wolf, Kyle defeats the Lich King and saves the realm. In the end, his father, the ancient dragon Vodar, awakens from his slumber, reuniting their family. Kyle claims his rightful place as the new Alpha of the Crimson Flame Pack and finds true love with Freya.
6aa3b5bdd5aadad2080fbafd.title: Dragonblood Alpha

6aa3b82c32eca1e150047623.synopsis: Three years ago, Chloe won the national clinical skills championship but chose frontline medicine over fame. When she saves a billionaire's wife and her baby, a rival doctor steals the credit, and a corrupt director fires Chloe. After the truth is exposed, Chloe returns to save the patient and brings her betrayers to justice. Vindicated at last, she leads a national emergency-care initiative and earns the country's highest medical honor.
6aa3b82c32eca1e150047623.title: I'm the Doctor You Never Should Have Fired

6aa3da026ad2b895d6070ebf.synopsis: Leo Banks got a special physique and X-ray eyes. After leaving his sect, he runs into his fiancée and tries to save her, only to be mistaken for a creep. To prove himself, Leo now has to dominate the city and live a carefree life.
6aa3da026ad2b895d6070ebf.title: My X-Ray Eyes Rule the City

6aa41b758d6e213b0101ffa5.synopsis: At Adrian Shaw’s company, everyone knew her simply as "Georgia Hale"—a manager who had worked by his side for eight years and his secret girlfriend. No one knew that "Hale" was merely her middle name; her real name was Georgia Hale Harrison, the sole heiress and Vice President of the Harrison Group. When she humbled herself for the first time in her life to beg her father, Richard Harrison, to approve the crucial thirty-million-dollar contract Adrian had been desperately chasing for months, Adrian repaid her by publicly announcing his marriage to an intern, Chloe Vance. Georgia withheld the deal, resigned, severed ties with Adrian, and agreed to marry Julian Prescott—the heir to the Prescott family who had waited twelve years for her. At the grand signing ceremony, her father appeared in person to reveal her true name and identity; she terminated the contract on the spot and exposed Chloe’s betrayal. As Adrian’s company collapsed and he spiraled into regret, Georgia’s life soared—cherished by Julian and welcomed back into the fold of her family, she finally lived life on her own terms, no longer anyone’s secret.
6aa41b758d6e213b0101ffa5.title: How I Bankrupted My Cheating Ex

6aa752ea136f31b62908c889.synopsis: Maya, a studious girl, agrees to help her crush Connor prank Harper. But Connor ties her up with zip ties and covers her in fake blood. Harper, terrified, beats her with a steel chair, breaking 17 bones. Maya survives after three months in ICU but is disfigured. She rejects settlements, testifies in court, and gets Harper jailed and Connor imprisoned. She moves away, rebuilds her life, and studies psychology and law. Connor spirals into madness. Maya moves on, scarred but unbroken.
6aa752ea136f31b62908c889.title: Prank Gone Wrong

6aa753ad83b3abf3980648be.synopsis: Five years ago, Evelyn, from the slums, was chosen by Adrian, a wealthy young man from New York, to be a surrogate mother to give birth to Chloe. However, after the child's birth, she was stripped of her maternal status and forced to remain at Blackwood Estate as a live-in nanny. For five years, she silently memorized Chloe's every habit, ailment, and fear, only to be repeatedly humiliated, forced to kneel, confined, and even distanced from her daughter by the nominal wife, Lillian. Chloe, however, instinctively relied on Evelyn, the one who truly cared for her, clinging to her through repeated crises of illness, fear, and abandonment.
6aa753ad83b3abf3980648be.title: The Slum Girl Who Became a Billionaire's Wife

6aa753efe13e65890e083ebb.synopsis: In AGENT BADBOY movie, top FBI agent Buddy looks exactly like Barton, the deceased patriarch of the Logut mafia family. He goes undercover as Barton to expose the family’s arms smuggling. Inside, he survives power grabs from Luca, probes from Barton’s stepmother Susanna, and uses their shared crescent birthmark to avoid exposure. He falls for Barton’s wife Elise, wins over bodyguard Haruko, and secures the San Francisco docks. With evidence in hand, he and FBI Deputy Director Helena plan a final raid—but FBI Director Burke is the mafia’s deepest mole. He and the Raine family spring a trap; Helena is shot. In the battle, Buddy kills Burke and Carlos. Dying, Burke reveals Buddy and Barton are twin brothers—stolen as infants and groomed to be a mafia mole inside the FBI. Torn between two bloodlines, Buddy stands with Elise, Susanna, and Haruko—as Helena, presumed dead, twitches her fingers. Cliffhanger.
6aa753efe13e65890e083ebb.title: Agent Badboy

6aa756337b3ea9ca6e0e382e.synopsis: Joe, self-made CEO of Vera Robotics, pioneered companion robots. In his past life, his wife Vanessa and her lover Dan conspired to murder him brutally, staged an accident, and stole his company.Reborn on the day of his companion robot launch, Joe initiates his revenge. Using the guise of testing robots, he mercilessly torments Dan, who is disguised as a machine. At the press conference, he meticulously manipulates Vanessa into signing divorce papers voluntarily, then publicly exposes Dan hiding inside a robot shell, shattering Vanessa's innocent facade. His scheme leaves the traitors ruined—family broken, company lost—while Joe reclaims his empire and relists it successfully.
6aa756337b3ea9ca6e0e382e.title: The Robot She Cheated With

6aa75787742a9765a10bfc80.synopsis: On the same day, two best friends gave birth. Ellen, drowning in poverty, secretly swapped her newborn with her billionaire best friend’s baby, desperate to give her daughter a life of luxury. What she never expected: her friend saw everything and silently switched the babies back. Eighteen years later, just as Ellen’s scheme is finally about to pay off, the truth explodes in her face: the daughter she’s tormented and belittled all along… is her own blood.
6aa75787742a9765a10bfc80.title: She Swapped the Wrong Baby

6aa76218b3be27359003c45c.synopsis: As a fake‑born heiress, Ivy was betrothed to three elite beastmen: Lucian the fox, Kieran the tiger, and Caelen the serpent. After stumbling across their group chat, Ivy mistakenly believed they disliked her and favored her sister Lia. At her birthday banquet, she publicly gave the three beastmen to Lia and fled abroad to become a renowned pianist. Four years later, Ivy returns home, only to be tracked down by the trio. Those hurtful messages turned out to be their scheme against one another, each plotting to have her exclusively. As misunderstandings clear and Lia keeps making trouble, the beastmen fiercely defend Ivy. After her solo recital, Ivy faces her true feelings, accepts their affection and lives for herself.
6aa76218b3be27359003c45c.title: Rejected by My Shifter Mates, So I Walked Away

6aa762ef7437581d78018d97.synopsis: Abandoned by her family, Eva is reborn on the day of the bloodline trial. In her past life, her stepsister Vivian framed her, and she died in a vampire castle as a pawn. This time, she sees through her family’s fake love and the vampires’ schemes, choosing wounded werewolf Alistair—secretly the supreme Lycan King. Poisoned by the Ice-Fire Divine Poison and betrayed by his closest subordinate, he hides as a lowly wolf slave. Vivian steals the vampire marriage contract and torments Eva, while her cold parents treat her as a bargaining chip. Even cast out and mocked by nobles, Eva stands by Alistair. At the Blood Moon Ceremony, Vivian forces her barefoot across silver thorns and sacred fire to kill her. Alistair arrives with his wolf legion, reveals his true identity, and avenges every insult. Together they uncover the vampire Progenitor’s plot to seize the Blackstone Divine Essence inside Eva. Eva enters the Void Sacred Spring alone, endures heavenly thunder as a mortal, absorbs the forbidden essence, and cures Alistair. They defeat the Progenitor, overthrow the old order, and punish all traitors. Eva ascends the twin thrones as Wolf Queen beside her Lycan King, bound by eternal love.
6aa762ef7437581d78018d97.title: My Lycan Lord

6aa7679f33c68355850005bc.synopsis: Legendary Captain Arthur once took command as a low-level maintenance worker when the captain lost the ability to steer and the giant ship was on the verge of losing control. He successfully saved five thousand passengers and thereby earned the honor of “Strongest Captain.” Yet at the award ceremony, he suddenly collapsed. When he opened his eyes again, he had returned to ten years earlier, transformed into his nine-year-old self, aboard the cruise ship Victoria. Arthur instantly remembered: it was on this very voyage that the ship encountered a disaster at sea, and his mother Mary drowned trying to save him. With memories of his previous life, Arthur decided to rewrite his fate.
6aa7679f33c68355850005bc.title: King of the Four Seas: Legend Reborn
