6aa7778e38d2cb6ba80c50e5.synopsis: Chloe is a brilliant strategist and a master of deflection.When she’s framed for seducing the dean, she instantly throws the real mistress, her own supervisor, straight under the bus.In retaliation, the mistress sets a deadly $500K embezzlement trap.Cornered, Chloe makes her boldest move yet: she fakes a severe concussion and slides the damning authorization token straight to the Chancellor.The next day, the mistress storms the VIP ward with campus police, demanding thearrest of the token’s final holder—completely unaware of the titan standing right behind the curtain.
6aa7778e38d2cb6ba80c50e5.title: Oops, You Messed with the Mastermind Queen!

6aa7937c010dc7b364022699.synopsis: Pyrrhos is the hammer-hand at Hermon's Forge — a nobody they call Emberless, because he can't feel forge fire the way a real smith should. He's spent a thousand nights making the runeblades that kill dragons and hydras across the continent. On Assessment Day, he watches the guild crown his senior brother Deryk for a masterpiece called Firstlight: Pyrrhos's design, his three years of work, his signature scraped off the plans. When he demands his wages and walks, his master upends a sack on the anvil — ten rusted scraps. Then, in the dying furnace behind him, a thread of pure gold flame rises on its own. Ten scraps is his starting stake. With a girl carrying a broken family sword, a landlord's back room, and a wartime order no one else will fill, he builds a forge out of nothing and starts scraping the paint off the guild's fake runes one blade at a time. But the fire in his hands isn't luck. It answers to a bloodline that traces back to Hephaestus himself, to a father who burned with his workshop rather than surrender the plans for the Godslayer, and to an order of ashes still hunting the seven fragments he scattered. Delphi has a name waiting for him. He'd rather earn one.
6aa7937c010dc7b364022699.title: GODFORGED: TEN SCRAPS OF IRON

6aa793819e09c929dd03bef8.synopsis: In The Alpha's Broken Mate movie, my entire family forced me to take the blame for my adopted sister, and my Alpha told me, "Seven years will pass in no time". While I was in prison for her, losing the child in my womb, my Alpha mate was holding her in his arms and saying, "I love you". After I was released, I severed our soul bond with my own hands and left for the war zone. Later, filled with regret, he clutched my boots and cried, "My Luna". I touched my heavily pregnant belly and said, "Sorry, but I'm already carrying your older brother's child".
6aa793819e09c929dd03bef8.title: The Alpha's Broken Mate

6aa7a6696a19b24c4c0d6384.synopsis: "On her wedding day, Megan’s fiancé Mark vanishes without a trace. After four years of investigation, the police still turn up no leads whatsoever. Consumed by her relentless obsession, Megan is taken by her best friend Jennifer to a hidden underground store that sells so-called hyper-realistic ""shared boyfriend"" companion robots. She is horrified to discover that ""Robot No. 07"" is none other than Mark, missing for four years. He is kept subdued with drugs and electric shocks, disguised as merchandise to be exploited for profit. To save her beloved, Megan swallows her humiliation and feigns compliance, secretly gathering evidence. Step by step, she uncovers the shocking truth: her best friend, driven by hatred born from scorned love, was the one who ""donated"" Mark to the store owner. In the final showdown, Megan collaborates with the police from the inside to raid and shut down the illegal operation. The two lean on each other through the long aftermath of trauma, moving steadily toward healing and a new beginning."
6aa7a6696a19b24c4c0d6384.title: Shared Boyfriend

6aa7a817352596cfcd03ec5b.synopsis: Chloe thought she was just an ordinary wife until her husband Noah and her sister Mia betrayed her. But they underestimated her—she is no victim. She is a queen, and revenge is a dish best served cold. After discovering their affair, Chloe devises a systematic plan to strip Noah of everything—his wealth, his company, and his dignity. With the help of her fiercely loyal right-hand man, Liam, she infiltrates the boardroom, exposes their schemes on a public stage, and dismantles Mia’s fragile facade piece by piece. What begins as a twisted love triangle soon reveals a deeper conspiracy: the truth behind Chloe's father’s mysterious death. From securing control of a billion-dollar corporation to unearthing long-buried secrets, Chloe's quest for justice turns into a sweeping power play. In the end, she rises as the undisputed queen of the empire, with her most dangerous yet loyal ally standing beside her—not as a servant, but as her equal. Revenge is just the beginning. This is a story of betrayal, power, and absolute redemption.
6aa7a817352596cfcd03ec5b.title: Surrender to the Night

6aa7be510277dd3ed1059830.synopsis: Mia is a 19-year-old college freshman who's beautiful but broke. Her father tells her to sell herself. Her mother offers her a job at a bar. With tuition overdue and no way out, she accepts an offer from her African professor, Kofi: $5,000 a month for companionship. But Kofi has other plans. He injects her with drugs, ties her up, and films everything. He doesn't stop there. He uses the videos to blackmail her into delivering packages—drugs, money, things she doesn't want to know about. Just when she thinks she's alone, Nina, the quiet girl in her dorm, steps in. Nina saves her from Kofi in a dark parking lot. She holds Mia through withdrawal. She becomes the only person Mia trusts. Until Mia finds messages on Nina's phone. Messages that prove Nina wasn't just helping her. She was positioning herself. She was waiting for Mia to fall so she could be the one to catch her—and own her.
6aa7be510277dd3ed1059830.title: The Freshman’s Secret

6aa7c414d1460ae9ca0f123d.synopsis: Synopsis:Fresh off her divorce, Ava travels to Hawaii for a getaway with her brother-in-law Jack, and the pair cross moral boundaries through a series of lingering temptations. When their secret comes to light, a marriage crumbles and the two sisters suffer a bitter falling-out. Burdened by guilt, both women grow and heal separately over their long estrangement. Ultimately, they bridge the rift between them, rebuild their sisterly bond despite the scars, and find true redemption.
6aa7c414d1460ae9ca0f123d.title: My Sister's Husband

6aa7c50450460871b005c79c.synopsis: Avalyn, a lone girl raised by wolves in the northern wilderness, is brought back by her birth father Duke Snow only to get trapped in royal conspiracies. After her father is murdered, she bides her time and devises schemes. With her courage and beast-taming skills, she slays her enemies, quells barbarian uprisings and earns widespread renown across the kingdom. Eventually, she uncovers her true identity as the lost heir of the Sacred Court of All Beasts, returns to the divine realm, executes the usurper, and ascends the Throne of All Beasts.
6aa7c50450460871b005c79c.title: Wolf of the North

6aa7c58723b93c5a45037516.synopsis: Cecilia, Crown Princess of Etheria, rescues a disfigured “deserter” named Amos from a death pit and makes him her personal guard. Three years later, King Helios of Nord storms her capital—and reveals he is Amos. Having used her to steal every military secret, he destroys her kingdom, burns her ancestral tombs, and enslaves her. To buy time for her brother Edmund to strike Nord’s rear, Cecilia endures public humiliation, torture, and repeated abuse, until she takes a fake-death potion left by Edmund and escapes. Edmund captures Nord’s capital, trades Helios’s mother for Cecilia’s “corpse,” and secretly revives her. Years later, Edmund dies, naming Cecilia regent for his young son. Helios, learning she is alive, begs for reconciliation, then threatens to massacre civilians when refused. Cecilia declares war and leads the army herself. After three years, she stands before Nord’s capital, shoots Helios twice but spares his life, then orders the assault. That night, Helios dons his old disguise mask and burns himself alive in the palace. Cecilia annexes Nord, abolishes slavery, standardizes weights and measures, establishes a people’s council, and unites both kingdoms into a new realm—Eternal. She never marries, devoting her life to her people. Upon her death, she is honored as the “Mother of the Eternal Realm.” Her bronze statue still stands in the capital square, gazing into the distance, a silent witness to the peace she won with blood and sacrifice.
6aa7c58723b93c5a45037516.title: Fallen Princess to Queen

6aa7df9fef241e84980c21b1.synopsis: Sterling Blake, once Arcadia's feared War God, Asura, has spent five years hiding as a lunch vendor to protect his daughter, Nora, after traitors killed his wife. When ruthless heiress Sloane Frost has Nora beaten and abducted, Sterling unleashes his sealed power, destroys the Frost family, and storms the Blossom Martial Arts Association alone. After rescuing Nora, he learns the conspiracy reaches Arcadia's former Guardian of War and sets out with her to settle a five-year blood debt.
6aa7df9fef241e84980c21b1.title: Asura Dad: Hands Off My Daughter

6aa8087087fabbce6b0b13a9.synopsis: In the early 1980s, Ellie is forced to marry John, a scarred logging foreman, in her sister's place. Expecting a hot-tempered brute, she finds a rugged husband who adores her and a fierce mother-in-law who always has her back. Blessed with uncanny luck, Ellie discovers rare mushrooms and century-old ginseng in the mountains, turning the family's fortunes around. Soon, the once-pitied bride becomes the forest camp's richest woman, while fighting off greedy relatives and her shameless sister.
6aa8087087fabbce6b0b13a9.title: I Married a Lumberjack and Struck It Rich

6aa80929eca954405107a0f4.synopsis: Born with the ability to understand animal language, Nora Seth was abandoned as a child and raised by Elder Tatum. When her grandmother falls gravely ill, Nora returns to reunite with her family. Yet her stepmother and her daughter constantly try to sabotage Nora. But with her beast-taming skills, she beats them all. Then comes her arranged fiancé... Vicious stepmom and stepsister, a company to save, and a fiancé to deal with, can she handle them all?
6aa80929eca954405107a0f4.title: Beasts at My Command, I Tamed a Kingdom

6aa82ca6fef73defe803d847.synopsis: Ever wonder what The Big Four really get up to after wrap? We kept the cameras rolling as they took a dip and dove into some heated sports debates.
6aa82ca6fef73defe803d847.title: ReelTalk EP 88-Bro Knows Ball

6aa83403a82a0a84ed0093e5.synopsis: Cool down from the steamy scenes with the Lyonesse Trilogy’s favorite throuple! Salt Kiss, Honey Cut, and Bitter Burn stars Nico Tortorella, Jake Lively, and Katelynn Rose whip up homemade ice cream while answering some seriously hot questions.
6aa83403a82a0a84ed0093e5.title: ReelTalk EP 91-Ice Cream & Hot Questions with the Lyonesse Trilogy Cast

6aa89f9e91cc2ef1d4004b47.synopsis: Everyone thought the charred corpse in the morgue was my husband, Marco. But I knew better. The man faking his tears behind me was Marco; the body was his twin, Fabian. In my past life, exposing his lie got me locked in a psych ward, while my children froze to death. Reborn on the very day I had to identify the body, I played along. I signed the death certificate and legally inherited his entire empire. To protect my kids, I walked straight onto the turf of his deadliest rival—the ruthless Don Dominic—and made him an offer he couldn't refuse...
6aa89f9e91cc2ef1d4004b47.title: My Husband Played Dead. I Made It Real.

6aa8a3355bc79b35270882d6.synopsis: In The Dragon Queen's Gambit movie, Dragon Queen Evelyn discovers her consort Cyril and handmaid Cecilia, both serpent-shifters, swapped her newborn with their son. She secretly raises her daughter Ann into a northern empire queen. After twenty years of silent endurance, Evelyn abdicates and is exiled. When Ann marries the impostor prince, the trap springs: identity reveal, economic ruin, and the arrival of Millennium Dragon Aurelius as Ann's true father. The betrayers lose everything while Evelyn reunites with her family.
6aa8a3355bc79b35270882d6.title: The Dragon Queen's Gambit

6aa8a5d7f08dff1bf80a3bda.synopsis: Abandoned at her tenth wedding—and insultingly replaced by a K-9 dog—Brigid Hayes marries powerful billionaire Marco Romano on the spot. Ignorant of her new status, her toxic ex-fiancé and his scheming assistant physically attack and frame her. Marco swiftly retaliates, uncovering their official corruption and bringing them to complete public and legal ruin. As her tormentors crumble, Brigid discovers Marco's devotion stems from a deep, shared past.
6aa8a5d7f08dff1bf80a3bda.title: Tenth Wedding, New Groom

6aa8a632ced94a7b9009c98c.synopsis: Five years ago, Luna, a girl from the slums, was forced by Alan, her wealthy mother-in-law, to jump off a building. She later gave birth to their son Neo alone. Five years on, Neo was diagnosed with leukemia and urgently needed a bone marrow transplant. Luna crossed paths again with Ken, her former boyfriend, who had become a chief orthopedic surgeon. To protect her son, Luna concealed the truth about their relationship and signed an agreement with Ken. However, trapped in a series of plots hatched by Alan and Tina, Ken’s fiancée, she suffered a miscarriage and fled to France. After uncovering the whole truth, Ken had his mother committed to a psychiatric hospital and sent Tina to prison. Eventually, he tracked down Luna, and the family of three was reunited.
6aa8a632ced94a7b9009c98c.title: Bound by Secrets: Her Billionaire Doctor

6aa8da2fbf58aac6cb0b70cd.synopsis: Ethan once had the life everyone dreamed of. After being adopted by a poor couple, he rose from humble beginnings through his own hard work and became a legend admired by many. While his most trusted brother, Cole, was adopted into a wealthy family,but still failed to achieve the success he desired. Cole was consumed by jealousy, believing that Ethan had taken everything that was meant to be his. Their bitter rivalry eventually led them both to a tragic end. As Ethan loses consciousness in the freezing river, fate gives the two brothers a second chance. They wake up and find themselves back on the day they were adopted. This time, Ethan is determined not to repeat the mistakes of the past or allow himself to be controlled by his brother again. Cole, meanwhile, is determined to reclaim what he believes was always his. Given the chance to rewrite their destinies, the two brothers set out on completely different paths. But the past they share, the grudges left unresolved, and the battle for the family legacy force them to stand at another crossroads of fate. With the same life beginning again, what choices will they make? And this time, who will truly control their own future? A battle over wealth, glory, and the choices that define a life has only just begins...
6aa8da2fbf58aac6cb0b70cd.title: My Brother Thought He Won

6aa8dad9632d51a1f901d837.synopsis: Elara thought the worst thing that could happen was getting pregnant by a dangerous stranger. She was wrong. Because the man hunting her down is Silas Thorne, New York's most feared mafia don. And he isn't just the father of her baby. He's her boyfriend's father. Now Silas wants her under his roof, his son wants her back, and the Thorne family is one secret away from tearing itself apart. Elara only made one mistake that night. But in this family, one mistake can start a war.
6aa8dad9632d51a1f901d837.title: Pregnant by My Ex's Father

6aa8dd440365004aed09970e.synopsis: Serena marries the mafia boss Dante Santoro. Their marriage begins purely out of interests, with no love involved. After Serena discovers she is pregnant with quadruplets, she suddenly receives a divorce text offering one hundred million on condition that she signs papers and leaves Dante. Instead of breaking down or weeping, she calmly signs the documents and vanishes overnight. When Dante returns, he finds out the divorce message and papers are all forged by his childhood friend Vivienne. He realizes he has long been in love with Serena. He makes a public sincere apology and spares no effort to win her back. Serena refuses to forgive him easily...
6aa8dd440365004aed09970e.title: Quads, Mafia Divorce ——I Took the Money and Ran

6aa8ff9f5f86a8b72f04e0e5.synopsis: At her wedding, Hailey's husband Ryan humiliates her with a cruel prank alongside his childhood friend Hadley. Ryan always prioritized Hadley, even publicly denying his relationship with Hailey. After fifteen years of sacrifice and betrayal, Hailey leaves for Europe. Ryan finds her, showing self-inflicted scars, but she refuses him. She builds a successful career, files for divorce, and wins her freedom. Ryan is publicly exposed and ruined. Hailey thrives, finally living for herself.
6aa8ff9f5f86a8b72f04e0e5.title: Done in Fifteen Years

6aa902759f0e8f89050c71b9.synopsis: In her past life, Liriel, Princess of the Moon Elves, loved her betrothed, the paladin Kaelen. When the Abyss crisis struck, he abandoned her to save Elara. Liriel was mortally wounded, her golden hair withered. Reborn at the betrothal temple, she watched Elara claim the golden oath meant for Kaelen. Heartbroken, Liriel signed the black oath of Azriel, the cursed Goblin Lord. Elara burned her relics, framed her, and killed her spirit bird, Snow. Kaelen publicly flogged Liriel, and her father moved to strip her title. Near death, Liriel was saved by Azriel, whose thousand-year curse her moonlight power had long eased. They forged a protection pact. Cold to all, Azriel cherished only her. When the Elf coalition and Elara attacked, he sacrificed his demon core and bound their lives forever. Together they exposed Elara’s plots. Elara was disfigured; Kaelen was doomed to regret. Liriel rose as Queen of the Abyss, loved eternally by Azriel.
6aa902759f0e8f89050c71b9.title: Bride of the Goblin Lord

6aa92d318ac4232b930dfeb7.synopsis: Six-winged Archangel Seraphina spent a thousand loveless years married to Heavenly Commander Michael, who loved her sister, Lyra. When Lyra died and Lucifer waged war on Heaven, Michael died begging Seraphina to let him go in the next life. Heartbroken, she burned her divine power to rewind time. Reborn at the altar, she severed all ties, took Lyra’s place in an ancient pact to marry Lucifer, and gave Michael his freedom. Michael, unaware, wounded her with cruel accusations. After Lyra’s deceit, Seraphina quietly left. On his wedding day, Michael lifted the veil expecting his “true love”—and found Lyra. Realizing Seraphina had sacrificed herself for him, he raced to the Demon Abyss in regret. There, Lucifer proved no monster, but a refined protector. He used his last drop of Angelic Grace to heal her and defended her against his own dark legion. They fell deeply in love, and he abandoned his vengeance for her. When Michael invaded the Abyss to “rescue” her, Seraphina coldly rejected him. In the end, she burned her divinity again to save Lucifer, purifying his dark core. Together they found redemption beyond Light and Darkness.
6aa92d318ac4232b930dfeb7.title: Bound to the Fallen: A Seraph's Rebirth

6aa935882bbb80a92d0a6aaa.synopsis: A mad prophecy circulates in the divine realm: whoever can conceive the "God-Child of Destiny" will overthrow Zeus and become King of All Gods. In her past life, Elara married Eros, the God of Love and symbol of romance, only to have her "soul fire" sucked by him day and night, eventually dying a miserable death of exhaustion after giving birth. Reborn at the ceremony where the gods choose their wives, her sister Cassia the coveted golden arrow of the God of Love, while Elara proactively grasped the black scythe symbolizing death and barrenness, choosing Thanatos, the God of Death whom all gods fear most. Everyone waited to see her fall into hell, but they never expected—the romance of the God of Love is devouring, while the death the God of Death is salvation. When her sister falls into the dark arts of necrophagy to give birth to a divine child, Elara is reborn under nourishment of the God of Death, who spares no cost to his own divine lifespan, and conceives an heir truly capable of severing the laws of fate. time, she will not only rewrite her own destiny but also force the entire divine realm to change its master.
6aa935882bbb80a92d0a6aaa.title: The Reaper's Fated Bride

6aa9f30660d949781b0ef205.synopsis: TZyrthos, the king of the dragon clan, is mortally cursed. Only by drinking the milk of the human woman Vera can he live. Vera broke into the Dragon Nest to apply for a nanny in order to save her young son, but she didn't know that she was the antidode that the Dragon King was looking for - not tole that Toby, the sick son in her arms, was actually the bloodline left by the Dragon King in the foggy forest a year ago. He thirsted for her body like a bloodthirsty, and she ran away desperately, and fate had already written this immortal love into the curse of the keel and blood.
6aa9f30660d949781b0ef205.title: Feeding the Dragon's Desir

6aa9f3cd0cf84de170032bc9.synopsis: Grayson, hidden ruler of the Five Nation Syndicate, poses as a gardener. His wife Vanessa leaves him for being poor and falls for Ivan — his most dangerous subordinate plotting to seize the vault. Grayson infiltrates his own summit, proving his identity through golden keys and escalating confrontations. Outgunned, he flees with waitress Sarah and discovers she, not Vanessa, once saved his life. He turns Ivan's heist into a trap, ambushes the traitors in the vault, and crowns Sarah as queen.
6aa9f3cd0cf84de170032bc9.title: Five Keys, One Hidden King

6aa9f4450efc92eabb076257.synopsis: Kit vanishes at age seven in a robot attack, raised by kidnapper Voltage as "Ash." Later, Ash infiltrates his family's tryouts, framed by brother Spark, Voltage's son. His birthmark nearly surfaces, Aura's intuition circles, and their father doubts him, until Spark burns the mark away. When Voltage publicly claims Ash, the family erupts into war. Ash proves his bloodline and helps them escape. He regains his memory at the crater, reclaims the name Kit Unbreakable, Spark's betrayal unresolved.
6aa9f4450efc92eabb076257.title: The Unbreakables: Super Son Returns

6aa9f4fe836e550fa6010f87.synopsis: Orphan Eileen saved Hatton Academy's headmaster and was adopted, growing up with three Alpha childhood sweethearts. Chloe framed her with forged notes; the three men refused to believe her, torturing her with hockey pucks, dragging her behind a horse, and hanging her from a flagpole. Her heart died, and she chose Bruno, a fallen Alpha. When the truth came out, the three regretted deeply and gave up their Alpha blood to save her—but she never looked back, bonding with Bruno and marrying him.
6aa9f4fe836e550fa6010f87.title: After My Three Alpha Childhood Sweethearts Abandoned Me, They Regretted It

6aaa008f38bdf5f65a0af22b.synopsis: Amelia lived in a novel world. Her human mother had transmigrated here, completed a system-assigned mission to conquer four beastmen (a phoenix, a rabbit, a wolf, and a snake), and given birth to her. After her mother returned to the real world, Amelia was raised and fiercely spoiled by her four fathers Later, they brought home another girl named Brielle, who constantly framed Amelia for abusing her. Blinded by the lies, the Dads locked Amelia up and tortured her, which tragically went too far and killed her. After her death, her mother contacted her through the system and brought her soul back to the real world. Eventually, Brielle’s lies were exposed and she was beaten to death by the furious four dads. The quartet were subsequently stripped of everything and sentenced to life imprisonment. Meanwhile, Amelia lived a peaceful and happy life with her mother in the real world.
6aaa008f38bdf5f65a0af22b.title: My Four Beast Daddies' Regret

6aaa0f8e6b8e83505f0b9260.synopsis: Once a legendary finance mogul, Eli Stone walked away from the industry years ago to live under the radar. After adopting his son, Caleb Stone, Eli settles into a laid-back life as a security guard. But his peaceful days are turned upside down when he unexpectedly rescues Reed Hayes. Forced into a fake relationship, the two soon find real feelings blossoming between them, and Eli's long-dormant heart finally begins to beat again.
6aaa0f8e6b8e83505f0b9260.title: Your Boss Becomes Your Stepmom

6aaa1042abae29938e04b14e.synopsis: The Samie House is holding a wedding. Felix Flora is marrying into the Samie family as a live-in son-in-law. Right as the wedding ceremony begins, a beggar couple suddenly appears at the gate, claiming to be Felix's parents. But what he doesn't know is that these beggars are actually the Emperor and Empress. They disguised themselves to test Felix and their daughter-in-law. Yet, things took a sharp turn...
6aaa1042abae29938e04b14e.title: That Great Emperor Is My Dad?!

6aaa11db6f352adbdf0772d6.synopsis: Lainey is humiliated by her fiancé Leo at City Hall, who marries pregnant Rosalie for power. She flees to New York, marries Don Falcone Marcus, and becomes his cherished wife and mother of their son. Five years later, back in Chicago, Leo and Rosalie mock her, steal her bracelet, and slap her. At Marcus’s gala, they attack her again. Their son Gable cries out for Mommy—exposing Lainey’s identity. Marcus arrives, enraged. Rosalie stabs Lainey, then dies. Leo is captured. Lainey discovers Marcus secretly loved her for years. They reconcile deeply.
6aaa11db6f352adbdf0772d6.title: The Don's Fatal Tenderness

6aaa3dd87b1c44ab070000bc.synopsis: Noble heiress Luna lost her memory after falling off a cliff, completely forgetting Evan, the heir to the empire’s overlord, whom she had humbly pursued for five years. After awakening, she cut off all affection, agreed to a family-arranged marriage, and coldly struck back at the provocations from Evan and the two-faced “white moonlight” woman. After a drowning incident in which Evan left her to die, Luna made a dignified farewell to the past at a banquet. Meanwhile, Evan, long accustomed to being favored, gradually lost control amid Luna’s coldness and headed toward an irredeemable wife-chasing crematorium.
6aaa3dd87b1c44ab070000bc.title: I moved on, and he fell apart

6aaa3ef79254462ce808d599.synopsis: On the night of a full moon, the Werewolf King Cain loses control and has a sexual encounter with a human girl named Jenny; she subsequently leaves, unaware that she is carrying the Wolf King's heir. She struggles to protect her pregnancy while enduring abuse from her cold-hearted father, cruel stepmother, and greedy younger brother, eventually giving birth prematurely to a half-breed son, Sammy. To cover exorbitant medical bills, she works odd jobs by day and sells alcohol in nightclubs by night, suffering endless humiliation. Amidst this desperate situation, she reunites with the child's father, Cain. Together, they mature through power struggles and family conspiracies, safeguarding a love that transcends the boundaries between their species.
6aaa3ef79254462ce808d599.title: Marked by the Wolf King, I Return With My Fierce Cub

6aaa3f867b1c44ab070000c0.synopsis: Real estate mogul James destroyed his own daughter Sophia’s life to please Charlotte and her daughter. Only after losing his company and dying beside Sophia in a fire did he finally see the woman he loved for who she truly was. But when James opens his eyes again, he finds himself back on the night that changed everything—Charlotte’s daughter’s dog is trapped on one side, while his own daughter is crying for help inside the burning mansion. Who will he choose this time? And what happens when the man Charlotte once controlled finally decides to fight back?
6aaa3f867b1c44ab070000c0.title: A Father's Redemption

6aaa412a5ffd78135c023c4e.synopsis: On the eve of her wedding, Alicia, the Saintess of Order, is secretly drugged by her elder sister Lina and catches her fiancé, the Sun God Apollo, in an affair with Lina. The two turn the accusation against Alicia, framing her for an illicit relationship with a guard. Humiliated before the gods, Alicia has her engagement annulled and her divinity stripped away before being cast into the Abyss as a sacrifice. At the brink of death, the dormant royal blood of Lilith awakens within her, transforming her into a succubus. She falls into a cavern where Lucifer, the Demon King, has been sealed for a thousand years. Through an unexpected twist of fate, Alicia forms a soul-seal bond with him and breaks his ancient imprisonment. When Alicia awakens, she is no longer the obedient and innocent saintess others once controlled, but a reborn queen empowered by seductive royal blood and a burning desire for revenge. She strikes a bargain with Lucifer and follows him to the Demon Palace, where she is scorned and challenged by its maids and the elders of the Abyss. Faced with humiliation and attack, Alicia reveals the ancestral mark of Lilith’s royal blood. Its overwhelming power forces the nobles of the Abyss to kneel before her. From that moment on, Alicia joins forces with Lucifer to wage war against the Divine Court, expose the hypocrisy of Lina and Apollo, and make everyone who betrayed her pay the ultimate price.
6aaa412a5ffd78135c023c4e.title: Married to the Demon King, the Sun God Begs for My Return

6aaa457647b731f35c0cb459.synopsis: Twenty years ago, Victoria Stone murdered her fiancé Charles in a candlelit bedroom, stole the golden heir ring, and seized control of the Stone empire as his ruthless "widow." For two decades, she has ruled with beauty, cunning, and a razor-sharp PR machine, treating her three daughters as pawns and turning every scandal into ratings gold for the family's reality TV show.
6aaa457647b731f35c0cb459.title: The Heir Game

6aaa467ef1bb6a94f302578d.synopsis: Harper has been in a secret romantic relationship with Alpha Connor for five long years. She waits patiently, hoping her lover will make their bond public and stand with her under the Moon Goddess for a sacred wolf‑clan moon‑vow ceremony. Instead, she discovers Connor is about to hold this very ritual with Maddie — her best friend of more than ten years. Connor claims registering as Maddie's official mate and going through the vow ceremony is only a practical measure. Maddie's father is critically ill and requires the spousal‑level pack medical benefits to afford his treatment. He begs Harper for understanding, yet he comfortably plays the perfect fiancé in Maddie's household. All those times he turned down Harper's invitations to go home for holidays under the excuse of work, he was actually staying by Maddie's side. To make the farce complete, Connor and Maddie pressure Harper into working as Maddie's maid of honor. They weaponize small‑town gossip and community reputation, forcing her to swallow five years of devotion and heartbreak for the sake of their dignified ceremony. On the day of the moon‑vow, Harrison, Connor's fierce business rival from the Blackstone Pack, crashes the event and exposes Connor's hypocrisy. To shield her family from vicious local rumors, Harper makes a desperate public lie: she announces Harrison is her boyfriend. Harrison quickly plays along and slips into the fake‑boyfriend role. Plunged into regret after losing Harper, Connor spirals into obsessive pursuit, desperate to annul his mate record with Maddie and win her back. Maddie, in turn, pours out years of pent‑up jealousy, confessing how she has always resented living in Harper's shadow. With her five‑year secret romance shattered beyond repair, Harper turns her back on her self‑delusional ex‑lover and her treacherous best friend. She refuses to compromise for a broken relationship, reclaims her self‑respect, and steps forward toward a new life.
6aaa467ef1bb6a94f302578d.title: Five Years of Secret Love, He Married My Best Friend

6aaa57320abf12301005e94e.synopsis: Typhon attacks Olympus and is sealed beneath Mount Etna, but the seal weakens every 600 years. As the Age of Gods ends, Hades lacks power to reinforce it. The Prophecy Stone reveals that a divine heir—born of Hades and a mortal woman with witch blood and different-colored eyes—can permanently strengthen the seal. In the mortal world, Saintess Layra is blamed for volcanic disasters and nearly burned alive. Hades saves her, taking her to the Underworld. The Prophecy Stone has chosen her as his bride: she must bear his child or die. Bound by the Serpent Soul Pact, Layra resists at first, but Hades’ care and protection win her over. They consummate their marriage. Jealous Minthe, who loves Hades, torments Layra. Nyx, the Goddess of Night, imprisons her and claims Layra carries a God-Devouring Curse. Heartbroken and misled, Layra tries to escape through the Well of Reincarnation, but Hades saves her, confessing his love. They grow deeply in love, and Layra becomes pregnant. Hades weakens, avoiding her. Then Alector, the high priest who raised her, lures Layra back to the mortal world and captures her—he has discovered her witch blood and has his own plans.
6aaa57320abf12301005e94e.title: The Nether King's Bride

6aaa596c0424e9843907daea.synopsis: Actress Lily had a one‑night stand with CEO Liam five years ago and returned home raising their son Leo alone. Leo accidentally recognizes his biological father, and a DNA test confirms their blood ties. The two sign a contract for a secret marriage. As Lily struggles in show business, she faces rumors and rivals’ harassment. She also deals with the pursuit of movie star Mason and hostility from actress Lucy. Quietly resolving troubles for her, Liam gradually falls for her and chases her heart. With the clever little son playing matchmaker, this fake couple slowly develops genuine feelings for each other.
6aaa596c0424e9843907daea.title: Run, Mommy! Daddy Is Coming!

6aaa5ca0d8704222850a577a.synopsis: Twenty-three years ago, EVELYNN, wife of the HARTMAN pharmaceutical tycoon, swapped her biological daughter LAYLA with an orphan DANIEL at her mother’s instigation to secure her position in the wealthy family. Twenty-three years later, LAYLA works as a bartender in a bar, while DANIEL has risen to the post of R&D President of the group. The two meet and fall in love amid misunderstandings, only to face fierce sabotage from the fake heiress THYRA. As the truth of the baby swap unfolds layer by layer, blood ties and hatred intertwine. After losing her child and her adoptive mother to illness, LAYLA eventually reconciles with her birth mother EVELYNN. Together with DANIEL, she exposes the HEER family’s plot to seize control of the enterprise.
6aaa5ca0d8704222850a577a.title: The Forgotten Blood Heir

6aaa72b1239fb7032b010b89.synopsis: After canceling the condo she decorated alone, Maya leaves her fiancé Ryan—who spent five winters in Japan with his first love Hannah, gifting her custom jewelry while bringing Maya only fridge magnets. She moves to a new city, starts over, and ignores his belated apologies and list of 47 broken promises. He signs the dissolution agreement and sends back her belongings, along with one last magnet he chose himself. Maya keeps the magnet, buys her favorite flowers, and closes her eyes—no longer waiting.
6aaa72b1239fb7032b010b89.title: Five Winters With Her, Five Fridge Magnets for Me

6aaa72c037997939fc0f6788.synopsis: Sloane, Westbridge University’s adored It Girl, wakes in the 220-pound body of Riley, the classmate who stole her face, wealthy family, and fiancé through a permanent soul swap. Riley expects Sloane to become the school’s favorite joke. Instead, Sloane discovers that Riley’s body is healthy and complete, while her own “perfect” body was starved, cut open, and mutilated to make her marriageable. Two months later, classmates rig a livestreamed ceremony to humiliate her. As hundreds laugh and wait for the 220-pound girl to appear, the doors swing open. Sloane enters in a red dress, and the entire auditorium falls silent.
6aaa72c037997939fc0f6788.title: From Plus-Size Girl to Campus Queen

6aaa73d81c3de108910ef9a3.synopsis: For five years, Serena built Adrian's empire, only to be branded a traitor when he protected his childhood sweetheart. Exiled, hunted, and presumed powerless, she vanishes for three years. Then she appears at a Blackwood underground auction, puts a gun to her rival's head, and claims the castle as her territory. Everyone expects her execution. Instead, the feared Vincent Blackwood steps forward and names Serena as his wife. She did not return for Adrian. She returned with evidence, an army, and a trap for everyone who destroyed her.
6aaa73d81c3de108910ef9a3.title: The Don's Abandoned Ex-Wife Strikes Back

6aaba53318dcc44dbd00634f.synopsis: Six-year-old orphan Ivy has a secret: she can see the color of people’s souls. Red means good. Pitch black means evil. When two couples visit the orphanage, her best friend Ashley ignores Ivy's warnings and insists on being adopted by the wealthy family. Ivy instead chooses a poor couple who seem stern but possess kind hearts. Just as Ivy settles into a simple and happy life, a jealous Ashley suddenly shows up, demanding they swap families...
6aaba53318dcc44dbd00634f.title: After Seeing Their Soul Colors, I Gladly Chose the Poor Family

6aabaeceb29a9b4590020ef1.synopsis: After his girlfriend sells him out to a death game, James unlocks a system that turns every coin spent on female monsters into ten thousand—and with it, he conquers monstrous bosses, crushes the elite, and seizes total dominion over the end of the world.
6aabaeceb29a9b4590020ef1.title: Spend on Her, Get 10,000X Back in the Apocalypse

6aabb1e4b185f80695072f0d.synopsis: On her wedding day, kindergarten teacher Emma was sold by her fiancé Kyle, who was tangled in gambling debts, to the border group leader Santiago. She was forced to sign a one-year contract marriage and also became the nanny for his niece Sofia, who had developed aphasia after losing her family. While adapting to the dangerous world of the group, Emma helps heal the girl, and they gradually develop genuine feelings amidst numerous crises. Facing attacks from rival Valentina, ambitious brother Nacho, and deadly enemy Emilio, Emma sheds her frailty, learns to use a gun for self-protection, and together with Santiago, crushes their enemies' schemes, breaks the contract's chains, finds true love, and builds a complete family
6aabb1e4b185f80695072f0d.title: The Cartel’s Contract Bride

6aabb8c90f0428a0f00f0531.synopsis: Cast out by the angels as worthless — no virtue, no power, no mother — Bastian is thrown into the Void to die. But the pendant his demon queen mother left him just awakened. Down in the abyss, the Seven Deadly Sins have waited fifteen years for their lost prince. The angels should have killed him when they had the chance. He's coming home — and he's bringing all seven Sins with him.
6aabb8c90f0428a0f00f0531.title: Seven Sins! I claimed them all!

6aabc45f8f37c9b52c024b26.synopsis: William publicly rejects Lora for her younger sister Selena, who bore a dragon egg in their previous life. Both reborn, William blames Lora for failing to produce a pureblood dragon heir. His older brother Asher saves and cherishes her. Together, they fight royal schemes—while she carries Asher’s pureblood dragon heir.
6aabc45f8f37c9b52c024b26.title: Eight Heirs for the Dragon King

6aabc4d597552fb960017530.synopsis: Nine-tailed heiress Aurora gives everything to help her black fox fiancé gain human form. He repays her by killing her and stealing her power for her scheming sister. Reborn at the mate selection ceremony, Aurora gives the black fox to Brielle and chooses Cassian, the feared four-tailed white fox prince. But her enemies still want her birthright, and the elders are ready to sacrifice her. This time, Aurora sets the trap first. As Cassian crushes anyone who touches her, she discovers her ruthless new mate may know exactly how she died.
6aabc4d597552fb960017530.title: In This Life, the White Fox Prince Slays for Me

6aabe2c2ddeda4f8620cf697.synopsis: Secret heiress Ariana is the angelic voice behind her best friend's fame. When that bestie steals her boyfriend too, Ariana's childhood friend—the school heartthrob and MVP —comes back.
6aabe2c2ddeda4f8620cf697.title: Prep School Pop Star!

6aac622e968c52e4da007355.synopsis: Bound By Hatred is based on Cora Reilly’s third book in the Born In Blood Mafia Chronicles. Gianna is the Scuderi family’s little princess, but all she has ever wanted is freedom. She wants freedom from her father’s demand that she marry into the Famiglia, but she also wants to escape the bloodshed and everything her sister has been forced to endure. Gianna has already seen what kind of monsters these men can be. Her family has other plans. They force Gianna into marriage with Matteo Vitiello, a ruthless killer who wants her all to himself. Known throughout the Famiglia as the God of Blades, Matteo is also the younger brother of the man who robbed Gianna’s sister of her virginity. While Gianna remains powerless to help Aria, Luca Vitiello seems ready to claim her older sister completely. No matter how many times Gianna says no, Matteo always finds a reason to pull her back to him. In their world, they are born in blood, sworn in blood, and bound by hatred. Matteo becomes Gianna’s dangerous prison—and the one temptation she can never fully escape. He is ready to burn the world for her, but when will Gianna finally feel the same way? Characters Gianna Scuderi Gianna Scuderi is the main female character of Bound By Hatred. As Aria’s younger sister, she refuses to repeat the fate her sister suffered at the hands of the Famiglia. More than anything, Gianna wants control over her own life. Matteo Vitiello Matteo Vitiello is the main male character and Luca’s playful younger brother. His deadly skill with a blade has earned him the name God of Blades. Matteo sees Gianna as different from every other woman and refuses to let her go. Luca Vitiello Luca Vitiello is Matteo’s older brother and Aria’s new husband. He softens around Aria and Matteo, but he remains fiercely protective and ruthless. His treatment of Aria also shapes Gianna’s hatred of the Famiglia. Aria Vitiello Aria Vitiello is Gianna’s older sister and Luca’s wife. She loves Gianna despite having married into the Vitiello family. Everything Aria endures strengthens Gianna’s determination to escape the same fate.
6aac622e968c52e4da007355.title: Bound by Hatred

6aac64819e2d618b790f0dd8.synopsis: The Story of Dream On: Hollywood's biggest star, Lexington Hall, quit his acting career, desperate for a normal life, and moved to Maple Creek in the Dream On movie. After an accident and an unexpected deal to play a lead role in a school play, he ended up in farm girl & theatre nerd—Stevie's world. Their attraction was inevitable as sparks flew. The ordinary country girl began chasing her acting dreams with the biggest star in her arms as they fell deeply in love. However, their budding romance was ruined when Veronica Hall, Lexinghton's hellish mother and agent, returned as the Dream On movie plot escalated. She wanted Lexington to return to LA and threatened to take him to court & destroy not just his but also Stevie's life, her dreams, and her home. Refusing to let his mother ruin Stevie's life, he broke her heart and abandoned her. But when Lexington Hall returns with an enticing fake-dating offer, Stevie is forced to risk her heart all over again, as their pretend romance only reignites their old love. Will there be a second chance, or would Hollywood destroy their one true love? Characters: Stevie St. James Stevie St. James is the central character of the Dream On movie. She was a country girl who fell in love with the Hollywood star, Lexington Hall, and got her heart broken. Lexington Hall Lexington Hall is Stevie's love interest in Dream On. He was Hollywood's hottest and most popular movie star. Quitting acting, he moved to Maple Creek and fell in love with Stevie only to break her heart when Hollywood pulled him back. Veronica Hall Veronica Hall is the antagonist of Dream On. She was Lexington's ambitious mother and agent who used her son as a ticket to fame and luxury. As the story escalated, she became the force behind Lexington and Stevie's heartbreak. 6aac64819e2d618b790f0dd8.title: Dream On

6aac6e6d5230d8d6ca013277.synopsis: Best friends, Ella and Leah, marry into the HARPER family at the same time – Ella to the firefighter older brother, Charles, and Leah to the doctor younger brother, Noah. On the three-year anniversary of their marriage, Ella is locked inside a blazing room by Charles's first love, Megan. Ella calls Charles and begs for help, but he brushes her off, saying he's busy helping Megan find her cat. At the most crucial moment, Leah rushes in to save Ella. Leah calls Noah, begging him to come and save Ella and her baby. But she's met with mockery and criticism. Heartbroken and betrayed, the best friends, who have endured years of their horrible marriages, decide to file for divorce with the HARPER brothers together.
6aac6e6d5230d8d6ca013277.title: Homegirls Before Husbands

6aac7d902de1a403610dba15.synopsis: Sloane's the country club's "it" girl - money, beauty, talent - but her boyfriend is out to steal it all from the trusted shadows of her world. Sloane's father is arrested, leaving her homeless and penniless. But Mason Crane has seen this before, he sees the signs, recognizes the pattern, and he's not going to let it happen again. He swoops in and takes Sloane to a safe space where the two of them can start to put the pieces together and regain everything she's lost.
6aac7d902de1a403610dba15.title: Playing Games in Paradise

6aac82d6cb3883b74605b9b8.synopsis: Based on the novel by Rina Kent. Good-girl university student Cecily Knight has spent years pining after popular golden boy Landon King. But everything changes when she impulsively saves Jeremy Volkov: Brutal mafia heir, Landon's deadliest rival, and the one man who will stop at nothing to make Cecily his. As Landon's manipulation is slowly exposed and Jeremy's relentless pursuit awakens something dark in Cecily she never knew existed, she must choose between the boy she thought she wanted and the dangerous man she can't stop craving.
6aac82d6cb3883b74605b9b8.title: God of Wrath

6aac8371968c52e4da007358.synopsis: Nothing exciting ever happens to Ryan Collins, the average nerd next door. Until one day, her best friend (and popular football prodigy) breaks down her door hiding from his ex. One thing leads to another, and the two hook up that night. Unbenkownst to Carsen, who has to leave for NFL training the next day, Ryan's pregnant. She lets him leave without telling him--after all, she'd only ruin his life. He'll forget all about her, now that he's a famous athlete...right?
6aac8371968c52e4da007358.title: Worth the Chase

6aac8448a2dbec86c80e73d7.synopsis: Leo is devastated to find out his new roommate at reformatory school is his arch nemesis, Tyler. But when the highly inexperienced Leo falls for the Headmaster's daughter, Tyler offers to give him "sex lessons." The more Leo and Tyler lose themselves in these lessons, the harder it becomes the deny their feelings for each other. But getting caught doesn't just mean expulsion, it means prison. And Leo and Tyler can't decide if being together is worth the risk.
6aac8448a2dbec86c80e73d7.title: The School for Bad Boys: S*x Lessons

6aac85383511c0b6df0eec87.synopsis: Ivy endured years as a quiet, devoted wife, only to be brutally betrayed and thrown into a blizzard by her arrogant ex. With nowhere else to go, she flash-marries Aiden, the dangerous stranger she saved years ago. Passion ignites as Aiden ruthlessly shields her from her toxic ex and empowers her to finally stand on her own. When her ex regrets his mistake and comes crawling back, Ivy has already moved on—and her new husband? A lethal predator her ex can never even dream of touching...
6aac85383511c0b6df0eec87.title: Married the Mafia Don, Now My Ex Regrets Everything

6aac991ac8ded976b8005a5a.synopsis: I am Victoria Vanderbilt, sole heir to a trillion-dollar empire. After three years away, I returned to find my trash husband starving my son, keeping a mistress, and letting his bastard bully my boy in the stables. They thought we were weak. They thought they owned New York. So I unmasked my identity, crushed their fake empire, and ruined every single one of them. Nobody touches my family and lives to tell the tale.
6aac991ac8ded976b8005a5a.title: Don't Touch My Son：I Am The Heiress

6aac9a50a5aa71b036008ada.synopsis: Desmond Finley wakes up to find he's transmigrated into a romance novel as a playboy. Betrayed on his wedding night by his fiancée and cousin, he awakens the Playboy's Comeback System. Meanwhile, Elowen Hawth is reborn on the very day of the wedding. Realizing Desmond isn't the good-for-nothing rumors claim, she decides to swap places to marry him. With a system and a reborn bride, Desmond is ready to conquer this era.
6aac9a50a5aa71b036008ada.title: Transmigrated, I Married the Reborn Bride

6aac9d1fff613013bf0bc8ef.synopsis: Seraphina Hart, the hidden heiress of the Ashford family, spent five years as Damian Sterling’s secret lover. As their agreement ends, Damian prepares to marry Isabella. Crushed, Seraphina tries to leave—but faces Damian’s coldness and Isabella’s relentless torment. At her breaking point, she returns to her family and makes a stunning comeback as CEO of an Ashford-owned corporation, ready to reclaim everything.
6aac9d1fff613013bf0bc8ef.title: Beneath the Secretary

6aacd2ad5611e2928b0c5c98.synopsis: Meara's cruel stepmother and half sister marry her off to Damian, a poor, cursed Alpha and single father to his disabled daughter, Sierra. Wolfless and trapped in the mountains, Meara struggles to survive—especially with Violet, the pack woman determined to have Damian for herself. As Violet plots to destroy her, Meara fights to protect her new family and reclaim her wolf. But Damian isn't the weak, cursed Alpha everyone believes him to be... He is the Supreme Alpha, and her fated mate.
6aacd2ad5611e2928b0c5c98.title: Married Off To The Cursed Alpha Daddy

6aacd6048765c9ffb501803d.synopsis: On her wedding day, Sabine brother Leo spills red wine on her mother's heirloom wedding dress. Her fiancé Marco then pressures her to apologize to Ava. She publicly calls off the engagement, and leaves the Ricci household to study design under Nora, an old acquaintance of her late mother. After Sabine's departure, Leo and Marco finally realize how their years of favoring Ava have hurt her. Plagued by remorse, they set out to find her. Deprived of her sources of support, Ava spirals out of control. She flees to Nora's home and takes her hostage, luring Sabine to come alone. At the critical moment, Marco, Leo and the police officers arrive. Ava is shot dead, and Nora is rescued...
6aacd6048765c9ffb501803d.title: I let her have all. They live in regret

6aad007e45c728dd8c0b3bca.synopsis: Dustin Curran felt like a spare son. He was sent to his grandfather in the countryside right after his birth, while his parents raised his adopted brother by their side. When he returned home after his grandfather passed away, he was immediately cast into the Clearwind Sect, where he improved his cultivation. One day, his parents suddenly showed up and demended him to wed Linda Collins, who was terminally ill. But Dustin is no longer the spare son they dismissed. They begged him to leave the sect, only to regret it.
6aad007e45c728dd8c0b3bca.title: He's Not A Spare Son

6aad0081cdd42d3e700dcdfc.synopsis: Holding onto Ethan's marriage promise, Cynthia was his secret lover for five years. But when pregnant Kelly returned, he dumped her. Cynthia joined Reese Group, cutting ties. Ethan's late regret failed to win her back. While he and Kelly faced retribution, Cynthia found true love with Jerome.
6aad0081cdd42d3e700dcdfc.title: I Was His Secret. Now I’m His Regret.

6aad031874dc6a0a85073c6d.synopsis: Three years ago, she pushed her husband into the rain, making him hate her enough to survive. Three years later, she escapes into the Underground Blood City, only to find its ruler is him—the man she "killed" is now a vampire godfather. He traps her by his side, punishing her with hatred, binding her with a blood oath, until he discovers the truth: she never betrayed him. She left to save his life.
6aad031874dc6a0a85073c6d.title: At the Mercy of My Vampire Ex

6aad0b798f6a7e56ac09c191.synopsis: Tessa was supposed to be graduating college. Instead, she wakes up trapped inside Vampire Academy, a survival horror game where dying means never making it back to the real world. Her only advantage? A dating system that keeps ordering her straight into the arms of Nolan Grave, the deadliest vampire in the game. Kiss him. Bite him. Get into his bed. Every task keeps her alive. Every touch makes him hungrier. But when the other vampires come for her, Nolan is always the one who stops them. So what does he really want? To protect her? Or to make sure no one else gets a taste before he does?
6aad0b798f6a7e56ac09c191.title: Kiss the Vampire or Die

6aad0e71e01e8ab9e30dbdc4.synopsis: Caesar, the universe's strongest "Mechanical Man," honors a dying friend's wish by escorting Princess Shirley through deadly territory. Battling the Wild Grass Gang at every turn, he holds the line until reinforcements arrive—keeping his promise, and keeping the people he cares for safe.
6aad0e71e01e8ab9e30dbdc4.title: Space Cowboy's Royal Escort

6aad112d89bf7cfe830389ca.synopsis: Sonny, heir to a lineage of vampire hunters, accidentally awakens Victor—the Blood Lord imprisoned for 300 years—during a sacred sealing ritual on Holy Mountain. As family betrayal, past-life memories, and a conspiracy surrounding the "Holy Blood" unfold one by one, two men who were born to be mortal enemies fall in love again and join forces to overthrow a hunting order that has endured for three centuries.
6aad112d89bf7cfe830389ca.title: Bloodbound to You

6aae902a8b430d94100b20e5.synopsis: On her wedding day, Nova is publicly abandoned when her fiancé, Cole, recognizes Elara as his fated mate. Meanwhile, Alpha King Ronan is also left at the altar by Elara. The next day, Ronan arrives at Nova’s door with 108 chests of betrothal gifts and asks her to marry him. United by betrayal, Nova accepts his proposal and begins a new life as the Luna of the Draven royal family. As Cole desperately tries to win her back and Elara repeatedly schemes against her, Nova gradually discovers that Ronan did not choose her on impulse—he has secretly loved her for twenty years.
6aae902a8b430d94100b20e5.title: Rejected Luna is His Fated Mate

6aaf3a9dbe776ffafc04f5e7.synopsis: Saria, an abused village girl, is seized by Dragon King Alarik, whose touch triggers an unprecedented Mark binding them as mates. Alarik hides their bond behind a slave collar. Amid Xander's suspicion and Celeste's schemes, Saria survives a slave hunt and discovers she can bend dragon fire. Alarik reveals his death curse: one month to live. Xander exposes the Mark and attacks; Saria channels blue fire to destroy him. Their first kiss seals the bond, but Celeste offers silence at an unnamed cost.
6aaf3a9dbe776ffafc04f5e7.title: The Dragon King's Slave Mate

6aaf3aa4bdadc9280a004fa7.synopsis: Scholarship student Abbi is bullied by Felix at Camden Prep, yet poverty forces her into his home as live-in nanny. Hatred turns to desire: Felix confesses cruelty masked attraction; Abbi sees his protective side. But his abusive father Scott forbids romance on pain of dismissal. Braving blackmail, viral humiliation, and a rival's sabotage, they love in secret. Felix uses years of recorded abuse evidence to banish Scott, freeing them both. Abbi earns Oxford and Head Girl, enemies become lovers.
6aaf3aa4bdadc9280a004fa7.title: Nanny to the Boy Who Hates Me

6aaf40ddadec8186070b64eb.synopsis: Crown Princess Astrid is poisoned by her fiancé Erik and her closest confidant Silas on the eve of her coronation. Her soul bargains with the Norns, trading her human warmth for black magic and a second chance. Resurrected in the frozen north, she allies with Ragnar—the late king's illegitimate son and a savage warlord. She supplies strategy and sorcery; he supplies muscle and army. Disguised as a priestess, Astrid infiltrates the capital, using mind-reading and desire magic to drive Erik to public madness, turn Silas against himself, and make the love-obsessed Linnea raise the Mirror of Truth before the kingdom. Every spell drains her life and triggers an ice curse; only Ragnar's searing body heat can pull her back, forcing intimacy that ignites a taboo love. At the coronation, the Mirror exposes Erik and Silas's treason and murder. In the final battle, Astrid freezes herself to shatter the royal array. Ragnar cuts open his chest, pouring burning blood over her to melt the curse. They are crowned together, founding a dark empire of vengeance, fire, and an unbreakable bond.
6aaf40ddadec8186070b64eb.title: The Revenant’s Vow: Shattered Crown

6aaf466ac9a67ebbca0ba786.synopsis: Sylvia, heir to the Slin Group in Los Angeles, was abandoned by her three adopted brothers on her eighteenth coming-of-age ceremony, all because of lies spun by Mia, the housekeeper’s daughter. Overwhelmed by despair, she chanced upon Silas, a mysterious tycoon, in a bar and married him on impulse. Faced with betrayal from her adoptive brothers and Mia’s relentless schemes, Sylvia grows from a dependent girl into an independent woman. Protected by her husband Silas, she reclaims control of the group, makes the wrongdoers pay for their crimes, and ultimately gains a thriving career, true love, and reconciled family bonds.
6aaf466ac9a67ebbca0ba786.title: Jilted at the Altar, I Flash-Married a Mysterious Billionaire

6aaf4731567556b68702a229.synopsis: A broke single mother, Emma, sells her breast milk to Locke, the werewolf football captain, for one million dollars. He drinks it before games to suppress his berserk wolf bloodline. As their transaction deepens, Locke protects her from her abusive ex and jealous rivals. Emma moves into his estate, where nightly feedings blur the line between deal and desire. Locke tears up the contract, giving her freedom—but she chooses to stay. They become a family, bound not by money, but by love.
6aaf4731567556b68702a229.title: The football captain insists on drinking my breast milk

6aaf478c87526e1dea08542e.synopsis: Lena, who possesses extraordinary innate strength, saved Ryan, a framed heir to a financial conglomerate, five years ago. She left after unexpectedly giving birth to a pair of boy-and-girl twins. Five years later, to fend off forced marriage and the inheritance crisis from their families, the two enter into a contract marriage. Ryan has no idea that Lena is the savior he has been searching for for five years, nor that the twins are his biological children. They join forces to fight William, Ryan’s scheming uncle who covets the family fortune. With superior intelligence and unusual strength, the twins repeatedly help them out of dangers. After many twists and turns, the whole family is finally reunited.
6aaf478c87526e1dea08542e.title: My Twins Picked a Billionaire Dad

6aaf5144865374f888020127.synopsis: Four years ago, Elena was a 200-pound Omega girl who secretly loved Victor, the most admired Alpha at their werewolf academy. On graduation night, one room card and a cruel misunderstanding turned her first love into her deepest humiliation. She disappeared, changed her name to Lena, lost the weight, and raised their son alone. Now she's back as a team doctor for Victor's hockey team. He doesn't recognize her at first—but he can't stop watching her. Then her three-year-old son calls him “Dad.” As old bullies expose her past and the internet turns against her, Victor finally learns the truth: the woman he lost four years ago has been beside him all along.
6aaf5144865374f888020127.title: Slimmed Down, My Wolf Crush Recognized Me

6aaf52d36f4b58546800f727.synopsis: Brady, the legendary sharpshooter known as the King of Guns, broke the world record for longest confirmed kill then vanished from the public eye. He hid his identity, working as maintenance at a shooting range. He endures humiliation from the dismissive shooting club captain who's unaware of his true identity. The shooting range is facing a hostile takeover. In order to protect Denise, the owner, and her daughter Sophia, Brady steps up and shows his legendary shooting skills, drawing attention to his mysterious identity...
6aaf52d36f4b58546800f727.title: King of Guns

6aaf575be7862770da05312a.synopsis: One morning, Zoe wakes up with a strange new power: when she narrows her eyes, she can see the hidden stats of anything — objects, prices, and even people's secrets. Her best friend Tiffany's dazzling new boyfriend? The words above his head read: "A married man with $1 million in debt." Her own boyfriend Daniel, the sweet guy she's been splitting discount groceries with for three years? "Heir to a $150 million fortune." The catch: Daniel has no idea either. The treasure has been hiding in his late grandmother's locked room all along — antique desks, oil paintings, and gold bars buried under the floorboards. As Zoe and Daniel's life transforms overnight, Tiffany spirals from heartbreak to jealousy to sabotage, determined to take everything Zoe has — including Daniel. Turns out the hardest thing to appraise was never the antiques. It was the people.
6aaf575be7862770da05312a.title: Hidden Values

6aaf6c6449315e6453090bd9.synopsis: Caterina thought a proposal to marry the Duke's son, Felton, would save her poor family. But the night before her debut ball, her bed is pillaged by Augustus, who brands her with his crest. Dishonored overnight, Caterina heads to her debut, hoping Felton will claim her love. But her world spirals when she realizes the man who's laid claim to her is the wicked Duke, and her fiancé's father.
6aaf6c6449315e6453090bd9.title: Marked by My Duke Daddy

6aaf76be9884ddb0cc07604a.synopsis: Death chooses Leo and gives him the power to see it coming — a red number hangs over anyone with three days or less to live, counting down what they have left. He brushes it off, until a stranger with a zero over his head is killed in the street right in front of him. Then he boards a flight and finds a zero over every passenger on board. This plane is going down. He fights to stop the takeoff and the other passengers throw him off; only Anna believes him and walks off with him. The plane crashes. He was right about all of it.
6aaf76be9884ddb0cc07604a.title: I See the Death Countdown

6aaf9bcc7bfb882718056152.synopsis: The Story of Divorced Claimed by the Mafia King: In Divorced Claimed by the Mafia King movie, Claire Hayes ended up penniless and homeless after divorce from her cheating and toxic husband Preston Hollis. Nowhere to go, she ended up at the Moretti mansion as Don Rafael Moretti's contract wife and his son Noah's stepmother in less than ten hours after her divorce. As Noah, the boy who refused to speak to anyone before, grew closer to Claire, the country's most powerful, Don Rafael Moretti began falling for Claire. But the story took a turn when Claire's ex, Preston, returned, determined to drag her back to the hellhole she escaped. Will Preston ruin Claire's second chance at a happily ever after? Or will Claire, now the Queen of Underworld, rise above her ex's schemes to make him pay the ultimate price? Characters: Claire Hayes Claire Hayes was the female lead of Divorced: Claimed by the Mafia King. She was a Harvard graduate who ended up in a hellhole when she married rich heir Preston Hollis. But once she escaped, divorcing the cheat, Claire ended up as the contract wife of Don Moretti, finding a second chance in love. Rafael Moretti Rafael Moretti was Claire Hayes’s Contract husband. He was the most feared and powerful Don in the country. He fell for Claire when she stepped up as his son Noah's mother. Preston Hollis Preston Hollis was the antagonist of Divorced: Claimed by the Mafia King. He was Claire's toxic ex who cheated and treated her like an unpaid maid. But when Claire ended up as Mrs. Moretti, he regretted it all and came crawling back. Noah Moretti Noah was the cutest son of Don Rafael Moretti. He was a silent boy who suffered from attachment issues. But when Claire became his stepmother, he quickly found comfort and accepted her as his mother. 6aaf9bcc7bfb882718056152.title: Divorced: Claimed by the Mafia King

6aafa66280208b713c0e08c9.synopsis: In The Husband She Took for Granted movie, a gifted scientist gave up his career to be a stay-at-home husband and dad for his baby, only to find out his wife had an abortion to save her business partner. He finally files for divorce, and returns to science. His wife who's taken him for granted now regrets it all.
6aafa66280208b713c0e08c9.title: The Husband She Took for Granted

6aafa7fc530d47585a054f74.synopsis: The Story of The Triplets' Final Regret: In The Triplets' Final Regret movie, for ten years, Elisa Carter, a half-human and half-vampire girl loved and cared for the Lockhart triplets. She even wanted to become a full human and marry one of them. But when they brutally abandoned her for the maid's daughter—Amber, Elisa's heart was shattered, and she was stripped of her dignity. Hence, as Elisa turned eighteen, she transferred to night school and became a full vampire. She also found love with the elite and powerful vampire lord Caine Trueblood, which ultimately led to the ruin of the Lockhart triplets. Now, as the triplets return, begging for forgiveness, will Elisa Carter give them a second chance, or will she build a new life with the vampire lord? Characters: Elisa Carter Elisa Carter is the female protagonist of The Triplets' Final Regret movie. She was an orphan, a half-human and half-vampire girl who was adopted by the elite Lockhart family. But when her protectors—the Lockhart triplets—turned into her tormentors and abandoned her, she became a full vampire and moved to night school. The Lockhart Triplets Jacob, Oliver, and Nash are the elite Lockhart triplets and the male leads of The Triplets' Final Regret movie. They promised to protect Elisa forever, but when they fell for Amber's lies, they deeply hurt Elisa and abandoned her only to regret it all in the end. Caine Trueblood Caine Trueblood is Elisa Carter's love interest. He was the powerful vampire lord who commanded the elite Cross Academy. When Elisa Carter was abandoned by the Lockhart triplets, he took her under his wing and became her ultimate protector. Amber Jackson Amber Jackson is the antagonist of The Triplets' Final Regret movie. She was a maid's daughter who stole Elisa Carter's status by lies and malicious tricks. 6aafa7fc530d47585a054f74.title: The Triplets' Final Regret

6aafa8f67f299dc17e02b3e7.synopsis: On the day of her birth, Princess Olivia of the Magic Empire was swapped by her ambitious aunt Sirena, who branded her with a dark magic seal to suppress her powers, leaving her a powerless "lowly bastard." For eight years, she was beaten and tortured by her false mother, bullied mercilessly by the false princess Julianna, and even forced to kneel and eat from a dog bowl at the royal banquet—while her real mother, the Queen, and her brother, the Crown Prince, remained unaware, though they were so close. On the eve of the Bloodstone Ceremony, which would decide the fate of the empire, Sirena cut open her chest to extract her pure blood. Dying, the 8-year-old girl, desperate to keep her promise to her brother that she "must come," broke her own fingers to free herself from chains, walked barefoot across molten rock, and pushed open the palace doors covered in blood. As she was dragged away, her collar tore, and her 11-year-old brother instantly recognized the Stardust mark on her chest—the truth was revealed. Her mother awakened in fury, and the divine pure blood returned in glory. The true heir reclaimed the throne, and the villains faced judgment.
6aafa8f67f299dc17e02b3e7.title: So close, yet so far the stolen princess

6aafa9872f378a0b720251f2.synopsis: In her past life, Iris, the true heir of the Pierce family, had her identity, designs, and fiancé stolen by Vivienne, the fake heiress. She was burned alive in a bridal workshop. Reborn on the day of Vivienne’s wedding, Iris refuses to be the bridesmaid. She steps onto the red carpet wearing her mother’s legacy gown and proclaims to the whole world: I am the real Pierce daughter.
6aafa9872f378a0b720251f2.title: Reborn Before the Impostor’s Wedding

6aafe6410426c658030ac987.synopsis: Disgraced tech heiress Aria publicly flirts with Victor, the city’s most powerful tycoon, at her own engagement party in a bid to reclaim her father’s AI technology and get revenge. She believes she is merely using his power, unaware that she is the very prey he has secretly pined for for eight years.When a mole’s scheme sparks a crisis of trust, Victor takes the fall to protect her. In the end, Aria uncovers the full truth, and the two join forces to take down their enemies, finally coming together in a true two-way rush of love.
6aafe6410426c658030ac987.title: I Married My Cheating Ex’s Uncle

6aafe6a0807f36ffca0c1225.synopsis: Elena, a wealthy merchant's daughter, spent her entire fortune to buy her husband Julian a baron title, only to endure his brutal abuse. To marry the Empire's Princess, Julian and his wicked mother conspire to frame Elena for adultery at the Holy Court and banish her to hard labor. To survive and seek revenge, Elena sets her sights on Julian's godfather—Duke Alistair, the most powerful man in the empire and Commander of the Knights Templar. Offering herself as the ultimate prize, she engages in a dangerous, taboo game of seduction with the cold-blooded Duke. Just as her mother-in-law drugs her and locks her in a room with a filthy beggar, with Julian and the Princess arriving to bust the door open and ruin her reputation, will the ruthless Godfather descend in time to save her...?
6aafe6a0807f36ffca0c1225.title: The Unchaste Charge:Plaything of My Husband's Godfather

6aaff98c9bcab205770fed07.synopsis: After three years on the front lines, Leon Bosch — a decorated war hero — finally returns home, only to walk into a nightmare. His fiancée Grace is seven months pregnant... with his own brother Jack's child. His family has carved up his property and savings, and he is even forced to serve as best man at their wedding. Refusing to stay silent, Leon exposes Jack's forged medical records at the ceremony, tearing off the family's mask of hypocrisy. But the real storm is just beginning — the truth emerges that Leon is no ordinary soldier. He is the War Master, an elite special-forces legend entrusted with a top national mission. At a military supply bidding banquet, Jack tries to climb to power with substandard weapons. Leon gambles with his own life, provoking Jack into firing a gun whose barrel explodes — exposing the defective-arms scandal on the spot. Jack's reputation crumbles as his crimes come to light. Just as Leon prepares to settle the final score with the family that betrayed him, Jack's hidden protector — Colonel Angelo — storms in. Corruption reaches the highest levels, and the former War Master must fight a new war: against the system itself. Can he turn the tables and reclaim everything they stole from him?
6aaff98c9bcab205770fed07.title: That Soldier You Betrayed Is The War Master

6ab00279b22e3e67590f8527.synopsis: The Kingdom of Silver Moon must send a princess to wed the King of the Wildlands. Two princesses, Maeve and Lila, draw lots to decide who will be married off to that barren land. Lila begs Maeve to go in her place. Then Maeve remembers her last life. She stayed — and married Asher, the general who had been her childhood sweetheart. Their marriage turned bitter, and they spent a lifetime hating each other. On the day the city fell, Asher died shielding her escape, and with his last breath he begged her to let him be with Lila. Maeve had spent a whole life and never won his heart. She threw herself from the cliff to follow him in death. Reborn, Maeve finally sees clearly: this time, she will give Asher and Lila her blessing.
6ab00279b22e3e67590f8527.title: Swapped Bride: Awakening of the True Princess

6ab090e57087873df908c6d9.synopsis: Tess is the only wolf in her pack who hasn't shifted — and if she doesn't figure it out by next week, she's out for good. Her only hope is Jaxon: her Alpha's son, her step-brother, her enemy. But the moment he's close, everything changes — her wolf stirs closer than ever, and the hatred she's clung to starts feeling like a lie. There's just one problem: pack law says a future Alpha can never take a wolfless mate.
6ab090e57087873df908c6d9.title: CLAIMED BY MY ALPHA STEPBROTHER

6ab0933d8ba05fe9750ac71c.synopsis: After his greedy girlfriend dumps him, Cole Preston awakens the LadyAid System and gains immense wealth by helping women. He rises from obscurity to become a hidden billionaire, building a vast empire and forming complicated relationships with powerful women. When his ex launches a smear campaign, Cole's allies expose her lies, leading to her arrest. With his enemies defeated, Cole reaches the pinnacle of wealth and power.
6ab0933d8ba05fe9750ac71c.title: LadyAid: From Dumped Pauper to Tycoon

6ab0966c2eac8bc8bb0d3e4d.synopsis: For Ava, Godfather Alexander’s Capone estate is the only safe place left in Hearing The Little Alpha’s Mind Saved My Life. At least, that’s what she believes as she desperately tries to stay inside. Beyond the estate, her husband has sent armed rogues after her, and every one of them is ready to tear her apart. When Ava first reaches the estate, wolf scratches cover her arms and legs, and she is bleeding badly. At first, Ava only hopes to find work as one of the maids. The job is far from easy. She is expected to tame Alexander’s cute but dangerous little pup, Leo. His raging bloodline can make him bite just about anyone—and anything—that gets too close. Something about Leo doesn’t make sense. Although he is dangerous around everyone else, he clings to Ava like a soft kitten. After she removes a nasty, sharp splinter from his mouth, she begins to discover what has really been happening to him. Through his thoughts, Leo tells Ava that his grandmother has been poisoning him. If Ava wants to earn her freedom, she must first find a way to cure the Young Master. Characters Ava Ava is the wolfless girl and main female character of Hearing The Little Alpha’s Mind Saved My Life. She possesses the unusual ability to hear Young Master Leo’s thoughts. Her connection with Leo catches Alexander’s attention and makes her the target of the Head Nanny’s jealousy. Alpha Alexander Alpha Alexander is the main male character and the feared King of the Black Werewolves. Other werewolves shiver at the sound of his name. He takes an interest in Ava after seeing how easily she can soothe Young Master Leo. Young Master Leo Young Master Leo is Alpha Alexander’s cute but dangerous little pup. His behavior is shaped by his raging bloodline and the mistreatment he suffers from his grandmother. Despite his aggression toward others, he quickly becomes attached to Ava. Head Nanny The Head Nanny is a minor villain in the series. She pretends to care for Young Master Leo while secretly conspiring with his grandmother. Ava’s growing connection with Leo also makes the Head Nanny jealous.
6ab0966c2eac8bc8bb0d3e4d.title: Hearing the Little Alpha's Mind Saved My Life

6ab097b14aae74c766097df7.synopsis: After seven years married to mafia Don Enzo Caruso, Valentina Moretti learns that he has been lavishing her former best friend Gia with gifts paid for by the Moretti fortune. Then Enzo announces that Gia is carrying his child and expects Valentina to accept a place in their new family. He thinks she has nowhere to go, unaware that Valentina is not merely his wife, but the sole heir to the most powerful family in New York’s underworld. When Gia begins reaching for Valentina’s jewelry, her home, and even her late mother’s bridal gown, Valentina stops begging for her husband to choose her. With a new marriage proposal waiting, she makes a choice Enzo never saw coming.
6ab097b14aae74c766097df7.title: Her New Groom, His Ruin

6ab098ced9cc957b8102d95d.synopsis: Little Lily is ignored by her wolf parents, who devote everything to her sick older sister. When Lily says another father and mother live inside the moon-silver mirror, her real parents call her a liar and lock her away. But the mirror family is real. They feed her, comfort her, and offer the love she never received at home. After one final betrayal, Lily chooses the mirror and disappears. Her birth parents spend years drowning in regret, only to learn the “monsters” were future wolf parents searching for abandoned pups. By the time they understand, Lily has found a real home.
6ab098ced9cc957b8102d95d.title: My Mirror Wolf Parents Loved Me Best

6ab0dd3efcd55b2fca0e84bd.synopsis: In Boston of 2049, after the Global Data Collapse wiped out massive digital archives, androids have woven themselves into human society. Alden Shaw, chief emotionalAI engineer at Wren Robotics, rescues prototype EL0 marked for disposal and labelled defective. He names him Elio. What begins as a technical rescue gradually blooms into a bond crossing the line between human and machine. Elio repeatedly breaks the Three Restrictions programmed into androids, developing jealousy, longing, possessiveness and selfsacrificing love. Drawn into corporate conspiracies, they uncover Gideon’s greed, Silas’ hidden agenda, and Julian’s unfinished hidden core. They are forced to confront one devastating question: is an android’s love merely code and command, or the genuine affection of a freewilled being?
6ab0dd3efcd55b2fca0e84bd.title: His Defective Robot Boyfriend

6ab0f1a2018580c9820e1475.synopsis: Five years ago, waitress Lily was framed by Vanessa. She accidentally had a one‑night stand with drugged tycoon Alexander. Afterwards, Vanessa cruelly blinded Lily, seized the keepsake and took her identity. Five years later, Lily’s biological son Leo took a job as a caddie for fake young master Ethan at the manor to raise money for his mother’s eye treatment. Within the estate, Leo endured constant bullying from Vanessa and her son, yet won the affection of the matriarch who held power in the family. During an accident, Leo saved the old lady from falling off a cliff. Vanessa shoved him off the mountainside out of malice, leaving him critically injured. Extremely rare golden‑blood type was urgently required for the rescue. Alexander rushed over to donate blood. The old lady secretly ordered a DNA test, which proved Leo was the true heir of the family. Sensing her scheme was about to be exposed, Vanessa tried to eliminate the mother and son. She framed them for theft and hired gangsters to chase them onto the rooftop of an abandoned factory with the intent to kill them. At the critical moment, Alexander and the old matriarch arrived on an armed helicopter and rescued Lily and her son.
6ab0f1a2018580c9820e1475.title: Stolen Identity: The Billionaire's True Bride

6ab0f24d963f1a91c60ab186.synopsis: Ryan, the only son of the wealthy Winchester family, was willing to work as a taxi driver for five years for love, only to be repaid with betrayal by his wife Bella.
