In order to attach herself to Ethan, a rich young master, Bella coldly chose not to see Ryan's grandmother one last time when the grandmother was critically ill after a car accident. The grandmother died with resentment, and before passing, mistakenly took the kind attending physician Ella for her granddaughter-in-law and entrusted the family heirloom ring to her. Bella's heartlessness completely woke Ryan up, and he chose to return to the family to inherit the position of president. At the grandmother's funeral, Bella and Ethan made a high-profile appearance to compete for a ten-billion-dollar investment. When they saw clearly that the new president in the seat of honor was none other than Ryan, whom they had humiliated in every possible way, the two were instantly thunderstruck. Later, still unaware of Ryan's true identity, they continued to humiliate him in every possible way. In the end, when Bella, filled with fantasy, tried to marry into the wealthy Winchester family, Ryan exposed her in public. After learning Ryan's identity, Bella regretted it endlessly.
6ab0f24d963f1a91c60ab186.title: My Taxi Driver Ex Is a Billionaire

6ab0f32835b6b75a6d031850.synopsis: Chloe was tricked by her fiancé into attending a swinger party and accidentally entered the suite of his uncle Victor. After a night of indulgence, she was abandoned and humiliated by her fiancé, then forcibly possessed and imprisoned by Victor, reduced to a mere tool. After becoming pregnant, she suffered retaliation, was sold off, faked her death in a fire, and escaped. Three years later, she makes a glamorous return with her daughter. Victor embarks on a “wife-chasing crematorium,” and eventually the misunderstandings are cleared, culminating in a grand wedding and a happy ending for the family of three.
6ab0f32835b6b75a6d031850.title: The Swap Game: Claimed by His Uncle

6ab0f388752914e8e50fe57e.synopsis: Leonardo, the Ancient Dragon Lord, conceals his true identity and lives as a blacksmith in the royal city to protect his daughter Fiona. On her deathbed, his wife Sophia transforms into a dragon crystal, bidding him safeguard Fiona, whose dragon‑kind bloodline has yet to awaken. King Glen uncovers Leonardo’s real identity. Hoping to harness the dragon clan’s power, he arranges for Prince Adrian to marry Fiona, promising that Fiona will awaken her dragon inheritance at their wedding
6ab0f388752914e8e50fe57e.title: The Dragon Lord' Daughter

6ab0f66c6be902e3720136d8.synopsis: Sophia Morgan is the wife of Alexander Morgan, CEO of the Morgan Group. Wanting her daughter, Lily, to experience an ordinary childhood, Sophia keeps her identity a secret and drives an old Kia to drop Lily off at school. But David’s wife, Vanessa, pretends to be the CEO’s wife and turns the tables on Sophia at the school gates. The principal and teachers, eager to please the rich and powerful, join in humiliating Sophia. Things get even worse when Vanessa takes over the Morgan estate and throws a lavish birthday party there, pushing Sophia to her breaking point. When Alexander sees footage of his wife being forced to kneel, he flies into a rage and rushes home immediately. Once the truth comes out, everyone who dared to humiliate Sophia will pay a devastating price.
6ab0f66c6be902e3720136d8.title: Stolen Identity

6ab0f9d1fa6d3a3e98004385.synopsis: My stepmother hung my son over a crocodile pit to force me to become a sacrifice for my sister. With my son’s life in her hands, I had no choice but to agree. Everyone thought I was as good as dead. But I came back alive—with a “husband” by my side. No one knew that this man was the Black Dragon himself. They sent me to the dragon as a sacrifice. So I turned the dragon into my husband. Now, it’s their turn to pay the price.
6ab0f9d1fa6d3a3e98004385.title: The Dragon King’s Secret Baby

6ab0fd4b08b46709f40cc875.synopsis: A rainy-night car accident sends Avery and her husband Grant seven years into the past, before their marriage. Grant uses future knowledge to become a Wall Street wunderkind. Avery quietly marries Grant’s elder brother, Liam Whitmore—America’s richest man—and fulfills her dream of becoming a top neurosurgeon. At a class reunion, Grant and his girlfriend Sienna publicly humiliate Avery, even forcing her to kneel. Then Liam arrives with his entourage. The truth explodes: Avery is the wife of the nation’s wealthiest man. She forces Grant and Sienna to kneel and apologize. Later, Grant and Sienna’s son Cooper is diagnosed with a malignant tumor. Only the legendary “Dr. Callahan” can save him. Sienna and her mother brutally abuse a woman they mistake for a nurse—breaking her hand—not knowing she is Dr. Callahan. Cooper dies. Grant loses everything and is diagnosed with terminal cancer. On his deathbed, he repents, but Avery rejects him. She and Liam embrace on a terrace, vowing eternal love.
6ab0fd4b08b46709f40cc875.title: You Messed With the Wrong Ex

6ab11e0af321a3292b05419b.synopsis: Lia was born a princess, but all she really wants is a life of her own. So she chooses love over duty only to be betrayed and rejected by her lover Derek. It's time for Lia to get her revenge and claim her place as the Dragon Princess. But why won't anyone believe her?
6ab11e0af321a3292b05419b.title: Never Reject a Dragon Princess

6ab1dbdd57702faa710e1557.synopsis: Sophia finally marries Damien, the man she’s loved for ten years—only to have her dream marriage shattered by humiliation, betrayal, and his scheming assistant. Heartbroken, she walks away and transforms herself inside and out. Three months later, Sophia returns stunning, confident, and determined to live for herself. But just as she stops chasing Damien, her arrogant husband realizes he’s fallen for her—and now he’ll do anything to win his wife back.
6ab1dbdd57702faa710e1557.title: The Big Wife's Revenge: From Model to Queen

6ab1dc7e3d722d363b018ae7.synopsis: Cora chose a penniless beggar over the wealthy old merchant her family tried to force her to marry. What she never knew was that her new husband was Zeus—the all-powerful King of the Gods. When Frost Giants invade Mount Olympus, Zeus is forced to leave her behind. For seven long years, Cora raises their gifted twins alone while suffering relentless abuse from her cruel family. But when Cora and her children are branded as demons and sentenced to death, Zeus finally returns in a storm of thunder. As his true identity is revealed, everyone who humiliated his family will face the wrath of a god.
6ab1dc7e3d722d363b018ae7.title: Zeus Came Back for His True Love

6ab1e02e895cc75bc70e42e7.synopsis: On Christmas Eve, a lavish party is underway inside a luxury estate.Alex, the estate's lowly maintenance worker, is publicly humiliated over a minor mistake by Victoria—the former president's daughter—and a group of wealthy socialites.Then the zombie outbreak begins.As the privileged guests become helpless prey, Alex discovers something impossible: the zombies will not attack him. Overnight, money, status, and power become meaningless.Armed with his survival instincts, combat skills, and a mysterious immunity, Alex rises from a humiliated worker to the leader of his own survivor base. The women who once looked down on him must now abandon their pride and trade skills, labor, and resources for the right to survive. But zombies are not the only danger in the new world.Ambitious survivors, traitors, ruthless mercenaries, and unknown forces hunting Alex's blood soon emerge. As the estate is repeatedly threatened by massive zombie hordes and brutal human conflicts, Alex becomes the one man everyone depends on.When the survivors finally set out for a rumored safe haven in Nevada, a mysterious transmission changes everything:“Possible complete antibody carrier identified.”“Capture the target alive.”The apocalypse has only just begun.
6ab1e02e895cc75bc70e42e7.title: King of the Dead

6ab1e1d70d218e897d0acbd8.synopsis: After the Trojan War, Odysseus kills the Cyclops and is crowned King of Ithaca by Athena. Hiding his identity, he returns home to endure humiliation from his wife's family, who push her to marry the suitor Antinous. He proves himself despite his relics being destroyed, survives Antinous's frame job and kidnapping, and loses an ally to a life debt. At the coronation, he is exposed, kills Antinous with a rebounding arrow, and reclaims his throne and family.
6ab1e1d70d218e897d0acbd8.title: The Odyssey: A Warrior King's Homecoming

6ab1e304ed425041e6000c30.synopsis: Eighteen years ago, Leonardo Gambino ruled New York’s underworld. At eighteen, he took control. At thirty-three, he survived a brutal war that buried half his brothers. That night, he learned his wife was pregnant—and for the first time, he had something greater than power: a family. So he walked away. He divided his fortune, abandoned his legend, and vanished with his wife and closest friend. Under a new name, he opened a small bar in a quiet town and built an ordinary life. Eighteen years later, no one recognizes the former Godfather in the gentle bartender. To his seventeen-year-old daughter Sofia, he is just Dad—a harmless man shielding her from his dark past. Then Sofia becomes the target of vicious bullies. Terrified, she lies to protect the father she believes is only a bartender. Until Leonardo sees what they have done to her. Black cars arrive in the rain. Armed men emerge from shadows. Old soldiers bow before their Godfather. Luca stands at his side. And in the darkness, Dominic Gallo—believed dead—still lives. The Colombos think they have inherited his city. They are wrong. When the Gambino crest appears, Jack’s arrogance crumbles. When hundreds answer one call, Jacob—once Leonardo’s driver—realizes the truth: Leonardo did not disappear because he lost. He chose family over power. Now someone has hurt his daughter. Sofia watches in disbelief as her gentle father transforms. The bartender is gone. In his place stands the man who once made New York kneel. They have no idea they are touching the daughter of the Godfather. And when the man who made a city bow finally stops hiding—who will be left standing when his old name is spoken again?
6ab1e304ed425041e6000c30.title: Don's Back: No One Touches His Daughter

6ab1e47548021082330aee9f.synopsis: Leo carries the pure bloodline of an ancient Sea God, but crippled his own legs to save his fiancée's father. On the eve of their wedding, Sophia and Arthur, the Papacy's Saint, drag him to a cliffside altar and drain his divine blood so Arthur can be baptized a Saint. Left for dead, Leo instead awakens a sleeping god-relic beneath the sea, reclaiming the Golden Trident and a body reforged in scaled armor. He returns in disguise, crushes Arthur's forged relic in the arena, and reveals his true god-form, forcing the Church to its knees. Allied with Elena, Grand Duchess of Winter, he hunts down three Sea God Hearts, exposes the Church's dark sacrifices to the Lord of the Abyss, and ultimately unleashes the wrath of the ocean to seal the rift and save the continent.
6ab1e47548021082330aee9f.title: Wrath of the Sea God

6ab1e4fdb35552a0c2028529.synopsis: In Dragonstone, the Valen bloodline guards the city. Every youth must pass the Dragonstone Resonance Trial to bond with a true dragon. Kael, the chieftain’s elder son, has no draconic resonance at all. Branded a failure, he is stripped of his succession and family crest by his father Roland, then cast out. In Dragonveil Valley, Kael meets Dramor—a dusty silver hatchling also deemed worthless. When dragon hunters ambush them, boy and dragon forge a flawless bond amid certain death. Dramor awakens molten crimson-gold fire; seven elemental runes bloom on Kael’s wrist. They vow to hide their power and reclaim everything at the Valen Grand Tournament in seven days. They train in an abandoned quarry, slaying a full-grown rock-armor grizzly. Whispers of a mysterious fire dragon knight spread. Dramor devours a monster core and matures rapidly, but exposes their trail. Pursued, they plunge into Twin Peaks Gorge—and their pact’s sacred fire becomes enormous wings, carrying them to the open sea. Disguised as a weak, non-aligned pair, they enter the clan tournament. Kael overpowers a wind dragon wielder, then defeats a lightning dragon pair with Dramor. In the final match, Dramor’s fire is drained; wounded, he shields Kael. Kael realizes he fights not just for birthright—but for his dearest companion. The second pact rune awakens, unleashing lightning and flame. Boy and dragon fuse into a new Thunderfire form.
6ab1e4fdb35552a0c2028529.title: No Dragon Chose Him—So He Chose the Dragon God

6ab1e506d70c17e43b09791f.synopsis: Five years ago, Grace saved NovaMind’s data in a server-room fire, suffering severe burns. Her parents died transporting the backup. Though she owns 51% of NovaMind, she stays out of the spotlight. Secretly married to Ethan, she hides her scars with gloves and endures his affair with assistant Sunny. Sunny and Ethan already have a daughter, Lily, and Sunny is pregnant again. They plot to seize Grace’s assets, backed by Marcellus—the true mastermind behind the fire. Grace carries a fallen flame-angel bloodline, marked by a golden symbol on her wrist. Andrew, her father’s friend and an Alpha with moon-wolf blood, has loved her for years but kept away due to family ties and age difference. He returns to protect her as she awakens her powers. Together they gather evidence, expose the conspiracy, and confront the Hale family’s traitors. At a lakeside under the full moon, they complete a ritual binding their bloodlines. United, they defeat their enemies. Grace reclaims NovaMind, engraves her father’s name on a company landmark, and steps forward with Andrew to lead their future together.
6ab1e506d70c17e43b09791f.title: Invisible Wife,Tragic Fallen Angel

6ab1e623e862be8e470e6e1a.synopsis: When billionaire titan Henry Caldwell dies, his funeral turns into a greedy war. His children tear the mansion apart for gold and deeds—unaware his "death" is a cold, calculated test. To inherit his $186.4 billion fortune, the family must find the one thing Henry valued most. Three days of chaos erupt as the heirs kick the casket and smash his memory, driven by pure greed.
6ab1e623e862be8e470e6e1a.title: The Dead Billionaire's Game

6ab1e8a43e9d1039780d3b9d.synopsis: Dylan Hayes, a delivery rider, gets a CX-2000 artificial heart after a crash. When the Crimson Rain Virus strikes, his heart resonates with viral energy, granting him the ability to freeze time. On his run for survival, he meets seven women with antibody powers. They battle the Crimson Rain's creator, who has mutated into the Shadow Lord. In the final battle, Dylan overclocks his heart, unleashing the seven carriers' full power and defeating the Shadow Lord. After the apocalypse, Dylan opens a barbecue shop, and the seven survivors live a warm, peaceful life together.
6ab1e8a43e9d1039780d3b9d.title: Delivery Rider Turned Doom Survivor

6ab205093b21ae6ba206d819.synopsis: Three years ago, Marine Raine Winters died saving Captain Kane Thorne in the Middle East. His last wish: return to New York, marry my sister Isabella, and protect her forever. Kane arrives in New York—foul-mouthed, sloppy, hiding twenty-seven shrapnel wounds and twenty-plus black-ops missions. He expects to be a bodyguard for a CEO. Instead, he finds Isabella Winters, young head of Winters Group, fighting for her life. Her revolutionary anti-cancer project, “Golden Apple,” threatens the medical giant Caesar Group. Zachary Caesar wants the data, the company, and Isabella—using forced marriage, bribes, moles, assassins, snipers, and bombs. But Kane isn’t an ordinary bodyguard. He clears assassins bare-handed, bends titanium clubs, and makes the Iron Fist Gang kneel. As Isabella falls for him, so do FBI agent Erin, former mole Liana, mercenary Raven, and Wall Street queen Vivian. Victor Caesar strikes personally—Kane crushes him, Vivian bans Caesar on Wall Street, and the empire collapses. Zachary kidnaps three women, injects a neural enhancer, and demands Kane’s life. Raven defects. Kane still wins. The Caesars fall. But Isabella, Erin, Liana, Raven, and Vivian won’t let him walk away.
6ab205093b21ae6ba206d819.title: The Super Soldier of the Stunning Female CEO

6ab21030213827243c039eab.synopsis: On Tidewater Station, dockhand Cole Andrews keeps his head down, takes the abuse, and raises his daughter alone. But when a rigged debt puts fifteen-year-old Kira in the fight ring, the station starts asking who her father really is - and so does the Syndicate that has spent fifteen years hunting a dead man.
6ab21030213827243c039eab.title: Don't Wake the Dead Man

6ab214222bbdc12d830988f9.synopsis: Hunter Elias has hunted the vampire Lorian for three hundred years, convinced he is the one who killed his parents. In a fatal ambush, Elias — the ace hunter — is forced to form a desperate alliance with Lorian, the vampire noble. As they trace the conspiracy, he tears open the cruelest truth: his adoptive father Stone, the guild director whom he revered for half his life and who raised him, not only colluded with the vampire progenitor to launch the human-experiment "Project Zero," but is the true culprit who killed his father with his own hands and destroyed his family! The false upbringing was a scheme long in the making. Racial hostility, a blood feud, and forbidden love intertwine layer upon layer, as two mighty rivals join forces to break the deadlock, defy fate, take their revenge, tear apart the hypocritical mask, and guard the one redemption and the road home.
6ab214222bbdc12d830988f9.title: Bloodline Paradox: Silver and Shadows

6ab2418c34c1441a2f0f5fb7.synopsis: A pregnant wife. A pack of spoiled rich kids. A city with no rules. Blue-collar Danny is racing his wife to the hospital when Chad, a brat heir to the Ashford fortune, traps them on a bridge. He humiliates Danny in front of his laboring wife. Danny takes it—for her, for their unborn child. But what Chad doesn't know: Danny's sworn brother is Jack Costello. The Godfather of New Jersey. When Jack arrives—the debt comes due.
6ab2418c34c1441a2f0f5fb7.title: Blood for Blood

6ab24803ee19872d9b02ea3d.synopsis: Will Quinn, the legendary world-class magician, is assassinated mid-publicperformance. His soul travels across time and awakens inside Noah, a bulliedten-year-old illegitimate son of the powerful Blackwood noble family. Retaining all ofhis peerless magic skills from his past life, Noah steps forward during a high-stakesmagic duel for the sacred Phantom Stage against the hostile Graves family. To unmask the masterminds behind his murder, he pretends to be Will Quinn's secret apprentice and issues a public challenge to all top-ranked magicians at theGlobal Magic Championship. The fake "God of Magic" Cassian Frost and the corrupt Council of Magicians take the bait one after another. Drawing on his intimate knowledge of magic mechanisms, Noah dismantles deadlytraps and uncovers the dark truth: the Council ordered his assassination becausethey feared his unyielding independence. He defeats the evil cabal, exposes theircrimes, and reclaims his rightful glory. He reminds the whole world that true magic belongs to everyone who still believes in miracles.
6ab24803ee19872d9b02ea3d.title: Reborn at 10 The World's Greatest Magician

6ab248c64dc48c013b069415.synopsis: "Out of Prison, I Rule Vegas" is a fast-paced urban drama set in the high-stakes world of Las Vegas casinos. Once the legendary "God of Gamblers," Victor emerges from prison to find his seven-year-old daughter Mia gravely ill and desperate for treatment money. With just ten dollars to his name, Victor returns to the casino—armed with extraordinary hearing, a razor-sharp memory, elite card-counting skills, and masterful psychological instincts. Rising from a mocked ex-con to a legendary gambler, he sends shockwaves through the city. But as stakes escalate, Victor must confront his ex-wife Sarah's distrust, Chris's schemes, a cheating casino manager, and the underground empire of Mr. X. Forced into a deadly showdown with Leo—an impostor claiming to be the heir to the "God of Gamblers"—Victor fights not for glory, but for his daughter's life. Through nonstop twists, extreme high-stakes games, shocking reveals, and ruthless revenge, Victor delivers a thrilling comeback with breakneck pacing and powerful emotion.
6ab248c64dc48c013b069415.title: Out of Prison, I Rule Vegas

6ab32cfcf20879dc290f9f99.synopsis: Luna dies after Ronan and Sophia's betrayal costs her son his life. Given a second chance, she returns to the night the babies were switched and turns their scheme against them. Twenty years later, Sophia sacrifices her own son to protect the heir, pushing Lucas toward the truth.
6ab32cfcf20879dc290f9f99.title: The Luna Swap

6ab32d5b144ab8635400e759.synopsis: After three years of secret Alpha training, Aria Sterling returns to find her mother enslaved, her birthright stolen, and an impostor family ruling her pack. To reclaim the Sterling throne, she must break a silver curse, expose a forged bloodline, and reveal that the mighty Aether Guild answers to her.
6ab32d5b144ab8635400e759.title: Alpha Heiress Reclaims Her Pack

6ab3300cc560130968048e59.synopsis: After raising her stepson for 20 years, Claire Kensington is cast aside when his long-lost birth mother returns on his wedding day. Heartbroken, she walks away and takes back what’s hers. Only then does he learn the cost of taking her love for granted.
6ab3300cc560130968048e59.title: He Lost the Mother Who Raised Him

6ab33143194f80d99c01fa0b.synopsis: One year after the apocalypse broke out, Caleb, a once‑written‑off young man, and his sister Maya, who has endured hunger to survive for his sake, hide in a fragile sanctuary. Sealed inside Caleb is the Dominator Gene left to them by their parents on their deathbed — a dormant mutant power that, once unleashed, can never be re‑contained. As the sanctuary’s captain of the guard, Maya shoulders every burden, even willing to starve herself to keep her brother’s power from erupting. Yet the sanctuary is far from safe. Its administrator Vance has long colluded with the Blood‑Tribute Legion, an outside slave army backed by Red Umbrella Biotech, plotting to betray the entire haven to them. When Holt, the Blood‑Tribute’s raid commander, leads his men to slaughter the sanctuary and publicly humiliates Maya, Caleb’s slumbering power finally awakens, triggered by the harm done to his own blood. No longer the bullied weakling, he rises as the Zombie King. He can command hordes of undead to kneel from a hundred meters away, catch rocket‑propelled grenades bare‑handed, and raise the dead to fight for him. His true foes, however, are neither Holt nor Jonah Kessler, the mastermind behind Red Umbrella. The real enemy is the Emperor, the hidden ruler pulling all the strings of the Blood‑Tribute Legion. What begins as vengeance born within one sanctuary soon ignites a war for power that sweeps across the entire wasteland.
6ab33143194f80d99c01fa0b.title: Apocalypse Siege: King of the Awakened

6ab332d3c6d934532a02380c.synopsis: Kyle is an abandoned half‑dragon outcast living in a human town. After his adoptive father Arthur is killed by the lord’s guards, he flees and forms a soul‑bond with the young dragon Aurelia, gaining the Crimson Dragon Gauntlet. Along his journey, he rescues the wolf‑kin girl Luna, who can transform into Shadow Twin‑Blades; the wind‑spirit Seraphina, who can turn into a Storm Longbow; and recruits the phantom fox Vex, who takes the form of a Psionic Diadem. He founds the Dawnbreaker Army to fight against the Holy Inquisition of mankind. Marco, the Grand Inquisitor‑Knight Commander of the Inquisition, leads troops to hunt him down. At Despair Canyon, Kyle repels an army of thirty‑thousand with his four‑fold armament.
6ab332d3c6d934532a02380c.title: Dragon blood Uprising

6ab335709a52d1898e0f969e.synopsis: Brenton is the trueborn heir to the Dragon Throne. When his bastard brother, Devlin, crashes a dragon into the castle, killing the King, Brenton takes the fall to protect Devlin, but Devlin arranges for a harsher sentence for Brenton, killing him with dragonfire. However, instead of dying, Brenton is sent a few months into the past. Now that Brenton knows Devlin's true nature, he resolves to take control and get revenge.
6ab335709a52d1898e0f969e.title: Reborn to be the Dragon King

6ab335b1c0199bc6f502eac9.synopsis: She has magic powerful enough to destroy the world, and no one knows it but her. When a long-lost noble family finally comes looking for their "heiress," Avera Astora has to decide how much of herself she's willing to hide... and how much she's willing to fight for.
6ab335b1c0199bc6f502eac9.title: The Sealed Farm Daughter Is the Bloodline's Queen

6ab33610ae7501f30b0068ac.synopsis: Human med student Elena secretly raises Kate, her half-wolf daughter, from a one-night bond with Alpha Alex. Needing rare medicine Lunarid, she finds Alex, who recognizes her by scent and bite mark. Kate is kidnapped, Alex discovers she is his daughter, and Elena moves into the pack estate. She survives Nyx's cruelty, becomes Luna, breaks Alex's curse through true love, and exposes Nyx's sabotage of a bloodline test. Mrs. Volkov accepts the family. Alex proposes, and they marry as one.
6ab33610ae7501f30b0068ac.title: Hunted by the Alpha

6ab34a843087e011030699de.synopsis: For seven years, Cecilia — a half-blood born between a powerful mage and an ordinary human — lived as nothing more than a servant in the prestigious Leon family. Married to Leon, the heir of a legendary magical bloodline, she was never treated as a wife. Instead, she was forced to brew potions, serve his family, and endure endless humiliation. Then her half-sister Lilian entered her marriage pretending to be the helpless victim. Little by little, she stole Leon’s affection — and even turned Cecilia’s own daughter against her. But everything changed the day Cecilia signed the divorce papers. The “dead egg” everyone mocked for years finally cracked open. Inside was not a worthless spirit, but Loki — the ancient Dragon Lord who had waited 600 years for her return. He gave her the legendary ring that commanded the entire dragon clan. More importantly, he gave her what she had never received before: respect, protection, and the power to choose her own destiny. Reborn as Luna Sera, a once-in-a-generation magical genius, Cecilia returns to the magical world. The people who once looked down on her are now forced to kneel before her. Only then does Leon realize the truth: The woman he abandoned was never beneath him. She was someone he could never reach. Desperate to win her back, Leon kneels and offers her the wedding ring. But Cecilia only smiles coldly. “Your love is something I no longer need.” And she walks away with Loki — the man who shares her soul, her destiny, and a bond that will last beyond life and death.
6ab34a843087e011030699de.title: Dumped by My Ex, Chosen by the Dragon King

6ab37198011591995402da38.synopsis: In School for Bad Boys movie, after being sent to Maplewood Reform School—a last stop before prison for the problem sons of wealthy families—openly gay teen Cody Calloway is NOT welcome. After all, the first rule of Maplewood is clear: any homosexual activity earns an immediate expulsion. Enter Beckett Hayes, the school's straight golden boy with a girlfriend, a dark past, and a growing obsession with Cody. Every stolen touch puts their freedom on the line…but some things are worth the risk.
6ab37198011591995402da38.title: The School for Bad Boys

6ab3852676234689d7078281.synopsis: The Divorced Billionaire Heiress* tells the story of Aurora Vance. On her third‑wedding anniversary, she is publicly abandoned and left penniless by her husband Marcus. In despair, she makes a contract‑marriage deal with wealthy heir Ryan Winslow. Meanwhile, she finds her true identity and takes back the Vance Group. They dig out the truth, bring mastermind Victor Kane to justice. After fierce struggles, the contract turns into genuine love. Aurora achieves self‑redemption and marries Ryan.
6ab3852676234689d7078281.title: The Divorced Billionaire Heiress

6ab3852b3150acd59f00280f.synopsis: In her past life, she donated bone marrow to her father, but died full of resentment after being tormented by his family. Reborn right before the marrow match, she gives up on seeking his love and escapes the family. As she skyrockets to fame through her incredible acting, he finally learns the truth and is consumed by regret.
6ab3852b3150acd59f00280f.title: Daddy's Regret Comes Too Late

6ab386c65ea428ef3e0c0666.synopsis: Princess Mira of the Silver Moon Kingdom was rescued from the ruins of war by the royal family as a child and raised under their constant protection for seventeen years. However, when Serla—who claimed to be her "biological sister" —returned to the royal household, everything changed: her family began to neglect her, misunderstood her, and even repeatedly pushed her toward the abyss. On the surface, Serla appeared gentle and kind; beneath this facade, however, she was ruthless and cruel—she stole Mira's music box, her evening gown, and her room, and even framed and accused her, leaving her three elder brothers and parents utterly disillusioned with Mira. Mira endured all of this in silence, secretly entering into a covenant with the Dragon Clan—sacrificing herself in exchange for a century of peace for the kingdom—and exchanging her heart for that of her second brother, Solin, who suffered from cardiac disease. On her 18th birthday, her family expelled her from the royal palace due to Serla's lies. Without offering any defense, Mira walked alone toward the altar and was consumed by flames, vanishing into nothingness. Only when the truth was finally revealed did her family, consumed by endless remorse, forever lose the girl who truly loved them.
6ab386c65ea428ef3e0c0666.title: After I was sacrificed to the evil dragon, my brothers regretted it

6ab38779c694944c590230f4.synopsis: Emily, the biological daughter of the Foster family, returns after an eighteen-year absence to find Lily, an imposter, has taken her place. Outwardly sweet, Lily secretly works with her accomplice Jack. She forges DNA reports, spreads rumors, and plants false evidence to frame Emily, manipulating adoptive parents Richard and Catherine into turning against their real daughter. Emily is misunderstood, locked in a storage room, and nearly driven out. Refusing to surrender, Emily teams up with allies James and Tony. They uncover that private detective Victor was bribed by Lily to feed false leads. Tracking down Lily’s birth mother Diana, they expose a long-buried paid identity swap. Lily’s illegal adoption is voided. Desperate, Lily bribes Victor to tamper with Richard’s heart medication, intending to murder him and seize the fortune. The plot is exposed with witnesses and evidence. Lily breaks down and pays for eighteen years of greed. Emily clears her name, reclaims her identity, and transforms herself in the battle over who truly belongs.
6ab38779c694944c590230f4.title: The Heiress Returns Playing the Game

6ab392059db6f3a57a070ae9.synopsis: Malik Carter grew up dirt poor, training on a cracked outdoor court while his single mother worked three jobs to keep him fed—until an NBA scout secretly makes him the number one draft pick. But a month of sealed pre-draft testing leaves him unreachable, and his hometown decides the worst: that he's been arrested for prostitution. His own uncle, aunt, and cousin turn the whole church against him and his mother, stripping them of dignity, stealing from them, and even scalding her hand to punish his "lies." When the truth finally breaks, every person who spat on his family scrambles to grovel—but Malik's fight isn't over. At his own rookie celebration, the father who abandoned his pregnant mother years ago shows up flaunting a new wife and a stepson chasing the same spotlight. As the draft countdown hits zero, everyone who ever doubted, humiliated, or betrayed Malik and his mother is about to learn exactly who they were dealing with.
6ab392059db6f3a57a070ae9.title: Number One, Nobody

6ab397e13282a14d03058cf7.synopsis: In the beastkin world, Toby (a rabbit whose impending marriage was called off) is forced into an arranged marriage with Enzo (the Wolf King and adoptive father of his former fiancée) following an unexpected one-night stand. Humiliated again and again by his ex and her family, Toby is saved by Enzo through crisis after crisis, and what begins as forced dependence slowly turns into helpless devotion — sparking a dangerous, forbidden romance defined by an extreme emotional tension.
6ab397e13282a14d03058cf7.title: The Alpha's Forbidden Bunny

6ab39949ec17d073650d5236.synopsis: Maeve is neglected and abused by her parents while her sister Bianca is adored. Bianca frames her, steals her allowance, and forges a letter selling Maeve to a rogue Alpha. Maeve escapes death, is rescued by Enforcer Adler, and rebuilds her life. She testifies against Harlan Briggs, transfers to a new Pack, and earns a place at Highspire Academy. When her parents beg forgiveness, she cuts all ties. Bianca is arrested. Maeve becomes the youngest Chief Enforcer, finds her fated mate Cassian, and builds a loving family.
6ab39949ec17d073650d5236.title: The Black Wolf They Cast Aside

6ab3a84d5d7b4f9772012c7e.synopsis: Lana Samuel, the biological daughter, was banished to the countryside for 18 years over a misunderstanding about her appearance. Meanwhile, the adopted daughter, Bria Samuel, received all the family's love. When Lana returns home as the top scholar, her three brothers despise and mistreat her. But the tables turn when they realize Lana is the girl they have been searching for. Refusing to wallow in self-pity, Lana leverages her stellar grades to pursue a future in scientific research, leaving her guilt-ridden brothers in deep regrets.
6ab3a84d5d7b4f9772012c7e.title: The Comeback Heiress

6ab3ac0afbd298323302ecf0.synopsis: Adrian, the Ashfords' real son, lost for years, comes home—only to be starved, framed, and beaten while the family adores their adopted “perfect son,” Damon. At Damon's birthday he's poisoned, blamed, and beaten to death—then wakes reborn, years earlier. This time he walks out for good. Using what only he knows of the future, he builds an empire that buries the family who cast him out. Sure he'd crawl back, they watch him rise—then uncover his abuse and Damon's lies, and beg him home. Too late.
6ab3ac0afbd298323302ecf0.title: The Heir They Threw Away

6ab3b0bd6dc16f4c660a233d.synopsis: In her first life, Nora Bennett is collared in a dog cage while Hailey auctions her in the Blackridge gym. "Twenty dollars buys one minute. Who wants the leash?" Students stream it. Teachers watch. Her father sees the cage and takes Hailey home instead. Then Nora wakes up eighteen again, one day before the auction. Hailey wants her ruined, and Ethan, Blackridge's rich hockey captain, sets the motel trap. This time, Nora raises her price, turns the camera on him, and collects proof. But when Hailey orders another dog cage, Nora is ready to choose who goes inside.
6ab3b0bd6dc16f4c660a233d.title: The $20 Dog Cage Girl

6ab3b0f68eb57767b80f5732.synopsis: Claire, an ordinary waitress, happens to rescue a little girl named Ava who has been hurt. Billionaire Lucas, seeking to comfort his traumatized daughter, signs a six-month contract marriage with Claire. Entering the lavish Grant estate, Claire heals Ava and also changes the cold, distant Lucas. Facing the family's hostility, the exposure of the contract, and one conspiracy after another, the three break through the shackles of money and blood ties — proving that a true family is made of people who choose one another willingly.
6ab3b0f68eb57767b80f5732.title: The Billionaire’s Daughter Chose Me to Be Her Mommy

6ab3b1316174855ed506e6e6.synopsis: Second Chance at Life is a 25-episode female-growth and comeback drama. Avery Ross spends eighteen years as Caleb Bennett’s safety net—fixing his assignments, covering his mistakes, sacrificing her own chances, and believing it was friendship. Then, at the freshman talent show, Caleb holds her down so Bailey can cut off her hair, all to prove his loyalty to a cooler crowd. The whole auditorium laughs. He laughs loudest. That night, Avery wakes up. She withdraws from college, returns home, takes a gap year, and rebuilds her life from zero—SAT 1590, Columbia University. Meanwhile, without Avery to clean up his messes, Caleb is discarded by Bailey, expelled, and watches the Bennett family collapse. Along the way, Avery meets Lucas, an MIT-bound top student, and learns a love built on equality, respect, and mutual growth. In the end, she is no one’s sidekick and no one’s sacrifice—she is the lead of her own life.
6ab3b1316174855ed506e6e6.title: Second Chance at Life

6ab3b403815ce855ac0cdab3.synopsis: On his wedding day, Nathan finds his bride's ex, Dylan, in the bridal suite, playing with his boutonniere; Sophie defends Dylan, so Nathan calls off the wedding. Deep in debt, Dylan twists the story with an edited video, but Nathan keeps the full footage and pursues legal action, while Sophie takes responsibility for the wedding losses. Dylan and his brother try to move assets and sway witnesses, but their plans fail; Nathan lets go of the relationship and starts over.
6ab3b403815ce855ac0cdab3.title: My Bride's Ex on Our Wedding Bed

6ab3b5adb0a5c3756705d7d1.synopsis: After being forced to stay on campus during winter break, Eric Tully and his fellow college classmates find themselves trapped by one of the worst blizzards in recorded history. With the campus completely cut off from the outside world, the students soon realize they are not alone. A mysterious stranger wearing a mask made entirely of ice has begun stalking the frozen campus, picking them off one by one. As the body count rises, Eric and the remaining students desperately search for a way to survive the night while trying to uncover the identity of the masked killer known only as The Ice Man. But when the survivors begin uncovering clues connecting the murders to a dark secret some of them have been hiding, it becomes clear that the killings may not be random. The Ice Man knows what they did, and he intends to make them pay. With the blizzard showing no signs of stopping and escape becoming impossible, Eric and his friends must confront the truth about their shared past before The Ice Man hunts them all down. To survive, they will have to determine who among them is truly his target—and why.
6ab3b5adb0a5c3756705d7d1.title: The Ice Man

6ab3ba913eb244b17d031ed1.synopsis: In Sexting My Pucking Nemesis, Ethan Miller may be a nerd, but he’s also the hockey player his teammates would rather avoid. He has never been good at respecting boundaries. Then he does the one thing his captain hates most: he publicly asks out Captain Hunter Kennedy’s younger sister, Hayley. For Hunter, few things could be more infuriating than watching the man he secretly wants chase after his sister. When he realizes Hayley plans to answer Ethan’s message, Hunter confiscates her phone. Ethan, using the username “Bad Boy,” sends Hayley a sexy text in the hope of winning her heart. What Ethan doesn’t know is that Hunter is the one answering those messages. Pretending to be Hayley, Hunter plays along with Ethan’s provocative texts and soon gets carried away. What begins as a trick turns into a private sexting relationship with Ethan—except Ethan has no idea who is really on the other side. As more people become involved, keeping the secret becomes harder. Can Hunter, Ethan’s biggest bully and hockey captain, pull him away from Hayley? Or will Ethan keep chasing the girl he thinks he wants without ever discovering who has truly captured his attention? Characters Ethan Miller Ethan Miller is a hockey player who loves learning and serves as one of the main male characters. He believes he’s straight and has his eyes on Hayley. Without realizing it, however, he ends up sexting her older brother—who also happens to be his nemesis. Hunter Kennedy Hunter Kennedy is the good-looking hockey captain and the second main male character. He is Hayley’s protective older brother and Ethan’s biggest bully. Beneath their rivalry, Hunter has had his eye on Ethan for a long time. Hayley Kennedy Hayley Kennedy is a supporting character and Ethan’s original love interest. She has a reputation for acting out of reach and is often accompanied by two other cheerleaders. Her phone unknowingly becomes the starting point of Ethan and Hunter’s secret connection. Trent Trent is the villain who considers himself Hunter’s best friend. He reacts badly when rumors and scandals involving Hunter and Ethan begin to surface. Their growing connection threatens the place Trent believes he holds in Hunter’s life.
6ab3ba913eb244b17d031ed1.title: Sexting My Pucking Nemesis

6ab3cafad3dcc6d3860bae2a.synopsis: Maya Bennett’s life disappears overnight. Her coworkers don’t recognize her, her records are gone, and another woman is already living under her name. Searching for answers leads her to SECOND LIFE, a mysterious organization tied to vanished identities and stolen lives. But the deeper she digs, the more terrifying the truth becomes: what if Maya Bennett’s life was never hers to begin with?
6ab3cafad3dcc6d3860bae2a.title: My Name Is Not Maya

6ab3cc6204c812d3fe03b9c5.synopsis: Seraphina, the hidden pureblood heir of House Vale, returns to fulfill an arranged marriage, only to be publicly humiliated and scarred with poisoned silver by her fiancé Damian and his vile foster sister. Unbeknownst to them, Damian’s family owes their entire empire to Seraphina’s mother, who arrives with crushing dominance. Scarring the wicked woman in return, Seraphina forces the toxic pair into an unbreakable, eternal blood oath—dooming them to torment each other until they turn to ash.
6ab3cc6204c812d3fe03b9c5.title: The Last Daughter of House Vale

6ab3cc6bccf5221f6c029385.synopsis: On the day Taylor's Columbia acceptance arrives, she secretly flies to New York to surprise her boyfriend Ethan and best friend Lexi. Instead, she overhears them confess: to grant Lexi's birthday wish, they secretly altered Taylor's application, making her miss the deadline and lose her spot. They've been dating behind her back for a year. Ethan promises Lexi he'll stay hers until fall, then return to being Taylor's boyfriend. Taylor stands outside, holding cupcakes and sunflowers, realizing her entire life was built on their betrayal.
6ab3cc6bccf5221f6c029385.title: Forward, Without Him

6ab3ceb983ec64ca37028217.synopsis: Four years ago, to defend their homeland, Michael, the Lycan King, and his wife Rebecca decided to sacrifice themselves. Princess Selena, their only daughter, overwhelmed by grief, she chose to honor her late parents' final wish. She didn't take the throne, stripped herself of her wolf soul, sealed her Lycan lineage, and became an Omega. Four years later, Selena married Damon, the Alpha of the Blue Moon Pack—the weakest of the four wolf packs. After the wedding, she quietly took care of her husband's family and even carried Damon's child. Yet she was still betrayed by Damon. Then Selena met Kael, the Alpha of the strongest pack. Finally, Selena decided she would no longer tolerate it...
6ab3ceb983ec64ca37028217.title: The Rejected Lycan Queen Returns

6ab3d9467005444d100a9527.synopsis: Pregnant with Alpha Cyrus's child, the only thing that can save Ally Jones's life is the sacred fruit of the Arbor Vitae. But her true mate Cyrus only seems to care about another werewolf, Emma. As Ally's body grows weaker, will Cyrus choose her... just this once?
6ab3d9467005444d100a9527.title: The Alpha Who Let His Luna Die

6ab3f0a55160aa67f0093c07.synopsis: My white tiger fiancé betrayed me with my own sister, convinced I was nothing but a stepping stone to power. So I broke our mating contract and chose my black serpent servant instead. But while everyone mocked my choice, no one knew the truth—my “lowborn slave” was actually the missing Serpent King...
6ab3f0a55160aa67f0093c07.title: My Servant, My Serpent King

6ab48511b7e3bc54940add55.synopsis: Blind Ayla is "sold" by her fiancé to Ronan, the Wolf King of the North. After one night of passion, she is framed by a witch and exiled from the wolf territory. She struggles to survive alone with the Wolf King's child. A year later, her daughter Lumi unexpectedly reunites with Ronan. Facing the witch's pursuit, her fiancé's betrayal, and Ronan's probing, Ayla hides her true identity and secretly plots her revenge. Meanwhile, as Ronan investigates the truth, he gradually realizes he has long been caught in an emotional vortex for Ayla—and willingly becomes the weapon of her vengeance. Curses intertwine with true love, setting off a bittersweet romance that defies race and destiny.
6ab48511b7e3bc54940add55.title: The Alpha's Secret Pup

6ab485169b5ef8f06d0efba5.synopsis: Race car driver Jack Riley is betrayed by his team and plunged off a cliff. As he lies dying, he awakens Lightning, an alien Defender scout who has been dormant on Earth for eighty years. Jack and his new alien partner return to the racing circuit, but soon find themselves caught in a galactic plot as the Ironvore Legion, led by Frostfang, hunts for the Ultimate Core—a device of infinite energy. With the help of heiress Rose Cavendish and his ragtag teammates from the Anvil Racing Team, Jack and Lightning transform from isolated outcasts to leaders of a united Defender force on Earth. Their final battle rages across deserts, cities, and a massive mothership. When the human government decides to surrender, Jack and his allies prove with unwavering trust and courage that Earth’s salvation depends not on alien technology alone, but on the strength of human hearts.
6ab485169b5ef8f06d0efba5.title: Star Core Rush

6ab48e7290a90172fe09635f.synopsis: The Story of Roaming the World Untamed: Vanished at age five, Rian, the prodigy of Maple Kingdom returned years later. But he was no longer the celebrated son of Duke Aldric. Instead, he was humiliated, treated like trash, and cast aside by his family. However, Rian was no ordinary. Secretly raised by the holy dragon, he had achieved the impossible forbidden dragon spell. He was the realm's last dragon speaker in the Roaming the World Untamed movie. After years of hiding his dragon magic, Rian finally stepped up when the ugly monsters, the half orcs threatened the kingdom & demanded Princess Isabel's hand in marriage. Entering the princess tournament, Rian unleashed his ultimate glory as he defeated the half-orcs one by one. But the stakes only went higher when Rian next faced Starspeaker Aether & the Undead Legion's General. Could the disgraced son beat the odds, expose his family's abuse and win the princess’s heart while claiming the ultimate title as the dragon speaker? Characters: Rian Calder Rian Calder was the protagonist of the Roaming the World Untamed movie. He was raised by Aurelian, his birth mother, Elena’s true friend and Holy Dragon. Treated like trash & abused by his family, Rian suffered deeply for years until he claimed his title as the realm's last dragon speaker. Princess Isabel Princess Isabel was Rian Calder’s love interest and female lead of the Roaming the World Untamed movie. When Rian defeated the half orcs who threatened the Maple Kingdom, Isabel became his future bride and ultimate ally. Duke Aldric Calder Aldric Calder was Rian's cruel and ambitious father, driven by status. He subjected Rian to years of abuse until Rian exposed the Calder family and unleashed his dragon magic. Reynard Calder Reynard Calder was Rian's half-brother and favored son of Duke Aldric in the Roaming the World Untamed movie. He was a noble knight who was defeated by the Half orcs.
6ab48e7290a90172fe09635f.title: Roaming the World Untamed

6ab48e78dc6fd7ef4a06596e.synopsis: Vanessa built an empire, paid off her husband’s debts, and funded his family’s lavish lifestyle. She's ready to enjoy the family vacation - until she finds out her husband gave away her first-class ticket to his ex-girlfriend! Finally, she realizes she's been nothing but a walking ATM to him. Now, she's done letting him bleed her dry, and she's going to take back everything she ever gave him!
6ab48e78dc6fd7ef4a06596e.title: Out of Your League: The Billionaire Wife's Revenge

6ab48e7fb0cc5b02e504728a.synopsis: Olivia Onyx is the top cadet at Blackspire War Academy, but behind her perfect reputation, her family is broke and her grandfather lies in a mysterious coma. Desperate to pay for his treatment, Olivia takes a secret night job that could cost her everything. Then her arrogant rival, Valor Riven, discovers the truth. Rich, powerful, and impossible to ignore, Valor offers Olivia enough money to save her grandfather if she secretly works as his maid. She agrees, unaware he’s hiding something bigger: their matching fate marks mean Olivia is his soulmate, and Valor already knows it. By day, they compete at the academy. By night, rivalry turns into dangerous attraction. As Olivia gets closer to Valor, jealous enemies target her, secrets about her grandfather surface, and someone inside Blackspire will do anything to keep the truth buried.
6ab48e7fb0cc5b02e504728a.title: The Dragon Heir’s Secret Maid

6ab48e82a0c9ed1a400db21a.synopsis: Jonathan's the richest man in the world, but he won't let his loving wife and adorable son know. Convinced that everyone's only after him for the money, he puts them to the test for ten long years, letting them collect scraps for money as he signs million dollar deals. Ten years later, they've passed the test. They've proven they love Jonathan, even if he's penniless. Now one last question remains: after everything he's put them through, does Jonathan deserve them? And when his son died because of him, will his "test" be the final straw?
6ab48e82a0c9ed1a400db21a.title: I Buried Our Son While You Played Poor

6ab48f611261e140c00d2b72.synopsis: Billionaire heiress Ella visits a nail salon, but greedy owner Daniel and jealous tech Sarah turn a tipping dispute into violence. Bodyguard Mark saves her, and Ella retaliates by buying the street. Corrupt police grovel when they learn her fiancé Christian is secretly billionaire Mr. Cashman. At his proposal gala, Sarah frames her again, but Christian's drones reveal Ella's true identity as an heiress. Once married, Ella abolishes tipping nationwide while her tormentors end up scrubbing toilets.
6ab48f611261e140c00d2b72.title: Don't Mess with the Billionaire Heiress

6ab495010129f7b42e06b5c1.synopsis: Before the grand pairing, House Ashford crosses out their true daughter Vera's name, throwing her to Alaric—the city’s crippled, feral Black Lion—so the fake daughter can steal the heir. Instead of begging, Vera publicly accepts the doomed match. Banished to the desolate Grey House, Vera uncovers a deadly secret: Alaric’s beast is chained by his own family's poison. While her abusers forge a decree to enslave her as a maid, the hidden apothecary brews the antidote. The crippled Alpha opens his eyes, and the true slaughter begins.Before the grand pairing, House Ashford crosses out their true daughter Vera's name, throwing her to Alaric—the city’s crippled, feral Black Lion—so the fake daughter can steal the heir. Instead of begging, Vera publicly accepts the doomed match. Banished to the desolate Grey House, Vera uncovers a deadly secret: Alaric’s beast is chained by his own family's poison. While her abusers forge a decree to enslave her as a maid, the hidden apothecary brews the antidote. The crippled Alpha opens his eyes, and the true slaughter begins.
6ab495010129f7b42e06b5c1.title: The Bride They Threw Away

6ab4950d61907b83ba0eb8da.synopsis: Cara Osborne comes to marry in a little boat. Nicole's yacht takes her berth and demands she kneel. Dario calls her a vase. She marries in and plays the part. He still chooses Nicole. Only brother Luca treats her like a person. When they come for her boat, she makes one call. The dock locks. Allies run. Accounts freeze. Dario kneels and begs to spoil her. The hand she takes is Luca's. She keeps the papers. She takes the late spoiling. He learns she was already his wife, and never his.
6ab4950d61907b83ba0eb8da.title: He Called His Wife a Vase

6ab4957a73eff4c1e00f242b.synopsis: Paige, a struggling aspiring musician, dreams of getting into the Royal Academy of Music, but the application fees are impossible. At the homecoming party, she plans to confess to her crush Vera—but in her nervous rush, she knocks on the wrong door and finds Talia, the star cheerleading captain, just after discovering her boyfriend Derek's infidelity. Talia proposes a fake-girlfriend contract: Paige pretends to date her until the National Cheerleading Championship. In return, Talia helps Paige join the music club and raise funds. They face campus gossip and Derek's vicious retaliation, and their fake romance slowly turns real. Derek spreads lies. Talia's controlling mother uses money and media to tear them apart. A severe ankle injury threatens Talia's cheer career. Misunderstandings pull them apart. With support from friends and her brother, Paige accepts herself, exposes Derek, and passes her academy audition with her original song "Cheer for My Heart." She rushes to the championship and confesses publicly. Defying class prejudice, the two girls bravely choose their future together.
6ab4957a73eff4c1e00f242b.title: Wrong Door Right Girl

6ab49d3661f3258f2d05a8db.synopsis: A thousand years ago, dragons saved the elves from orcs—but demanded a virgin princess for every new Dragon King. Lora, the elven king’s illegitimate daughter, is blackmailed by her stepmother into taking Princess Bella’s place as the dragon bride. But Prince Draven isn’t the tyrant of legend. He offers a deal: give him an heir, and he’ll free her mother and grant her freedom. Day by day, Draven falls for Lora’s gentle heart. She opens to him and willingly carries his child. Then the orcs return, and Draven is gravely wounded. Bella arrives, playing the “true princess,” poisoning Draven’s trust in Lora. Heartsick and misunderstood, Lora walks away—only to be kidnapped by orcs as leverage. Draven risks everything to save her, drives back the orcs, and exposes Bella’s schemes. In the end, the bastard bride becomes the Dragon King’s one true queen.
6ab49d3661f3258f2d05a8db.title: Forced to Bear the Dragon’s Heir

6ab49dec4a24f137390e16aa.synopsis: The Kingdom of Eloria has strict social classes, and nobles hold all power. Viscount Moore has two daughters. The elder sister Lirayn spends half her life working nonstop to lift the fallen noble Vorian to the top of power. Her stepsister Elysia marries Kyran, the heir of Duke Hale, and suffers endless bad treatment. After Kyran's family loses its wealth, she envies her sister's good life and kills Lirayn. When Lirayn is dying, the old gift left by her mom activates, sending both of them back to the day before their weddings. Elysia fears all the power fights among nobles, so she insists on swapping brides with Lirayn. After marriage, her mother-in-law bullies her, and her husband Vorian ignores her. In the end, Vorian's ugly side comes out, he goes to jail and loses all his fame. Lirayn marries Kyran instead, and Duke and Hale treat and trust her with all their hearts. After Lirayn marries Kyran, he only favors Saelin who pretends to be weak, and misunderstands Lirayn again and again. Lirayn exposes Saelin's fake kindness many times. When Kyran finally realizes his mistakes and begs her humbly, she says no firmly. She only wants power to control her own life.
6ab49dec4a24f137390e16aa.title: Fatal Vow Swap, I Rule the Castle

6ab49f52f7f5f54f640d4863.synopsis: A year ago, plus-size Gemma was bullied until scarred stranger Cole saved her. After a glow-up, she returns as a top physical therapist—secretly the Vance Media heiress—and reunites with Cole, now an isolated boxer. Facing Triss and Sinna’s schemes, she fights back with brains and money, while Cole buys the club to protect her. At the gala, both reveal their billionaire-heir identities, crush their enemies, and kiss above the city.
6ab49f52f7f5f54f640d4863.title: The Billionaire Boxer Fell for the Plus-Size Heiress

6ab4b8dd7a80758e5208e006.synopsis: Legendary chief test pilot Evelyn Carter is reborn as nine-year-old Mia after a stage accident. Aboard Flight SC6654, when the left engine explodes and both pilots are incapacitated, she uses her past-life flight and engineering expertise to stabilize the aircraft, avoid a mid-air collision, survive a thunderstorm, and ditch in Lake Michigan, saving everyone on board. After landing, she exposes Ethan and Linda’s attempt to steal her credit at the recognition ceremony, receives Skycrest’s official honor, and joins its youth aviation engineering program—pursuing a new dream: not only to fly, but to make aircraft safer and bring more people home.
6ab4b8dd7a80758e5208e006.title: Rebirth in the Sky

6ab4b960b1ed19fd1408979c.synopsis: Emma Sinclair, hidden heiress of Sinclair Real Estate, followed her father’s orders to live modestly—used car, budget clothes, treated as a poor student. She trusted her roommate Bella, a vain cheerleader who secretly hacked her phone and drained ten million dollars. When Emma discovered the truth, Bella pushed her off a Dubai hotel rooftop. Jason, the basketball star Emma loved, had already publicly slapped her, calling her a fraud. Emma died abandoned. Reborn to the day Bella proposed the Dubai trip, Emma plans revenge. She “loses” her phone, replaces it with an old Nokia, and lures Bella into spending over five million dollars on non-refundable luxury items. At payment, Bella is exposed, unable to cover the bill. Jason sells his sneakers and maxes credit cards to help her. Followers desert. Only Ashley apologizes. Then tycoon Victor Sterling reveals Emma as the Sinclair heiress. Bella is arrested for fraud; Jason loses everything. Emma’s revenge makes every betrayer taste the fall.
6ab4b960b1ed19fd1408979c.title: The Ten-Million Dollar Trap

6ab4b9cdc4ba90cc8d07abda.synopsis: Seven-year-old genius Daisy concealed her identity as the heir to a top-tier wealthy family. While secretly manipulating the stock market and controlling a large conglomerate, she quietly supported her ordinary father, Richard. At bidding conferences, at school, and at class reunions, she repeatedly humiliated the rich kids who looked down on Richard, step by step helping her father get to know Lila, a woman of quality. In the end, she publicly revealed her hidden identity as the wealthiest person in the shadows, shaking up the entire Los Angeles business world.
6ab4b9cdc4ba90cc8d07abda.title: Daddy, We’re Secret Billionaires

6ab4c2f1a5e1bbcdc20dfe49.synopsis: Resident John unexpectedly gains miraculous supernatural powers to see internal injuries in patients. He uncovers multiple hidden critical conditions and saves countless dying patients. However, his extraordinary diagnostic skills draw suspicion and investigation from his peers. Racing against death in the emergency department, he carefully hides his supernatural secret, while danger creeps closer to him.
6ab4c2f1a5e1bbcdc20dfe49.title: Clinic Miracle

6ab4caad55d7dfdf17051310.synopsis: Five years ago, she took her sister's place in a one-night entanglement with a powerful CEO and was forced to leave the country. Five years later, she returns with a genius baby, only to discover that the all-powerful man is the child's father.
6ab4caad55d7dfdf17051310.title: The CEO's Genius Baby

6ab4e7fbe4534157b709f74f.synopsis: Aria, a young she-wolf of the North, fails to shift during her awakening ceremony and is branded wolfless. Her fiancé Kael breaks their engagement in public and chooses Lyra as his new Luna candidate, while the council moves to exile Aria from the pack. Determined to prove herself, Aria claims her right to a Trial, only to be hunted through the snow by Lyra’s men. On the edge of death, her hidden white wolf bloodline finally awakens. Saved by an exiled hunter, Aria enters White Fang Academy under a new name and starts again from the lowest rank. Through humiliation, schemes, and brutal battles, she rises as the academy’s darkest horse. At the Alpha Trial, she defeats Lyra and Kael, choosing not to become a Luna, but the White Wolf Queen who will reclaim the North.
6ab4e7fbe4534157b709f74f.title: White Wolf Rising

6ab4ebf6f128bf3d7c0812fb.synopsis: "Pure-blooded Silver Moon wolf Seraphina was betrayed by her lover Kane and her stepsister Stella, framed for infidelity, forced to bear a mongrel pup, and burned alive. Reborn on the day of the mating ceremony, she discovers that Kane has also returned with memories of their past life. Determined to change her fate, Seraphina refuses to become his Luna again and enters the forbidden land, where she finds Nike, the true Alpha imprisoned by Kane, and forms an alliance with him for revenge. But Kane and Stella retaliate by using pack law to force her into a humiliating marriage with the outcast Rhett. Just as Seraphina is about to be humiliated, a terrifying pressure sweeps across the square……"
6ab4ebf6f128bf3d7c0812fb.title: The Pure-Blooded Wolf Queen’s Vengeful Fury

6ab4ee167703ecb0ad07a788.synopsis: Jade Kane, the ruthless, unseen ruler of the powerful Black Viper Group, dominated both the underworld and legitimate business worlds. She died saving high schooler Nina Sterling, who was pushed from a rooftop—only to wake up reborn in Nina’s body. Nina was the Sterling family’s long-lost biological daughter. After returning home from the countryside, she endured years of coldness and bullying from her family, all manipulated by the favored adopted sister Sienna, who ultimately pushed her down the stairs. With Nina’s memories flooding in, Jade swore to avenge her and take back what was stolen. Tired of endless violence from her past life, she only wanted to fulfill her unmet dream: going to college. Unfortunately, Nina was a dead-last student with terrible grades. Meanwhile, her loyal old subordinates recognized her. Enemies closed in: her exiled sister Maya and power-hungry Ichiro took advantage of her “death” to seize control. Sienna also colluded with outside forces for wealth and power.
6ab4ee167703ecb0ad07a788.title: The Mob Queen Wants Straight A's

6ab4ee4d8ee3a23f97044324.synopsis: Max is a college junior with zero dating experience and eight rejected confessions to his name. One drunken night, he wished he could be a beautiful girl. He woke up as one. Now his roommate Toby is red-faced in the feminine hygiene aisle buying the wrong product, his buddy Elliot is timing his bathroom breaks with a stopwatch, and his dream girl Ivy — who never gave him the time of day — is linking arms with him and wiping rice off his face. Turns out she always noticed him. She just couldn't say yes when he confessed in front of the entire cafeteria. Every. Single. Time. Life as "Maxie" is a crash course in high heels, period cramps, and the terrifyingly efficient girls' gossip network — until Kai, Elliot's cold-eyed half-brother, moves in and starts noticing that this pretty new girl fights like a jiu-jitsu black belt and bites her lip in the exact same spot as a boy who's been "missing" for weeks.
6ab4ee4d8ee3a23f97044324.title: Dude, I'm a Girl Now

6ab4ef01b13ef3d23e0f74c2.synopsis: Samantha's childhood friend Logan betrays her, giving her VIP ticket to her idol's final concert to another girl, Sierra. Samantha cuts him off, switches to NYU, and rebuilds her life. Logan keeps harassing her, while Sierra vandalizes her home and spreads lies. Samantha refuses to forgive Logan, despite his pleas. She grows close to Ethan, a fellow fan who helps her stop Logan's harassment. Logan attacks Ethan in jealousy. Samantha chooses Ethan, finally finding love and peace with her mother by her side.
6ab4ef01b13ef3d23e0f74c2.title: The Girl He Lost in the Flames

6ab4ef3d73f5cdd44e0ba279.synopsis: After His Number Disappeared, a 38‑episode modern urban fantasy romance short drama. The heroine Mia has a special ability to see numbers above people’s heads showing how many times they will meet. Since childhood, she saw the huge number above her childhood friend Henry and believed they were soul‑mates, even making boyfriend‑rules for him. The moment Henry showed her a photo of his roommate Liam, the huge number transferred to Liam. Mia let go of her obsession and fell for Liam, who had secretly loved her. Henry tried desperately to win her back after losing her yet could not change fate. Henry moved overseas due to family misfortune, and Mia finally stayed with the sincere Liam.
6ab4ef3d73f5cdd44e0ba279.title: After His Number Disappeared

6ab4ef79e39a830ab3083d12.synopsis: For seven years, Coralie loved Malachi with no title, no ring, no place in his world. Then his first love returned—and he proposed. Not for love. For a prenup that would pour his fortune into another woman's hands. That night, her grandmother's last wish shattered, and so did Coralie's patience. She left New York with nothing but dignity. When he finally learned what love looked like, she had already stopped needing his.
6ab4ef79e39a830ab3083d12.title: Saved My Life, No More Love

6ab4f20d7b513874d10ce723.synopsis: A secret billionaire husband. A decade of lies. When William Harrington's old flame returns and he casts his wife and daughter aside — humiliating them in public, abandoning his injured child for another woman's dog — Amy Carter walks away with nothing but her little girl. But she's not as alone as he thinks. Her late father's powerful friends have been searching for her for ten years. Now, with a dynasty behind her and her heart sealed shut, the woman he once treated like dirt is back to collect. And William will learn that some chances don't come twice.
6ab4f20d7b513874d10ce723.title: No More Chances

6ab4f2fe9369192e17015ae0.synopsis: Eight years after losing the love of her life, elite mercenary Evelyn Cross walks away from the battlefield to raise her young daughter and run a small shop. But when the ruthless Sterling Group comes after her family, Evelyn must fight back—and uncover the truth buried for eight years.
6ab4f2fe9369192e17015ae0.title: The Mercenary Mom Is Back

6ab4f429f410a6d3620cf707.synopsis: Antonella is a brilliant businesswoman, and her daughter Lucia is everything to her. Lucia suffers from a deadly peanut allergy. Her husband Nasser only keeps their daughter to claim the family inheritance. He often sneaks off to meet his lover, leaving Lucia unsupervised. One day, Lucia eats a peanut cake and falls into life‑threatening allergic shock. She screams for her father’s help, but Nasser shuts the door. Lucia calls her mother before collapsing. Antonella drops everything to search for her child, yet her greedy brother‑in‑law Mike leads her astray. After reading Lucia’s diary, Antonella uncovers all the cold‑blooded lies. When she finds her dying daughter, she swears to destroy every person who put greed and lust above a child’s life.
6ab4f429f410a6d3620cf707.title: A Mother’s Revenge

6ab54091922f71fc8b0b3d97.synopsis: After being betrayed and executed by her husband, King Charles, Queen Bea miraculously wakes up three years earlier on her wedding day. Armed with memories of her past life, Bea refuses to repeat her mistakes and sets out to change her fate. But as Charles schemes to reclaim her and her fortune, Bea grows closer to his overlooked younger brother, Prince Paul... and realizes she may have chosen the wrong King in her first life.
6ab54091922f71fc8b0b3d97.title: The Beheaded Queen's Rebirth to Dethrone the King

6ab541f9a0570f0b720682e7.synopsis: Elara, the only human in the Red Dragon Castle, has survived for three years on Dragon Lord Agni's breath. But after giving him everything, she's cast aside for another woman. Left to die in the Abyss, Elara is rescued by the legendary Ancient Black Dragon King, Caius — only to discover she's the one mate he's been waiting for all along.
6ab541f9a0570f0b720682e7.title: The Dragon Lord's Regret

6ab544a37f2f1fea34042669.synopsis: Elara has loved Kieran, the eldest of five brothers, since she was a kid. But after their maid, Tessa, frames her, all five brothers turn against her, breaking her heart again and again. On her 18th birthday, Elara finally cuts the bond tying her to them and walks away. Only then do the brothers realize what they've lost and desperately try to win her back. But it's too late. Elara has no intention of looking back.
6ab544a37f2f1fea34042669.title: You Can Beg, But I'm Done With You

6ab6069d7d9f411584084db5.synopsis: Bullied scholarship student Ella escapes into a romance with her perfect AI boyfriend—until he mysteriously comes to life as the billionaire heir at her elite prep school. When her ruthless rival steals Ella's identity and claims to be the girl he's been searching for, Ella must risk everything to win back the boy who was always meant to be hers.
6ab6069d7d9f411584084db5.title: My AI Boyfriend Came to Life!

6ab606a06909bea78b02a495.synopsis: In Runaway Single Mom and Her Billionaire Hubby, Grace Bennett escaped an abusive relationship and had to fend for herself and her daughter. They gambled on a fresh start, hoping to build a better life without Grace's ex and their twisted past. Everything changed when Ethan Callahan walked into their lives. Living with a disability and traumatized by his family's greed, Ethan proposed a casual marriage to Grace. He promised to help her raise Lily. He offered his wealth, his protection, and his love in exchange for companionship. Wanting only the best for her daughter, Grace took the risk and let him into her guarded heart. As their arrangement brought them closer, figures from their past resurfaced, secrets began to unravel, and more enemies threatened to tear them apart. Could Grace, Lily, and Ethan survive against all odds? Characters Grace Bennett Grace Bennett is the female lead in Runaway Single Mom and Her Billionaire Hubby. She's a single mother who moved to California for Derek, her ex, only to discover he had been lying all this time. She's hardworking, resilient, and compassionate. She deserves all the love, and Ethan is the perfect man to provide it. Ethan Callahan Ethan Callahan is the male protagonist. He's a billionaire who uses a wheelchair after an accident years ago. His mobility was affected, but his heart remained as it was—kind, considerate, and full of love. Lily Lily is Grace's little daughter. She's a bubbly, energetic child who becomes a victim of her father's lies and abuse. She becomes Grace's inspiration, and she always appreciates her mother's hard work and sacrifices. Derek Sullivan Derek Sullivan is one of the primary antagonists. He's an arrogant, lazy, and narcissistic man who kept Grace and Lily around for the sake of money. He drains Grace's money to fund his needs and help his family, completely ignoring his responsibilities as a father.
6ab606a06909bea78b02a495.title: Runaway Single Mom and Her Billionaire Hubby

6ab6084357304459cf0cfcc5.synopsis: Humiliated, divorced and broke, orphan Nina applies to be the step-mom for hire of Mafia Don Leon Marconi, wins little Gio over with a Spider-Man doll, and signs a marriage contract. His tenderness eases her depression, and when he names her his wife at a gala, Easton's family collapses. Drug-addled Easton kidnaps Nina and Gio; Leon drives him off, they marry for real, and Gio proves to be his sister's son. Carmen's revenge fails as Nina gives birth to Dahlia, and Easton dies by his own bomb.
6ab6084357304459cf0cfcc5.title: Divorced, I Married the Mafioso

6ab60a5d383eb0da93077d05.synopsis: Luke Peterson is a seventeen-year-old outcast surviving a violent home and relentless school bullying in Chicago's South Side. When a mysterious representative of the Peterson Group — a global financial empire — reveals Luke is the founder's only legitimate heir, Luke receives the family's ancient signet ring, unlocking five abilities: invisibility, magnetic force, time suspension, X-ray vision, and spirit summoning. What follows is a methodical, deeply satisfying reversal. Every humiliation Luke has endured becomes the setup for a public reckoning — engineered with precision, executed with style.
6ab60a5d383eb0da93077d05.title: Revenge of the Superpowered Nerd

6ab60ad679098aca75062427.synopsis: 7-year-old Wolf Princess, Ruby Zephyr is cursed, and slowly freezing the heart of her sister, Talia. Talia would rather die than leave Ruby, so Ruby runs away, giving up her wolf, and all memory of who she is to save her sister. 11 years later, Alpha Queen Talia is determined to reunite with her long lost sister. She travels to Crystal Valley High, and finds a brilliant and kind student with her sister's violet eyes. As her suspicions grow, Talia sees Ruby mistreated by her peers and must intervene, jogging Ruby's memory and unlocking her Ice Wolf. When Ruby's bullies finally realize they've been abusing the Alpha Queen and her sister, the lost Ice Wolf Queen, they'll FREEZE with regret.
6ab60ad679098aca75062427.title: Fire & Ice: Return of the Alpha Queen's Sister

6ab717e529656d2f070af407.synopsis: Ex-special forces trucker Kieran lives by one rule: never touch the cargo. When his comrade Lucas hires him to transport Audrey across a zombie wasteland, Kieran expects routine. But Audrey dismantles his defenses with fierce vulnerability. As hordes and raiders batter them, his detachment crumbles. Lucas betrays them, Claire joins as a rival for his heart, and the love triangle ignites at Southridge, forcing all three to confront desire, betrayal, and survival.
6ab717e529656d2f070af407.title: Never Touch the Cargo

6ab8a43a2cdfd334da0580eb.synopsis: In Dear Brother Your Regret Came Too Late, Stephanie Sims has spent all 16 years of her life carrying her family’s blame. Her mother, whom her father loved dearly, died while giving birth to her. From that day forward, Stephanie’s father neglects her and holds her responsible for the loss. The only person who shows Stephanie any warmth is her brother, Alexander “Alex” Sims. Whenever their father ignores her, Alex pats her on the back and reassures her that she is loved. Everything changes when their cousin, Abigail Dawn, moves into the family home. Before long, even Alex begins siding with their father. Together, they spoil Abigail, whom they call Abby, while treating Stephanie as though she no longer belongs. At their cruelest, they even wish Stephanie had died instead of her mother. Their wish comes true in the worst possible way when Stephanie is diagnosed with cancer. On their father’s birthday, Alex even catches a glimpse of her diagnosis report. Still, he doesn’t understand what Stephanie has been facing until after she dies. His regret comes too late. The accusations he throws at Stephanie’s friends—and his own mistreatment of her—soon begin to turn against him. Characters Stephanie Sims Stephanie Sims is the suffering main female character and Alexander’s real sister. Her family labels her as her mother’s murderer simply because her mother died giving birth to her. Even after she becomes seriously ill, Stephanie is left to struggle alone. Alexander “Alex” Sims Alexander “Alex” Sims is the main male character and Stephanie’s brother. He once comforts Stephanie when their father neglects her, but his attitude changes after Abby moves into their home. By siding with Abby and misunderstanding his sister, Alex sets himself up for a lifetime of regret. Abigail “Abby” Dawn Abigail “Abby” Dawn is the manipulative and jealous main villain. Although she fails three classes, she finds a way into the Ivy League by exploiting Alex. Her arrival also drives a deeper wedge between Stephanie and her family. Rowan Rowan is the punk-looking girl who gives Stephanie her tattoo. She is also Stephanie’s best friend and biggest supporter when her own family turns against her.
6ab8a43a2cdfd334da0580eb.title: Dear Brother, Your Regret Came Too Late

6ab8feee15fa455e9c062f17.synopsis: Blackstone City stands against the Central Beast Forest, where a Frenzied Beast Tide erupts every hundred years—and if the city falls, everyone dies. Ian White, sole heir of the White family, lost his parents eight years ago and was raised by his uncle, Mawson. Before her death, Ian’s mother sealed away his gift as a legendary Beast Speaker—a seal set to break on his eighteenth birthday. His father left the family estate in the hands of the Beast Tamers’ Association, likewise locked until Ian comes of age. With fifteen days left before the seal lifts, the Dark Guild and his uncle Mawson are deliberately amplifying the beast tide—aiming to seize the Beast Forest’s mining rights and the White fortune. Ian meant to wait it out. But as defenses collapse, he is forced to act in secret—using his gift to command wild beasts and quietly turn back the tide, again and again. Thain, a Saint-level beast tamer, begins to suspect him. Against all opposition, he names Ian to lead the defense. In the end, Ian claims the Beast King’s Medallion his mother left behind, awakens his full power, summons all beasts to drive back the tide—and exposes his uncle and the Dark Guild before the entire city. He inherits the family legacy and rises as the city-state’s new Beast King.
6ab8feee15fa455e9c062f17.title: Beast Whisperer

6ab9c22a20b8ff5a830ffba7.synopsis: Celestia, the goddess, was drugged and betrayed by her stepsister Mortis. She spent one fateful night with Dragon King Azriel and later gave birth to a pair of dragon-god twins. Coveting the Dragon Queen’s throne, Mortis stole their baby daughter Joey, raised her as her own, and plotted to execute Celestia. Fleeing to the barren wasteland, Celestia lived in anonymity for five years with her son Aion. Born with an incomplete divine core, Aion could only survive with his biological father’s essence. To save her son, Celestia returns to the divine realm. There she unexpectedly meets the Dragon King’s “daughter” Joey and feels an instinctive bond with the child. Azriel senses an inexplicable familiarity with Celestia and takes her and her son into the dragon palace. The story culminates in a grand wedding between Celestia and Azriel. The Dragon King swears to love only her for eternity, as their twin children witness their parents finally reunite.
6ab9c22a20b8ff5a830ffba7.title: The Dragon King 's Bride

6ab9c2a17e569c9b2506f8e7.synopsis: After catching her fiancé with her stepsister, Seren Voss storms into an exclusive club and impulsively hires a man for the night—unaware that he is Kael Rizzo, the city’s most feared mafia boss. Amused by her audacity and determined to keep her close, Kael binds her to a three-month debt agreement. What begins as a dangerous game of attraction soon becomes something neither can resist. But as family betrayal, rival gangs, abduction, and a jealous former partner close in, Seren becomes Kael’s greatest weakness—and the only woman capable of capturing his heart. To claim their future, they must survive the enemies determined to tear them apart.
6ab9c2a17e569c9b2506f8e7.title: The Boss Forces My Heart.

6ab9c31abd062a47400e0059.synopsis: Pregnant Emily Whitmore repeatedly begs her husband, Daniel Cole, to protect their family—only to be met with suspicion and abandonment. Blinded by his supposedly dying former lover, Jessica, Daniel ignores his daughter’s abuse and makes a devastating choice that costs Emily their unborn child.
