6ac8b5f95b8ca2a9ab048cb6.title: Their Brother, the Dragon Sacrifice

6ac8b7da0094c70570055c74.synopsis: Six years ago, Elise fled the wedding arranged by her father and spent a passionate night with a mysterious stranger in a valley beneath the Blood Moon. By morning, he had vanished, and she could no longer even remember his face. Six years later, Elise lives in a rented apartment with her daughter, working three jobs just to make ends meet. When the school's new security guard saves her daughter from danger, the little girl looks up at him and suddenly calls him "Daddy." Desperate to escape another forced marriage arranged by her father, Elise impulsively marries the seemingly penniless security guard. But she has no idea that her new husband is actually the Alpha of a powerful wolf pack. Even worse, she doesn't know that he carries a secret execution order from the Council of Elders—commanding him to kill her half-blood daughter. And the date on that deadly order? Just two days before their marriage certificate was signed.
6ac8b7da0094c70570055c74.title: My New Dad Howls at the Moon

6ac8b852a1ca084740019042.synopsis: Nora Bennett and Roman Vale were the golden couple of college. On the night Roman won the national amateur fighting championship and was about to sign his first pro contract, Nora discovered she was pregnant—and diagnosed with stage III breast cancer. To keep him from abandoning his dreams, she staged an affair with their friend Julian, forcing Roman to break up with her. She went abroad alone, gave birth to their daughter, and endured chemotherapy and surgery. Eight years later, Roman returns to Los Angeles on an eleven-fight win streak, ready to challenge for the title. But new league rules require medical clearance from an independent physician. The doctor assigned to evaluate him is Nora. Roman has hated her for eight years. Now one signature from her could decide his career. But Nora hides two truths: their seven-year-old daughter—his flesh and blood—and a knee imaging report he secretly underwent, automatically synced to her medical terminal. As Roman prepares for the biggest fight of his life, the woman he believes betrayed him may be the only one who can save his career—and the one holding the truth that could shatter everything.
6ac8b852a1ca084740019042.title: My Ex is the Undefeated Champion

6ac8c04abc6f87735105852a.synopsis: Bored of her arranged-family-marriage, real heiress Katherine Foden hides her identity and joins MG Corporation as an intern. Ordinary girl Kathleen Davis is mistakenly taken for CEO David McGuire's fiancee. Greedy for wealth and status, Kathleen takes the fake identity, sabotaging Katherine and stealing her creative work. Katherine bides her time and gathers proof to expose the fraud. After a series of workplace schemes and dangerous traps, all villains get punished. Katherine and David finally see each other's true character and fall in love.
6ac8c04abc6f87735105852a.title: The Fake Heiress's Fall

6ac8c0fda4ed13dda9011f67.synopsis: Over-fifty Maeve loses her memory in a big fire. Her greedy birth-son Ricky tries to sell her off. To escape the trap, she marries stranger Hank in a flash marriage, unaware he is a billionaire. Hank hides his wealth, and his five outstanding sons pretend to be poor to test Maeve. Kind-hearted Maeve wins their affection, yet faces constant harassment from Ricky's family and fierce rival Vanessa, with dangers piling up.
6ac8c0fda4ed13dda9011f67.title: Blind Marriage Billionaire Husband

6ac99c5d1eb02e828b0ef0b5.synopsis: Inez hid her four-star general father and loved Lachlan for five years—until she found his prenup with Senator's daughter Sutton and saw him shield Sutton first in a crash. She left, took an NSC post, and met Lucian Sinclair. When Sutton's smear campaign backfired, Inez exposed the truth and both families fell. Lachlan begged mercy; she refused and began again with Lucian.
6ac99c5d1eb02e828b0ef0b5.title: He Left Me for a Senator's Daughter

6ac9ab991eb02e828b0ef0bd.synopsis: Six years ago, the Empire's War Goddess crossed paths with the last Dragon Knight, a man who commands time itself. She raised their daughter alone and searched for him for six years. Now, side by side, they stand against a rotting throne and the Abyss that means to end the world.
6ac9ab991eb02e828b0ef0bd.title: Her Baby Daddy Is the Last Dragon Knight

6ac9b625e72d499d6106650e.synopsis: In her past life, Sophia was abused by her husband and betrayed to death by her closest kin. Reborn, she returns to the life crossroads of the "blind husband selection." This time, she does not choose the man she picked in her previous life—the mafia godfather Mark—but instead selects a seemingly utterly useless drifter, Leon, to be her husband. Amid everyone's mockery and contempt, Sophia fights back from the brink of despair, growing from a victim into a strategist. Yet the "good-for-nothing husband" she chose is in truth a man in hiding—the supreme figure who strikes terror into the entire North American underworld.
6ac9b625e72d499d6106650e.title: Reborn: I Chose a Homeless Godfather

6ac9f405c750922fe70106b9.synopsis: Twin sister Ollie Campbell spent eighteen years as the family green leaf while porcelain-pretty Willow took the dresses, the MacBook, and the praise. Beck forgot her mango allergy for Willow's iced drinks; Hayes spent months of pay on Willow and blamed Ollie. On application night, they steered Willow to Stanford and Ollie to community college—never asking about her 1580 SAT. Beck dropped MIT for Willow; Ollie quietly chose UT Austin, 2,400 km away. When Mom stole her savings for Willow's graduation party, Ollie left. A reporter exposed her National Merit scholarships too late. In Texas, she rebuilt herself—honors, papers, NSF work—and refused Dad's regret, Hayes's scolding, and Beck's rain-soaked plea. Years later, she turns away their money pleas and harassment. At graduation, she smiles for the camera and toasts, "To the future." Willow got the party. Ollie got the scholarship—and a life that is finally hers. Favoritism breeds no loyalty; silence never buys being seen. An underestimated life can still bloom.
6ac9f405c750922fe70106b9.title: My Sister Got the Party, I Got the Scholarship

6ac9fbfddb09a64e84053d2c.synopsis: For revenge, Elena disguises herself as an obedient good girl and marries into a New York mob family. She maneuvers between a twisted young master and a cold-faced godfather, falling into a fatal rivalry between brothers. When she discovers that her mother's head was made into a specimen, that her fiancé is actually her mother's killer, and that her real father is the Sicilian boss, this game of revenge and love spins utterly out of control…
6ac9fbfddb09a64e84053d2c.title: Addicted to Love: Caged by a Mafia Don & a Madman

6aca118e312e62fcc007fdac.synopsis: Her childhood was stolen, will her entire life be stolen too? Alice was originally the heir of the Damon family,but was kidnapped and abandoned by her uncle,who wanted the family fortune to himself. Alice was then adopted by Lisa. After becoming an adult, Alice ran into her biological parents again,but she's already lost her childhood memories. Lola, Alice's high school friend, not only wants to steal Alice's identity, but also her ex-boyfriend Benjamin, who's still deeply in love with Alice. In order to get Alice out of the picture, Lola had commited to a series of evil plans. Luckily, Alice's biological father, Robben, eventually recognized his daughter, and Alice finally acquired her true identity. The story ends with a happy ending with Alice once again becomes the Damon family's heir and marries Benjamin.
6aca118e312e62fcc007fdac.title: The Getaway Heiress Returns

6aca1241e0afe3039005cac0.synopsis: If you didn't kill me completely before, I will make my enemies pay with blood in the future. Matthew conspires with his lover Fiona to push his pregnant wife Grace off a cliff to seize her assets. Alice, Grace's twin sister who has been separated for twenty years, returns to take Grace's place and seek revenge. Just as Alice is about to succeed, Grace returns with a new face and lost memory, leading to continuous misunderstandings with Alice. The complex web of emotions and interests slowly unfolds…
6aca1241e0afe3039005cac0.title: Revenge Beyond the Grave

6acc38938fa6eb2dbc0f7827.synopsis: Small-town Lila flees a forced wedding, kisses a stranger in the Texas wild. Five years on, single mom to Sophia, she meets billionaire Murphy—who hires her as his fake wife. He's Sophia's father. After a forged-DNA plot and a farm showdown, they become a real family.
6acc38938fa6eb2dbc0f7827.title: My Fake Husband Is My Daughter’s Billionaire Dad

6acc3aadc2155aff410950e7.synopsis: Julian and Naomi had a brief encounter four years ago but went separate ways. Naomi gave birth to Lena alone. Three‑and‑a‑half‑year‑old Lena ventures into the wealthy manor with a family‑crest lighter to find her father, cold‑natured CEO Julian Hale. A paternity test confirms their kinship. Lena melts his icy heart and reunites Naomi and Julian. Consumed by jealousy, Lydia persecutes Naomi repeatedly. Julian stands up for his family and brings her to justice. The storm passes. Julian proposes to Naomi, and they live as a happy family.
6acc3aadc2155aff410950e7.title: Baby Strikes Back：Find My Daddy

6acc3b2530e26b9ae20a3785.synopsis: GiGi, granddaughter of a Sicilian Mafia godfather, discovers on TV that her biological father Logan—once Silicon Valley's tech god—is now a legless homeless man in a New York slum. She flies to New York alone, beating up hijackers, storming a skyscraper, and rescuing her father from thugs. She fits him with an exoskeleton to stand again. Together they infiltrate Peak Tower to steal back his stolen core code, but villain Richard sets a trap. At the critical moment, the godfather arrives with Mafia forces, and former chief attorney Mary uncovers evidence that Richard forged psychiatric reports and orchestrated the car crash that destroyed the Carter family. Three generations—GiGi, Logan, and Salvatore—join forces in legal and armed battle to crush Richard and reclaim the company. Logan uses his late wife Rosalie's data to create an AI hologram, reuniting the family in a new form.
6acc3b2530e26b9ae20a3785.title: Oops! Her Grandpa is the Godfather and Daddy is a Billionaire

6acc3b282dc3fe635e088389.synopsis: Criminal psychologist Claire mistakes Kent, a blood-soaked Mafia King, for an inmate and tells him he desperately needs to get laid. Days later, he kidnaps her to his estate out West, where she discovers she's the long-lost heiress of a rival Mafia family, promised to his son. She's meant to marry the son, yet secretly climbs into the father's bed. When outside money moves to seize the West, Claire must unite two rival families, protect their homeland, and rise as the Queen of the West.
6acc3b282dc3fe635e088389.title: The Rival Heiress Who Tamed the Mafia King

6acc3b2c608321117001c5b7.synopsis: Evelyn Sterling, heiress and gifted jewelry designer, gave eight years to fiancé Adrian Whitmore—hiding her brilliance to keep the peace. On their engagement night, he abandoned her to celebrate Lydia Carter, the horse trainer’s daughter, even moving Lydia into their home. Adrian stole “Heart of Eternity,” the final masterpiece left by Evelyn’s late mother, and let Lydia enter it under her own name. He then forced Evelyn to confess plagiarism, destroying her reputation. Heartbroken, Evelyn breaks the engagement and accepts an arranged marriage to banking heir Sebastian Kingsley. Adrian soon learns his empire and life were held together by Evelyn. Lydia’s lies and theft unravel, and Adrian discovers Evelyn—not Lydia—saved his life eight years ago. Evelyn returns as Mrs. Kingsley, reclaims her designs and reputation, builds her own brand, and finally opens her heart to Sebastian, who has secretly loved her all along.
6acc3b2c608321117001c5b7.title: Betrayed at My Engagement, I Wed the Billionaire Who'd Secretly Loved Me

6acc3df57b5a4b38920d301a.synopsis: Raised in the wilderness by a poor but loving couple, Corven discovers he is the long-lost heir of powerful House Kelun. But the reunion he dreamed of turns into a nightmare when his birth family treats him like an outsider and favors their adopted son, Dorian. When Corven finds his sister gravely injured, Dorian frames him for the attack. Can Corven clear his name and expose the truth?
6acc3df57b5a4b38920d301a.title: The Outcast Returns: Supreme Wolf God

6acc4d3253c16996930419d5.synopsis: Lyra is about to be exiled for her “cursed” wolf unless she can find a legal mate overnight. Luckily, the mysterious man she rescued earlier agrees to marry her on the spot. Their fake marriage quickly becomes real and spicy, while Lyra gradually realizes that her omega husband might be the missing Alpha King, Caius…
6acc4d3253c16996930419d5.title: Her Secret Lycan King

6acc7b9923005054b50d1dbb.synopsis: Low-born Vera spent a year despised and hurt by Julian, her leopard beastman — to him, her purchase was shame. Heartbroken, she asked the Guild for a new contract and came home with the dragon nobody wanted, Cedric, unbowed by three years of taming. But he chose her. He shielded her, guarded her, and gave his life against every hunter. She understood at last. This contract is not taming, but two souls leaning on each other. When a plot aims at her unborn child, this dragon will tear down the city.
6acc7b9923005054b50d1dbb.title: Ditched My Jerk Beastman, Bound a Dragon

6acc822a42e96cfd6f066a03.synopsis: Layla, a gifted translator, enters into a flash marriage with Cassian, a corporate tycoon, to pay off her student loans. After taking up her post under the guise of a secret marriage, she is repeatedly framed by her supervisor, Cressida. Leveraging her capabilities, she rises in her career, heals little Romy, the adorable child. Amid a kidnapping crisis and mysteries surrounding her lineage, she and Cassian uncover the truth behind his past amnesia. Eventually, they reveal their secret marriage and embrace a happy reunion as a family of four.
6acc822a42e96cfd6f066a03.title: The Billionaire Tiny Secret Wife

6acc9b3dd382011ba206bb98.synopsis: In Lulu the Little Goddess, Lulu possesses rare magic that can heal all living things. She is driven out by villagers who mistake her for an evil witch and blame her for the plague. During her escape, she encounters the wounded King Alaric of Elyria and brings him back to life. It is the beginning of her adventures as the new royal princess. After King Alaric adopts her, more miracles happen in his kingdom. Lulu heals his dying son, Cassian, and even awakens the thousand-year-old Dawlight Dragon. Together, the three of them face crises, fight hunger, and end the evil reign of the Nockent Clan. By repeatedly saving the royal family and civilians, Lulu protects the whole continent from destruction. Characters Lulu Lulu is the female protagonist of Lulu the Little Goddess. She's a little witch whose background remains shrouded in mystery as the story progresses. She's bubbly, kind-hearted, and already knows right from wrong—a true sign that she's a goddess walking among humans. King Alaric King Alaric is the male protagonist. He's the compassionate and merciful king of Elyria. His wife died weeks ago, and he's been searching for the Sacred Lotus to heal his son, Cassian. He finds Lulu instead. He later realizes she's worth more than the mystical flower. Cassian Cassian is King Alaric's bedridden son. He falls ill after his mother's mysterious death and has never known peace since. Lulu becomes his little savior and the only one who gives him enough hope to keep fighting.
6acc9b3dd382011ba206bb98.title: Lulu the Little Goddess

6acc9c032b2c2c5a7f0b0f75.synopsis: Holden Crawford is the Supreme Commander of the Realm, disguising himself as an invalid while training in seclusion. His wife, Valerie Mercer, returns victorious from a three-year military campaign—but pregnant with Kian Pierce's child. When she forces Holden Crawford to step aside, he leaves heartbroken. Soon after, he reveals his true power, shocking everyone who looked down on him. Meanwhile, Valerie Mercer discovers her lover's true colors and is left drowning in regret.
6acc9c032b2c2c5a7f0b0f75.title: My Warrior Wife Returned Pregnant

6acc9c2d99f03bc711087047.synopsis: Ava, the orphan descendant of the wolf clan, holds the right to pick the next Alpha. In her previous life, she foolishly loved second prince Caleb. On their wedding day, Caleb and his lover Lena framed and killed her, while loyal crown prince Logan sacrificed himself to save her. Reborn to the day of choosing her spouse, Ava sees through Caleb's selfishness and hypocrisy completely. She turns him down firmly and chooses Logan, the mixed-blood prince who has silently guarded her all along. The pair endures constant schemes and battlefield traps set by Caleb and Lena. They gather solid evidence to expose the poison plot against Logan. The villains get their deserved punishment. Finally, Ava and Logan rule the wolf clan hand in hand, with sincere love for each other.
6acc9c2d99f03bc711087047.title: After Rebirth, I Married My Fiancé's Brother

6acc9f7976352db912056f8d.synopsis: Orphan Kevin gains super strength, indestructible avian features and the ability to communicate with birds after eating a radioactive turkey, secretly guarding New York as Turkey-Man. Betrayed by his girlfriend Amanda, who mistakes arrogant Chad for his benefactor, Kevin faces new threats from escaped supervillains. Fueled by jealousy, Chad injects superhero serum to mutate into the brutal Rooster. After a fierce showdown, Kevin defeats Chad, upholds justice, and receives an invitation to a global hero alliance, embracing his destined heroic journey.
6acc9f7976352db912056f8d.title: Turkey-Man

6acd99897b9c9a1185016582.synopsis: Jesse was once a talented pro boxer — until a fixed fight cost him his entire career. Now he’s forced to fight in underground matches to pay for his young daughter Mia’s life-saving surgery. The last man he ever wants to see again is Grant: his cocky, self-proclaimed straight high school nemesis, who’s hated him for years, convinced Jesse stole his girlfriend back in school. But Grant holds all the cards now. He offers Jesse a well-paid contract as his personal bodyguard — with intimate, non-negotiable conditions attached. With Mia’s life on the line, Jesse has no choice but to sign. Caught between his long-hidden secret crush and Grant’s simmering resentment, he’s pulled into a dangerous game of hate and desire, with stakes higher than any fight he’s ever stepped into.
6acd99897b9c9a1185016582.title: Sold to the Rival I Secretly Loved

6acd9a794f534f2de302448e.synopsis: On her mating night, Selena finds fated mate Alpha Aiden kissing Lily, the Omega she raised like a sister. Framed and abandoned by the pack, she severs her memories with a witch and vanishes into the Lunar Guard's war zone. Five years later, she returns as an undefeated general—while Aiden has spent years haunted by losing her. Selena no longer remembers the bond, and must decide whether the past deserves to be remembered or buried forever.
6acd9a794f534f2de302448e.title: The Lunar Eclipse's Scar

6acdcb3acc97f121640d5bc1.synopsis: During the Awakening Ceremony, the impoverished youth Elias awakened an SSS-level talent, yet he was classified as a "Grand Druid"—someone who had lost their contractual partner. His girlfriend announced their breakup in public; he was burdened with overwhelming debts; and the entire school mocked him. Then, Willow—the first Ancient Spirit to emerge after a century of silence—opened her eyes amidst a green glow.
6acdcb3acc97f121640d5bc1.title: The Last Sovereign of Druids

6acdcefa922cf5d20a0249f6.synopsis: In 2100, volcanic upheavals awaken colossal monsters, pushing humanity to the brink. Nations race to build giant intelligent mechs. Titan Group is closest to success—thanks to chief engineer and world-class hacker Bryan Smith. But on acting chairwoman Alexandra Sloan’s first day, she mistakes Bryan for a useless connection hire and fires him for sleeping after an all-nighter. She elevates fraudulent engineer Ryan Smith instead. Ryan steals Bryan’s identity as “XOmaster,” his technology, and his achievements, even accusing Bryan of theft. Pushed to the edge, Bryan is recruited by Aurora Group’s chairwoman Alice Morgan with company shares and a $40 million salary. He builds his own mech: Savior. At the global launch, Ryan activates Titan—but a flaw Bryan warned about causes it to go out of control. The monsters return. Bryan activates Savior, overwhelms Titan, and turns the tide. Sloan realizes she threw away Titan’s greatest asset—and humanity’s real savior. Titan goes bankrupt. Bryan secures a military partnership and gets engaged to Alice.
6acdcefa922cf5d20a0249f6.title: They Laid Off the Savior

6ace10217046f451b503ef23.synopsis: Rose dates Ethan for seven years, only to face breakup pranks at three supposed‑proposal events. She discovers Ethan is already married to Claire and loses her babies. She ruins her wedding dress, exposes the truth at the wedding and flees to Paris. Five years later, Rose becomes a fashion design director with a new partner. At a fashion show, Ethan begs for reconciliation while Claire provokes her. Rose fights back calmly and steps onto her own runway.
6ace10217046f451b503ef23.title: Proposal To Breakup, I Saw The Truth

6acee041bb5a2ea4f7015507.synopsis: Pregnant heiress Nicole discovers her father married his mistress and her husband held a wedding with her half-sister. Saving her baby with Andrew's help, she seizes the family fortune, exposes them, and takes her life back.
6acee041bb5a2ea4f7015507.title: Past Loves and New Beginnings

6acee0f59c274b3eb003f549.synopsis: On her 25th birthday, Blythe Whitaker waited in vain for fiancé Ambrose, only to watch him marry her favored adoptive sister Savannah. Betrayed by her family, Blythe later lost her adoptive father after Savannah and Caleb provoked him to death, while Ambrose injured her. Done with love and family, Blythe gathered evidence and exposed Savannah’s crimes, fake pregnancy, and her mother’s lies. With Savannah facing prosecution, Blythe took her father’s ashes, left Atlanta, and started a new life.
6acee0f59c274b3eb003f549.title: Fiancé Wed My Sister,I Exposed Them

6acee7fd8a72998cc10e0bcb.synopsis: At sixteen, Beatriz’s foster mother sold her eggs on the black market, stealing her chance to ever have children of her own. Years later, Beatriz is working as a school janitor when she risks her life to save a little girl from a kidnapping. That brave act brings her face-to-face with the girl’s father—a mysterious billionaire locked in a bitter custody battle. Desperate to protect his daughter, he makes Beatriz an unexpected offer: a flash marriage.
6acee7fd8a72998cc10e0bcb.title: The Billionaire’s Daughter Chose Me

6acee92a2bafabe23200bba9.synopsis: Jack, Titan Group CEO, hid as a school janitor for twenty years. Disowned by his son and framed for theft, he rescues Emma's daughter, entering a contract marriage that becomes love. When principal Carl sabotages Emma, Jack deploys CEO power. At the Gala, Princess Vivian arrives with the Royal Guard, bows calling him "Boss," and names Emma representative of a ten-billion-dollar deal—shattering Carl's plot. His son weeps in remorse. Jack proposes; Emily calls him "Dad"; they embrace as family.
6acee92a2bafabe23200bba9.title: The Janitor Is a Secret Billionaire

6aceea923711492bf1053e59.synopsis: In the apocalypse, a female zombie with no heartbeat, no fighting ability, and a somewhat slow mind accidentally blends into a survivor squad while searching for her sister. Everyone thinks she is a hidden expert, but only she knows—she has simply been lucky every time. And the man who is falling more and more in love with her happens to hate zombies above all else.
6aceea923711492bf1053e59.title: I'm a Dumb Zombie in the Apocalypse

6aceedda2ae1959af208710a.synopsis: Eighteen-year-old scholarship student Sloane Reed lives interdependently with her cancer-stricken mother, Elaine. On the surface, she is the daughter of a fish market stall owner, but in reality, she is the never-acknowledged illegitimate daughter of Marcus Voss, the crime boss of Silverhaven. When her mother urgently needs money for treatment, Marcus suddenly acknowledges Sloane and demands that she complete a dangerous mission to seize “The Prize” as his direct blood relative. Knowing she is a discarded pawn, Sloane still enters the underworld to save her mother. At the private casino The Dominion, she sees through an ambush, cuts off Roman Drake’s hand as The Prize, and uses it to seize control of the casino’s management. She then faces The Thirteen Slashes alone, establishing her authority amid an attack by thirteen enforcers, and maneuvers among the three families: Voss, Hale, and Whitmore. She exploits debts, clubs, surveillance, car accidents, and infighting among heirs to create rifts, while cooperating with the police to gather criminal evidence. In the end, Sloane uses herself as bait to lure the two families into West Yard Chemical Depot, using Celeste Hale as the final “prize” to ignite a shootout and enable a police roundup. After the criminal forces are destroyed, she graduates as valedictorian and a Governor’s STEM Scholar, returning with her mother to an ordinary yet bright life.
6aceedda2ae1959af208710a.title: You Picked the Wrong Heiress

6acefdc97624412647085929.synopsis: Blythe dated Orion for five years and damaged her optic nerve saving him in a mountain accident. Before their wedding, she found he spoiled Celeste and secretly changed their venue. When Orion skipped their seaside wedding for Celeste, Blythe married her caring ophthalmologist Desmond at their original mountain chapel instead. Orion broke his leg taking reckless snow risks to win her back, then was deserted by Celeste. Blythe began a new pregnant life with Desmond.
6acefdc97624412647085929.title: Whirlwind Marriage, Ex Lost It

6acf2dd507d1b73b60088e76.synopsis: A boy once saved a god's life. Sixty years later, with his own life running out, that now old man begs the god for three more year
6acf2dd507d1b73b60088e76.title: The Sea God's Disguise: Fishing for Love

6acf324a232e294970083c4a.synopsis: Programmer Adrian is pulled into the beta test of a horror game called "Oracle," but a mysterious "Romance Patch" accidentally infiltrates the system, forcing him to replace violence and combat with kindness and emotional comfort. Instead of fighting terrifying monsters, Adrian gradually wins over horrifying creatures such as Lace, Subject Zero, and Jocelyn, one by one, using empathy and affection to survive the game's deadly challenges. As he progresses through the game, Adrian uncovers a horrifying truth: these NPCs are actually real people declared brain-dead, whose consciousnesses have been imprisoned through illegal experiments conducted by Dawn Hospital. Worse still, the mastermind behind the entire conspiracy is none other than his trusted mentor, Professor Luthor. Determined to save them, Adrian ventures deep into the mysterious "Gate of God." Armed not with weapons but with compassion, he shatters the sinister conspiracy and awakens every trapped soul, finally setting them free.
6acf324a232e294970083c4a.title: Glitched My NPC Girlfriend

6acf3286c2bc030713092d90.synopsis: Irina Ravenhart — Princess of the Kingdom of Aeris and heir to the Dragonbinder bloodline's Dragon Bond — once made the grave mistake of falling for Roland, a commoner who excelled in the dragon-training grounds. She gave him everything, even placing the Dragon Bond, the symbol of her Dragonbinder inheritance, into his hands. In return, Roland conspired with his lover Celeste and offered her up as a sacrifice to the Dark Dragon Lord. At the moment of her death, the Dark Dragon Lord Alaric saved her. Only then did Irina realize that the man she had dismissed as a lovesick fool was the one who truly loved her. Using the power of ten thousand dragons, Alaric sent Irina back three years into the past. This time around, Irina was fully awake. She would no longer be the humble suitor groveling at Roland's side, nor would she believe herself a failure who could never tame a dragon. Together with Alaric, she set out to make everyone understand that she was never a madwoman or a good-for-nothing — she was the queen chosen by the Dark Dragon Lord.
6acf3286c2bc030713092d90.title: Reborn from the Ashes: The Betrayed Princess and Her Dragon Lord

6acf472519a5b7f4e5052fe6.synopsis: Sold into slavery by her cruel stepmother, fallen Numidian princess Lenora spends one night with Rome's war god, General Lucius Valerius, who leaves her his signet ring. A few months later, she gives birth to a boy alone and sells the ring to save their sick son, never knowing the buyer is Lucius's mother. Lucius has been searching for her ever since. Once he learns the truth, he rescues Lenora and brings her home. Now, against a jealous rival and a powerful senator, she must fight to protect her child.
6acf472519a5b7f4e5052fe6.title: The Roman War God's Tribute

6acf6bf26ef29bc8fd09e0d5.synopsis: Silver Moon Wolf King James went into hiding to secure a quiet life for his daughter and wed her to his trusted ally's Ethan family. But on their wedding day, Ethan's grandson Bob brutalized her. Having seen everything, James swore revenge. He sets out to avenge his daughter, ensuring all wrongdoers face justice.
6acf6bf26ef29bc8fd09e0d5.title: The Hidden Wolf King’s Vengeance

6acf6effddc743a5490f8999.synopsis: After slaying the Blood Lord, Chels Grena returns home, hiding his title as Grand Marshal commanding one million imperial troops. Humiliated and dumped at a banquet by his arrogant fiancée Lina, Chels walks away in silence. But when a ruthless orc warrior crashes Lina's husband-hunting tournament and maims his brother, Chels slays the monster with a single strike of his silver dragon spear. As imperial decrees arrive and his supreme identity is revealed, Lina weeps on her knees—only to find the war god she discarded will never look back.
6acf6effddc743a5490f8999.title: All Mortals, All Heroes

6acf6fee2942f8d4200e9835.synopsis: Impoverished firefighter Zane gains superpowers, including pyrokinesis, x-ray vision, teleportation, after an electric shock. He becomes CEO Veronica Winters' contract fiancé, foils C4 bombings and dark web assassins, crushes villain Cassius Slater, and terrifies his estranged dark-corporate father Cole Slater so badly that Cole mistakes him for a “national-level secret boss”and all while Zane rises to the top with his sweet wife by his side.
6acf6fee2942f8d4200e9835.title: Super-firefighter

6acf7066a79c254f51093da7.synopsis: Rowen, a lowly stable hand expelled from the academy, has always believed his blood sends spirit beasts into a frenzy. After rescuing a black-winged foal, he discovers the truth is far different. As the Staff of All Beasts chooses him, all nine Trial Pillars light, and his lost bloodline is exposed; he gradually uncovers the Sacred Court's conspiracy to drain the power of all beasts through Dark Pacts. In the end, he awakens the Heart of All Beasts and earns the recognition of the four Primordial Guardians.
6acf7066a79c254f51093da7.title: Lord of Beasts: The Stable Boy They Called Cursed

6ad02c9a3d67475767005f2c.synopsis: Eldest princess Elsa keeps three fox beastmen—until they see her sister Luna. She trades all three for Luna's untouchable cold-faced werewolf. She wanted a servant; yet he bows only to her, and once he bites, won't let go. Forced to marry, she signs, schemes, and flees on her wedding day. Then the foxes kneel begging her back—but can't pass the gates. When the capital falls to chaos as Luna drains the treasury, Elsa returns with the mountain king. What she wants back was never just the throne.
6ad02c9a3d67475767005f2c.title: I Traded Three Beasts for One Wolf King

6ad02d11e200fce7fe0ec8f9.synopsis: After years of abuse, Evelyn leaves her marriage with nothing. Fate makes her the stepmother of mafia Don Matteo Vicari's daughter. Their contract marriage pulls her into a dangerous world where she heals traumatized little Bella and slowly captures Matteo's guarded heart. Standing up to her ex-husband, she breaks free from her past—and finds family, true love, and a new life.
6ad02d11e200fce7fe0ec8f9.title: After Marrying the Mafia Don, I Found a New Life

6ad02e7924c3ed10cf07970b.synopsis: At her wedding, Josephine watched Chiara steal the bouquet and joke that she'd leave with groom Rhys. The room laughed. He'd slept on Chiara's lap at his bachelor party. Rhys called it a joke. Josephine took the mic. "Then he's yours." His mother chose Chiara too. Alone, Josephine left the man her parents had died saving. Then came his deepfake, Chiara's bag on her card, Grandma's missed rescue, and the hate that cost her job. At the station, she ended him. Auden stayed. Rhys's "sorry" met her back.
6ad02e7924c3ed10cf07970b.title: The Joke Was Real to Me

6ad031121f6076d33e09b0f9.synopsis: For seven years, top architect Vivian hid her true identity for Ethan, planning to reveal it and propose at his promotion ceremony. Instead, she discovered he was engaged to socialite Chloe—and had stolen credit for her design. Seeking a fresh start, Vivian entered a one-year marriage agreement with Damian, who needed a legal wife to secure his family trust. As Vivian fights to reclaim her work and career, she and Damian confront her ex, the fake socialite, and a traitor within his family. What begins as a marriage of convenience gradually turns real through every battle they face together.
6ad031121f6076d33e09b0f9.title: After Being Abandoned, I Married His Boss

6ad03185111b4b25b60a4149.synopsis: Her sister locks the cage.Her father orders the arrows.The monster gives her a way out.Elara chooses his hand anyway, and marries the scarred creature her kingdom fears.When she takes a spear meant for him, nine chains break.Her husband is Nerion, god of the abyss, and the ocean is kneeling to its queen.But a beautiful face cannot undo a lie.As Elara fights to save the mother her family buried alive, stolen sea hearts draw both worlds toward war.A god wants her vengeance.A kingdom wants another sacrifice.This bride has other plans.
6ad03185111b4b25b60a4149.title: Bride of the Abyss

6ad031ff993f8552fd0d2366.synopsis: Humiliated at her ex's wedding, Nora reveals she owns the hotel's debt. She has ninety days to save her mother's legacy. With Julian, she uncovers a deadly 15-year-old arson secret hidden by elites.
6ad031ff993f8552fd0d2366.title: The Bride Kicked Out the Wrong Woman

6ad033a1c4f6a79bc90fd72a.synopsis: Beneath a low‑key facade lies a culinary genius, Madeline, the secret‑married wife of powerful CEO Osborn. Within their own restaurant, vain Mia fraudulently claims two identities: Mrs. Osborn and the legendary Chef E. Faced with Mia's endless harassment, stolen recipes, plus her cold mother‑in‑law's prejudice, Madeline refuses to back down. With unwavering support from Osborn, she draws on extraordinary cooking skills and sharp wits for a spectacular comeback at the global culinary gala. Her signature dish, Ashen Snow, shatters every lie on the spot. Mia, who plotted to poison her, ends up behind bars, and Madeline reclaims her well‑deserved glory and equal love.
6ad033a1c4f6a79bc90fd72a.title: They Called the CEO's Wife a Kitchen Maid

6ad035452c2efde7bd0e4e5a.synopsis: Isabelle, a brilliant designer, suffers a brutal betrayal: her malicious older sister Colette steals her designs, slashes her face, sets a fire to murder her, and even takes the bracelet that proves Isabelle once saved Nicolas, the CEO of the luxury brand ÉLAN. Miraculously surviving, Isabelle undergoes plastic surgery and returns with a vengeance as Séraphine, the heiress of a top haute couture dynasty. Faced with Nicolas—her once-blind fiancé who favors Colette—and Colette’s relentless schemes, she publicly strips the imposter of her disguise, exposes her crimes on live streams, and systematically tears down Colette’s fake persona. When the two are trapped in an ice room and Nicolas finally realizes her true identity, he is consumed with regret. At their grand final wedding, Nicolas teams up with Isabelle to broadcast concrete evidence of Colette’s crimes, sending the vicious sister to prison. What follows is a sweet, relentless pursuit of love as Nicolas sets out to win Isabelle back, no matter the cost.
6ad035452c2efde7bd0e4e5a.title: Reborn on the Runway

6ad0358139e2eb3ab505cc3c.synopsis: On their third wedding anniversary, Elowen, a wealthy heiress, catches her husband Dorian cheating and is forced into a divorce. To get back at her ex-husband, she publicly kisses a "down-on-his-luck male dancer" named Stellan and enters into a contractual relationship with him. Little does she know that this dancer is actually the sole heir to the top-tier Rothwell financial conglomerate, while Stellan himself begins to suspect she is "Vanta," the mysterious club owner he has been desperately searching for. Amidst a web of lies and the villains' frantic retaliation, the two team up to set a trap that makes the scumbag ex-husband and his mistress face the consequences of their own actions. After a life-and-death rescue mission, they finally drop their disguises and embrace each other deeply as their true selves.
6ad0358139e2eb3ab505cc3c.title: My Stripper Fiancé Is a Billionaire

6ad036710b295987ca0394db.synopsis: Maid Joanna conceives a dragon heir by King Atlas on the Night of the Lunar Eclipse. Queen Sophia scars her and jails her in the Tower of Oblivion, where she raises Louis. Louis saves the Queen Mother; Atlas recognizes the woman from six years ago. Sophia and her father Augustus forge the bloodline crystal and rebel. The Queen Mother exposes them, and Atlas crushes the rebels. Atlas crowns Joanna, who carries a second child.
6ad036710b295987ca0394db.title: The Dragon King's Forbidden Maid

6ad03bd55678622f2900e2e5.synopsis: Hypnotherapist Melody Nightingale takes a job with the Corvins to pay for her sister's medical bills. But she soon realizes her high salary comes with a heavy price — this is no simple sleep-therapy gig. Plagued by 19 years of insomnia, her client is cold, paranoid, and refuses her help. What's worse, his family is full of troubles. To top it off, her hyper-controlling client is breathing down her neck. With her soothing voice, Melody takes it one night at a time to heal these tormented, sleepless souls.
6ad03bd55678622f2900e2e5.title: Lullabies for the Broken Family

6ad09a4a112c065a9c08732f.synopsis: Wrestling God Jake Morrison—167 wins, 0 losses—dies in a helicopter crash and is reborn in ten-year-old Dylan, a boy barely clinging to life. Awakening, Dylan finds his mother Sarah and brother Marcus living under the cruel Morrison family, bullied by Uncle James, who covets the inheritance. With Jake's elite fighting instincts, Dylan smashes the family strength record at 1050 and defeats champion Brett with the "Deadly Jaw Kick." Rival Vance Sterling storms the manor with three professional fighters, wagering the North Docks against the South Estate. Dylan crushes Kozlov, Silas, and Victor, winning everything back and earning four golden tickets to the Global Wrestling Series. At the GWS, Dylan dominates and defeats world No. 2 "Thor" Sol. The true mastermind emerges: Kane, Jake's former sparring partner, whose jealousy caused the crash. Kane kidnaps Dylan's family and forces a death match with 40-kilo weights. Dylan stages a comeback, crushes Kane, and both villains are arrested. Sarah confronts Dylan about his identity; he confesses and vows to be her son forever. Fifteen years later, undefeated Dylan stands as the new "Eternal God of the Ring."
6ad09a4a112c065a9c08732f.title: The Ten-Year-Old Wrestling Champion - Synopsis

6ad0abde65dc2d829002d407.synopsis: Set in a medieval city‑state, Princess Liora, the second princess, is deeply in love with Ron, her personal knight whom she has promoted. Yet Ron is head‑over‑heels for Seraphina, the arrogant and jealous elder princess. After all her devotion goes unrequited, Liora sees through the hollow love and family affection in the royal palace. She volunteers to take her elder sister’s place and become the sacrificial bride bound by contract to the evil dragon. Her selfish father, the king, is secretly delighted and sends her off to this fate. Liora terminates her knight‑bond with Ron and gives him to Seraphina, cutting off all her old feelings. When the sacrificial bugles blare, Ron is horrified to find that it is Liora heading for the dragon’s lair, consumed by regret. The ferocious‑legendary dragon Kaelion is actually the Sun God cursed by a dark witch, and he falls for Liora at first sight. Leaving the cold‑hearted city‑state behind, Liora embarks on a brand‑new life with the cursed dragon. Those who once hurt her will eventually taste the pain of loss.
6ad0abde65dc2d829002d407.title: Abandoned, I Turned and Married the Evil Dragon

6ad1819dc30e51a1b4034137.synopsis: Sophie, 35, discovers her husband Jeff's affair with Chelsea, 22. She hires Alex for $200,000 to seduce Chelsea and destroy their relationship. After Jeff's betrayal is exposed, Sophie forgives him, knowing he'll cheat again. When Chelsea demands $5 million, Sophie reveals Alex's disappearance and warns her about an STI. She delivers the same blow to Jeff. Days later, Alex texts her. Sophie ignores him, finally done with them all.
6ad1819dc30e51a1b4034137.title: Betray Me With a Kiss

6ad1843269512bd4e109a609.synopsis: Ronan, Alpha King of the Northern Wolf Moon Pack, is poisoned while investigating a mysterious threat and left dying in a frozen wilderness. He is rescued by Mia, a five-year-old human girl abandoned by her family and rejected by the world. Mia possesses an extraordinary gift—she can hear the voices of all living things, including the suffering caused by the poison in Ronan's body. With innocent kindness and gentle warmth, she makes the cold, lonely Wolf King feel at home for the first time. Moved by her longing for family, Ronan adopts her and brings her to Wolf Moon Castle. A human child among wolves sparks fierce controversy. Distrust spreads, and hidden power struggles surface. Using her ability to sense danger, Mia repeatedly saves the pack—predicting avalanches, exposing deception, uncovering truths—gradually earning the Northern Pack's trust. Meanwhile, Ronan's wolf poison worsens and a dangerous power struggle threatens to tear the pack apart. Once helpless, Mia uses her gift and pure heart to heal the wounded Wolf King and change the fate of the entire wolf clan.
6ad1843269512bd4e109a609.title: The Wolf King’s Little Cub — Final Draft

6ad18f450bc9c0247b07b690.synopsis: Abandoned at birth for having zero magic, Orion returns fifteen years later and kills the Skeleton Dragon King with one blow. Revealed as the Sanctum Lord's lost son, he is mocked as a "waste" when the undead calamity strikes. But when the Undead King mortally wounds his father, Orion unleashes supreme magic and annihilates him. The dying King curses the living; the High Temple offers to execute Orion in exchange for retreat. Orion reverses time, shatters the curse, and falls into darkness. Waking with an Arcane Heart for a heart, he learns his family has been taken for judgment—and sets out to rescue them.
6ad18f450bc9c0247b07b690.title: The Zero Mage

6ad192429eb301833103d2f9.synopsis: Marina, a disfigured, tail-less outcast, spent one fateful night with the tyrannical Sea Emperor Caspar at the Abyss Altar before vanishing for six years. When she returns with her child, Caspar is arranged to be her betrothed—yet he does not recognize her. Worse still, their twin sons were swapped and separated between two worlds.
6ad192429eb301833103d2f9.title: Returned Hotter With the Sea King's Twins

6ad192b9473a5f5f610055a3.synopsis: To save her dying brother, she sets her sights on a ruthless billionaire. She'll seduce him, play his game, and do whatever it takes. But he's not a man who falls easily or forgives betrayal. As jealousy ignites and their dangerous game turns into an obsession, she risks losing the one thing she never meant to give him: her heart.
6ad192b9473a5f5f610055a3.title: Claim His Heart

6ad192f68e38f54f5007ae12.synopsis: A paladin, a noble, and an elven prince are cursed into stone. The witch heroine saves them by signing a cursed marriage contract: if they refuse to marry her in five years, they turn back to stone permanently. She protects them for five years, but the forest witch disguises herself as a weak woman and turns them against her. They betray her, take her staff, and break her heart. She leaves and accepts the Demon King's invitation—discovering he's the boy she once saved. The curse reactivates. The three beg for forgiveness, but it's too late. The heroine awakens her divine blood, defeats the witch, and becomes the Princess of Light, staying with the Demon King who always stood by her.
6ad192f68e38f54f5007ae12.title: The Unremembered Vow

6ad195120346f628500d546f.synopsis: Blackmoon Academy grooms young werewolves, where students awaken wolf spirits and choose mates at the bonding ceremony. The legendary Alpha King surpasses all Alphas. Reborn on the ritual day, top student Sera Veyre rejects powerful Alpha Cassian, who betrayed and killed her in her past life. She shocks everyone by picking Rowan Black, the ridiculed “wolf‑less” outcast. Rowan hides a dormant Alpha King soul that stirs under sincere devotion. As their bond grows, his power surfaces. Without Sera, Cassian’s wolf rages uncontrollably. Facing rival Dorian’s plots, Sera awakens her silver wolf. The pair defeats their foes and builds their own mighty pack.
6ad195120346f628500d546f.title: Reborn I Rejected My Alpha For the Wolfles

6ad1958aa3eaf99b3c075bbe.synopsis: To find her sister, who vanished two years ago, talented young chef Ivy Sterling goes undercover aboard the *Nihility*, a luxury cruise ship sailing across the Mediterranean. There, she meets Lucian, a ruthless head chef who may be connected to her sister’s disappearance. But the more she investigates, the harder it becomes to resist him. Ivy soon discovers that Lucian's mysterious dishes are based on a secret technique developed by her sister. Just one bite forces guests to confess their darkest sins. As Ivy and Lucian face deadly dangers together, their dangerous attraction grows into something neither can control. But the ship's true owner, Victor, is planning one final, deadly judgment—and no one on board is meant to survive. Trapped between love, lies, and death, Ivy must uncover the truth about her sister before it's too late.
6ad1958aa3eaf99b3c075bbe.title: Feast of Condemnation

6ad4c0012ea7059aa9045e57.synopsis: Duke is the secret god of his island home, and he loves surfing on his magic Koa wood board more than anything. But the powerful Sea Hag curses him and shrinks his board. To get it back, he has to stay married to Kai, the Sea Hag's human daughter, for 5 years. Duke helps Kai rise to stardom as a surfer, but Kai thinks Duke is just a worthless house husband. She mistreats him, and falls back in with her ex-boyfriend, a world famous surfer. When the five years are up and the curse is lifted, Duke must choose – stay with Kai and hope she recognizes his worth or divorce her and live life on his own terms?
6ad4c0012ea7059aa9045e57.title: Surf God's Revenge

6ad4c12dfc8b3de47a0cf295.synopsis: Leonis of Thrace was the legendary gladiator known as the God of the Arena, until his enemies murdered his wife and he vanished from the fighting pits. He hides his identity, working as a handyman at his son's gladiator training ground, enduring humiliation from everyone unaware of his true identity. When his son's team faces dissolution, he chooses to join them in the prestigious War Trials competition, showing off his legendary skills and drawing attention to his mysterious identity.
6ad4c12dfc8b3de47a0cf295.title: God of the Arena

6ad577fe14c92a010b00fd2c.synopsis: Vera is deceived by husband Marcus in her past life and loses her children. Reborn before the tragedy, she ignores empty sweet words. She defeats Marcus and scheming Selina, protects her kids, reclaims her resources and starts a brand new life.
6ad577fe14c92a010b00fd2c.title: Project Title：My Man Was Never Mine

6ad578b21dba93202c06b9cb.synopsis: Emma Sullivan, the true heiress, made a three-year bet with her mother, but ended up tragically defeated after falling for the scoundrel Adrian Blake. Upon returning to the Sullivan family, she found herself usurped by her adopted sister Sophia Sullivan, who seized her identity and aura. The adopted daughter, in collusion with the scoundrel, plotted against her and humiliated her in public, attempting to secure her position as heiress. James Carter, a powerful figure, has had a crush on her for many years, concealing his identity as the president of Bellmont Group and silently protecting her. Faced with a series of attacks in the workplace, including scheme theft and bidding fraud, Emma Sullivan retaliated with a hardcore approach, setting data traps to expose the plagiarism scheme on the spot and publicly tearing off the hypocritical facade of her adopted sister. With the high-profile exposure of James Carter's true identity, the villain falls from grace and suffers the consequences of his actions. Emma Sullivan regains her family's fortune and honor, holds onto her career, and reaps the rewards of a grand love that both parties have pursued.
6ad578b21dba93202c06b9cb.title: My Ex Lost Me. The Billionaire Found Me.

6ad578b6b2c9ceb38d028a7a.synopsis: Claire Shaw put her stellar career in gene therapy on hold for seven years to care for her critically ill daughter before leaving her wealthy husband Daniel Grant. He had always seen her as a homemaker to be looked after and believed she had manipulated him into marriage. Upon her return to Helixor Labs, Claire led a groundbreaking study that could transform Lily's future. Yet Daniel's jealousy, paired with his blind trust in Vivian, allowed rival investor Adrian Vale to weaponize the divorce proceedings, custody battle, and fabricated evidence against her. This forces Claire to protect her daughter, prove her innocence, and reclaim her identity as the brilliant scientist she never stopped being. Meanwhile, Daniel's prejudices not only endanger Lily but cost Grant Capital billions, ultimately destroying his own career.
6ad578b6b2c9ceb38d028a7a.title: Damn! My Ex-Wife Is a Genius!

6ad578eebb9c83517208462f.synopsis: Ellie possesses a heavenly voice, but after donating bone marrow to save her boyfriend's life, she gains weight due to hormonal changes and is shut out of the spotlight. Desperate to pursue her dream of becoming a singer and pay for her mother's medical treatment, Ellie is persuaded by her best friend and boyfriend to become her best friend's secret singing voice, performing behind the scenes while someone else takes the credit. But on the night her mother becomes critically ill, Ellie discovers that her boyfriend has betrayed her and that everything has been an elaborate deception. In one devastating night, she loses her voice, her dreams, and her mother. Three months later, Ellie makes a stunning comeback, having shed the weight and transformed herself. With a single breathtaking performance, she takes the music world by storm and rises to become its newest singing sensation. This time, Ellie claims the spotlight that was always rightfully hers—and makes those who betrayed her pay the price.
6ad578eebb9c83517208462f.title: Call Me Backup? Call Me Queen

6ad579f5855c61c1470a4399.synopsis: Mora Grey is the Beast Tamer Academy's most outstanding student. She raised and trained two spirit beasts—Aiden, a white fox, and Cole, a black panther—into the academy's most powerful combat partners. But both are secretly bribed by Isa Black, the headmaster's jealous daughter. Isa orders them to drug Mora with a forbidden potion that destroys her magic, drag her to a snowy cliff, shoot an arrow through her shoulder, and push her into the abyss. Mora falls into the mist-shrouded wasteland and, on the verge of death, grabs a mysterious man named Draven Thorne—a cursed dragon sealed by the royal family, trapped in serpentine form for eternity. Swearing an oath, Mora forces a blood-bound soul contract: if she dies, he dies too. Draven saves her, using ancient dragon power to reconstruct her body, leaving him severely wounded and transformed into a silver-and-black feathered serpent coiled around her shoulder. Mora returns to the academy. Everyone believes she is dead; Isa parades Aiden and Cole as her own. Mora walks into the arena and boldly announces the forbidden name—Draven Thorne. Flames consume anyone who speaks it. When she places her hand on the Spirit Testing Pillar, golden light erupts, a massive water dragon tears through the clouds, and her SSS-level power crushes everyone present.
6ad579f5855c61c1470a4399.title: Traitors, Meet Her Dragon

6ad57b0bbd6844da7a01e0fe.synopsis: A hospital janitor named Rick gets into a car accident and awakens the ability to hear the voices of all living things. With this power, he exposes his fiancée's betrayal, fights relentlessly to save his critically injured brother, and is dragged into a whirlwind of elite power struggles, gangland feuds, and life-or-death crises at sea. Step by step, Rick rises from the bottom of society to become a respected hero, all while navigating complex relationships with multiple women and uncovering the dark secrets lurking behind his abilities.
6ad57b0bbd6844da7a01e0fe.title: My Hearing Beat the Odds

6ad5abc915be831ff006ec8b.synopsis: Graduate student Isabella mistakes ancient overlord Medusa-Christine for an ordinary snakefolk and teaches her courtship songs—which Christine takes as a love confession. After Isabella flees, Christine abducts her; buried childhood memories resurface, untangling their misunderstandings. Isabella proposes, and they build a family with their serpent baby.
6ad5abc915be831ff006ec8b.title: I Taught a Snake Woman How to Flirt—Then She Got Me Pregnant

6ad5d09651591d05800c0d80.synopsis: Trick or Treat? More like Kiss or Die! Sophia's Halloween just got a whole lot hotter and deadlier. A gorgeous Reaper is turning an amusement park into a bloodbath, and her secret Love Survival System has one wicked demand: kiss him, seduce him, and get into his bed. Refuse, and she's dead. Give in, and she might live to see another round. But every sexy but deadly move brings her closer to the monster running the show. And the more he wants her, the harder it gets to escape his deadly games.
6ad5d09651591d05800c0d80.title: Halloween System: Kiss or Kill

6ad5d946682a6c0dd502b244.synopsis: Elena was married into New York’s elite Howard family as a stand-in for Chloe—the widow of her late brother-in-law James. For seven years, Elena and her daughter Luna endured humiliation and abuse from Chloe and her son Ian. On Luna’s seventh birthday, Elena overhears her husband Alexander confessing his deep love for Chloe. She realizes she has been nothing but a shield covering their forbidden romance. Blinded by favoritism toward Ian, Alexander neglects Luna, who is hit by a car. Worse, he rolls a fake die that delays emergency treatment, costing Luna her leg. Crushed, Elena files for divorce and flees with Luna to a poor Miami neighborhood. Only after losing Elena does Alexander realize he loves her. Chloe plots against Elena and kidnaps Luna. Alexander is shot rescuing them. A DNA test reveals Ian is not James’s biological son—Chloe has lied for seven years. Alexander fakes his death and watches over Elena in secret. Two years later, Elena builds the S&L brand into a business empire. She discovers Alexander is alive and forces him to reveal himself. He joins S&L as Vice-President to atone. In the end, he eliminates all threats, earns forgiveness from Elena and Luna, and the family reunites with a wedding on Miami Beach.
6ad5d946682a6c0dd502b244.title: The Wife He Lost Twice

6ad5e1edc9be74c2020b2d8f.synopsis: Elowen was the Grand Sorcerer's wife until her sister killed her. Reborn, she’s forced to marry a poor ranger instead, who's secretly the Human Emperor. Now he humiliates her sister. But danger looms.
6ad5e1edc9be74c2020b2d8f.title: Lost the Elf Crown, Found the Human Emperor

6ad5ee5a9e4124f3f607de7b.synopsis: The humble Blood Slave turns out to be the long-lost Blood Queen of the entire realm! When the arrogant Blood Lord's fiancé cruelly severed the Blood Covenant before a crowd, demoting her to a wandering exile and even allowing a vicious supporting character to humiliate her, the last glimmer of warmth in her eyes was utterly extinguished. Did she really think she was merely an insect to be trampled upon? From victim to Nightlord—an utterly heart-wrenching tale that follows her fierce counterattack and her rise to wield the supreme power of the Blood Clan.
6ad5ee5a9e4124f3f607de7b.title: I Crown Myself In Crimson

6ad5ee5ecd808aa0cd01c573.synopsis: Lena Vale has spent sixteen years giving blood to her adoptive sister, Seraphina. At a Blood Moon charity ball, she catches Seraphina kissing her boyfriend—and finally refuses to sacrifice herself again. One drop of Lena's blood then awakens Alpha King Kael Thorne's cursed Mate Scar and restarts Vampire King Lucien Noctis's heart after 170 years. Hunted by wolves, vampires, and the secret Order of Dawn, Lena discovers she is a rare Veilborn whose blood has secretly powered artificial bonds, addictive stabilizers, and Seraphina's false miracles. As Kael and Lucien uncover how their own bodies were manipulated, Lena refuses to become anyone's mate, consort, or weapon. Together, they expose Gideon Ashcroft's decades-long experiment and stop the Dawn Anchor from controlling both supernatural races. But when the ancient Veil Gate finally opens, Lena's supposedly dead mother returns—revealing that the Veil was never built to keep monsters out, but to keep something far older trapped inside.
6ad5ee5ecd808aa0cd01c573.title: Blood Moon Bound to Two Kings

6ad5ef86c6d28fa55407954e.synopsis: During her five‑year‑long marriage, Elaine supported her husband Jason as he rose to become a rising tech tycoon. She later uncovers that his claim of being incapacitated following a car accident was nothing but a lie. For a long time, Jason has been betraying their marriage with Chloe, a woman close to him, while covertly transferring their marital joint assets. Elaine opts for divorce and reclaims her true heiress status and access to her family's resources. She then methodically sets out to settle scores with Jason and Chloe.
6ad5ef86c6d28fa55407954e.title: Too Late to Want Me Back

6ad6c9f699003b3a11082e89.synopsis: To save her mother, Vanessa ventures alone into the territory of the dragon clan, where she meets Caesar, the Dragon King consumed by a death curse. Thus begins a romantic and fantastical love story.
6ad6c9f699003b3a11082e89.title: The Blind Dragon King's Virgin Bride

6ad6d62545ea25866d0fd569.synopsis: Chase Walker lands in a cultivation world as a lowly Skyblade Sect janitor with no spirit root, no system, and a head disciple ready to beat him to death over a splash of sewage. Then he finds out his five pets crossed over too, and each one is now the Grand Elder of a great sect. With a Samoyed, a black cat, a turtle, a parrot, and a betta fish behind him, he exposes a fake hero, crushes the Demon Cult, tames wild beasts, and founds his own sect... so who's laughing at the janitor now?
6ad6d62545ea25866d0fd569.title: My Pets Rule the Sects, and I'm the Janitor

6ad6d6611f8ac2e64004f71c.synopsis: At eighteen, F-rank slum boy Kane enters the Abyss to save his dying sister. Thirty thousand enter; he alone survives. The Abyss Lord Vargos stores his power inside Kane, shrinking into a black cat named Peanut. Branded a deserter, Kane signs a false confession and kneels before the memorial wall. To save Lily, he hunts monsters and fights in the Academy Arena, awakening Vargos’s power each time he’s cornered. With ally Aria, he defeats noble heir Lucius and exposes the truth: talent is rationed from the Abyss Mother. When the city’s rift reopens, Kane becomes the new Abyss Lord—not to rule, but to close the door from within.
6ad6d6611f8ac2e64004f71c.title: Lord of the Abyss

6ad6d75192bc58fa4a0f0f4d.synopsis: The only daughter of Chicago’s mafia kingpin gave up her name for love and spent eight years as a housewife. Her husband cheated on her, tried to take her children, and used her home as a front for a drug lab. To the outside world, she was just a housewife who depended on him for everything. But one day, she decides to face the mistake she made—and dials a number she hasn’t called in eight years. “Dad?” The fearless princess of the Moretti family is back.
6ad6d75192bc58fa4a0f0f4d.title: The Mafia Princess Comes Home

6ad6d96d4772255e940a231b.synopsis: He only has eyes for his first love and won't even let Aria, his own daughter with his wife, call him "Dad." Aria waits all day for him on her birthday, only to witness him propose to his ex. At the school talent show, the mistress and her daughter bully Aria, and the husband helps them. To steal Aria's summer camp spot, he feeds her a strawberry cake, knowing she's allergic—she nearly dies. That's when she decides to divorce him and finally reveals her secret: she's the daughter of a duke. She uses her true identity to fight for justice for her daughter. In the end, even when he kneels and begs Aria for forgiveness, she never calls him "Dad" again.
6ad6d96d4772255e940a231b.title: Goodbye Daddy

6ad6db891fbf6186360315ac.synopsis: After three years with gentle, dependable Eric, Anya thinks moving in together is the start of their future. Then she discovers a locked room filled with drawings of herself sleeping, crying, pregnant—and dead. A faceless six-limbed figure appears in every picture. The evidence keeps pointing back to Eric: bloody footprints, secret photographs, missing jewelry, and security footage of him watching Anya sleep. But the man Anya knows still respects her boundaries, protects her, and seems genuinely terrified by what is happening. When six black tentacles finally tear from Eric's back, Anya learns the truth is worse than simple possession. The creature protects her, knows their shared memories, and wants to "keep her close." Now Anya must discover whether Eric is trapped inside the monster—or whether the monster has always been part of the man she loves. The closer Anya gets to the answer, the more dangerous intimacy becomes. Because if Eric is still in there, loving him may be the only way to reach him. If he isn't, getting close may be exactly what the monster wants.
6ad6db891fbf6186360315ac.title: My Boyfriend's Monster Wants Me

6ad70aa67b6354fa7701090c.synopsis: Catherine, the godmother of the Mafia, tracks down her long-lost twin sister at last, only to discover her sister is already suffering from terminal cancer. On her deathbed, the sister pleads with Catherine to raise and properly educate her three children. Catherine poses as her late sister and returns to the family home, where she soon uncovers a harsh truth: her sister's husband never truly loved his wife. He has been cheating on her for years and has even moved his mistress into their house. While nurturing the three children into accomplished, well-educated adults, Catherine accidentally stumbles upon the real cause of her sister's death—her sister was deliberately poisoned by her own husband and his mistress. As the formidable Mafia godmother, Catherine will make this despicable couple pay dearly. Nobody hurts her sister and gets away with it.
6ad70aa67b6354fa7701090c.title: My Mom Turns Out to Be a Mafia Godmother

6ad7183d76ef422d090ad938.synopsis: Warehouse worker Cole is kicked down by his boss as bikini girls laugh — the CEO ignores him, HR mocks him, even the intern jeers. A black wave sinks their yacht, stranding them on an untouched island: paradise and hell, no signal, no rescue, only sharks and crocodiles. They learn he is a retired SEAL. He fights off a shark, kills a crocodile, beats down thugs. The CEO melts under a waterfall; HR draws close in a hot spring; the intern falls too. Once despised, he is now the island's king.
6ad7183d76ef422d090ad938.title: Desert Island Throne: Four Goddesses Fall for Me

6ad723b9386a7e81dc099b5f.synopsis: For three years, she was his lowest aide by day, his secret lover by night — until his marriage cost her their unborn child. No one knew she was the dragon empire's lost heir, and the legendary Phantom Rider who vanished years ago! She drops her disguise — a dragon bows, gold armor gleams, the court kneels — and he sees what he lost. A forged heir, a scheming rival, a war of dragons: she fights back as another man falls for her. He pays everything for forgiveness, and a kiss at the altar.
6ad723b9386a7e81dc099b5f.title: After Mistaking the Knight, the Commander Felt Bitter Remorse

6ad7255ea62824a1ae04d664.synopsis: "She's still alive? Call me when she's dead." Those were her husband's last words. Then Bella Hamilton opened her eyes—five years in the past. This time she ditched the white dresses, walked into the auction in red, and dropped $1.5 billion on a lot everyone called worthless. They laughed. She just smiled. Her husband showed up with his mistress. She handed him divorce papers. Three years later, that "worthless" lot is the new center of New York—and she's the one they're all begging for. Watch her take back everything.
6ad7255ea62824a1ae04d664.title: The Heiress and Her Billion Dollar Comeback

6ad7273ef138fb900f00efb9.synopsis: Princess Layla of the Radiant Gold Dragon Clan is framed by sinister conspirators at birth. Branded a "Zero-Marked Harbinger of Disaster," she is cast out of the royal family and forced to grow up among commoners. Twenty years later, Layla awakens her legendary dragon bloodline and returns to the royal capital. Amid deadly palace intrigues and ruthless power struggles, she uncovers the truth buried for decades and fights to reclaim her rightful throne. But when an ancient force of darkness emerges from the abyss after a thousand years, threatening the entire dragon race, Layla faces an even greater challenge. In the end, she shatters the ancient caste system that determines status and power by dragon markings, leading her people into a new era of freedom and equality, where every dragon is valued regardless of their bloodline or markings.
6ad7273ef138fb900f00efb9.title: The Dragon Queen Returns

6ad7723ec04b9882bd0d2b01.synopsis: In her previous life, Stephanie devoted herself to training the giant wolf Claude, only to be betrayed by him and her sister Garcia, dying while the small gecko Alex, whom Garcia abused, gave his life to protect her. After rebirth, Garcia seized Claude, while Stephanie chose Alex and cured his curse. Alex, actually a divine dragon, transformed and protected her, exposing Garcia's abuse of magical beasts. Garcia was imprisoned for forbidden magic, and Claude became a crippled wolf. Stephanie and Alex married and lived happily ever after.
6ad7723ec04b9882bd0d2b01.title: This Time, I Chose the Dragon Who Loved Me in Silence

6ad82d45b5ab0082800c9419.synopsis: In a city where freezing means death, Nova Reyes sacrifices everything for two passes into the last heated tower—only for her fiancé to betray her and leave her to die. Rescued by Cole Ashford, the icy billionaire who controls the city's heat, Nova discovers she's the only one who can warm his body. He offers to save her sick brother in exchange for sharing his bed every night, skin to skin. He swears he'll never touch her further unless she begs. Nova vows she never will.
6ad82d45b5ab0082800c9419.title: The Ice King's Contract

6ad82d49d226a9daf90013a7.synopsis: Framed by fake daughter Bianca, Rosalie loses a leg to zombies and goes to prison. Back at Winslow Manor, Gerald beats her and all believe Bianca. Bianca hires men to burn her alive; only Martha saves her. Forced to marry comatose Cassian, she finds him awake and sworn to protect her. At the banquet, Bianca admits the DNA fraud and attacks. Cassian's troops and evidence expose her. The family kneels; Bianca is dragged into the horde, and Gerald's family is trapped in the cellar.
6ad82d49d226a9daf90013a7.title: They Left Me to the Dead

6ad8512221132c11b900bf19.synopsis: Lily Clark travels to Sterling City to get money for her sick grandmother's surgery. On the train, she meets feared crime boss Alexander Vance, who falls for her after she tends his wounds. Forced into a marriage to save her grandma, Lily initially mistakes another man for her childhood savior. Gradually, she discovers Alexander is the boy who once rescued her. After fighting family plots and dangerous conflicts, the pair overcome hardships and embrace their true love at a grand wedding.
6ad8512221132c11b900bf19.title: The Devil's Obsession

6ad86aeea2ae2e4c8e07842a.synopsis: Six years ago, Lyra Aurelian voluntarily renounced her position as the empire's first heir to the throne, handed the crown to her younger brother, Cassian, and disappeared from public life. Now widowed and pregnant, Lyra returns to the imperial capital for one reason alone: to attend her brother's engagement ceremony. But a secretly recorded video, deliberately taken out of context, leads Cassian's fiancée, Seraphine, to mistake Lyra for the emperor's secret mistress. Despite Lyra repeatedly explaining that she is the emperor's biological elder sister—and even offering to have her royal identity verified—Seraphine, consumed by jealousy, refuses to investigate the truth. Instead, she joins forces with her family to publicly humiliate and brutally torment Lyra at the engagement banquet. Their cruelty ultimately causes Lyra to lose her unborn child. Only when Cassian finally arrives does the shocking truth come to light. The woman everyone has been treating as a lowly mistress is none other than the legendary Architect—the former imperial heir who willingly surrendered her throne and rebuilt the entire empire. Realizing the terrible injustice inflicted upon his sister, Cassian joins Lyra in holding everyone responsible accountable. What began as an absurd attempt to expose the emperor's supposed mistress soon spirals into a devastating reckoning, ultimately bringing about the downfall of the entire Thorne family.
6ad86aeea2ae2e4c8e07842a.title: Cast Out at the Star-Betrothal

6ad96bf20b2ba0552202e71c.synopsis: Corrupt executive Modrick traps game creator Leo's mind inside a glitched stolen DND‑style VR game.Amnesiac Leo uses a magic golden die to bend game rules and assembles a ragtag adventurer party.A secret mole hides within the group, while outside hacker Lucy secretly offers support.With real‑world brain danger lurking, Leo must defeat Modrick's GM power, escape virtual imprisonment and win justice.
6ad96bf20b2ba0552202e71c.title: Players, Gamblers, and the Last Hope
